steps.text: Speak with Grand Vizier Hassan in the Merchant district of Menaphos. (1•✓•~•2)

sections.heading: One small favour
sections.needed: 1 free inventory space

steps.text: Speak to the faction heads, preferably ending with worker (closest to tomb)

substeps.text: Speak to Grand Vizier Ehsan (Merchant) also in the same building. (1•~)
Speak to 'Admiral' Wadud (Ports) in the Golden Scarab Inn in the Port district. (1•~)
Speak to Commander Akhomet (Imperial) in the Imperial district. (1)
Speak to Batal (Worker) in the Worker district. (1)

steps.text: Enter the Shifting Tombs and speak to Ozan inside.
Exit the Shifting Tombs and use the mask you received from Ozan with the bucket of blood next to the fish stall in the Merchant district.
Speak to Akhomet in the Imperial district. (1)
Give the signets to Batal in the Worker district. (1)
Give the certificate to Wadud in the Port district. (1)
Speak to Ehsan in the Merchant district. (1)

sections.heading: Confronting the Pharaoh
sections.needed: Combat equipment and food
sections.recommended: Feathers of Ma'at, Beast of Burden familiar or Combat Summoning familiar, emergency teleport
notes: If you die here, it is not considered a safe death; your gravestone will appear in the Imperial district, west of the Shifting Tombs entrance.

steps.text: Gear up for a battle.
Speak to Hassan in the Merchant district. (1•1)
Kill four level 105 Menaphos palace guards. This will be a checkpoint for the final fight.

substeps.text: Use Protect from Magic prayer and finish off the ones using melee combat style first.

steps.text: Fight the Pharaoh. (~)

substeps.text: Use Protect from Magic.
"Kneel" or "Usurpers!" - Use the freedom ability to break free and prevent further damage.
Move off the green fire as soon as it spawns.

steps.text: Watch the cutscene. (~)
Quest complete!

items: Access from Sophanem to Menaphos via the bridge between the two
Relic of Tumeken, giving 15,000 base reputation with a faction in Menaphos of your choice

A Christmas Reunion.name: A Christmas Reunion
items_required: Thread (can be omitted with the effect from a Crafting cape)

steps.text: Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village. (✓)

sections.heading: Building the workbenches
sections.needed: 3 split fir logs, 15 steel nails

steps.text: Fully build the three piles of planks.

sections.heading: Recruiting the pixies
sections.needed: A free backpack space

steps.text: Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village.
Talk to three of the pixies found in the following areas. You can optionally scan with the magical thingymabob for status indicators for how close you are to the correct spot.

sections.heading: Creating the pixie uniforms
sections.needed: A free backpack space, thread (or the effect from a Crafting cape), 6 bolts of cloth, red dye, green dye

steps.text: Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village. (1•~)
Talk to Iffie in Varrock.
Use red dye on green dye. (1)
Craft the pixie uniform pattern.

sections.heading: Stocking the kitchen
sections.needed: Chocolate dust, bucket of milk, biscuits

steps.text: Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village.
Add hot chocolate powder to the hot chocolate storage and enter "0", "2", and "3" when prompted.
Add biscuits to the biscuit storage and enter "1", "2", and "2" when prompted.
Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village.
Quest complete!

items: Prismatic XP lamp yielding 5,000 experience in a skill of choice
Green, red, and white Winter Hat and Winter Scarf (if not unlocked)
Emotes from previous Christmas events (if not unlocked)
Access to the hot chocolate brewing and toy production activities in the Christmas Village

A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains.name: A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains
items_required: Secateurs (tool belt will not work, can be obtained during the quest from Vanessa near Dantaera)
Three or four random items assigned individually for each player

steps.text: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village. (2•1•✓•1)
Talk to 5 different gardeners near farming patches around RuneScape. Easy options include: (2)

substeps.text: Frizzy, on the other side of the wall, just west of Martin.
Elstan, to the north of Frizzy.
Alain, north of Taverley lodestone.
Dantaera, north-west of Catherby lodestone.
If you do not have secateurs yet, buy them from Vanessa's Farming Shop just to the south.
Ellena, east of the Catherby lodestone, beside the fruit tree patch on the beach.

steps.text: Note that:

substeps.text: Spirit Tree Patch gardeners all count as the same gardener.
The gardeners in Prifddinas won't work.
The zombie farmer does not work.
Head Farmer Jones in Taverley won't work.
Wyson the gardener in Falador won't work.
Demetrius in Wendlewick won't work.

steps.text: The fifth gardener you talk to will mention fairies.
Talk to Martin again. (2)

sections.heading: Finding a cure
sections.needed: Dramen staff, secateurs

steps.text: Equip your dramen staff or lunar staff and head to the Lumbridge Swamp to enter the Lost City shed.
Run south and talk to the Fairy Godfather (near Chaeldar, the Slayer master) about the Queen. (2)
Run west to the bank, then go north a few steps and talk to Fairy Nuff.
Travel to the Dark Wizards' Tower, west of Falador. (2)
Climb to the top, talk to Zandar Horfyre.

substeps.text: Players with low combat level should be aware of the aggressive dark wizards inside the tower.

steps.text: Teleport to Port Sarim and talk to Malignius Mortifer about a Tanglefoot. (2)

substeps.text: Talking to Malignius at the Um ritual site will not work.

steps.text: Head back to Draynor Village and enter the gates of Draynor Manor. (2 or 1)
Dig the gravestone inside the fence north of the manor, west of the gallows. It resembles a celtic cross.
Return to Malignius. (2 or 1)
Fetch the items that Malignius requested, then make your way to the Nature Spirit. Bring multiple of any edible item, or bring a filled druid pouch to ward off ghasts.

substeps.text: Make sure to clean any requested herbs.
Make sure to bring extra of any requested food items.

sections.heading: Magic secateurs
sections.needed: Secateurs, and requested items
sections.recommended: Teleport to Barrows or Burgh de Rott for quick access to Nature Grotto

steps.text: Talk to the Nature Spirit in Mort Myre Swamp to receive magic secateurs.

sections.heading: The final fight
sections.needed: Dramen staff, Magic secateurs
sections.recommended: Combat gear

steps.text: Return to Zanaris, then enter the shady grove (dungeon icon) west of the cosmic altar.

substeps.text: You can use a cosmic altar teleport to teleport to the cosmic altar.

steps.text: Run south around the bend then north to the opening with the Tanglefoot.
Equip your magic secateurs and kill Tanglefoot.
Take the Queen's secateurs (area loot will not work).
Talk to the Fairy Godfather, next to the Slayer Master icon.
Quest complete!

items: Magic secateurs Wielding the magic secateurs, having them in the backpack or in the tool belt while harvesting allotments, herbs, hops and nightshades, increases the chance of saving a harvest life by 10%.

A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.name: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

steps.text: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in the Draynor Market.
After 5 minutes have elapsed, talk to him again.
Go to Fairy Nuff's cottage, north of the Zanaris bank.
Click the door and wait for the cutscene to play.
Enter the house and take Nuff's healing certificate from the floor in the south-east corner. Keep this in your inventory throughout the quest.
Right-click Study Nuff's certificate (using Read will not allow you to reach the Fairy Resistance HQ).
Head south and read the rune temple sign, on the ground south of the cosmic altar.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather (located in the Throne Room) about the Queen's disappearance.
Talk to the Co-ordinator just north of the throne room at the crossroads.

sections.heading: Resistance hideout
sections.needed: Dramen staff or lunar staff, Nuff's certificate

steps.text: Talk to Fairy Fixit near the fairy ring, south-west of the wheat field.
Make sure you have Nuff's certificate in your inventory. It can be retrieved from her grotto if lost.
Equip your dramen or lunar staff, click on the fairy ring, and teleport to the following codes (in this order): AIR, DLR, DJQ (will appear to fail, continue regardless), AJS.
In the Fairy Resistance Hideout, talk to Fairy Nuff in the northeastern clearing.
Return to Zanaris and pickpocket the Fairy Godfather for the queen's secateurs (may take several attempts).
Return to the Resistance Hideout by selecting the "Fairy Resistance HQ" option in the Fairy Ring. Nuff's certificate must be in your inventory.
Talk to Fairy Nuff.

sections.heading: Magic essence
sections.needed: Vial of water, Nuff's certificate
sections.recommended: Equipment and food for combat

steps.text: Travel to the Cosmic Entity plane using CKP.
Wait for a starflower to spawn (may take 1-2 minutes).
Pick the star flower and use it on a vial of water.
Ensure you have equipment required to fight at least one gorak, then travel to the Gorak Plane using DIR.
Kill Goraks until you receive gorak claws.
Grind the Gorak claws, then use the resulting gorak claw powder on the magic essence (unfinished).
Return to the Resistance Hideout by first teleporting back to Zanaris and then clicking the Fairy Resistance HQ as a teleport destination.
Talk to Fairy Nuff.
Right-click use the magic essence (3) on the Fairy Queen. She is laying on the stretcher near Fairy Nuff, not as an interactable NPC. (3)
Finish dialogue with the Fairy Queen.
Quest complete!

items: 2,500 Skill experience lamp (skill must be level 30 or higher, bankable)
Access to the Fairy rings network and the Fairy Resistance Hideout
Ability to make Magic essence potions

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: All's Fairy in Love and War (Fairy Resistance hideout)

A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.name: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
items_required: Nuff's certificate (if dropped, another can be found in Fairy Nuff's grotto)
Secateurs (can be obtained during the quest)
Hammer (can be obtained during the quest)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: Nuff's certificate, Dramen staff or the Lunar staff

steps.text: Use any fairy ring to travel to Zanaris.

substeps.text: If you cannot start the quest, enter and leave Zanaris via fairy rings repeatedly until Fairy Very Wise appears and talks to you.

steps.text: Talk to Fairy Very Wise and accept her offer. After accepting, Nuff's certificate is no longer needed to reach the Fairy Resistance headquarters.
Accept the teleport from her, or use the fairy ring to get to the Fairy Resistance headquarters (AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS).
Talk to the Fairy Queen south-east in the headquarters and then finish talking to the Tooth Fairy. (2•✓)
Talk to the Tooth Fairy, then turn on the projector to watch the first briefing.
Talk to the Tooth Fairy again after the briefing. (5•1)
Turn on the projector to watch the second briefing.
After both briefings, agree to collect her wand.
Run north-west and take a hammer and secateurs from on top of the crates. Use them on each other to create a tooth extractor.
Leave through the fairy ring.

sections.heading: Gnarly
sections.needed: Bucket of milk and tooth extractor

steps.text: Go to the house north-west of Zanaris bank. Use your tooth extractor on the door to pick the lock.
Talk to Gnarly. (4)
Compliment him with the listed responses (only 3 compliments may be needed).
Use the bucket of milk on him. Gnarly should jump into your inventory. (2•2)
Use the fairy rings to go back to the Fairy Resistance HQ.
Talk to the Tooth Fairy in the south-east room, then turn on the projector.
After the briefing, agree to the tooth extraction. (2•2•3•4)
Step onto the yellow flowers and use the wave emote. There will be a cutscene.
Leave through the fairy ring.

sections.heading: Bre'egth's Tooth
sections.needed: Dramen staff or Lunar staff
sections.recommended: 4 regular planks, 8 nails, and 8 willow logs if Firemaking 85

steps.text: Talk to General Bre'egth outside of the Zanaris mill, northwest of the fairy ring. (3)
Talk to any other Ork about K'Chunk. (4)
Run to the fairy ring, talk to Fairy Fixit about K'Chunk. (2)
Teleport to DIP and talk to K'Chunk. (4)

substeps.text: Recommended: fix the bridge with planks and nails.
Recommended: light the bonfire for K'Chunk for Firemaking XP.

steps.text: Pickpocket him for the tooth.

sections.heading: Gromblod's Tooth
sections.needed: Dramen staff or Lunar staff and tooth extractor

steps.text: Teleport to BKQ.
Head down the waterfall to talk to the Wood Dryad to the west. (2)
Talk to General Gromblod.
Talk to the Wood Dryad again.
Teleport to CLR.
Pick a mango from the mango tree.
Return to BKQ.
Talk to Gromblod, giving him the mango; he will spit it out about 15 tiles south of where he is standing.
Pick up the mango with tooth and use the tooth extractor on it.

sections.heading: Shredflesh's Tooth
sections.needed: Dramen staff or Lunar staff, and tooth extractor

steps.text: Teleport to ALP and talk to General Shredflesh. (4•1•2•3•4)
Calm him with the listed responses.
Use the extractor on him.
Clear the pile of rock behind him if you haven't yet already.
Go back and talk to the Tooth Fairy in the hideout.
Turn-on the projector to watch another briefing. (5)
She gives you the fairy wand.

sections.heading: The final battle
sections.needed: The fairy wand, the 3 teeth and combat equipment

steps.text: Prepare for the final battle, with the above listed items.
Teleport to BIR, DIP, CLR, ALP.
Look-through the fairy tree for a cutscene.
After the cutscene talk to the Tooth Fairy.

How to kill the Fairy Godfather: use all 3 teeth on the farming patches; kill the generals and ork warriors (prioritise the general at the drum); once teeth have grown, instruct them to fight; focus on ork warriors while teeth kill generals; ensure all 3 teeth attack the godfather simultaneously to remove his 3-layer shield.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather for a cutscene.
Continue dialogue with the Fairy Queen and accept her teleport. (1)
Talk to Martin the Master Gardener. (2)
Quest complete!

items: Free access to the Zanaris Market
Ability to use the fairy rings and get into Zanaris without a dramen or lunar staff.
Ability to fetch teeth to get a Tooth creature by speaking to the Tooth Fairy after the quest.

Ability to have gardeners keep your farming patches weed free. First, talk to Martin the Master Gardener after the quest, then talk to a gardener at one of the patches. If any patch has preexisting weeds, you'll have to remove them before this takes effect.
Requires 8 planks and 16 of any type of nail to repair the bridge which must be repaired from both sides.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: 10,000 Firemaking experience requiring level 85 Firemaking and 8 willow logs by lighting the fire by K'Chunk (fairy ring DIP)
A cache of herbs and seeds requiring 85 Herblore (nb) by searching the mushroom patch in the 'south-eastern' section of Shredflesh's Cave (fairy ring ALP) containing: 7 grimy ranarr

sections.heading: Return to Ashdale
sections.recommended: Decent armour, some food, a gem bag, weapons to deal damage from a distance

steps.text: To start, talk to Gudrik, east of Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim. (1•✓)
Talk to him again. (1•1)
Once you arrive at Ashdale, head north into Lucy's house to speak with her. (1•3)
Enter the storm drain just west of the house.
Go through in the sewer, killing or running past crassians.
Climb up the ladder at the end of the sewer. (1)
Run west, then south up the stairs. Continue south through Ashdale, through the gate and into the house.
Inspect the bust by the fireplace.
Climb down the staircase. (1)
Ignore the crassians and enter the eastern room.
Pick up the valve outer wheel, valve inner wheel and pitch.
Repair the pipe on the ground.
Combine the valve parts to create a valve wheel.
Repair the socket on the central barrel.
Turn the valve wheel on the filled barrel, repeating this process on each of the barrels to move the water through the pipes to open the door.
Continue through and kill the crassian scouts in the next room to open the barrier.
Pull the lever to the south when the crassian warrior isn't looking.

substeps.text: If seen, simply try again.

steps.text: Do the same with each crassian warrior guarding a lever to kill them.
Optionally loot the chests along the path for some coins and uncut gems.
Run past the scouts.
Climb on the ship.
Kill the 4 tentacles, moving to avoid their attacks.
Kill Agoroth, ideally from a distance.
Continue dialogue with Lucy and agree to return to Port Sarim. (1)
Continue dialogue with Gudrik and ask for a reward. (1•1)

substeps.text: The reward requires seven free backpack spaces.

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: 3 black pearls May break one per day to receive bonus experience in any skill equal to that of a large fallen star

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Shadow Hanging Over Me ( 5) – Claim all treasure from the chests during 'A Shadow over Ashdale', or talk to Gudrik to claim them afterwards. 757 coins, four uncut sapphires and an uncut emerald, for searching the chests in the dungeon

steps.text: Talk to Launa who is east of Varrock and south of the path leading to Silvarea. (✓)
Enter the rift.
Near the entrance is a set of weapons.
Only these weapons will defeat the monsters in this room. Kill monsters until the rage meter at the top of the screen is full. To be safe, un-equip all gear except the anger weapons.

substeps.text: Anger sword - kills Angry unicorn
Anger spear - kills Angry bear
Anger maul - kills Angry giant rat
Anger battleaxe - kills Angry goblin

steps.text: Watch the short cutscene.
Enter the exit to the east to proceed.
'Look-inside' a dark hole; if the fear reaper does not show up right away move onto the next hole. Move around the room clock-wise until the fear reaper has been killed 5 times.
Continue the process until you receive a cutscene.
After the cutscene, enter the black hole on the west wall to proceed.
Start attacking a confusion beast; if you do not deal any damage immediately move onto another beast until you find the one that takes damage.

substeps.text: Any confusion beast that you hit will continue to attack you.

steps.text: Find and kill the confusion beast 5 times in total in order to proceed.
After all beasts have been killed enter the remaining confusing door for a cutscene.
Kill each of the hopeless creatures 3 times.

substeps.text: Eating food will cause the hopeless creature to restore 75% of their life points.

steps.text: Cross the bridge and 'Use' the exit to proceed.
Kill all three of Tolna's heads.
Talk to Tolna.

substeps.text: If he doesn't spawn, exit the room and re-enter.

steps.text: On the surface, talk to Tolna again.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Tolna's rift for combat training
Anger Battleaxe, Maul, Spear and Sword overrides

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Wrath and Ruin (In the anger room)
Fear and Loathing (In the fear room)
Method of Madness (In the confusion room)
No Way Out (In the hopelessness room)

steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the library on the 1st floor of White Knights' Castle in Falador. (✓)
Enter Senntisten through the ancient door at the Varrock Dig Site.
Once inside, enter the Zamorakian Undercity by using the nearby pulley lift. (2)
Talk to Sir Cadian close to the entry.
Clear the Zamorakian Undercity on any difficulty.

substeps.text: Players who have already cleared it may skip this step.

steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the library on the 1st floor. She is not in the throne room.
Go to the throne room on the 2nd floor and talk to Saradomin. (1)
Talk to anyone again to continue the dialogue. (~)
Travel to the Kharid-et Dig Site and talk to Dr Nabanik. (1)
Talk to Nex, Trindine, Wahisietel, or Azzanadra.
Talk to Armadyl in his tower south of Falador.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: 2 free backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the library on the 1st floor, not the one in the throne room. (~)
Quest complete!

All Fired Up.name: All Fired Up
items_required: 45 logs of any kind that you have the Firemaking level to use, in 2 sets of 20 and 1 set of 5 (all the same kind).
Regular logs are enough for the quest, which can be cut from nearby trees.
Some logs like acadia logs, corrupted magic logs, and eternal magic logs will not properly work.

steps.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace. (3•1•✓)
Talk to Blaze Sharpeye in Silvarea which is north-east of the Varrock Dig Site and south-west of the Paterdomus Temple on the River Salve. (1)

sections.heading: Tending the Beacons
sections.needed: two sets of 20 unnoted logs, each set must be all the same type of log

steps.text: Add-logs to the unlit beacon next to Blaze (requires 20 logs). (1)
Light the beacon.
Talk to Blaze Sharpeye again. (2)
Acquire 20 more logs by chopping or banking.
Go north-west to the beacon near the Odd Old Man, add 20 logs and then light it.

sections.heading: Finishing Up
sections.needed: 5 unnoted logs of the same type

steps.text: Go back and talk to Blaze again. (1)
Add-logs to the beacon (requires 5 logs). (1)
Talk to Blaze. (~)
Talk to King Roald. (2)
Quest complete!

items: Access to the All Fired Up minigame

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: The ring of fire for lighting 6 beacons
The flame gloves for lighting 10 beacons
The Inferno adze for lighting all 14 beacons

steps.text: Talk to Rasial, the First Necromancer on the bridge in the City of Um. (✓)

substeps.text: If Rasial isn't there, home teleport to the City of Um or relog.

steps.text: Talk to Kharen in City of Um to travel to Rasial's Citadel. (1)

substeps.text: You must talk to Kharen; using the right-click travel option will not start the fight.

sections.heading: The fight
notes: If at any point you die during the fights, talk to Kharen in City of Um to get back to Rasial's Citadel.

steps.text: Defeat Hermod, the Spirit of War. Cannot be killed with deathtouched dart.
Defeat Rasial, the First Necromancer. Cannot be killed with deathtouched dart.
A cutscene ensues. Continue speaking with Rasial.
Return to Death in the City of Um to complete the quest.

items: Access to the Rasial, the First Necromancer boss encounter

steps.text: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre in the Fort Forinthry. (2•✓•~)
Go north of Fort Forinthry and enter the Wilderness crypt entrance. Pray Protect from Magic against the risen ghosts inside.
Go across the bridge and enter the ancient door.

substeps.text: If the bridge is missing, log out and back in to have it reappear.

steps.text: Talk to any character near the map table. (~•~•~)
Collect 20 dragonkin artefacts in the tomb. Kill any tomb zombies that appear, and then collect the artefacts they drop.
Talk to anyone near the map table again. (~)
Go to the Jolly Boar Inn, south-west of Fort Forinthry. Stay on the ground floor.
Talk to Bill at the bar. (2)
Go up the staircase, talk to Ellamaria. (4)
Continue the quest with the marker near the bridge west of the Champions' Guild.
Talk to Aster slightly south. (3)
Go back to Fort Forinthry, continue Ancient Awakening at the Town Hall.
Talk to anyone in the Town Hall.
Leave through the marker at the entrance to the Town Hall. (1)
Gear up for combat.

substeps.text: Most of the enemies are weak to magic (earth or fire spells)

steps.text: Go to the Grove east of the fort and interact with the rowboat to travel to Ungael. (1)
Kill all of the attacking monsters.
Talk to the team and make your way north-east up the path.
Interact with the Ruins Entrance.
Go up the stairs to the east, then head west. Interact with the tower entrance. (1)
Watch the cutscene.
Defeat 12 waves of Zemouregal's minions. After each wave, activate necrotic energy and sometimes choose a power-up for one of your allies.
Watch the cutscene.
Talk to Aster. (~)
Interact with the doorway to the south.
Walk west, then south, then interact with runic projector.
Collect three motes of energy: just outside the tower, in the bookcase inside the tower on the north side, and searching the ruined pillar in the south-west.
Interact with the runic projector.
Listen to the archivist. (~•2•3•4•1)
Inspect the mysterious device to the south-east.
Finish the conversation.
Return to Fort Forinthry and continue via the marker in front of the Town Hall.
Talk to anyone in the Town Hall.
notes: Quest Complete!

items: 15,000 Necromancy experience lamp (Skill must be level 50 or higher)
10,000 Skill experience lamp (Skill must be level 50 or higher)
Access to the standard difficulty of the Ungael combat activity
Ability to build all three tiers of the Botanist's Workbench at Fort Forinthry

Another Slice of H.A.M..name: Another Slice of H.A.M.
items_required: At least 3 free backpack spaces (8 preferable)
Magic, Ranged, or Necromancy gear to fight a level 28 H.A.M. ranger and a level 28 H.A.M. mage (cannot be killed using Melee weapons; a crossbow and 50 bronze bolts can be found at their location)
A rope (only if you have never entered the Lumbridge Swamp Caves from the surface before)

steps.text: Talk to either NPC in the north eastern most building on the 1st floor of Dorgesh-Kaan: Ambassador Alvijar or Ur-Tag. (1•✓)

substeps.text: If Ambassador Alvijar says you might be a human spy, you haven't completed The Giant Dwarf yet.

steps.text: While on the same floor, head west then south until you find a transportation map icon.
Enter the doorway, head south down the tracks and talk to Tegdak (need 2 free spaces for the specimen brush and trowel).
Use the trowel on the 6 artefacts on the ground to dig them up.

substeps.text: You can talk to Tegdak per restored artefact, you don't need to give all in at once.

steps.text: Use each of them on the specimen table.
Talk to Tegdak and Zanik will be following you after the dialogue.

substeps.text: If Zanik isn't following you, dismiss any pets/familiars and talk to Zanik.

steps.text: With Zanik following, exit the train tunnel using the doorway to the north.
Talk to the Goblin scribe, in the building directly west of the quest start point.
In the house just west of the Goblin scribe, climb down the stairs.
Talk to Oldak.
You will be teleported to Goblin Village with Zanik, receiving a Dorgesh-kaan sphere in your inventory.

sections.heading: The Goblin Village
sections.needed: A ranged, magic or necromancy weapon and ammunition to defeat 2 H.A.M. members
sections.recommended: a crossbow and 50 bronze bolts found on the ground at their location

steps.text: In Goblin Village, in the northernmost building, talk to either General Bentnoze or Wartface.
After the cutscene, go behind the buildings to the west, go south, then climb up the ladder to the east.

substeps.text: If you attempt to walk around the front of the buildings, you will be stopped by falling arrows.

steps.text: Kill the H.A.M. Mage and H.A.M. Archer.

sections.heading: Infiltrating H.A.M.
sections.needed: A light source (and a rope if you have never entered the caves from the surface before)
sections.recommended: water altar teleport or enlightened amulet

steps.text: With a light source, head to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves entrance north-west of the Water altar.
Talk to Sergeant Slimetoes or Mossfists outside the entrance to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. (2)
Climb down the dark hole under the tree entering the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Go down the ladder, directly south east of the Climbing Rope.
Distract the guards by luring them to Slimetoes and Mossfists.

substeps.text: If a guard catches you by getting too close, you will be thrown out to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Once the 2 guards are fighting the goblins, carefully go towards the south end of the tunnel.
Let the patrolling guard spot you from a distance, then lure the guard to the goblins.
For the final guard blocking the exit, step next to the pillar in his view and he will spot you. Lure him to the goblins.

steps.text: With the guards engaging the goblins, it is safe to run south to the ladder.
Equip the ancient mace and climb down the ladder.
Initiate combat with Sigmund.

substeps.text: With legacy combat, use the Ancient Mace's special attack at the start of the fight.
Without legacy combat, use the Ancient Mace's special attack to disable Sigmund's prayers once you reach 100% adrenaline.

steps.text: After defeating Sigmund, untie Zanik.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to buy Goblin village spheres
Free access to the Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system

As a First Resort.name: As a First Resort
items_required: Four spears of the same type (bone spears work; poisoned/leaf-bladed spears do not)
Some logs of any kind for traps

steps.text: Head to Oo'glog and talk to Chief Tess. (1•✓•1•1)
Talk to Balnea in the Oo'glog bank. (1•2•1•1•1•1)

sections.heading: The food
sections.needed: 10 eucalyptus logs, 8 achey tree logs, 4 spears and 2 raw chompies

steps.text: Talk to Chargurr north of the bank. (1)
Talk to Chargurr with 8 achey tree logs and 10 eucalyptus logs in the backpack to add them to the fire pit.
Talk to Chargurr.
Give her four spears. (2)
Talk to Chargurr.
Use two raw chompies on Chargurr.
Talk to Chargurr.
Light the fire pit.
Talk to Chargurr.

sections.heading: The beds
sections.needed: 8 stripy feathers, or a bird snare to get them

steps.text: Talk to Balnea located in the bank. (1)
Talk to Snurgh who is in the easternmost building of Oo'glog. (1)
Give her 8 stripy feathers (obtainable via bird snare on tropical wagtail, north of the Oo'glog lodestone).

sections.heading: The salon
sections.needed: 8 larupia furs and 4 wolf bones; teasing stick if trapping larupias

steps.text: Talk to Balnea. (1•1)
Talk to Kringk in the building east of the bank. (2)
Give her 4 wolf bones and 8 larupia furs. (1)

sections.heading: The pools
sections.needed: at least 6 eucalyptus logs, 2 tansymum, 1 fever grass, 1 primweed, 1 stinkbloom, and 1 lavender
sections.recommended: 16 eucalyptus logs, 7 tansymum, 6 fever grass, 6 primweed, 6 stinkbloom, and 6 lavender

steps.text: Talk to Balnea.
Talk to Seegud in the building north-east of the bank.
Head north-east of Seegud to the thermal spring.
Use a pile of eucalyptus logs and a tansymum on the fire pit nearby.
Light the fire pit. The insects won't disperse.
Talk to Seegud.
Head back to the spring and talk to Snarrk.
The 'long brown stone' always represents eucalyptus logs.
Correct plant and stone combinations are different for every player; check and record combinations to solve the puzzle.
Fresh logs are required for each attempt.
Determine, by trial and error, the plant needed for the thermal bath's 'yellow egg-shaped' stones.
At the mud bath, the primary plant matches the thermal bath's plant; find the secondary plant by trial and error.
At the salt-water spring, use the mud bath's secondary plant as primary; find the new secondary plant.
At the yellow sulphur spring, use the salt-water spring's secondary plant as primary; find the new secondary plant.
At the Bandos pool, combine three plants: the mud bath's secondary plant, the sulphur pool's secondary plant, and the unused herb.
After all bugs are dispersed, talk to Seegud.
Talk to Balnea. (1)
Talk to Chief Tess. (1•1)
Head to the salt-water spring.
Use deadfall traps baited with lit fever grass to catch diseased kebbits (two from west side, two from east side).

sections.heading: Wimpy birds
sections.needed: Bird snare and a few tansymum

steps.text: Set up a bird snare west of the bank, light tansymum and move around until all birds are caught.

sections.heading: Platypodes
sections.needed: Box trap and a few lavender

steps.text: Head west of Chief Tess and the sulphur spring, set up a box trap, burn lavender and move around.
Once the box shakes, check the trap; repeat until all four platypodes are caught.
Release them next to the plants in the water in the north-east corner of the village.
Dismiss any followers before continuing.
Talk to Balnea and do not skip the cutscene.
Quest complete!

items: A mixture of 4 items, either caskets or oysters
Access to the Oo'glog Hunter area
Access to the platypus summoning pet (requires 10 Summoning). If you release your pet in the spot you released the others during the quest you will receive another casket or oyster

sections.heading: Starting off
sections.needed: Combat weapon, equipment, and supplies, food (a Beast of Burden is allowed if more food is needed)

steps.text: Talk to the Raptor in Fort Forinthry. (1•✓•1)
Watch the cutscene.
Begin Encounter with Fort Forinthry Gate.

sections.heading: The battle
notes: The battle is in story mode and a death will result in appearing near the Raptor. This is a safe death.

steps.text: Run north to the camp with an undead giant.
Kill the undead giant. The other enemies are optional.
Disrupt the place of power.
Head west.
Kill the undead giant. The other enemies are optional.
Disrupt the place of power.
Head south.
Kill the undead giant. The other enemies are optional.
Disrupt the place of power.
Defeat the Zemouregal & Vorkath encounter.

Drink 1 dose of super antifire.
First use of extra action Ballista after Vorkath lands.
Dive, Surge, or Escape during Vorkath's AoE (10x10 area).
Second use of extra action Ballista when the Raptor mentions "Ready the Balista"
Use Balista as often as possible after this.
Target Zemouregal only after killing Vorkath.

sections.needed: 4 empty backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to the Raptor, near the Guardhouse.
Talk to guard captain Sofía or Overseer Siv in the Guardhouse.
Talk to Aster or Bill in the Command Centre.
Talk to Oak or Zoe east of the Command Centre.
Talk to Copperpot, Father Flint or Granny Rowan in the Chapel.
Talk to Princess or Rodney in the Kitchen.
Talk to the Raptor, near the Guardhouse.
Talk to Bill in the Town Hall.
Head east of the Kitchen and collect 4 stone wall segments from the pile of stone.
Fully repair the fortifications with the 4 repair hotspots to the west, north of the broken Workshop.
Talk to Aster, Overseer Siv, or Rodney in the Town Hall. (1)
Talk to the Raptor, near the Guardhouse.
Enter floor hatch to the east of the Command Centre.
Talk to Zemouregal in his prison cell. (~)
notes: Quest complete!

items: Access to the Zemouregal & Vorkath boss encounter via a commemorative statue in the town hall.

steps.text: Each of the battles can last around 10 minutes.
Position your allies in the positions indicated for each battle, then start the battles.
It is recommended to train skills at the bank chest during the battles to make good use of time.
Talk to Ali the Wise or Wizard Trindy found north west of the mysterious monolith (Archaeology Guild). (✓)
Move Thaerisk Cemphier, Commander Zilyana, and Helwyr south-west of the barricade.
Press the start button to begin the battle.
Talk to Ali the Wise.
Move Helwyr and Nex just inside the southern barricade.
Move Zilyana and Thaerisk just inside the northern barricade.
Start the battle.
Talk to Wizard Trindy or Ali the Wise. (3)
Head to the Fight Kiln and enter it. (1)
Return to the Archaeology Guild and talk to Ali the Wise again. (1)
Move Helwyr and Commander Zilyana just outside the northern barricade of the Gower farm.
Move Thaerisk and Nex just outside the southern barricade of the Gower Farm.
Move the 3 TokHaar just outside the Varrock east gate.
Start the battle.
Talk to Ali the Wise.
Move Helwyr to the southern barricade.

steps.text: Move Thaerisk and Nex to the crossroads outside Varrock's east gate. (Sometimes an enemy can slip the crossroads defence and start attacking the north-western barricade.)

Start the final battle.
Talk to Ali the Wise for a cutscene. (3•1)
notes: Quest Complete!

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Zaros Stirs (before the second battle, if not unlocked already)
Zaros Zeitgeist (before the fourth battle, if not unlocked already)

steps.text: Talk to Wizard Myrtle at the fountain near the entrance to the Wizards' Tower. (Fairy ring DIS) (2•✓•1)
Go to the Edgeville Mausoleum just south of the bank and talk to Vannaka. (1•4•1)
Return to the Wizards' Tower, and talk to Wizard Myrtle. (2•1)
Make your way to Mudskipper Point. The fastest route is via fairy ring AIQ. Alternatively, you can run south from the Port Sarim lodestone.
Unequip your weapons and dismiss followers and then talk to Wizard Myrtle. (1•2•1)

substeps.text: If you have completed the Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Pirate Pete subquest, or have built any kind of diving suit in the Aquarium. (1•1•2•1)

steps.text: East of the room, read the message in the bottle for the key and open the door.
Talk to Brynna, the survival expert (directly to the south).
Catch two raw shrimps.
Gather the seaweed nearby.
Cut a tree to get a soggy branch.
Interact with the boulder to push it into the hole.
Cook both shrimp on the steam vent (two squares west of the boulder) to receive two boiled shrimps.
Boil 1 shrimp again to burn it. Keep one boiled shrimp.
Talk to Brynna twice.
Continue through the west gate.
Go to the building to the west and talk to the master chef.
Go to the large jellyfish south-east of the chef's house and play the music box. (2•3•1)
Gather tasty seaweed.
Talk to the master chef again.
Prepare the large table 3 times by matching the 3 tastes with 3 ingredients (large table is in the same house).
Continue through the west door to the small house in the north.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to mining instructor. (1•3)
Mine soggy copper ore and soggy tin ore.
Click the furnace (1)
Right click and close the doors.
Operate the pump and light the furnace.
Retrieve the bronzish bar from the furnace.
Smith a bronze dagger.
Talk to the mining instructor again.
Continue through the east gate.
Talk to Vannaka, the combat instructor. (1•2)
Open the gate and click on the sword in the middle of the room to begin combat training.
Click on the rats and other elements bouncing on the screen.
Exit the cage and climb the ladder to the north-east.
Talk to the financial advisor in the house directly to the east. (1)
Enter the vault (the code is 139).
Talk to the financial advisor again.
Leave through the 2 doors to the east.
Head south to the church through double doors.
Talk to Brother Brace.
Read the friend list.
There will be 2 fish just east of the bank and the 3rd fish west of the bank, back through the two doors leading through the bank.
One of the five fish will tell you where the book is. Search for it.
Give the book to Brother Brace.
Go through the south door to the south-east building and talk to Wizard Terrova. (1•1)
Attack a chicken.
Talk to the wizard.
Pick any option during the cutscene.
Channel the spell while repelling Crassians.
Finish Hector Vivian.
Talk to Wizard Myrtle. (1)
Quest complete!

items: 10,000 Combat experience lamp in a choice of Attack, Constitution, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Prayer, Magic, Necromancy, Herblore, Slayer, or Summoning (Skill must be level 10 or higher)
Vannaka's Sword, a sword override similar to that of Vannaka's steel two-handed sword which can be held in one hand
Lev's old music box – crumbles to dust when played, unlocking Newbie Melody (original)

Big Chompy Bird Hunting.name: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
items_required: Feathers (100+ to be safe, 25 can be bought during quest for 50 coins)
4-6 wolf bones (can be obtained during the quest)
4-6 achey tree logs (can be obtained during the quest)

steps.text: Talk to Rantz east of Feldip Hills. (3•✓)
Chop down two Achey Trees.
Craft ogre arrow shafts from the logs.
Use feathers on the ogre arrow shafts.
Obtain some wolf bones. There are some wolves just south-west of Rantz, by the swamp.
Craft wolf bone arrowheads from the wolf bones.

substeps.text: Be careful not to bury the bones.

steps.text: Use the wolf bone arrowheads on the shafts.
Use 6 ogre arrows on Rantz.
Ask Rantz all possible questions. (1•2•3•4•5)
Enter the cave north of Rantz.
Unlock the Locked Ogre chest in the north-west corner, then search it to receive ogre bellows.
Exit the cave and run a short distance south-west to the swamp.
At the swamp, fill bellows via the swamp bubbles, then bloat 3 nearby swamp toads for 3 bloated toads.
Remove any Armour/Augmented Armour this will stop you from killing Chompy
Talk to Rantz.
Drop a bloated toad where the arrow points and wait for a chompy to appear.

substeps.text: You may need to drop more toads if the bird doesn't spawn.

steps.text: Talk to Rantz after the chompy appears.
Wait until Rantz has fired his bow and missed the bird, then talk to him.
Convince him to let you try shooting the bird instead. He'll give you an ogre bow. (2•1)
Place another toad in the clearing.

substeps.text: Alternatively, you can kill the same chompy bird, if it has not left.

steps.text: Kill the chompy bird that appears with the ogre bow.
Pluck the carcass and take the raw chompy.
Talk to Rantz. Take note of the specific ingredient he wants on the chompy
Go back into the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs. Take note of the specific ingredients they want on the chompy, all are possible but not necessarily needed.
Obtain the ingredients that they ask for and use the raw chompy on the spit-roast north of Rantz.

substeps.text: In case you forgot the ingredients, using the raw chompy on the spit-roast will list them out.

steps.text: Talk to Rantz.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to hunt chompy birds and cook raw chompy

Biohazard.name: Biohazard
items_required: Priest gown top and bottom (or 10 coins to buy them)

Talk to Jerico, who is in the building south of the Ardougne north bank.
Search the cupboard in Jerico's house for some bird feed.
Go to the outside eastern wall of Jerico's house and pick up a pigeon cage.
Go back across the river, west of the castle to the West Ardougne gate.
Use bird feed on the watchtower fence (the spears, highlighted in red on your minimap) where several Mourners are perched above.
Open the pigeon cage.
Go south along the wall and talk to Omart. Make sure to finish the dialogue (1)
Go to the east side of Martha Rehnison's house, highlighted in the picture (do not enter the house), north-west of where you breached the wall.
Take the rotten apple on the east outside of the house.
Squeeze through the gap in the metal fence directly east of the rotten apple.
Use the rotten apple on the cauldron in front of you. Make sure you right click it, as the left click option is to eat it.
Go to Nurse Sarah's house in the corner, south-west of the church.
Search the box on the north side of the house to obtain a doctors' gown.
Equip the gown.
Go to the north-east corner of the city and enter the Mourner Headquarters.
Open the door to the west and go upstairs.
Open the door to the east and kill a Mourner to obtain a key that automatically goes into your inventory.
Use the key on the gate in front of you to get into the caged room.

substeps.text: You can dispose of the key now

steps.text: Search the crates in the caged room to find the distillator.
Teleport back to the Ardougne lodestone.
Talk to Elena in a house just west of the East Ardougne north bank, across the river.
Without teleporting, go to a bank and deposit your plague sample. Teleporting with the plague sample in your inventory will destroy it, forcing you to retrieve another sample from Elena.
Go to Rimmington and retrieve the three vials and the plague sample from the bank there.

Enter the westernmost house in Rimmington and talk to the Chemist. (Do not mention that you have the sample or he will take it away from you, and you will be forced to go back to Elena to get a new one. Also, do not give the wrong vial as it will force you to go back and get new ones). (3•2•2)
At the fire outside the house talk to Chancy. (2)
Talk to Da Vinci. (1)
Talk to Hops. (3)
Make sure to bank sample before teleporting. You can quickly bank the sample by using Bank chest to the east.
Teleport to Varrock.

sections.heading: Delivering the samples

steps.text: If you have not done so already, obtain a priest gown set (can be bought from the nearby Fancy Clothes Store).
Go to the bank and get the plague sample.
Go through the gate in the south-east corner of Varrock.
Talk to the 3 chemist's assistants at the Dancing Donkey Inn to get the vials back.
Equip the priest gown top and bottoms now.
Go to the building south-east of the pub and go inside.
Talk to Guidor, tell him you are sent by Elena, and give him the samples. (1•2•1)
Go back to Ardougne and talk to Elena.
Go to Ardougne Castle, south of Elena's house, and climb either the stairs to the north or south.
Talk to King Lathas, who is in the middle chamber of the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the castle. (1)
Quest complete!

Access to the Combat Training Camp north of the city

Talk to Vigr.

steps.text: Enter the Barendir caves southeast of west Keldagrim. The caves can be accessed by selecting "Travel" on the Dwarven Boatman on the eastern side of Keldagrim near the northern bridge, or selecting "Cross-river" on the Dwarven Ferryman to the south of western Keldagrim.
Proceed to the north end of the tunnel and enter the cave at the end.
Talk to Veldaban. If Veldaban isn't there, make sure the cave with suspects is empty.
Talk to Nulodion. He'll give you explosive gears.
Fire the cannon. This part is not a safe death. Should you die, your gravestone will be a short walk inside the Barendir caves.

After destroying all 5 cannons, walk up onto the platform with Colonel Grimsson.
Pull the lever that's on top of the platform above the minecart, then get into the mine cart.

Catch all the loose memory fragments. There will be 9 fragments total, 3 of each type.

Kill Chaos Hreidmar.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities

After speaking to Philipe with 400 quest points, players can also claim Spot the black dragon from Henryeta Carnillean.

steps.text: Within the city, put light globes on the light pedestals to illuminate the immediate area. When outside of an illuminated area, you will receive stacks of Shadows of the Empire debuff. The more stacks you have, the more damage you are dealt. Standing in an illuminated area will remove stacks of the debuff. This includes stepping into houses with lights. The ward only dims the light from the globes.

Light globes will persist when teleporting out and additional light globes are spread through the west district of the city. You don't need to obtain all light globes to complete the quest, so it may be more beneficial to juggle them as you explore new areas.

Inspect the sundial (Crondis).
Click the "" symbol on the right bottom corner of the outer ring to align it to Crondis (crocodile head).
Enter the tunnel the sunbeam points to and walk through the tunnel at the end of the path.
Slice open the dung kalphites until the Kharid-ib is found.

substeps.text: A bronze scimitar can be found on the ground near the torch for players without a slashing weapon.
The sparkling kalphites contain gems and must be slashed open. They appear to have an extra glowing circle near their heads.
You must slice open any three kalphites before they will begin to sparkle.
Changing various game settings can help identify the sparkling ones.
Switch your graphics settings' "Lighting Detail" option to "Low".
Switch your skybox setting "Midday".
Switch your audio settings' "Ambient Sounds" option on. A twinkle sound indicates the sparkling one is nearby.

steps.text: For the last kalphite, pick up the kharid-ib and a cutscene ensues.
Climb-out the exit (the rope that appears in the centre).
Talk to Ozan or Leela.
Inspect the sundial (Scabaras).
Click the "" symbol on the outer ring to align it to Scabaras (beetle).

Dream Mentor.name: Dream Mentor
items_required: 3 different kinds of food: 6 of 1 type and 7 of 2 others for a total of 20 pieces.

Purple sweets, roast potatoes, mince pies, yule logs, and mint cakes cannot be used; stackable foods, such as holy biscuits, will be counted as a single piece of food; cake can be used in all 3 pieces.
An easy way to acquire the food items is to use the lodestone teleport to Port Sarim, which brings you right next to the Wydin's Food Store, and then lodestone teleport right back to Lunar Isle.
Cabbages, onions, and raw potatoes can be found within Rellekka. To use fewer backpack space, you can fill the vegetables into empty sacks, or alternatively bring uncut pineapples.

steps.text: Enter the mine in the north-east area of Lunar Isle.
Crawl-through the cave entrance (quest minimap icon).
Talk to the fallen man (close the interface when it appears). (✓)
Starting with one of your 7 item foods, feed him 4 food while cycling through your different foods.

substeps.text: Starting with a food item of which you brought 7 items will ensure you do not run out of variety.

steps.text: Talk to him again. (1•1)
Feed him 4 more food as before.
Talk to repeatedly to raise his spirits:

substeps.text: Of the four chat options, choose the one that appears on the table below.
Select the response according to the table.
Repeat until a short cutscene plays and he sits up.

steps.text: Feed him 6 more food.
Talk to him and raise his spirit as before until he stands up.
Exit the cave and climb up the ladder.

substeps.text: Or just use the Lunar Isle lodestone

Ranged: Splitbark Helm, Karil's top, Torag's platelegs, Adamant boots, Magic shortbow
Magic: Robin Hood hat, Dragon Chainbody, Black dragonhide chaps, Infinity boots, Ancient staff

Use an astral rune on an anvil (there's one on Lunar Isle in a small building to the south), then grind the shards. Add it to the potion.
Prepare for 4 fights (below level 100). Prayers and emergency teleports won't work. Neither will familiars.
Light the Ceremonial Brazier in the long hall building, near the lodestone.
Talk to Cyrisus (dismiss any followers before). (1)
