Make your way to Varrock Square.
Search the sleigh near the Varrock Palace entrance.
Find the five piles of snow (show on map):

substeps.text: Just inside Varrock Palace courtyard.
Inside Zaff's Superior Spellcasting.
Inside Aris' Reward Shop.
Near Pelters' Veg Stall, behind Varrock General Store.
Inside Horvik's Armour Shop.

steps.text: Add decorations to the missing Christmas decorations in the north-eastern part of Varrock Square.
Teleport back to Christmas Village.
Investigate the Christmas spirit map.
Take Santa's request next to the map.
Make five of the following deliveries:

substeps.text: You need to check Santa's sack in your backpack and choose a character in the interface before talking to them with the sack and some backpack space.

steps.text: Talk to Santa Claus in the southern part of Christmas Village to complete the quest.

items: Winter Hat and Winter Scarf (green and red)
Ability to place a Christmas tree and other decorations in Fort Forinthry with Zoe
Santa's sack that allows the player to deliver one present a day in return for more Christmas spirit
Emotes from previous Christmas events (if not unlocked)
Access to the decoration making activity in the Christmas Village

steps.text: Talk to Trufitus in his house located northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai. (3•1•✓)
Head south-west to some marshy jungle vines (refer to map).
Search one for a grimy snake weed.

substeps.text: Take three if you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters.

steps.text: Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean snake weed. (1)
Head north-east to some palm trees (refer to map).
Search one for a grimy ardrigal.

substeps.text: Take two if you intend to do Legends' Quest.

steps.text: Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean ardrigal. (1)
Head south of Tai Bwo Wannai to the scorched earth near two fires (refer to map labelled "sito foil").
Search it for a grimy sito foil.
Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean sito foil. (1)
Head south-east to the mine.
Search the green-coloured rocks for a grimy volencia moss.
Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean volencia moss. (1)
Head back north near the palm trees and follow the shoreline west to some rocks (refer to map labelled "rogue's purse").
Search the rocks to enter the cave (1)

substeps.text: (Optional) Kill one jogre to complete one of the easy Karamja achievements, It's a Jungle Ogre.

steps.text: Search a fungus covered Cavern wall for a grimy rogue's purse.

substeps.text: Take two if you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters.

steps.text: Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean rogue's purse. (1)
Quest complete!

items: Access to Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame
Access to use Rionasta for parcel service
Access to a gardener for calquat trees

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Jungly1 (If you went to Cairn Isle to gather the snake weed)

steps.text: Talk to Kennith in the house west of the church in Witchaven (Fairy ring BLR or Cape of legends and run south). (✓)
Climb down the Old ruin entrance to the west.
Enter the wall opening on the eastern wall immediately as you enter.
Navigate through the tunnel.

substeps.text: Take the agility shortcut near the entrance, requiring 30 Agility.

steps.text: Climb over the rocks and talk to one of the villagers.
Climb back over the rocks and a cutscene will occur.
Exit the tunnels and talk to Kennith again.
Talk to Kennith's parents, Kent and Caroline, east of the church.
Travel north to the entrance of the Legends' Guild (or teleport with Cape of legends) and talk to Kent.
Travel back to Witchaven and talk to Kimberly in the northernmost house next to Jeb and Holgart. (1)
After the cutscene, run around the house to get all four villagers to follow you. (Note: the following must be done without leaving the area, or exiting to the lobby or it must be done over!)
Trap the villagers inside the church.
Talk to Kimberly again (2)
Talk to Kimberly.
After the cutscene, get the villagers to follow you and trap them in the church, again.
Talk to Kimberly again (2)
Talk to Kimberly.
Talk to Kimberly again.
Before continuing, if you are currently under the effect of Sign of the Porter or similar buff, make sure to disable the buff.
Head back to the Old ruin entrance, through the wall opening, over the rocks.
Dismiss any active followers.
Talk to one of the villagers.
Once through the dark entrance, talk to Ezekial.
Go through the northeastern wooden door.
When the three minecart villagers turn their back to you, run south to the southern wall and hide there.
Wait for the southern villager to face the barrel, then run past him to the three nooks in the eastern wall. Hide inside these nooks to remain undetected.

While the northern and southern villagers have their backs turned, prospect the wall until you find a crack (The piece of wall that will have the crack has a slightly different texture on top). Mine the wall, then enter the hole.
Run to the other side of the tunnel and pull the lever. Ezekial Lovecraft will enter the area and follow you.
Run back to the eastern side of the tunnel and open the wooden door.
Speak with Kent or Caroline.
Talk to Ezekial. Disable any items that would automatically bank ores, such as signs of the porter.
Open the eastern door.
Each time the villagers face and walk towards the middle is when you move.

substeps.text: Harvest up to 2 Rubium along the Northern wall the first time they face the middle, then take cover behind the NE Wall.
Harvest another 2 Rubium giving you 4 total and take cover behind a wall.
Then each time the villagers face and walk towards the middle, Try to fill one Steam vent.
Repeat this 4 times until the villagers pass out

steps.text: Go through the wooden door.
Talk to Ezekial.
A quick way to proceed to the next room is as follows:

substeps.text: As soon as the mine-cart villagers turn their back, break through the rock in the middle of the room - hide one tile east of where the rock was.
Wait for the north-eastern villager to face to the east and for the door villager to face the door, run north and mine rubium here, while walking behind the patrolling villager (4). (4)
When the door villager turns to face the door, and the southern villager is not looking, run past him to the south and put the rubium in the south-eastern vent.
Wait for the door villager to face the door again, then run back to the middle and hide.
When the mine-cart villagers turn their back, run to the south vent and drop the rubium in, then quickly hide in the middle.
When the mine-cart villagers turn south again, run north to place the last rubium in both northern vents. They should all pass out now.

steps.text: Go through the wooden door.
Talk to Katherine or Clive.
Backtrack through the rooms to the tunnel with the lever. Go through the metal door on the western side.
Talk to Kennith.
After the cutscene, talk to Kimberly to find the location of the toy train.

Return to Witchaven and find the toy train. It will be on the ground, but there will not be a red dot on the minimap. Going into game settings > Additional Options > Accessibility and turning on entity highlight will make the toy train easier to find, appearing as the color you have set for interactable items. It can be at one of the following locations:

substeps.text: The North-East building nearest to the dock, outside the northern door, beside the fishing net.
Outside the building, on the north side beside the fishing net.
Near the pillar outside Mayor Hobb's house (which is on the west side).
By the water (south of the town).
South of the house with the well.

steps.text: Return to the caves and go to the room with Kennith; use the toy train on him.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the mines under Witchaven
Ability to mine and sell a volatile new ore rubium to Ezekial Lovecraft for 10 coins each
Ability to make super fishing explosive and super explosive shaker.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: A New Menace (After talking with Kimberly)
Creepy (When you enter the room with rubium)

Kili Row.name: Kili Row
items_required: 2 regular ghostly ink for drawing glyphs, or having the required glyphs already drawn
7 basic ghostly ink for drawing glyphs, or having the required glyphs already drawn
4 light sources for rituals, or having them already set up

steps.text: Talk to Kili by the anvils in north-eastern corner of the City of Um (✓)
Go to the ritual site in the City of Um
Select the Lesser ensoul material (Kili Row) with the pedestal
Complete the ritual (requires Change I glyph which requires two inkwells of regular ghostly ink and one inkwell of basic ghostly ink to draw)
Withdraw the output of the ritual from the ritual chest on the ritual site
Go back to Kili to get a soul urn
Kill five chickens using Necromancy anywhere or go back to the ritual site and perform a lesser communion ritual
Talk to Kili
Quest complete!

items: Access to lesser, regular, and greater ensoul material rituals
Ability to upgrade Death Skull equipment and deathwarden robe armour to tier 20
Ability to learn further equipment upgrades from Kili
Ability to access Thalmund and Thalmund's Wares

King's Ransom.name: King's Ransom
items_required: Granite (any size), or a ring of stone
Telekinetic Grab runes (1 air rune and 1 law rune, can be obtained during the quest) and the standard spellbook
Animate rock scroll (required to bring if you have it in your bank, otherwise Wizard Cromperty will give you one during the quest)

steps.text: Talk to the Gossip south of the Sinclair Mansion (Fairy ring CJR). (✓)
Talk to the Guard inside the gates.
From the outside, break the eastern smashed window of the mansion (right click to choose break).

substeps.text: You might have to try again because of the dog

steps.text: Once inside, go to the large room and take the scrap paper next to the fireplace.
Go up to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US].
Take the address form from the table in the central northern room and read it.
Search the nearby bookcase for a black knight helm.
Go back down the staircase and "break" the smashed window again to climb out.
Talk to the Guard three times. (1)
Talk to Gossip. (3)
Go to the Seers' Village Courthouse, directly south from the mansion gates.
Talk to Anna. (1)
Dismiss any followers you might have and go down the stairs to begin the trial. (1)
Call the dog handler as a witness (2)

substeps.text: You may need to resize your interface and zoom out before descending the stairs since he appears near the bottom of the screen.

steps.text: For the following options, talk to the judge to call a witness, then choose who you would like to call:

substeps.text: Call the butler (3)
Call the maid (4•2)

steps.text: After the balloons drop, exit via the gate.
Talk to Anna in her cell.

sections.heading: Jailbreaker
sections.needed: 1 air rune and 1 law rune for Telekinetic Grab

steps.text: Go to the northeast of Camelot Castle, outside of the castle hedges
Search the statue.
Talk to Merlin. (3•1•2•3)
Reach the vent on the northern wall, it should trigger a cutscene in which the imprisoned knights lift Merlin out. Do not reach for the vent again afterwards.

substeps.text: If you don't see a cutscene, then talk to Merlin again and exhaust all options.

steps.text: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the guard fixing his hair outside your cell door. Ask the knights around if you didn't bring any Telekinetic Grab runes.

substeps.text: Drop trick will work here if you would like an extra hairclip.

steps.text: Use the hairclip on the metal door.
Complete the puzzle.

substeps.text: To complete this puzzle, you must set each of four tumblers to the correct height. The most foolproof way to do this (although not necessarily the quickest) is to set all tumblers to the lowest height and try the lock.
If a tumbler shows a green circle, do not change that tumbler anymore.
For the remaining tumblers, they will each show a blue or red circle. Increase those tumblers height by one and try again.
Continue until the lock unlocks. This method will take at most six attempts.

steps.text: Once you have bypassed the gate, climb up two sets of staircases to reach the top floor.
Search the table and click the purple cylinder second from the right.

sections.heading: For Camelot!
sections.needed: Granite, bronze med helm, iron chainbody, holy grail and animate rock scroll
sections.recommended: Skull of Remembrance

steps.text: Go to East Ardougne, northeast corner, and talk to Wizard Cromperty. (1)
Equip your bronze med helm and iron chainbody and unequip other equipment, then enter the Black Knights' Fortress from Edgeville.

substeps.text: If you have the Skull of Remembrance, you can teleport to the 3rd floor[UK]4th floor[US] of the fortress and head down to the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US].

steps.text: Climb-down the ladder in the south-west corner.
Remove your bronze helm and iron chainbody, then free King Arthur.
Talk to King Arthur. Give him the bronze helm and iron chainbody.
Return to Camelot and talk to King Arthur.
Quest complete!

items: 5,000 Magic experience lamp (Skill level must be 45 or higher)
5,000 Skill experience lamp (Skill level must be 50 or higher)
33,000 Defence experience lamp (Skill level must be 65 or higher)
The hair clip (a more durable version of the lockpick) if obtained during quest
Access to the Knight Waves training ground
Access to the Court Cases Distraction and Diversion

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Knightmare (unless it was already unlocked in the Black Knights' Fortress)

Land of the Goblins.name: Land of the Goblins
items_required: Ironmen can easily obtain a clean toadflax from the Brimhaven Agility Arena
Black mushroom ink (obtainable during the quest)
Empty vial (if you don't already have the black mushroom ink)
Must have enough backpack space to unequip all items

steps.text: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines. (2•3•✓)

substeps.text: Dismiss any familiar or Grubfoot won't follow you.

steps.text: With Grubfoot following, enter Dorgesh-Kaan using the door to the south and head north-west where Oldak is.
In the north-west room, talk to Zanik. (3•3•2•~•1•1)

sections.heading: You not a goblin!
sections.needed: Black mushroom ink or a vial, toadflax potion (unfinished)
sections.recommended: An extra vial or Black mushroom ink, and an extra toadflax potion (unfinished) to make a second potion. (Or, you can attempt to save a dose from your first potion)

steps.text: If you forgot to bring the toadflax potion, proceed until Zanik has entered into the temple.

substeps.text: Otherwise, you will need to go back to Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan to meet with her, and provide him two law runes and one molten glass.

steps.text: Once you teleport with Zanik, head north-west to the temple entrance blocked by two goblin guards.

substeps.text: Pick and grind a black mushroom into an empty vial if you don't already have black mushroom ink.

steps.text: Talk to the guards and they will allow Zanik to pass into the temple.
Talk to the Makeover Mage south-west of Falador. (4•1•3)
Use the pharmakos berries on an unfinished toadflax potion to create the goblin potion.

substeps.text: (Optional) After making the potion, collect another set of pharmakos berries if planning to complete the Contract Claws mystery.

steps.text: Head to the goblin cave (just north of the Ardougne lodestone).

sections.heading: Transmogrification
sections.needed: goblin mail, Enough free inventory spaces to unequip all items

steps.text: Unequip all items and dismiss any followers.
In front of the goblin guards, drink the goblin potion (pick any goblin appearance).
Climb down the entrance. (1•1)
North, sitting on his throne, talk to the High Priest. (1•1•1)
Take the quiz. (1•1•2•2•2•1•2)
After the quiz, ask about Yu'biusk. (1•2•5)
Dye your goblin mail black with the mushroom ink.
Wear the black goblin mail and go in the north-east room by talking to the goblin in the passage.
Pickpocket the priest for a key. Keep this key. You will need it later.
Search the crate in the room to find the teleport sphere.
Talk to Zanik in the prison cell to the north-west of the crate, she will teleport. (1)

sections.heading: Whitefish
sections.needed: 5 coins, 1 black goblin mail, 1 raw slimy eel
sections.recommended: Combat bracelet

steps.text: Leave the cave.

substeps.text: You can equip a piece of equipment to be thrown out, then you can teleport to Draynor.

steps.text: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village. Ask her about black or white dye. (4•2•4)

substeps.text: Or, if Vampyre Slayer is complete. (5•2•4)

steps.text: Teleport to Seers' Village lodestone and head south-west to Hemenster near the Ranging Guild. Alternatively, use a combat bracelet.

substeps.text: Be sure to have a raw slimy eel or you will have to repeat the next steps.

steps.text: Attempt to open the gate near Morris. (3)
After finishing the dialogue, open the gate.
Catch a whitefish.
Return to Aggie and use the goblin mail on her.

sections.heading: Macabre crypt
sections.needed: Blue dye, yellow dye, purple dye, orange dye, enough backpack spaces to unequip all items

steps.text: Unequip any items and dismiss any followers.
Go back to the goblin temple entrance, take a sip of your goblin potion, and equip your white goblin mail.
Enter the temple.
Steal the white key from the priest in the room west of the temple.

substeps.text: Remove the goblin mail to leave the room quicker.

steps.text: Repeat the operation of stealing keys, dying your mail in the following order:

substeps.text: Yellow (north-west)
Purple (south-west)
Orange (south-east)
Blue (east)

steps.text: Enter the crypt (large door north of the temple).
Prepare for battle by equipping weapons and armour.
Use the Say-name option on each of the graves. After killing them, talk to them.

substeps.text: South-west: Snothead (1•1•4)
South-east: Snailfeet (2•2)
North-west: Mosschin (3•2)
North-east: Redeyes (4•2)
North: Strongbones (ignore his skeleton minions) (5)

steps.text: Talk to Strongbones after defeating him. (1•4)
Return to Dorgesh-Kaan and speak with Zanik in the north-west (Oldak's lab).
With a light source, head to the south end of Dorgesh-Kaan using fairy code AJQ. Alternatively, without using fairy rings:

substeps.text: Go up the stairs to the agility course.
At the start of the agility course, climb down the ladder west of the agility cable.
Follow the cave path east then south to the Fairy ring.

steps.text: Adjust the machines next to Oldak, use combination 9-4-1, activate the machine.
Open the strange box in the north-western part of Yu'biusk for a cutscene.
Continue dialogue with Oldak.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Goblin Temple (with an altar to recharge prayer points)
Access to Yu'biusk, using fairy ring code BLQ
Ability to buy moving-over-distance spheres (plain of mud sphere) that transports you to the goblin cave
Access to the Bandos gravestone (talk to Blasidar the sculptor in Keldagrim)
Ability to access the beacon located near the Goblin Village, west of the Ice Mountain

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Catacombs and Tombs (Catacombs of a Goblin Temple)

Legacy of Seergaze.name: Legacy of Seergaze
items_required: Combat gear (Necromancy or two different combat styles recommended for lower-level players)
1 coal (can be obtained during the quest)
Lvl-2 enchant tablet (if not on the standard spellbook) or;
1 cosmic rune and 3 air runes (can be obtained during the quest)
1 mithril bar (can be obtained during the quest, metal bank works)
1 silver bar (can be obtained during the quest, metal bank works)
1 silver sickle (b) (can be obtained during the quest)
1 emerald (can be obtained during the quest)

sections.heading: An evil conspiracy
sections.needed: Rod of Ivandis, or another silver weapon, and 2 backpack space
sections.recommended: 2 different combat styles and equipment

steps.text: Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer at the Temple Trekking ending point (west of Canifis). CKS or the Canifis lodestone are good options to reach the area quickly. (✓•3)
Enter the Mausoleum west of the Adventurer.
Talk to Drezel. (2•4)
Go through the gate west of Drezel and climb down the stairs north of the well.
Search the sparkling wall storage unit a few steps east of the stairs, then go back up the stairs.
Exit the Mausoleum via the west entrance ladder, enter the Paterdomus temple and head to the top floor.
After the cutscene, kill Fistandantilus and Zaromark Sliver (or wait until they time out and teleport away).

substeps.text: Both enemies have 2,750 life points, a combat level of 77, and a max hit of 220 in magic and ranged. These enemies will use prayer to become immune to your combat style, but do not protect against necromancy. Necromancy or multiple combat styles are recommended for this fight.

steps.text: Search the crude table in the north-west corner of the room.
Return to Drezel. (2)
Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer and escort him the same way as any Burgh de Rott Ramble. (2•1)

substeps.text: Easy path recommended for least time and effort. Be sure to remove any melee-reducing equipment like ranged and magic armour. If you encounter juvinates, you will require your Rod of Ivandis or another silver weapon.

steps.text: Once in Burgh de Rott, if the dialogue does not automatically start, talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.

substeps.text: If no one with that name is present in Burgh de Rott, skip to the next step.

steps.text: Climb over the wall inside the Pub and then climb down the trapdoor to the cellar.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz until he gives you a crate. (2•3)
Climb up the ladder.
Go south of Burgh de Rott and take the boat to Meiyerditch.
Go to the Meiyerditch Myreque base. Refer to the Meiyerditch shortcut guide for help. Being caught by the vyrewatch and sent to mines provides a fast and reliable route.
Talk to Flaygian Screwte, in the north room, and offer him your help. (3•4•5)
Ask Andiess Juip or Kael Forshaw in the same room about weapons. (2)
Go to the next room south (near Mekritus A'hara) and search the middle bunk bed on the eastern half of the north wall for a book.
Read it and remember which page mentioned flails.
Give the book to Flaygian, giving him the proper page number. He will give you 10 nails and a hammer. (You can drop the hammer)
Head to the northernmost part of Meiyerditch and enter the house south of the house with the furnace ("mass of debris").
Use the Make-ladder option on the centre post.
Climb up the post.
Jump across the floorboards to the east, then to the north.
Jump west through the damaged wall.
Climb up the ladder and search the trough.
Take a piece of coal from the coal barrel.
Go to the bottom floor and select "dig" on the mass of debris (right click).

substeps.text: If the "dig" option doesn't appear, you must go back to the top floor and search the trough

steps.text: Use the coal on the furnace, then light the furnace.
Return and talk to Flaygian, then in the same room;

substeps.text: Take 2 silver and 2 mithril bars from the barrel on the northern wall.
Take a blessed sickle from the shelf on the south-western wall.

steps.text: Go to the room to the east of the entrance ladder.
Search the crate for a chain link mould and add it to your tool belt.
Return to the furnace and make the Silvthril chain. It can be found by clicking on the silver bar in the smithing interface (scroll with down arrow next to "Casting Metals & Glass").

substeps.text: You do not need to make 2, you will have 1 bar of each type left. These are not used at any point in the quest so you can safely deposit them into your metal bank.

steps.text: Talk to Flaygian, then use the blessed sickle on him. (2)
Talk to Safalaan.
Proceed to the laboratory; the building south-east of the furnace, third from the top on the east wall and through the slashed tapestry.
Dismiss any followers and climb down the stairs.
After the cutscene, Look at one of the bodies in the north-west corner. (2•3)
Search the door to the south and use the saw in your tool belt.
Climb-through the door, then after the cutscene continue down the long and winding tunnel.
Continue north on the path to the large chamber where the strange stones are.
If you need runes for the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, search the corpse next to the rocks before continuing.

substeps.text: Searching the corpse will complete the Bloodstained Treasure achievement, if not already completed.

steps.text: Search the strange stones in the northern part of the cavern.
Talk to Safalaan. There will be a cutscene and a fight against vyrewatches in which you cannot deal any damage, but the fight will end in another cutscene with Safalaan being attacked.
Make sure you have 4 free backpack spaces, then talk to Safalaan.
Use the emerald on the sickle (right click, don't accidentally make bolt tips).
Use the Lvl-2 Enchant spell on it.
Use the chain on it.
Talk to Safalaan.
Go to the surface, equip the Ivandis flail, kill a vyrewatch, and pick up its corpse.
Return to Safalaan.

sections.heading: Back to the Columbarium
sections.needed: Teak pyre logs or better

steps.text: Return to the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott and talk to Veliaf. Ask him what to do. (1•4•5)
Return to and talk to Drezel at the Mausoleum. (2•4)
Go through the west gate, then down the stairs north of the well.
Use the pyre logs on a funeral pyre, then the vyre corpse. Light it.
Take the ornate tomb key from the pedestal.
Use it on the wall storage unit from the beginning of the quest on the north-eastern side of the room (the same one that is still sparkling) to acquire a blood talisman.
After the cutscene, go upstairs and ask Drezel what to do. If you still have the library key: (2•3)
Report to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.
Quest complete!

items: Tome of xp 2nd ed, giving 2,500 experience each in any skill that's at least level 35, up to 3 times in total, or 1,250 experience when used on an elite skill.
Ability to craft blood runes at the blood altar with 77 Runecrafting.
Access to Meiyerditch tunnels including skeletal hands, zombie hands, bloodvelds and mutated bloodvelds, as well as a jutting wall shortcut (requires 65 Agility) between Canifis and Meiyerditch.
Access to a furnace in Meiyerditch.
Access to the columbarium beneath Paterdomus and the ability to cremate the vyre corpse for rewards.
Access to vyrewatch event in Temple Trekking.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Conspiracy: Part 1 – during the Paterdomus temple cut scene
Conspiracy: Part 2 – during the same cut scene
The Terrible Tunnels – in the Meiyerditch secret laboratory
The Terrible Caverns – in the long tunnel before entering Mutated Bloodveld's lair
The Columbarium – during burning the Vyre corpse

Let Them Eat Pie.name: Let Them Eat Pie
items_required: All of these can be obtained for free during the quest.

steps.text: Talk to Nails Newton a few steps east of the Taverley lodestone. (✓)
(Optional) Gather wheat and fishing bait.

substeps.text: Go south and then east across the bridge and take some fishing bait from the ground near the bait barrel and hanging fish.
Go south and pick some wheat.

steps.text: Go to the watermill in the north-east of the bank and south of the pub.
Climb the stairs.
Investigate the hopper with fishing bait and wheat in the backpack.
Operate hopper controls.
Go down the stairs.
Take-flour from flour bin to obtain maggoty flour.
Talk to Nails Newton. He will give you a maggoty pie shell.
(Optional) Go north and trade with Head Farmer Jones outside of the flax field to receive a free raw potato.
(Optional) Go east and cage on a fishing spot to catch a raw crayfish.
Go inside the flax field or animal pen and watch the cutscene.
Talk to Nails Newton.
Go north-west into the snowy Hunter area near the animal pens.
Inspect a hole with a raw potato in the backpack to receive a stinking potato.
Use the stinking potato or manky crayfish on the maggoty pie shell to create a terrible pie (uncooked).
Cook the pie at an oven in The Pick and Lute pub which is right next to Nails Newton.
Talk to Nails Newton.
Pickpocket Foppish Pierre for expensive spices. His location is marked on the map, which is west of the watermill and north-east of the bank.
Use the expensive spices on the pie to create a mouth-watering pie.
Climb up spiral stairs in the Pick and Lute tavern.
Talk to Rolo the Stout. (~•2)
After the cutscene, talk to Nails.
Climb up spiral stairs in the Pick and Lute tavern.
Open the chest and steal the seal.
Talk to Nails Newton to receive a forged letter.
Deliver the letter to Foppish Pierre, just south of Nails Newton.
Talk to Nails Newton.
Quest complete!

Making History.name: Making History
items_required: Spade (or the meerkats familiar; the spade can be purchased from Richard's Farming Shop during the quest)
2 ecto-tokens (or completion of Ghosts Ahoy), or 2,600 coins (1,300 coins after Cabin Fever) to charter ships from Port Sarim to Port Phasmatys
A ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (not required if you have completed the hard Morytania achievements)

steps.text: Go to the Outpost; an old, now-derelict tower to the north of West Ardougne.

substeps.text: Traveller's necklace teleports directly to the Outpost.
Eagles' Peak lodestone and run south, then south east.

steps.text: Speak with Jorral for a cutscene. (1)
After the cutscene, agree to help. (✓)
Talk to the silver merchant in the East Ardougne marketplace. (3)

substeps.text: Do not steal from the stall otherwise the merchant will not talk with you.

steps.text: Ring of dueling to Castle Wars, run north and cross the bridge south of the Observatory.

substeps.text: West of fairy ring CIQ and north-west of Yanille lodestone.

steps.text: When you're just north of the bridge, play hot-and-cold by feeling the key and walking around until it feels steaming hot, and use the spade to dig. (Between the two trees)
Use the key on the chest to unlock it.

sections.heading: Droalak
sections.needed: Ghostspeak amulet, sapphire amulet, and two ecto tokens or enough money to buy a charter boat to Port Phasmatys if Ghosts Ahoy has not been completed

steps.text: Speak to Droalak south of the General Store in Port Phasmatys.

substeps.text: Ectophial or Port Sarim lodestone and charter ship to Port Phasmatys.
Wear the ghostspeak amulet.

steps.text: Talk to Melina in the building east of the General Store with a sapphire amulet in your inventory.
Talk to Droalak again for the scroll.
Talk to Blanin, west of the cow pen in Rellekka.
Talk to Dron, west of the helmet shop. (3•2)

sections.heading: Jorral
sections.needed: Journal, scroll

steps.text: Return to Jorral at the outpost, talk to him until he gives you a Letter.
Talk to King Lathas on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Ardougne Castle. (Remove Mourner Outfit if equipped)
Return to Jorral.
Quest complete!

items: The enchanted key, allowing you to go on your own treasure digs until it disappears; see the enchanted key lore activity
Access to the museum in the Outpost
You can read an incomplete list of all your exploits during the quest on the bookcase at the Outpost, but cannot take it away.

You can return to Droalak in Port Phasmatys after the quest and upon learning of what happened, he will finally be at peace and will disappear. Doing so is a requirement for obtaining the master quest cape.
You can talk to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum to receive 5 Kudos and an antique lamp that gives 1,000 experience in a skill of level 20 or above.

Merlin's Crystal.name: Merlin's Crystal
items_required: All the following items can be acquired during the quest:
Bread (Can be obtained during the quest with 24 coins)
Bat bones (Can be obtained during the quest)
If getting the black candle from Wendle's Wicks:
If getting the black candle from Catherby:
Bucket (Can be obtained during the quest)
Insect repellent (Can be obtained during the quest)
Can be used off of the toolbelt if already added

steps.text: Talk to King Arthur at Camelot. (1•✓)
Talk to Sir Gawain nearby. Ask him how Merlin got stuck in the crystal. (3•2)
Go upstairs, and talk to Sir Lancelot. Ask if he has any ideas on getting into Keep Le Faye. (3)
Hide in the crate just west of the candle-maker in Catherby. (1•1)
Climb to the top floor.

Attack Sir Mordred until his health drops to 0. If you use bleeds/poisons/conjures, future dialogue will be interrupted until the bleed/poison effect ends. Aggressive familiars would continue to attack when Sir Mordred goes back to full health after reaching 0 health, thus restarting the fight.
Talk to Morgan Le Faye. Spare Mordred's life to discover how to save Merlin. (1•2)
If you do not have bat bones, exit the keep to the west and kill a Giant bat.

sections.heading: Getting a black candle
sections.needed: Bucket, Insect repellent

steps.text: Talk to the candle-maker in Catherby. (1)
Gather a bucket of wax from the beehives to the north-west. A bucket can be found at the beehives.

substeps.text: If you do not have insect repellent then speak to the beekeeper for some. You can also add it to your tool belt.

steps.text: Left click the hive to use insect repellent on it and then use an empty bucket on a beehive to fill the bucket.
Talk to the candle-maker again to get the black candle from him.

sections.heading: Getting Excalibur
sections.needed: Bread

steps.text: Talk to the Lady of the Lake in southern Taverley. Ask about the sword Excalibur. (2)
Go to Port Sarim.

substeps.text: If you don't have bread, buy a loaf from Wydin's Food Store, just south of the Port Sarim lodestone.

steps.text: Enter Grum's Gold Exchange to the north of Port Sarim lodestone.
Give the beggar your bread. (1)
The beggar will turn into the Lady of the Lake and give you Excalibur for your good deed.

sections.heading: Ritual
sections.needed: Bat bones, Black candle

steps.text: Go to the Temple of Zamorak south of the Varrock east bank.
Check the chaos altar's inscription.
Return to Camelot and enter the gates.
Run north-east outside of the castle to the ritual site (the gazebo outside the castle).
Stand on the star and light the black candle.
Drop the bat bones on the star.

The magic words are "Snarthon Candtrick Termanto". If you get this wrong, you will have to get the black candle remade; or click away before proceeding with the dialogue and re-drop the bat bones to try again.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: Excalibur

steps.text: Enter the castle and climb the top of the south-east tower.
Smash the giant crystal to free Merlin.
Talk to King Arthur.
Quest complete!

items: A replica of Excalibur will be placed in the Varrock Museum as a Varrock Museum display by talking to Historian Minas. This will give you 5 Kudos and an antique lamp that gives 1,000 experience in a skill of level 20 or above.

Missing My Mummy.name: Missing My Mummy
items_required: 20 fire runes (cannot be substituted by a staff that provides fire runes)

sections.heading: Pharaoh's pyramid
sections.needed: 3 backpack spaces
sections.recommended: armour and weapons

steps.text: Talk to Leela, north of the Draynor Village jail. (✓)

substeps.text: If Leela does not show up in Draynor Village, you need to complete the Stolen Hearts and Diamond in the Rough quests first, even if Icthlarin's Little Helper is already completed.

steps.text: Enter the flat-topped pyramid Uzer Mastaba from the west side, south of Uzer.

substeps.text: Teleport to the fairy ring DLQ and then run east.
Teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay's Pass (Or use amulet of glory's teleport to Al Kharid).
Use the magic carpet network to get to Uzer.
Teleport with the traveller's necklace to desert eagles' eyrie.

steps.text: In the initial east chamber, rummage and kill the skeleton for a canopic jar.
Head north-west and through the imposing doors to the south.
Kill the four skeletons in the room for a mummy hand and the scroll of the dead. The mummy hand and scroll of the dead don't appear in area loot, you need to right click to take them.
Return to Leela in Draynor Village. (5)

sections.heading: Reclaiming the papyri
sections.needed: Al Kharid flyer, Sq'irkjuice, ring of charos (a)

steps.text: The scroll of praise:

substeps.text: Get an Al Kharid flyer from Waseem the Leaflet Dropper north of the Al Kharid mine (at the entrance to the desert).
Varrock Lodestone or Archeology Journal Teleport.
With your Al Kharid flyer, talk to Reldo in the Varrock palace library (most northern room of the ground floor) about the pyramid. (3)

steps.text: The copied name papyrus and mummy's name papyrus:

substeps.text: Play the Sorceress's Garden minigame and obtain a mug of any sq'irkjuice.
You need to use the sq'irkjuice on Ali Morrisane at his stall. Then talk with him. (3•1•4)
Talk to him again with a ring of charos (a) equipped. (3•1•4)
This step will only work after talking to the Wise Old Man during the Garden of Tranquillity, as the ring does not allow you to persuade people before this step.
You should have received both a copied name papyrus and a mummy's name papyrus.
Do not destroy the copied name papyrus or you will have to re-obtain a sq'irkjuice for another copy.

steps.text: Return to the pyramid with prayer points.
Again, open the imposing door in the north-west corner.
Kill the golem and descend the stairs (You may be placed in the mummy's tomb after descending the stairs, past the puzzle. If so, you will need to cross the puzzle to do the next 4 steps).
Find a path of blue and green blocks or of red and yellow blocks all the way through.
Go across the tiled room and collect the first canopic jar to the west of the northern staircase.

substeps.text: If you spawn at the bottom of the northern staircase simply pick up the canopic jar to the west.

steps.text: Collect the two remaining canopic jars and mummy with no hand in the tunnels. If you did not collect the fourth earlier, it can be found on one of the skeleton bodies upstairs. "Rummage" them and defeat them.
Use the mummy hand on the mummy with no hand.
Return to the tiled room and cross back towards the empty sarcophagus.

substeps.text: You may go upstairs and back downstairs to teleport to the tomb room to skip the tile puzzle.

sections.heading: Restoring the tomb
sections.needed: 20 fire rune, 1 willow log, jug of wine, spice, empty pot, and wheat

steps.text: Place jar on the shelves 4 times.
Fill the empty sarcophagus.
Pray at the 5 broken statues.

substeps.text: This requires 150 prayer points.

steps.text: Repair the chair and table.
Use spice on your jug of wine.
Use wheat on your empty pot.
Replace the pot and jug.
Run east and kill the shadow. Then light the enchanted sconces in the following order: south, north, west, east. Shadows will spawn and must be killed between each sconce lighting.
Return to the Queen's chamber and create the statue on the empty base, then carve it 2 times.
Talk to the Pharaoh Queen who has appeared in front of the table to give her the 2 papyri and the Scroll of Praise. (5)
Right-click check-progress on your scroll of the dead or pyramid journal to verify you've rebuilt the mummy 75%. Otherwise, check any parts missed. (Or 100% if you want to finish the mummy)
Talk to Leela in Draynor Village.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Amascut statue in Senliten's tomb, giving extra prayer points at the cost of some life points.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Experience earned while completing the mummy: 2,100 Cooking experience

Monk's Friend.name: Monk's Friend
items_required: A jug of water (you can buy a jug at the general stores in Port Khazard; there is a sink in a house to the south of the monastery)
Normal logs (there are plenty of trees nearby)

steps.text: Talk to Brother Omad on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] of the Monastery south of East Ardougne zoo. (1•✓)
Exit the monastery and head west to the location shown on the map, there is a circle of stones (visible on the minimap).
Stand in the circle of stones and climb down the ladder that appears. The stones are the same colour as the grass in high graphics modes, and are very easy to overlook.
Go south, enter the room with thieves, and grab the Child's blanket on the table to the east.
Return to the monastery and talk to Brother Omad. (1•1•2)

sections.heading: The party
sections.needed: Jug of water, logs

steps.text: North of the Monastery and near a crashed cart, Brother Cedric will be wandering around. Talk to him.
Talk to him again to give him a jug of water. (2)
Talk to him once more to give him one log.
Talk to Brother Omad.
Quest complete!
Pop a balloon for area task.

Mountain Daughter.name: Mountain Daughter
items_required: A plank (can be obtained during the quest)
A pole or any kind of staff (can be obtained during the quest)
A pair of leather gloves (most other gloves work too)
Five muddy rocks (can be obtained during quest around the camp)

steps.text: Run north of the Golden Apple Tree south-east of Rellekka (fairy ring code AJR).
Climb the cliffside to the north of the musician with a rope in your backpack.
Talk to Hamal the Chieftain in the nearby village. Ask him why everyone is so hostile and continue through all the dialogue; he will then offer the quest. (1•1•✓)
Walk south and Dig-below the Roots for a lump of Mud.
If you do not have a pole and a plank, go north of Hamal's house and pick up one of each.
Run north to the lake, then west along the edge.
Use the mud on the tall tree, climb it.
Use your staff/pole on the clump of rocks.
Use your plank on the flat stone.
Stand next to the pile of rocks and listen to one of the shining pools. (2•2•1•1)
Use your plank on the flat stone again. (1)
Talk to Hamal the Chieftain. (2•1)
Talk to Jokul in the goat farm to the north.
Talk to Svidi wandering near the Fremennik lodestone. (2)
Go to the longhall in Rellekka, talk to Brundt the Chieftain about the Mountain Camp. (1•~)
Mine the ancient rock in the mountain camp's southern tent.
Return to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. (1)
Give the safety guarantee to Svidi.
Make your way to White Wolf Mountain.

substeps.text: If you have completed The Grand Tree, teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, run north-west and click on "Glider Captain Dalbur" (2)

steps.text: Wearing leather gloves (or gauntlets), pick from the bush next to the gnome glider.
Eat the fruit.
Return to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp. (3•2)
Go to the centre of the lake and stand next to the pile of rocks.
Listen-to the shining pool again.
Jump-across the flat stone, falling into the water, and run east along the northern shore.
Chop down some of the small trees.
Enter the cave.

If you've not fully completed both tasks in the section above and gone through the dialogue completely, you'll receive a message referring to a stench that prevents you from entering the cave. Repeat the tasks until you're allowed to enter the cave.
Talk to the Kendal. (1•2•3•2•1)
Kill the Kendal.
Take the corpse of woman next to all the skeletons.
Return to Hamal the Chieftain. (2•1)
Take 5 muddy rocks from the camp. They can be found around the mud pond and in the goat pen north of the tent.
Talk to Ragnar by the lake for Asleif's necklace. (1)
Bury the corpse in the centre of the lake.
Use the rocks on the burial mound.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Mountain Camp without a rope (only requires partial completion)

Murder Mystery.name: Murder Mystery
items_required: An empty pot to fill during the quest, or 7 pots of flour if you prefer

steps.text: Talk to a guard on the Sinclair Mansion property which is located north of Camelot Castle. (✓)

substeps.text: You can use fairy ring CJR, then walk south-east to the mansion entrance.

steps.text: Inside the mansion, go to the crime scene in the room on the east side with the criminal's dagger and pungent pot on the floor.
Take the pungent pot and criminal's dagger and investigate the window to find a criminal's thread.
Search the barrels in the bedrooms owned by the following two suspects for two silver items.

substeps.text: If the thread is red, search the barrels belonging to Bob to the west and Carol upstairs for a silver cup and silver bottle.
If the thread is green, search the barrels belonging to Anna downstairs and David upstairs for a silver necklace and silver book.
If the thread is blue, search the barrels belonging to Elizabeth and Frank upstairs for a silver needle and silver pot.

steps.text: Fill the empty pots from the barrel of flour from the kitchen.
Go to the gardener's shed in the very north-west of the mansion and take three flypapers from the sack. (1)

substeps.text: You must click the sack 3 times.

steps.text: Use the pot of flour on the dagger.
Use the flypaper on the dagger to lift the fingerprint.
Repeat with the two silver objects.
Compare each fingerprint by using each suspect's print with the unknown print. The unknown print will then turn to the killer's print.
Go to the mansion's gate and talk to Gossip. (2)
Go to the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village and talk to the Poison Salesman (to get there quickly, teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone). (2)

substeps.text: Or if "The Fremennik Trials" is started or finished. (1•2)

steps.text: Return to the mansion and talk to the suspect with the matching fingerprint. (3)

substeps.text: Or if the player still has the criminal's thread with them (4)

steps.text: Find evidence. If your quest log says you have conclusive evidence and to talk to a guard, you may skip this step.

substeps.text: If the prints match Bob, search the beehive in the cow pen.
If the prints match Carol, search the drain on the wall directly north of the row of potatoes.
If the prints match Anna, search the compost heap.
If the prints match David, search the spider web upstairs between the two south rooms.
If the prints match Elizabeth, search the fountain.
If the prints match Frank, search the family crest on the outside of the manor building to the east of the entrance.

steps.text: Talk to a guard. (3)
Quest complete!

Murder on the Border.name: Murder on the Border
items_required: 24 limestone bricks to make stone wall segments
144 willow planks to make willow frames

steps.text: Talk to Aster in the Town Hall at Fort Forinthry. (1•1•✓•~•~)

sections.heading: Building the kitchen
sections.needed: 12 willow frames and 6 stone wall segments

steps.text: Talk to Bill about building the Kitchen. (1)
Check plans on the Fort Forinthry blueprints table near Bill and choose Kitchen (Tier 1).
Build the Kitchen located east of the Town Hall. (1)

sections.heading: The banquet
sections.recommended: Combat gear, food, and three empty backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to Aster. (1•1)
Click the light blue portal south of the well to start the cutscene. (1)
Watch the cutscene and welcome the guests as they arrive. (~•~•~•~)
Talk to three groups of guests in the Town Hall:

substeps.text: Any guest in the western room.
Any guest on 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US].
Any character in the central room. ground floor[UK]1st floor[US]. (~)

steps.text: Talk to Aster in the central room on ground floor[UK]1st floor[US]. (1)
Converse with the guests during the feast cutscene. (~•~•~)
Once the cutscene is completed, continue the conversation with Aster to obtain a mystery journal. (~)
(1/8) Go back to the Kitchen and investigate the nut roast located on a table in the southeast corner of the room.
(2/8) At the north-west part of the Fort, by the northern gates, investigate the strange satchel beside the rock (southeast of the guards). (~)
(3/8) Talk to Simon outside of the Town Hall (2)
(4/8) Investigate the half-buried box in the northeastern corner of the fort.
Detect the poison:

substeps.text: Investigate the strange satchel again and take a poison detection potion (base). (1•2)
Search the supply cupboard in the Kitchen and take a hollyhock. (1•4)
Use the hollyhock on the vial to create an unheated poison detection potion (hollyhock).
Heat the vial on the range.
(5/8) Use the poison detection potion (hollyhock) on the duke's meal (meat pâté) on the dining table. (2)

steps.text: (6/8) Talk to King Roald in the Chapel. (1•1•3)
(7/8) Go to the Command Centre and speak to Duchess Alba (2)
(8/8) Talk to Bianca outside the chapel (2)
Ascend to the top floor of the Town Hall and talk to Aster.
Fight the assassin.

substeps.text: If you die, Princess will kill the assassin for you.

steps.text: Talk to Aster after defeating the assassin.
Search the assassin's body for an assassin's letter then talk to Aster.
(1/8) Speak with anyone outside by the well. (1•~)
(2/8) Investigate the wax seal outside the northwestern corner of the Chapel.
(3/8) Speak to Iris in the Workshop (2)
(4/8) In the Town Hall, investigate the burnt parchment on the floor near the fireplace.
Find the unearthed coffer:

substeps.text: Talk to Princess, the dog, just east of the stonecutter outside the Workshop (2)
Go to the northwestern corner of the fort next to the ladder and speak to Princess. (Princess will follow you, you may have to take a wide way around to get her unstuck on corners.)
Investigate the miscellaneous items that appear.
Stand near Queen Ellamaria outside by the well, then speak to Princess again.
Stand at the altar in the chapel, then speak to Princess once again.
(5/8) Investigate the unearthed coffer (which may be underneath Aster, Princess, or your character).

steps.text: (6/8) Talk to Duchess Alba in the Command Centre. (1•2•~•3)
Talk to Rodney outside the Workshop and ask about Ellamaria. (1•2•3)
(7/8) Speak to Rodney again (2)
(8/8) Speak to Queen Ellamaria outside by the well and ask about being friends with Bianca. (1•2•4)
Talk to anyone in the courtyard. (~•~•~•~)
Identify the murderer as Bianca. (5•~)
Talk to King Roald. (1)
Talk to Aster in the Town Hall. (1•1•~)
Talk to Rodney in the Kitchen. (~)
Quest complete!

items: 8,000 Construction experience lamp (Skill must be level 40 or higher)
3,000 Skill experience lamp (Skill must be level 30 or higher)
The ability to build all three tiers of the Fort Forinthry Kitchen

My Arm's Big Adventure.name: My Arm's Big Adventure
items_required: Bucket (may be obtained during the quest)
Climbing Boots or rock climbing boots or Trollheim teleport
There is a Tool leprechaun available when and where the below items will be needed, and he sells them, so players will not need to carry these items with them for the duration of the quest.
Rake (can't be on the tool belt, may be obtained during the quest)
Seed dibber (can't be on the tool belt, may be obtained during the quest)
Spade (can't be on the tool belt, may be obtained during the quest)
Plant cure (or an additional supercompost; Cure Plant from the Lunar Spellbook will not work, may be obtained during the quest)

sections.heading: The adventurer
sections.recommended: Bring all items required for the next step

steps.text: Go to the Troll Stronghold, head south then downstairs into the kitchen.
Speak to Burntmeat. (✓•2)
Talk to My Arm, east of Burntmeat.

sections.heading: Getting the goutweed
sections.needed: Climbing boots, 3 buckets of Ugthanki dung, 7 buckets of supercompost, 1 empty bucket

steps.text: Travel to Burthorpe and head north-west past Troll Invasion.
Climb the rocks and head east past the thrower trolls to reach the Death Plateau.
Search the cooking pot to obtain a goutweedy lump.

substeps.text: If you receive the message "... but you can't reach very far into it.", use an empty bucket on the cooking pot.

steps.text: Return to the Troll Stronghold kitchen and speak to My Arm.
Once on the surface, talk to him near the farming patch.
Read the farming manual he gives you, then talk to him again.
Use the 3 buckets of ugthanki dung and 7 buckets of supercompost on the soil patch.
Talk to My Arm for a cutscene. (1)

sections.heading: Getting the tubers
sections.needed: At least 1 free inventory space to receive the gout tubers

steps.text: Talk to Captain Barnaby if you find yourself in Ardougne.
Talk to My Arm south-east of the Karamja lodestone. He is east of Jiminua's Jungle Store.
Talk to Murcaily, guarding the tree grove north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. (1)
A cutscene will play. Go through the dialogue.
Talk to My Arm south-east of the Karamja lodestone. Continue through the dialogue while on the boat.

sections.heading: Teaching a troll to farm
sections.needed: Spade, rake, hardy gout tubers, seed dibber, plant cure, combat equipment to fight a level 56 and 77
sections.recommended: supercompost

steps.text: Return to the roof of the Troll Stronghold where the soil patch was.
If you don't already have the farming tools, right-click talk to the Tool Leprechaun to buy some. (4)
Talk to My Arm.
Use the following items on him in order:

substeps.text: Rake (twice as he breaks it)
Pick up and use the rake head on the rake handle, give him the assembled rake again.
Supercompost (optional but recommended). Without supercompost, the patch may become diseased and require curing. Regular compost and ultracompost have no effect.
Hardy gout tubers
Seed dibber
If the patch becomes diseased, a plant cure

steps.text: Defeat the Baby Roc after the cutscene.
Make sure to have a spade or buy one from the tool leprechaun now, to avoid any extra steps after the next cutscene.
Talk to My Arm.
Defeat the Giant Roc that appears after the cutscene.
Talk to My Arm.
Use a spade on him.

substeps.text: If needed, you can get the leprechaun to come back by climbing the ladder down and up again.

steps.text: Return to Burntmeat in the stronghold's kitchen and talk to him.
Return to My Arm and speak with him.
Quest complete!

items: 5,000 Farming experience (as well as 495 more, when My Arm harvests the goutweed)
Access to a disease-free herb patch on top of the Troll Stronghold.
Giant Roc is unlocked in Dominion Tower.

Nature Spirit.name: Nature Spirit
items_required: Silver sickle (Can be made from a silver bar and a sickle mould or bought from the Grand Exchange. Not able to make unless part of the Nature Spirit quest has been completed. Talk to Filliman to obtain the ability to craft this.)

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.needed: Ghostspeak amulet

steps.text: Make sure you have prayer points before starting.

Talk to Drezel, who is located underground near Paterdomus. The entrance is north from the temple's door. You should have six empty backpack space; otherwise the food he gives you will appear on the floor.

substeps.text: If you have lost Wolfbane: (2•2•✓•4•1)
If you have Wolfbane in your bank or backpack: (2•✓•4•1)

If you have just completed Priest in Peril, then you might need to exit and reenter the Mausoleum before the quest dialogue will appear. Drezel should be standing in the last chamber before the holy barrier.

steps.text: Exit into Morytania and travel south to a fence.
Look along the fence for a gate and go through it.
Go south until a round island is found with a grotto tree.
Jump across the broken bridge and onto the island.
Search the bench nearby for a small mirror.
Search the grotto tree for Filliman's journal.
Equip your ghostspeak amulet and talk to Filliman Tarlock. (2•2•4)

substeps.text: He'll give you a druidic spell.

steps.text: Return to Drezel to be blessed and teleported back to Filliman.

substeps.text: If you have lost the wolfbane: (2•1)
If you have the wolfbane in your backpack or bank: (1)

steps.text: Jump the bridge and find a nearby rotting log in the swamp.

substeps.text: There is some directly West of the Grotto tree island.

steps.text: Cast the druidic spell in your backpack, then pick the fungus from the log.
Take the Mort myre fungus mushroom from the log and talk to Filliman.
Use the Mort myre fungus on the western, yellow stone.
Use a used spell on the eastern, grey stone.
Stand on top of the southern, orange stone in the centre by right-click selecting "Walk here".
Tell Filliman the puzzle is solved. (3)
Enter the Grotto tree.
Search the Grotto in the centre.
Continue speaking with Nature Spirit (4)

sections.heading: Killing the ghasts
sections.needed: Silver sickle, at least 1 prayer point

steps.text: Obtain a silver sickle via:

substeps.text: Purchasing it from the Grand Exchange.
Crafting one yourself:
Obtain a sickle mould from a Crafting shop or the Grand Exchange. You may add it to the tool belt.
Smelt at a furnace with a silver bar. Select "silver bar" under "Casting Metals & Glass" section on the interface, and then select the "silver sickle" option in the "Silver Casting" section.

steps.text: Return to the grotto either by speaking to Drezel (1)
Enter the grotto tree.
Talk to the Nature Spirit with a silver sickle in your backpack. He will bless it for a silver sickle (b).
Exit the grotto, jump the bridge into the swamp and stand next to the nearby rotting log.
Right-click Bloom the silver sickle (b) in your backpack. Blooming requires at least 1 prayer point.
Pick the fungi from the log. You will need at least 3 total fungi (ghasts can rot the contents of the pouch).
Fill the druid pouch in your backpack to add the fungi into it.
Invoke and kill 3 nearby ghasts, consuming 1 fungus per invocation.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: 3 backpack spaces

steps.text: If you drop anything to receive the rewards, it will be lost.
Return to the Nature Spirit in the grotto.
Quest complete!

sections.needed: Combat equipment and high-healing food

steps.text: Dwindle away Nomad's health, and move away from the centre of the bridge to avoid Gielinor's hand. Also move away from shadows that appear on the ground to avoid rapid powerful magic attacks. Use Surge if you can.
Stand in the middle of each of the three sections in the area and constantly use the 3 abilities made available. Move to the next one when one side is finished.

substeps.text: Use Fire Blast when Rorarii are present.
Use Shield Dome when Gladii are present.
Use Shadow Stalk when Scutarii are present.
Every time you attack a Capsarii, it will heal Xenia for a small amount.

steps.text: In addition to the previous phase's attacks, when Nomad teleports you near him and orders you to 'face his wrath', switch to your shield to use Resonance to negate any and all damage from the attack.
Go directly north, south, east and west of Gielinor. Each time provoking him and quickly getting out of the way, to then use Scythe on the hand, and finally claim the released spirit.
In addition to the previous phases' attacks, Nomad will create a clone of himself when he reaches half health. Kill them both (you might kill Nomad first, in which case you will move on).
Quickly and without stopping, run around the area anti-clockwise, releasing the souls as you get in the middle of a group of them. Make sure to get over half of the initial total number of spirits.
The more souls you release, the more powerful the attack reflected onto Gielinor will be.
Once all souls have been released, continue circling until Gielinor stops firing the beam, then shield yourself from Gielinor's attack with the ability, in order to reflect the damage onto Gielinor.
You will have to repeat this process a few times.

In this phase, Nomad will only be using rapid melee attacks. Kill him by any means. If using Ranged, Magic or Necromancy, then you can run around the room to avoid damage from Nomad, using Surge to gain distance. Watch out for Gielinor's attacks. Protect from Melee or Deflect Melee, especially combined with Devotion, can reduce or negate much of Nomad's damage in this phase, though the speed of his attacks can still be problematic.

substeps.text: Begin the encounter. Staying south of the moonstone conduits will make learning The Gate of Elidinis encounter easier.

Gather 25-40 moonstone fragments from nearby moonstone outcrops. Moonstone fragments provide 10% barrier strength per repair action on any of the moonstone conduits. Moonstone fragments also deal 7,500 damage per throw to summoned feline akhs by clicking on the feline akhs.

Repair any of the moonstone conduits located in the middle of the encounter with moonstone fragments until the barrier's strength reaches at least 30%. Staying south of the moonstone conduits will use their barrier strength to reduce the damage taken from each "Begone!" mechanic proportional to the barrier's strength. This mechanic also depletes up to 30% of the barriers strength.
Transmute any corrupt shard of Elidinis until it becomes a cleansed shard of Elidinis. Transmuting adds corruption stacks which increases the damage the player takes over time in the encounter.
Mine the cleansed shard of Elidinis to obtain cleansed statue shards.

Activate the action button once 10+ cleansed statue shards have been collected to ask Icthlarin for aid. This will spawn pillars to help the player jump up to The Gate of Elidinis, consuming all the cleansed statue shards on them and applying a damage bonus depending on how quick the player performed all the jumps. Corruption stacks decrease by the amount of cleansed statue shards consumed with the jump.

Stand within Icthlarin's protective shield after performing all the jumps. Icthlarin's shield will mitigate the incoming attack. The attack also depletes all the barrier strength from the moonstone conduits.

Keep collecting cleansed statue shards by transmuting corrupt shards of Elidinis and mining cleansed shards of Elidinis, using the action button as needed, repairing the moonstone conduits as needed, and clicking on summoned feline akhs to throw moonstone fragments at them.
