steps.text: Travel to Catherby and speak to Arhein on the docks. (General store owner, south of the lodestone) (3•1)

substeps.text: While here, purchase an empty pot from Arhein's Store.

steps.text: Go to Seers' Village and speak to Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight, south-east of the lodestone. (4•5•1)
Enter the Goblin Cave south-east of the fishing guild (teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run north).

substeps.text: Sometimes the cave is not marked on the minimap. It is just outside the fence opposite the fishing guild building near the windmill.

steps.text: Once inside, head north, then east where you find Petra Fiyed trapped in rock. Search the sculpture.
Go to Ardougne and speak to Wizard Cromperty, located north-east from the market. (4•2)
Pick up five full pigeon cages from the back yard of the first house south of the north-western bank in Ardougne. There are three cages that will respawn immediately.

Go to Port Khazard (teleport to Catherby and use a charter to Port Khazard or teleport to the Yanille lodestone, run east through town then north) and talk to Tindel Marchant on the southern pier. (2•1)

substeps.text: While you are here you can also speak to him about identifying swords for one of easy Ardougne achievements, They're Long and Pointy (1•1)

steps.text: Go to the Feldip Hills and talk to Rantz, located to the far east of fairy ring AKS. (1•4)
Go west to the gnome glider and right-click to talk to Gnormadium Avlafrim. (4•1)
For each of the 8 gnome landing lights immediately east:

substeps.text: Select the "Search" option on the gnome landing light to receive an uncut gem.
Cut the gem. If you crush one talk to the gnome to buy a replacement. (4•1)
Use the cut gem on the light it came from (from west to east is sapphire, opal, red topaz, jade).
Make sure to use them on the gnome landing light.

steps.text: Talk to the gnome again. (4)

sections.heading: Completing the favours
sections.needed: Armour and a weapon for the fight with Slagilith (weak to air spells), bronze bar, iron bar, steel bar, empty pot, and 5 pigeon cages

steps.text: Go back to Rantz to receive a comfy mattress. (1)
Take the mattress to Tindel in Port Khazard, who gives you iron oxide. (2)
Take the iron oxide to Wizard Cromperty in Ardougne, who gives you an animate rock scroll. (4)
Read Animate rock scroll in the Goblin Cave near the trapped Petra and kill Slagilith when it appears.
Read Animate rock scroll again, then talk to Petra.
Go to Seers' Village and speak to Phantuwti in his house. (4•4•2•2•1)
Access the roof via either the ladder on the north wall of Phantuwti's house, or the ladder in the building to the east (you have to go up two ladders to get to the roof).
Search the weather vane twice to get three broken vane parts.
With a bronze bar, an iron bar, and a steel bar, use each of the the parts of the weather vane on any anvil (there is an anvil just north of the house).
Go back to the roof of the house and put the weathervane pillar, the directionals and the ornament back.
Talk to Phantuwti again and he will give you the weather report. (4)
Take the report to Arhein in Catherby. (3)
Talk to Captain Bleemadge on the White Wolf Mountain. (2)
Talk to Sanfew in Taverley. (2)
Talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the Dwarven Mine. Kill his minions. Talk to him again.
Talk to Tassie Slipcast in Barbarian Village.
Form the unfired pot lid at the nearby potter's wheel.
Fire the pot lid in the pottery oven.
Use the pot lid on an empty pot to get an airtight pot.
Go to the apothecary in Varrock and give him the pot. (1•5)

substeps.text: Or if player has destroyed their Doctor's hat. (2•5)

steps.text: Go to Horvik (Varrock Platebody Shop) and give him the herbal tincture and breathing salts. (2•3)
Talk to him again with five pigeon cages to get some chicken cages. (2•3)
Go to Seth Groats in the house of the chickens' pen in Lumbridge and give him the chicken cages.
Go to the H.A.M. Hideout and talk to Johanhus. (4)
Go to Draynor Village and talk with Aggie the witch. (1)
Go to Port Sarim and talk with Brian in his axe shop (north-east of the lodestone), who gives you a sharpened hatchet. (3)
Go back to Shilo Village and speak with any jungle forester (closest fairy ring CKR), who gives you red mahogany logs in exchange for the hatchet. (4)
Speak with Yanni in Shilo Village. (2)
Quest complete!

items: 2 antique lamps giving 10,000 experience to any skill of your choice. Skill must be at least level 30.
Steel key ring (automatically added to the tool belt)
Ability to make Guthix rest potions
Access to the gnome glider route to the Feldip Hills
Adamantite stone spirit, an uncut ruby and an uncut diamond dropped by Slagilith
1,000 Smithing experience from repairing the weather vane components

steps.text: Talk to Grand Vizier Hassan in the Merchant district, south of the bank deposit box. (1•✓)

sections.heading: The bloodline
sections.recommended: Combat gear and food, Pollnivneach Teleport, 1 free backpack space

steps.text: Go to the Grand Library of Menaphos in the Imperial district. The entrance is next to the deposit box (bank chest).
Talk to Kohnen the librarian, who is just north of the entrance. (1)
Exit the Grand Library.
Head north to talk to Commander Akhomet. (1•2)
Head to Pollnivneach.
Speak to Aristarchus, who is north-west of the south magic carpet station. (1)
You will have to fight four Menaphite Thugs.

substeps.text: They are level 122 and fight using melee.
You can hide behind Aristarchus if you need a safe spot and are using ranged/magic/necromancy.

steps.text: Speak to Aristarchus again who will agree to meet you in the library. (1)
Return to the Grand Library and speak to Aristarchus, who is south of the entrance inside the library.
Go to Uzer Mastaba and enter the pyramid to trigger a cutscene. (fairy code DLQ)
After the cutscene, enter the pyramid once more and speak to Senliten. (4•4•2)
Go to Al Kharid and speak to Osman, who is in the throne room, south of the lodestone.
Speak to Emir Ali Mirza in front of the throne. (1)

sections.heading: Tracking down Jabari
sections.recommended: Have the 'remove roofs' setting set to 'selectively' in your graphics settings

steps.text: Leave the Palace and head north-east to Dommik's Crafting Store.

substeps.text: Ignore the quest active area marked on the minimap.

steps.text: Climb the stairs on the inside of the crafting store.
Climb the ladder south of the stairs.
Follow these steps across the rooftops:

substeps.text: Walk across the plank to the south.
Slide down the awning to the south.
Go through the building.
Walk across the washing line (north-west from where you started).
Climb the ladder to the west.
Talk to Jabari.
Cross the planks to the west.
Climb the ladder to the southwest.
Jump from the scaffold to the west.
Climb down the rug to the south.
Swing across the wooden frame immediately west.
Jump from the scaffold (west) to the next building.
Bounce on the awning (south) to the bank.
Climb up the brickwork to the west on the wall.
Talk to Jabari.
Parrot drop on the rug to the south.
Do not shimmy across the rope.
Run north of the bank, west of the furnace, and talk to Jabari.
Run north-east of the Al Kharid lodestone into a tent, and talk to Jabari.
Run north to the house near the north-east exit of Al Kharid, and talk to Jabari.
You can get a free heal from the Surgeon General west of this house.

steps.text: Go to Het's Oasis.

sections.heading: Fighting Jabari
sections.needed: Combat equipment and food

steps.text: Prepare to battle Jabari four times. He is level 112 and uses magic. He has a weakness to slash.
Talk to Jabari. (1)
Jabari will teleport you into the centre of the arena, surrounding you with his clones.

substeps.text: Choosing the wrong Jabari will cause an explosion that damages the player and scales with level.
Find the real Jabari by attacking the odd one out. As it is random for each player, it could be any of these:
The only one facing backwards.
The only one in attack position.
The one with the smallest sceptre.
The largest one of them.
The one targeted by the audience.
The one with the correctly spelled name.
The one with a different robe colour.
The one without prayer renewal particles.
The one who is not translucent.

steps.text: Talk to Het.
Talk to Emir Ali Mirza, in the Al Kharid throne room. (1)
After the cutscene, talk to Emir Ali Mirza again. (1)
Quest complete!

items: Relic of Het, gives 9625 reputation with a faction in Menaphos of your choice when handed in to a faction leader.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: With level 80 Strength, right click the ground directly behind the Statue of Het and select "Pry open Hidden Door" to access the Het tomb containing: Het mask
20,000 Strength experience for accessing the tomb for the first time

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Tale of Het (after the quest in The Golden Scarab Inn)

Perils of Ice Mountain.name: Perils of Ice Mountain
items_required: 1 watering can (with water, magic watering can from tool belt works as well)
2 nails of any metal (Non-members must use steel nails or lower)

steps.text: Talk to Lakki the delivery dwarf, who can be found to the east of the Invention Guild, north of Falador. (1•2•✓)
Along the path west towards Falador are eight bushes you can search. Search each of them until a crate is found.
Give the crate to Drorkar, who is in the Power Station west of the Dwarven Mines. (1•2)
Head to the Edgeville Monastery (use the Edgeville lodestone to save time).
Give the letter to Brother Bordiss in the garden. (1)
Talk to Brother Althric. (2•1)
Use compost on the dying roses, then water them. If your watering can is empty, you may use the fountains in the monastery to fill it.
Talk to Professor Arblenap (the gnome) half way up to the top of Ice Mountain. (1•2)
Wield the icefiend net and catch the four baby icefiends.
Talk to Professor Arblenap.
Talk to the Oracle, who is just north on the mountain. (1•1)
Take the wrecked tent from the base of the mountain, south of the Black Knights' Fortress entrance and east of the Oracle. It does not appear as a red dot on the minimap.
With the tent, two planks, and two nails, use the tent on the remains atop the mountain, next to the Oracle.
Continue dialogue with the Oracle. (5)
Talk to Drorkar at the Power Station. (1•4•4)
Pickpocket Drorkar for a Dwarven key.
Go in the Dwarven Mines and talk to Nurmof in the north-western corner of the mines, at the pickaxe shop. (4•1•3)
Talk to Brother Bordiss at the Edgeville Monastery. (1)
Head back down into the Dwarven Mines, then immediately east into a small alcove.
Open the small, bright chest against the north wall.
Return to the pickaxe shop and talk to Nurmof. (4•1)
Quest complete!

items: Knowledge of Ice Mountain, which grants experience in 4 skills: 500 Farming experience

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Icy Trouble Ahead (Unlocked during the third cutscene)
Icy a Worried Gnome (Unlocked after the second cutscene)

steps.text: Talk with Leela outside of the northern gates of Menaphos. (✓•2)
Empty your backpack, worn equipment and dismiss any followers and then head to the throne room inside the Golden Palace. (1)
Talk to anyone inside to begin the conversation. (~)

sections.heading: A shifting perspective
notes: You will take increasing amounts of bleed damage while in the tombs. If you die, you will spawn in the centre of Menaphos and must re-enter the Golden Palace to try again. Your progress will not be saved. It is not known if this death is safe for Hardcore Ironman Mode players. You can regenerate life points inside with the Persistent Rage relic power.
It is possible to generate a Shifting Tomb without all resources present (e.g. chests or sarcophagi). If you do, you have to lobby and restart.

steps.text: Attempt to exit the shifting tomb via the rope.
Search the arrow shafts to receive a mysterious message and a spare arrow shaft.
Read the mysterious message.
Speak to the four cats (indicated by yellow dots on your minimap) to receive a curved bone:

substeps.text: Bestopet
Katarina
Shebit
Takhuit

steps.text: Mine crystalline corruption to obtain crystal shards.
Search treasure chests to obtain feathers.
Smash urns to obtain a gut string.
Search sarcophagi to obtain mouldy bandages. To do this, click on the panels the energy bounces off in the order of which it started.
Use the gut string on the curved bone to create a fragile bow.
Use the feathers on the spare arrow shaft to create a feathered spare arrow shaft.
Use the crystal shards on the feathered spare arrow shaft to make a scrappy arrow.
Stand next to the arrow shafts where the exit rope was, then fire arrow with the bow in your backpack.
Exit the rope.
Talk to Ozan.
Talk to Commander Akhomet outside the northern gates of Sophanem. (~•2•5)
Talk to the following people:

substeps.text: Maisa next to the High priest in Sophanem.
Grand Vizier Hassan in the south-west building of the Menaphos merchant district. (1)
Lydia in Pollnivneach, south-east of Sumona.
Emir Ali Mirza in the Al Kharid palace. (1)

steps.text: Talk to Ozan back in the Shifting Tombs lobby. (1)
Exit the tomb west to the Imperial district. (1)
Sneak past the guards and enter the library.

substeps.text: Head north and around the edge of the pool towards the VIP skilling area.
Go west and go behind the two guards near the Golden Palace.
Head south to the library, going behind the stationary guards. Be careful of the roaming guards who can still catch you.

steps.text: Talk to Ozan for a cutscene, and finish the dialogue to get the signal torch.
Go south and make your way to the staircase on the south side, avoiding the guard.
Stand halfway down the stairs and use the signal torch in your backpack.
Head a bit west and talk to Leela to have her follow you (you will be able to continue the next step if she gets stuck).
Continue to the bottom floor using the eastern stairs and talk to Ozan. (~)
Speak to Leela or Ozan on the Sophanem beach. (~)
Head to the throne room inside the Golden Palace. (1)
Talk to each of the members to turn the bar over their heads red. Exhausting all chat options is not required.

substeps.text: Grand Vizier Ehsan. (2•4•1)
'Admiral' Wadud. (2•1•1)
Commander Akhomet. (2•3•2)

steps.text: Re-enter the Golden Palace (1)
Talk to Pharaoh Leela.
Quest complete!

items: Agility XP lamp (60,000 Agility experience; requires level 50)
Thieving XP lamp (60,000 Thieving experience; requires level 70)
The following passive effects: 20% less damage from Corrupted Scarabs and soul obelisks.
5% boost to the number of runes created at the soul altar, plus a 5% experience boost.
2.5x increase to reputation gain in Menaphos.
4% extra chance to save a feather of Ma'at.
5% increase in ushabti catch rate (regular and cursed).
10% increase in experience and movement ability cooldown halved in the Shifting Tombs. (Stacks with Shadow's Grace or Mobile, resulting in a cooldown of 5.4 seconds.)
Improved drop rates for objects needed for Jewels of the Elid and Insects of the Desert.

Plague City.name: Plague City
items_required: 4 buckets of water (can be obtained during the quest)

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.needed: Dwellberries, rope

steps.text: Talk to Edmond who is located at a house north of the Ardougne Castle and Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne. (1•✓)
Talk to his wife Alrena directly east in the house and give her the dwellberries.
Pick up the picture of Elena from the table in the eastern room of their house.
Talk to Edmond.
Equip the gas mask.
In his garden, use all 4 buckets of water on the mud patch in the south part of his garden, between the cabbages and potatoes.

Bring all of the required items with you before you enter the mud patch. Once inside the city, there is no bank nearby. If you leave the city, you will need to re-enter the mud patch and climb through the pipe to return.
Dig the mud patch.
Go south and try to open the grill on the pipe.
Use a rope on the grill and talk to Edmond.
Make sure the gas mask obtained earlier is equipped and climb up the pipe.
Use the picture on Jethick, who is found walking around the town square, and tell him that you will help return the book. (1)

substeps.text: Optional: Talk to the nearby Recruiter for one of easy Ardougne achievements, Red Revolution.

steps.text: Talk to Martha Rehnison or Ted Rehnison (speak to both) in their house, north of the town hall building.
Go up the ladder and talk to Milli Rehnison.
Exit the house and go south of the town square.

substeps.text: Optional: Pray at the altar in the church for one of easy Ardougne achievements, Preaching to the Infected.

steps.text: Go to the central southern house with spooky stairs and attempt to open one of the doors with a big X. (1•2)

sections.heading: Getting to Elena
sections.needed: Chocolate dust, bucket of milk, snape grass

steps.text: Go north to the large building you first arrived at, in the town square.
Talk to the Clerk on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US], and tell him it's urgent. (2•1)
Climb the stairs and enter the eastmost room.
Talk to Bravek. (1•3)
Add the chocolate dust to the bucket of milk and then add snape grass to make a hangover cure.
Talk to Bravek and give him the cure. (3)
Go back and enter the house with the black Xs.
Search the barrel on the western side of the building's ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] to obtain a small key.
Go down the stairs, open the gate and talk to Elena.
Return to the town square you arrived at, and re-enter the manhole.
Talk to Edmond.
Quest complete!

items: A magic scroll, which when read unlocks the Ardougne Teleport with level 51 Magic
Ability to make and use an Ardougne teletab

Priest in Peril.name: Priest in Peril
items_required: 50 rune essence or 25 pure essence (the essence must be un-noted)

steps.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace. (2•✓)
Go to the temple in Silvarea which is east of the earth altar.

substeps.text: Players with an invitation box can teleport twice to arrive outside the temple.

steps.text: Knock at the large door of the temple. (2•1•1)
Go north and enter the mausoleum.
Kill Cerberus.
Teleport to Varrock.
Talk to King Roald. (1)

sections.heading: Making things right
sections.needed: A bucket

steps.text: At this time you can bring the 25 unnoted pure essence to save a trip later.
Enter the Temple and kill a level 23 Monk of Zamorak to obtain a golden key.
Go outside and enter the Mausoleum to the north and through the gate.
Study the monuments.
Use the golden key on the one that has the iron key.
Fill a bucket with water from the well in the centre of the monument room.

sections.heading: Saradomin's blessing
sections.needed: Iron key, bucket of murky water, and 50 unnoted rune essence or 25 unnoted pure essence

steps.text: Go back to the temple and climb to the top floor.
Use the iron key on the cell door and talk to Drezel.
Use the bucket of blessed water on the Morytania coffin.
Return to the mausoleum, enter the monument room, and speak with Drezel.
Talk to him again to give him 50 unnoted rune essence or 25 unnoted pure essence.
Quest complete!

items: Talk to Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum to receive 5 Kudos

items_required: Raw meat (raw beef is obtainable during the quest)
A hammer (tool belt will not work)
2 wool (not ball of wool, not season wool)

steps.text: Talk to Rodney in the kitchen of Fort Forinthry. (1•✓)

substeps.text: If Princess does not follow you, talk to Princess one square west of Rodney. (1)

steps.text: Talk to Aster at Fort Forinthry (1•1)
Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre (2)
Exit the Command Centre and stand west of it, just by the wooden barrels.
Talk to Princess to obtain a lost sausage.
Talk to the Cook in the Jolly Boar Inn. (1)
Head north to the Wilderness wall just outside the inn and talk to Princess to obtain a half-eaten meat pie.
Go to the small cabbage patch south of the Blue Moon Inn within Varrock and talk to Princess.
After the cutscene, talk to Princess again. Pick up the raw beef nearby if you don't have one.

sections.heading: Preparing a meal
sections.needed: Bowl of water, raw salmon, raw meat, and a hammer (tool belt does not work)

steps.text: Get the ingredients for the dinner:

substeps.text: Use a hammer on raw meat to obtain tenderised meat.
Pick the redberry bush south of Varrock, near the elder tree. (2)
With a free inventory space, talk to Gertrude in her house about the secret ingredient. (4)
If you have started Rat Catchers, (5)
Use the raw salmon on the range in Gertrude's house to make a gently smoked salmon. (2)

steps.text: Use a bowl of water on any of the ingredients to make an uncooked dog's dinner.
Cook the uncooked dog's dinner on the range to obtain an unseasoned dog's dinner.
Use the finest doogle leaves on it to make a perfect dog's dinner.
Talk to Princess to show her the completed perfect dog's dinner.
Go back to the cabbage patch near the south entrance of Varrock and talk to Princess there. She will lead you back in the direction of the Jolly Boar Inn.
Go back to the Jolly Boar Inn. Stand inside, west of the kitchen, and talk to Princess. (1)
After the cutscene, talk to Princess.
Go directly north, and talk to the stray dog outside the inn (the dog is just south of the wilderness wall).
Talk to Rodney at Fort Forinthry. (1)

sections.heading: Building a doghouse
sections.needed: 2 wooden frames, 6 planks, 10 steel nails, 2 bolts of cloth and 2 wool

steps.text: Talk to Bill. (1)
Talk to Bill again with the materials in the backpack. (1)
Choose a name for the dog to finish the quest. (~)

items: Cooking XP lamp (1,000 Cooking experience - requires level 25)
Construction XP lamp (1,000 Construction experience - requires level 25)
A new dog in the Fort Forinthry household

Rag and Bone Man.name: Rag and Bone Man
items_required: 8 core logs of any type (can be collected during quest, eternal magic logs does not work)
A rope (needed to get into Lumbridge Swamp Cave if you haven't placed a rope there before, unless you have started The Lost Tribe)

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.needed: one or more empty pots (can be reused)

steps.text: Talk to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea. (1•✓)
Go to Draynor Village market and talk to Fortunato about the quest (do not steal from the stalls before talking to him, as you won't be able to initiate the conversation for a couple of minutes). (2)
Buy 8 jugs of vinegar.
Use the jugs of vinegar on your empty pots.
Gather and use each bone listed below on the pots of vinegar.
Obtain the bones. Use the table below as a reference.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: 8 core logs of any type (eternal magic logs does not work)

steps.text: Go back to the Odd Old Man's hut.
Add logs, then a pot of bones to the pot boiler, and light it. Collect the bone when it finishes boiling after 12 seconds (hopping worlds will skip the boiling).
Repeat for the remaining bones.
Talk to the Odd Old Man.

Talk to Laniakea, south-east in the ruins on Anachronia. (2•✓•1•3)

substeps.text: She is also at the ruins around the lodestone but she tells you to go to the south-east and talk to her there.

steps.text: Run west, up to the top of the stairs.
Siphon the shadow anima pools until you reach 100%.

steps.text: Unlock the door.
Talk to Zaros.

Recruitment Drive.name: Recruitment Drive
items_required: Store all equipment and anything in your inventory to be able to start the puzzles

steps.text: Teleport to Falador.
Go to the White Knights' Castle, and head up to the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of the western tower.
Talk to Sir Amik Varze. (2•✓)
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien without any items equipped or in the inventory. He can be found in the Falador Park. (3)
Optionally, sit on the bench next to Sir Tiffy Cashien to complete the achievement: Tiffy Time.
In this room there will be eleven statues when there should be twelve. The goal is to study the statues then, when the twelfth one is returned, pick the one that was originally missing.

substeps.text: Easy method: look for the colour (bronze, silver, gold) of statue that only has 2 statues instead of 3, then note which weapon of that colour is missing out of the 4 possibilities (sword, halberd, great axe, or mace.)
Alternative method: the moment it shows 12 statues, take a screenshot. Then open the screenshot and compare which was missing and click it.

steps.text: Find the statue that wasn't there originally and touch it.
As a female character, kill Sir Leye.

substeps.text: If you have not visited the Makeover Mage before starting the quest, you can change your gender via the Customisation interface, under the Appearance tab.
Low level players are encouraged to use Legacy Combat Mode as the life points range won't be as high, thus, quickly ending the fight.

steps.text: In this room, the chicken, grain, and the fox must all be transported to the other side of the bridge in a specific order.
Take the chicken across and put it down. In order to put down an object, open your equipment panel and click on the equipped object.
Take the fox across and put it down. Grab the chicken and return back.
Drop the chicken and take the Grain across.
Drop the grain and return back.
Take the chicken across and drop it.
Search the most south-western bookshelf for a knife.
Search all four of the most southern shelves with vials, take all of them.
Search the north-eastern middle-sized crate next to the chest for a tin.
Search the four northern shelves for the remaining vials, take all of them.
Pick up the metal spade on the table.
Use the metal spade on the bunsen burner in the room.
Use the metal spade on the door.
Use cupric sulphate on the door.
Use a vial of liquid on the door.
Pull on the spade to open the door.
Use the gypsum on the tin.
Use a vial of liquid on the tin.
Use the tin on the key chained to the south-western wall.
Use the cupric ore powder on the tin.
Use the tin ore powder on the tin.
Heat the tin on the bunsen burner.
Use a knife, bronze wire, or chisel on the tin.
Walk-through the open first door.
Unlock the door with the bronze key.
Talk to Sir Ren Itchood.
The first letter of each line he says is the answer to the door's lock.

sections.needed: 5 cooked fish, butterfly net, teasing stick or ferret, vial, antisanguine (3)

steps.text: Go to Anya's camp, south-east of the Shrine of Inanna (fairy ring BKS), and talk to Anya. (1)
Head north-west and talk to Shrine Tender Joanna to receive a blessed rabbit snare and a spirit jar. (1)
South-east of Anya's camp, talk to Mossbrain at the goblin camp. (1)
Talk to him again with 5 cooked fish to receive the offering bowl. (1)
Go to Highweald Forest, north of Wendlewick, and search a hollow tree (found at the Hunter icons on the minimap) to spawn spirit moths.
With your butterfly net equipped, catch 5 spirit moths.
Go to Jackalope burrow, south-west of the Shrine of Inanna, lay the blessed rabbit snare and, using your teasing stick, flush the jackalope burrows until you catch a Jackalope.

substeps.text: The easiest method is to lay the snare directly in front of a burrow and spam-clicking another burrow.

steps.text: Go back and talk to Shrine Tender Joanna. (1)
Pray at the Altar of Inanna to enter Inanna's Den. (1)
Talk to Inanna. (2•3)
Talk to Anya to receive a vial of blood.
Go to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Wendlewick lighthouse and talk to Esther. (1•~•2)
Combine your antisanguine (3) potion with the vial of blood. (3)
Return to Inanna's den and use the empowered antisanguine on Inanna.
Talk to Inanna. (~•1)
Go back and talk to Sorrel. (~•~)

substeps.text: Make sure to have 6 backpack spaces, or you will have to go grab Anya and Inanna again and walk back (If Inanna vanishes, using the Wendlewick lodestone may respawn her).

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: Combat XP lamp (requires level 30 in the chosen skill; grants 2,500 experience in one of: Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, Prayer or Necromancy)
Construction XP lamp (requires level 30 Construction; grants 2,500 Construction experience)
Herblore XP (requires level 35 Herblore; grants 2,500 Herblore experience)
Hunter XP lamp (requires level 32 Hunter; grants 2,500 Hunter experience)
Summoning XP lamp (requires level 30 Summoning; grants 2,500 Summoning experience)
Access to Amberfell and the Moonrise Temple

Shades of Mort'ton.name: Shades of Mort'ton
items_required: 2 or more vial of water (can be obtained during quest)
2 or more ashes (can be obtained during quest)
2 or more clean tarromin (obtained during quest but this is a rather uncommon drop, so bringing extra tarromin is recommended.)
A pile of logs (can be gathered during quest)
1,000 or more coins to buy resources

steps.text: Enter the south-western ruined house in Mort'ton.

substeps.text: Teleport to Canifis and run south-west to the gate of the swamp (must have Nature Spirit quest started), and then head to Mort'ton.
Teleport to fairy ring BKR and then run south by south-east to where the map says the Hollows, to find a rowboat that takes you there.
Alternatively use Drakan's medallion to teleport to the Barrows and run west.

steps.text: Search the shelf on the wall and read the diary. (✓)

substeps.text: If you do not find it, it's probably already in your bank.

steps.text: (Optional) Chop three swamp trees nearby and burn two logs to get the ashes.

substeps.text: If you have an Underworld Grimoire equipped make sure to disable the auto-storage function, otherwise your ashes will be sent to the bank.

steps.text: (Optional) Pick up the vials (on the ground near the shelf) and search the smashed table for extra tarromin and one grimy rogue's purse.
Make vials of water by using the empty vials on the sink nearby.
Make Serum 207 by adding clean tarromin and ashes to a vial of water.
Use it on Razmire (afflicted) in the general store. (4•1)
Kill five Loar Shades and pick up their remains. Be sure to talk to Razmire first. They can be safespotted using the rocks south west of the waypost in the middle of town.
Give him the remains. He may require more Serum 207.
Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy, located in the house east of the general store.
Wait a minute and ask him about the remains and the temple. (1•2•5)
Talk to Razmire. (3•2•4•1)
Buy at least one olive oil from his general store and optionally a Flamtaer hammer.
Open his builders' store.
Buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, 25 swamp paste.
Hop to World 88 which is the official world for this minigame.
Head north-east and kill shades or repair the temple to increase your sanctity.
Repair the temple until you reach 100% and at least 20 sanctity.
Light the sacred altar in the centre of the temple.

For solo questers: Shade luring dummies can be used to distract the Loar Shades when repairing the temple. Using the Flamtaer bracelet, the solo player can instantly create the temple walls section by section, until at 100%.
Use your olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil.
(Optional) Use Serum 207 on the flame to make Serum 208, which permanently cures NPCs.
(Optional) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire and Ulsquire in the houses nearby to permanently cure them.
Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.
Head to south-western Mort'ton to the Funeral Fires (do not cross the river to the west). The Funeral Fires appear as black crosshairs on the minimap on the western part of the Mort'ton.
Use the Pyre Log to light the fire, then use the Loar Remains to sacrifice them on the funeral pyre.
Talk to Ulsquire.
Quest complete!

items: A few hundred coins if the player uses Serum 208 on Razmire and Ulsquire
Ability to create Serum 207 and Serum 208
Ability to play the Shades of Mort'ton minigame, burn shades, and claim the rewards from the shade keys.
Players can take the diary of Herbi Flax to the Apothecary in Varrock who will exchange the book for 335 Herblore experience. This can only be done once.

Shadow of the Storm.name: Shadow of the Storm
items_required: Silverlight (If you do not have the sword, it can be re-obtained during the quest)
Empty vial (To dye Silverlight/clothing black if you have not done so already)
3 pieces of a black outfit (see Blending into the dark; you can also dye the desert robe and desert shirt during the quest for two of the pieces)
The strange implement (If lost, it can be re-obtained during the quest)

steps.text: Talk to Father Reen south of Al Kharid bank. (✓)

substeps.text: He will give you Silverlight if you've dyed or destroyed it.

steps.text: Talk to Father Badden at Uzer, east of Shantay Pass. (Optional: take the magic carpet to Uzer) (1•3•1)

Pick and grind a black mushroom (the closest is just south-east of the stairs east of Father Badden). Use it to dye Silverlight black. You can find some beside the staircase, downstairs east of the stairwell, or in the north east corner of the room, east of Evil Dave.
Go down the stairs.

substeps.text: If you do not have the strange implement from The Golem quest, you can pick it up from the ground in the northwest room.

steps.text: Talk to Evil Dave wearing your three black items and your dyed Silverlight. He is standing at the entrance to Agrith Naar's demonic temple in the underground Uzer ruins. (2•1)
Talk to Denath. (4)
Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. (2)
Talk to Matthew. (3)
Go to any furnace and smelt a demonic sigil. (1)

substeps.text: Your black outfit can be discarded at this point and replaced with combat gear. Keep Silverlight for the duration of the quest.

steps.text: Talk to the clay golem outside the ruins about last night. (3)

Look in the nearby Broken kilns for a book until you have found the Demonic tome (there's a broken kiln north of the Rug Merchant and one behind the walls east of the staircase that are easy to miss).
Talk to Matthew back in the lair.
Go north to talk to Denath and write down the incantation he tells you. (4)
Complete the circle and click the sigil to chant the incantation. Be sure to remember it, as you’ll need it again later in the quest.
Be sure to take the sigil from the floor, or you will have to make a new one at a furnace.
Enter the portal and take Tanya's sigil.
Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair - you should have 4 sigils now. (2)
Go up the stairs, talk to Father Badden and Father Reen. (3)
Talk to the golem. (4)
Return to the throne room downstairs.
Talk to Matthew to start the incantation. (1)
Form the circle and Chant demonic sigil and say the incantation in reverse. (If you have forgotten the incantation, it can be found on page 6 of the demonic tome.)
Kill the demon with the Silverlight (dyed). After defeating it, you will have the Darklight equipped.

substeps.text: You can damage the demon with any combat style, but you must equip the Silverlight (dyed) as it dies.

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: 10,000 Combat experience, as a combat XP lamp, in one of: Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic or Necromancy
Demonic sigil (can be used to chant any number of times even after the quest)

Silverlight turns into Darklight: It is even more powerful against demons. If a player loses Darklight, it can be retrieved by talking to Gideon Bede at Varrock's north church. You must have him replace Silverlight for you first.

steps.text: Talk to Councillor Halgrive south of the Ardougne church and north of the zoo. (1•✓)
Talk to Doctor Orbon inside the church and buy a pair of clothes for 100 coins. (2•2)
Return to the lodestone and go west until you reach the fenced enclosure with a stone building and incinerator (looks like a furnace). It is south of the fishing guild.
Equip the plague jacket and trousers and enter the gate.
Pick up the cattleprod inside the stone enclosure, equip it.
Prod 1 of each colour sheep in and through the incinerator pen's gate. If the sheep are stuck, simply switch worlds.
Enter the pen and use the sheep feed on each of them.
Take all 4 bones, then use them on the incinerator.
Return to Councillor Halgrive.
Quest complete!

items: 3,100 coins (reimbursement for plague set, and 3,000 coins as reward)

Shilo Village.name: Shilo Village
items_required: 3 regular bones (can be obtained during quest by killing level 44–46 skeletal undead ones)
Can be bought from Jiminua's Jungle Store (the general store north-west of Tai Bwo Wannai):
A chisel (the tool belt will not work for certain parts)
A torch (or any other light source, such as a lantern can be used, but be aware that you WILL lose this item)

steps.text: Teleport to Karamja (shortest teleport is CKR) and run far south/southeast to the southeast corner of Shilo Village.
Speak to Mosol Rei near the Broken cart. (1•1•1•4•✓)
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone and run southeast to Trufitus, northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai Village, west of the hardwood grove.
Use the belt on Trufitus. Tell him you're going to search for "Ah Za Rhoon". (2•1•3•1)

substeps.text: If you don't yet have a chisel, a rope and torch, you should get those now from Jiminua's Jungle Store. You may also craft bronze wire at the nearby anvil.

sections.heading: The mound
sections.needed: Torch and rope

steps.text: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, cross a wooden log and then head south to the mound of earth surrounded by three dead trees, Ah Za Rhoon.
Search the mound of earth and select excavate. (1)
Use a lit torch on the fissure.

substeps.text: To obtain a lit torch, light the torch in the backpack.

steps.text: Use a rope on the fissure.
Search the fissure, climb down. (1)
Search the cave in (see map) and wiggle through the rocks to proceed to the second area. (1)
After wiggling through, follow along the west side of the wall and search the loose rocks against the northwestern wall for a tattered scroll. (1)

substeps.text: You might fail and take damage, retry until you succeed.

steps.text: Search the old sacks in the far southeast corner for a crumpled scroll.
Search the ancient gallows to the north for the Zadimus corpse. (2)
Read the scroll. (1)
Use the Karamja lodestone/Tai Bwo Wannai teleport to get back to Trufitus.
Use the tattered scroll and crumpled scroll on Trufitus.
Use the Zadimus corpse on Trufitus.
Ask about the sacred ground. (1)
Walk west to the nearby Tribal Statue. Bury the corpse then talk to the Spirit of Zadimus for the bone shard.
Use the bone shard on Trufitus. (1•1•1)
Talk to Trufitus. (2)

sections.heading: Cairn Island
sections.needed: Chisel, bronze wire (or a bronze bar to make the wire), and three backpack spaces

steps.text: Head southwest to Cairn Isle by climbing the rocks and going across the bridge. Be careful, you can sometimes fall - use the Surge ability to bypass this.
Search the well stacked rocks to the north to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. If you fail search again until you are able to enter. (1)
Inside, run south and search the tomb dolmen to receive three items: sword pommel, locating crystal, and Bervirius notes.

substeps.text: If you do not have enough space the notes will drop on the ground.

steps.text: Read all 3 options on the Bervirius notes.
Use the chisel on the sword pommel to create bone beads (the chisel on the tool belt will not work).
Use the bone beads on the bronze wire to create beads of the dead.

substeps.text: You can make the bronze wire from a bronze bar at an anvil near Trufitus.

sections.heading: Rashiliyia's Tomb
sections.needed: Chisel, bone shard, beads of the dead, and 3 regular bones (can be obtained from monsters in cave)
sections.recommended: Combat equipment and food, three forms are weak to fire spells

steps.text: Travel east of Trufitus' hut, over the agility log and run north, to the general area of The Shaikahan.
Search the foliage, then attempt to open the Ancient Door. (See the map for the location.)
Use a chisel on the bone shard.
Equip the beads of the dead.
Use the bone key on the door to open it.
Open the ancient metal gate.
Climb down the rock.
Run to the south west corner and use 3 bones on the tomb doors. Be careful not to bury them instead.
Open the doors and search the tomb dolmen.
Kill all 3 forms of Nazastarool. The stalagmites to the east of the tomb dolmen can be used as a safe spot.
Search the tomb dolmen again for a Rashiliyia corpse.
Travel back to the Tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle.
Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the tomb dolmen.
Quest complete!

items: Access to Precious gem rocks in Shilo Village
Access to the Shilo Village cart system, which travels between Brimhaven and Shilo Village for a fare of 10 coins

After completing the quest, you can sell every item you obtained during the quest to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for 2,000 coins — 100 coins each for the stone-plaque, tattered scroll, crumpled scroll, Bervirius notes and the bone key, 500 coins for the locating crystal, and 1,000 coins for the beads of the dead.

steps.text: Talk to Mr Mordaut at the Anachronia base camp. (1•1•✓)
Talk to either Eliza or Alpheus south of the lodestone. (1)
Exit Anachronia base camp to the north down the stairs, not via the Agility shortcut.
Continue north up the first set of stairs and investigate the bottom part of the dragonkin statue to your immediate west.

substeps.text: If a message appears telling you to complete this very quest, go back to the open area between the two flights of stairs (by the entrance to Kerapac's laboratory until you trigger a dialogue about something "out of place".
You must also trigger another dialogue in front of the statue itself about the statue looking different before you can enter the statue.

steps.text: Enter the door.
Talk to Vicendithas (2•2•1)
Talk to Vicendithas again.
Collect an effigy casing from the middle.
Collect 20 resources from one of the nodes.

substeps.text: A chat box will appear. Confirm it or you won't be able to continue dialogue with Vicendithas.

steps.text: Talk to Vicendithas. You need atleast 2 free inventory spaces.
Go to Kerapac's workbench and construct the effigy.
Talk to Vicendithas.
Turn the valves in the order instructed.
Interact with the incubator hatch to deposit the effigy.
Interact with the incubator hatch again.
Talk to Vicendithas.
Talk to Vicendithas again after ending the tutorial.
notes: Quest complete!

items: Access to Effigy Incubator Distraction and Diversion

Smoking Kills.name: Smoking Kills
items_required: Ranged/Magic/Necromancy weapons or spells (must kill skeletons without melee)
Kitten, cat, overgrown cat, hellcat, wily cat, or lazy cat

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: Catspeak amulet

steps.text: Head to Pollnivneach. You can use the magic carpet network from Shantay Pass or Al Kharid lodestone to travel to Al Kharid and head south-east.
Speak to Sumona in Pollnivneach (✓)
Equip your catspeak amulet.
Run south to the well in the town centre.
Attempt to climb down the well.
Speak to the cat, finish all prompts.

substeps.text: If you do not wear a catspeak amulet or skip the conversation, you will be unable to open the sealed tomb door later in the quest.

sections.heading: Finding the tomb
sections.needed: Bring all items needed for the next section, including cat of any sort, catspeak amulet, ghostspeak amulet, combat gear (ranged, magic, or necromancy, or simply ignore three low damage ranged minions for a few seconds), earmuffs, facemask
sections.recommended: rope, waterskins, food for lower-level players

steps.text: Travel to Sophanem by either one of the following methods.

substeps.text: Use the Magic carpet Network, and then run southeast, then along the seashore to the swamp.
Menaphos lodestone teleport, then run east across the bridge to Sophanem (requires completion of The Jack of Spades and Contact!)

steps.text: Head southeast towards the sea/swampland
Enter the swamp using the entrance at the south end of the swamp, by the seashore.
Make your way to the north-west part of the swamp, "climb fallen pillar", and go up the stairs.

substeps.text: Optional: Go west, "climb low wall", use your rope on the "rock", jutting out over the edge - this will give you quicker access in the future.

steps.text: Walk north past the archaeologist's fire, through the opening between the cliffs.
Search the western wall for a sealed door to enter the dungeon.

sections.heading: Inside the tomb
sections.needed: Cat of any sort, catspeak amulet, ghostspeak amulet, combat gear (ranged or magic recommended), earmuffs, facemask
sections.recommended: food for lower-level players
notes: Note: leaving the tomb or logging out may revert some of your progress in this section.

steps.text: Drop your cat, search the western "holey wall". Agree, and your cat will enter, opening the wall.
Go west, kill (or ignore) the 3 skeletons to the south with magic/range/necromancy.
Destroy the broken door until you can walk through it.
Search the west wall (not the odd markings on the east wall) twice to temporarily disable and pass two traps.
Enter the door to the north.
Kill the zombies and skeletons.
After about 10-20 seconds, a level 77 mummy warrior will spawn. Kill it and take the Ranged path key.
Open the door to the east, pull the lever on the northern wall.
Return to the starting room (traps on this side are now permanently disabled)
Repeat steps on the other side.

substeps.text: Go east, kill (or ignore) the 3 skeletons to the south with magic/range/necro.
Destroy the broken door.
Search the east wall (not odd markings on the west wall) twice to disable and pass two traps.
Enter the door to the north.
Kill the zombies and skeletons.
After about 10-20 seconds, a level 77 mummy warrior will spawn. Kill it and take the Magic path key.
Use the key on the door to the west, pull the lever on the northern wall.

steps.text: Return to the starting room (traps on this side are now permanently disabled).
Walk north, all traps have been disabled and can be ignored.
Equip your Ghostspeak amulet and talk to Catolax.
Use your Earmuffs on your Face mask to create Masked earmuffs.

sections.heading: The final fight
sections.needed: Masked earmuffs, combat gear, food

steps.text: Return to Pollnivneach.
Equip your masked earmuffs and combat gear.
Enter the well in the town centre.
Head north, kill a mighty banshee to get a Banshee voice. The drop must be manually picked up; it will not appear in the area loot interface.
Ensure any follower is dismissed and auto-retaliate is turned off first, then run all the way north to the large blue/purple wavering mystic barrier and pass through it.

substeps.text: Do not click on anything else while the cutscene is in motion, or you will go back outside the barrier and will need to acquire another banshee voice.

steps.text: After the cutscene, attack the Banshee mistress. She is weak to bolts, so using range is recommended if you're lower-levelled.

substeps.text: Enable the Protect from Ranged prayer after she gets to 50% health.

steps.text: Finish the fight and watch the cutscene.

substeps.text: If you click on anything else, you will go outside the barrier, but you will not have to fight again; you can easily go back inside the barrier to continue the last cutscene.

steps.text: Return to Pollnivneach (you can climb out of the well).
Pick up your cat if you have not already done so.
Talk to Sumona again to complete the quest.

items: Ability to earn the full amount of slayer points that can be exchanged for slayer rewards
Access to the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon and Tomb of Catolax
Ability to craft slayer helmets and full slayer helmets if the prerequisite unlock has been purchased
Access to the Desert Slayer Dungeon miniquest

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Cool for Ali Cats (When approaching the well in Pollnivneach)
Under the Sand (After entering the sealed door in the desert tombs)
Desert Smoke (When descending into Pollnivneach well)
Slain to Waste (Facing the Banshee Mistress)

Some Like It Cold.name: Some Like It Cold
items_required: Clockwork suit (if not using the clockmaker's bench in player-owned house to make the costumes)
At least 5 backpack spaces for the ransom letter and materials to make costumes for Ping and Pong
You will be required to deposit all your items and worn items at some point during the quest.

steps.text: Talk to Chuck the polar bear in Ardougne Zoo.
Speak to him again. (1•✓)
Speak to him a final time to be teleported (1•1)
After being teleported by Chuck, head west to the seals.
Wake up the seal that can be interacted with. (3•1)
Perform the Dance or Jump For Joy emote.
Talk to the seal. (1•2)
Travel-Iceberg the smaller boat to the north-east. (1)
Talk to Ping & Pong. You don't need to be in your tuxedo for this.
After receiving the items from them, do one of the following:

substeps.text: Option one
Use a Clockmaker's bench 4 in a player-owned house to make their rock costume.
To return, use the Fremennik Province lodestone and head north to board the ship to iceberg.
Option two
Head to the north-east corner of the Iceberg and right-click Jim, a well disguised polar bear next to the stepping stones, and select 'tuxedo-time'.
Head to the north-west and investigate the avalanche of snow. Follow the main hall to the end and talk to the KGP agent in the booth.
After proceeding through the door, head east and then follow the western wall in the war-room to the western workbench. Craft Ping & Pong's costumes there.
Head back outside. To get back in to the hallway, Push the big button west of the gate.
Return to Jim, the polar bear, to get out of tuxedo.

steps.text: Give Ping & Pong their costumes.
Board the nearby boat to return to the seals. (1)
Wake up the seal, bank any items, including your clockwork suit, and head to the camp. There is a deposit box option when talking to the seal. (1)
Talk to Teddy, the polar bear in a clown costume, in the centre of the camp.
Talk to Larry, north of Teddy
Talk to Teddy again.
Talk to Noodle outside the south-west building.
Try to open the door to the southern building where the Walrus is in.
Take bat-in-box the bat-in-box (slightly west of the door where the walrus is) from the front of the building. (1)

Encourage Teddy, Ping, Pong, and Bouncer to make noise by clicking on them repeatedly in turn. Click Ping, then Pong, then Bouncer, then Teddy until a cutscene starts. Their bars should all be blue, so it's a good idea to walk in circles.
When the Walrus is outside, enter his building and steal from the table to receive an egg.
Talk to Larry in the north with the egg.
Talk to Teddy.

Talk to all six of the unnamed penguins. (Four in the courtyard, one between the north and north-west buildings and one, hard to see depending on camera angle, on the fishing hole in the north-east corner).
Talk to Teddy.
Talk to Plaza outside the easternmost building.
Collect the following items:

substeps.text: Fish the fishing hole in the north-east until you receive a shark tooth and squid.
Take a board from the wood scrap pile north of the easternmost building.
Search the shelves in the easternmost building for olive oil, popsicle tray, and a rock carving hammer.
Right click Teddy and Tear off fabric.
Search the shelves in the south-west building for lye and a cork screw.

steps.text: Once all of the supplies are obtained:

substeps.text: Use the lye on the olive oil.
Use the unmoulded soap on the popsicle tray.
Use the squid on the popsicle tray.
Use the hammer on the soap.
With a shark tooth in your backpack, use the ripped fabric on the board.

steps.text: Talk to Plaza.
Talk to Teddy.
Talk to Astoria outside the easternmost building. (1)

substeps.text: If you are not prompted to start the game, talk to Teddy again.

steps.text: Defeat Astoria in a game of Battlefish.

substeps.text: Place your fish anywhere on the board.
You can click on the "HIT" and "MISS" notifications to speed up this section considerably. But beware spam clicking may exit the game making you start over.
Solution:

steps.text: In the small building just south-east, take from the circus prop crate on the northern wall.
Talk to Teddy.
To repair the engine:

substeps.text: Use Bowling pin -> lever opening
Use Hula hoop -> broken valve wheel
Use Circus plate -> pressure gauge
Use Foam finger -> pressure gauge
Use Balloon -> metal wire
Use Insulated wire -> wirebox
Use Cloth -> cracked pipe

steps.text: Talk to Teddy. (2)
Defeat the seals in Battlefish (if you accidentally exit, click on the periscope through the door to the left).

substeps.text: Solution:

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: Access to a new thieving event in the Circus
Rock and Pop costumes for clockwork penguin

Extension to Penguin Hide and Seek, which consists of a 3-point Penguin Spy that requires the seeker to be wearing a ring of visibility to be able to spot it. The penguin randomly teleports every few minutes. It can also travel across the water and over mountains to any part of the Gielinor surface.

rewards.label: Early bird bonus
items: Early bird tome for players who completed the quest before 23:59 UTC on 28 August 2012. 40,000 Crafting experience

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Death (If you have not already unlocked it)

steps.text: Talk to Lucille who is in a house west of the Rimmington well. (1•1•✓)
Stay within Lucille's house and drink the restless sleep potion.
Follow the souls north-east to a cave entrance located south of the Rimmington mine and north-west of the Port Sarim lodestone and enter it.

substeps.text: If you go past the cave, exit to the lobby, or logout in the cave, you will have to go back to Lucille and obtain the potion once again.

steps.text: Go north over the bridge.
Continue through the cave to the east.
Talk to the Raptor. (1)
Enter the door to follow the Raptor.
Enter the north door.
Enter the west door.
Enter the south door.
Enter the east door.
Follow the souls and enter the final door to the north.
After the cutscene, go to the north-east corner of the room to discover the first symbol. It is two steps south of the wall feature against the north wall and two steps east of the fissure.
Head to the north-west corner where the second symbol will be located a bit south-west of the wavy section of the ground.
Enter the sparkling doorway that just appears. The location will be different for each player.
Go just west of the central fissure to find the first symbol.
Go west of the northern fissure to find the second symbol.
The last symbol is just north-west of the eastern fissure.
Enter the sparkling doorway that just appears. The location will be different for each player.
Follow the souls and enter the door to the north.
Take the burning sapling from the centre of the room and plant it in the pot overflowing with water to the southwest.
Enter the doorway with a waterfall to the northeast.
Take the dead sapling from the previous pot and plant it in the pot with living fungi to the northwest.
Enter the doorway surrounded by fungus to the southwest.
Take the budding sapling from the previous pot and plant it in the pot with ivy growing around it to the southeast.
Enter the doorway surrounded by ivy to the west.
Take the healthy sapling from the previous pot and plant it in the pot covered in cobwebs to the northeast.
Enter the doorway covered in cobwebs to the east.
Proceed north and enter the doorway.
After the cutscene, jump into the chasm.

Proceed through the three passageways and enter the openings whilst evading the acid, players with high life points or some food can simply run through the acid taking the shortest route to save time. Running straight through the acid deals some (2-15) damage. Use Surge and Dive when available.
After an interactive cutscene, finish the dialogue with the siren, Remora. (1•1•2•2•1•1•1)
Talk to the Raptor. You will receive 3 items. (2•2)
Head south-west to Rimmington and talk to Lucille.
Quest complete!

items: Remora's necklace (Providing unlimited teleportation to the Queen Black Dragon and Mature grotworms)
Reduced incoming damage when fighting the Queen Black Dragon (with 60 Summoning)

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Two ancient writings in music maze cave for the player to read to gain Constitution experience: 5000 experience, which requires 50 Constitution

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Awoken (Only if you had not previously entered Queen Black Dragon's lair)

steps.text: Talk to Trista on the dock north of Soul Supplies in the City of Um.
Choose the "Eavesdrop" option on Trista. (✓)
Talk to Death in the City of Um. (1)
Talk to the Suspicious Stranger on the dock where Trista was earlier. (1•2•3)
Talk to Death in the City of Um. (1)

sections.heading: Malignius
sections.needed: 3 Cadava berries, 10 fishing bait, antipoison (3), charcoal, and papyrus

steps.text: Talk to Malignius Mortifer at the Um ritual site with the required items in your backpack.
Return to the dock with the Suspicious Stranger.

sections.heading: Zombification
sections.needed: potion of zombification

steps.text: Drink the potion of zombification at least 8 paces away from the Suspicious Stranger but still closer than the bottom of the stairs to transmogrify into a zombie.
Talk to the Suspicious Stranger.
Board the northern gondola.
Continue dialogue with Icthlarin. (3)
Quest complete!
