Spirit of Summer.name: Spirit of Summer
items_required: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless the player has claimed the reward for completing the hard Morytania achievements)
1-3 Spirit scorpion pouch (more of each pouch if your reflexes are not relatively fast)
At least 4 summoning points, but preferably full summoning points
Limpwurt seed (obtainable during quest, not guaranteed, not needed if you already have a limpwurt plant planted in the patch beforehand)

sections.heading: The farm
sections.needed: Ghostspeak amulet

steps.text: Talk to the spirit at the Wilderness wall north of Infernal Source Dig Site. (✓)
Keep trying to catch the spirit until you see a cutscene. (1)
Talk to the father figure with a ghostspeak amulet equipped.
Use the table below to respond to the man's emotes.

substeps.text: Don't repeat yourself.
Use the Think emote to see the emote again. Talk to him and your character will say the emote he is doing.
The rings around the girl will disappear on successful emotes. When all the rings are gone, the girl is free.

steps.text: Once the girl is free, talk to her. (1•1)

sections.heading: Fixing the village
sections.needed: none
sections.recommended: Supreme growth potion (leafy)

steps.text: Once in the village, ask the girl to be taken back. (3)
Search a crate for a limpwurt seed.
Rake the farming patch and plant the seed.

substeps.text: Note: You can use a Supreme growth potion (leafy) on it, but do not harvest the roots yet.
Wait limpwurt plant to grow (roughly 20 minutes), but do not harvest it. You cannot continue the quest until the plant grows.

steps.text: Pick up 4 steel nails and a hammer in the anvil building (south east).

substeps.text: Note: Sometimes you will find only 3 nails there. More nails can be found in the sacks or the building west of the farming patch, near the bucket. You can also smith nails on the anvil.

steps.text: Pick up 2 planks in the centre-most building.

substeps.text: The north-western most building has more planks, if needed.

steps.text: Use a plank on the wardrobe in the building south-east of the statue.
With three free inventory slots, Pick from the Hollow log near the statue for button mushrooms.
Grab a bucket from the building directly west of the farm patch.
Use the bucket on the barrel of water south-east of the farming patch which is just outside the anvil building.
After the limpwurt plant is grown, talk to the spirit for a cutscene.
Talk to her again and agree to come along. (1)

sections.heading: Back in the farm
sections.needed: None

steps.text: Talk to Summer Bonde once more to be taken back. (3)
Take a skull and 5 bones east of the farm.
Stand in the portal which is the white circle.
Talk to Summer Bonde. (2•1)
Follow her and Climb-down the Trapdoor.
Use the skull on the altar, then right-click each of the 5x bones to "Use" it on the altar. You do not need to move around the altar to use bones and skull.

substeps.text: Note: Take care not to bury the bones.

steps.text: If she is not right next to you, Climb-up the ladder and then in both situations, talk to Summer again. (1•3)

sections.heading: Luring the beast
sections.needed: Multiple Spirit wolf pouches, Desert wyrm pouches & Spirit scorpion pouches
sections.recommended: food (for lower-levelled players)
notes: Read all the following steps before executing them:

steps.text: Optional: Customise your interface to allow you to dismiss familiars as fast as possible.
Run north to the wolf platform.
Summon a spirit wolf so that it stands on the platform (it doesn't have to be in the centre).
The Spirit Beast will only be lured to a platform with a familiar summoned.
Dismiss the familiar as soon as the beast steps on the platform. (As the spirit beast foot is midair about to land.)

substeps.text: There will be a cutscene that plays the very first time the beast approaches the platform. This is not the success cutscene.
The beast does not need to fully be on the platform.
Your familiar will be dismissed immediately without the "are you sure" warning; a lightning effect will show if successful.

steps.text: Don't let the beast consume your familiar, and don't move your familiar off the platform. It is helpful to try to position yourself between the beast and your familiar.
A cutscene in which the spirit beast is electrified, and the next summoning platform will appear will play if you have succeeded.
If you have to teleport out for more pouches, you must talk to Summer by the quest start location to return to the spirit realm.

Repeat this process with the desert wyrm, using the platform that appears during the cutscene. You can also push the Spirit Beast by walking at beast to position the creature, but it can give you some damage and may push you away sometimes.
And again, for the spirit scorpion - the platform is far west.
Talk to any of the spirits by the Spirit Beast.
Quest complete!

items: A new Spirit Realm to explore
Ability to fight the level 42 Ghostly warriors at the Spirit realm magic axe hut.
Access to the Cursed Magic Tree
Access to a Goth leprechaun in level 22 wilderness, as well as the flower patch he guards.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: By operating the ring on the portal in the Western ruins, 15,000 Farming experience will be acquired.
By operating the ring on the portal in the Forgotten Cemetery, 15,000 Prayer experience will be acquired.

By operating the ring on the portal near the magic axe hut (North-East of the Ardougne-Wilderness lever inside the wilderness), 11,250 Attack experience will be acquired. (Take a lockpick if you wish to open the hut doors.)
There are also weak portals that can only be used after completing the sequel to this quest - Summer's End.

Spirits of the Elid.name: Spirits of the Elid
items_required: 1 law rune and 1 air rune to cast the Telekinetic Grab spell
A light source (such as a torch, mining helmet, bullseye lantern or Seer's headband)
One or two spools of thread
A weapon for each melee attack style - stab (sword), crush (mace) and slash (scimitar) (other styles work but are extremely inefficient)
For higher melee levelled players, all may not be needed
A method of attacking with at least 4 range
A Bow or crossbow with ammo unless using chargebow (a shortbow and bronze arrows can be found during the quest)

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.needed: 1 thread, 1 law rune and 1 air rune to cast the Telekinetic Grab spell

steps.text: Head to Nardah (south of fairy ring DLQ) and talk to Awusah the Mayor in the building east of the fountain. (1•2•✓)
Head to the house north-east of the fountain and talk to Ghaslor the Elder. You should receive a Ballad. (1•1)
Head to the building that has a statuette plinth just west of Ghaslor's house and north of the fountain.
Telegrab the ancestral key from the table.

substeps.text: You may attach the ancestral key to your steel key ring if you've completed the One Small Favour quest

steps.text: Go to the other side of the building and open the northernmost cupboard and search it for the robe top and bottom.
Fix the top and bottom robes.

sections.heading: The Golems
sections.needed: A weapon and ammo for a combat type other than melee, rope, thread

steps.text: Head north, past the Dominion Tower until a waterfall is seen.

substeps.text: You can teleport to there by using a traveller's necklace to south of the Uzer eagles' eyrie.
There is a bronze arrow south-east of Dominion Tower and a shortbow north-east of it.

steps.text: Climb the waterfall.
Equip the Robes of Elidinis and open the door.

substeps.text: If the door will not open, make sure you repaired and are wearing both robe pieces, and make sure you have the Ancestral key you tele-grabbed earlier.

steps.text: Head east to the three doors.
Try to open any door, kill the golem that spawns, then enter the room and clear the water channel for each room.

substeps.text: If you click the door before the golem's death animation has finished, it will respawn and you will have to fight it again.

steps.text: Head through the door to the north and talk to one of the spirits in the large area. (4•1)
Head back to Nardah.

substeps.text: It is possible to be bugged when exiting the cave. To get out of the bug, simply use a Home Teleport spell.
Amulet of glory teleport to Al Kharid and then taking the magic carpet to Nardah is a quick option.

steps.text: Talk to Awusah the Mayor.
Take shoes just south from the entrance door inside the Mayor's house.
Go outside the house, then remove-sole from the shoes to obtain a sole.

substeps.text: Ensure you have a light source or you will not be able to talk to the next NPC without being interrupted.

steps.text: Head west from the Nardah General Store, past a camp of trainee adventurers and climb-down the crevice.
Talk to the Genie (1•1•3)

substeps.text: If your backpack was full, pick up the Statuette. - There will be room now as you gave the Genie a sole.

steps.text: Head back to Nardah and use the statuette on the plinth in the shrine room, north of the fountain.

substeps.text: Optional: Pray at the statue for medium desert task achievement Heathen Idle.

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: Access to Nardah's fountain and shrine (praying at the statue will fill your life points, temporarily boost it, and restore your prayer points)

Stellar Born.name: Stellar Born
items_required: Wizard Blizzard or Premade Wizard Blizzard

steps.text: Talk to the crashed star west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. (✓)
Mine the crashed star and finish the dialogue.

sections.heading: Sending Zoob back
sections.needed: 152 cosmic runes, 52 astral runes and a Wizard Blizzard (or its premade version)

steps.text: Go to the south side of the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of the Wizard's Tower and talk to Wizard Rosalina. (1•~•~)
Return to the crashed star west of Piscatoris.
Talk to Wizard Rosalina to hand her your cosmic and astral runes and the Wizard Blizzard drink. Finish the cutscene.
Head to the desert goebie camp, north-west of Menaphos. Players can use Leela's favour to get to the Merchant District (option 2) and exit through the north Menaphos gate.
Talk to Wizard Chambers. (1)
Return to the Piscatoris crash site and talk to Wizard Chambers or Wizard Rosalina.
Talk to them again.
Shoo away fireflies to keep them away from the crashed star until the portal progress at the top of your screen reaches 50.
Talk to them again.

sections.heading: Exploring the homeland of star sprites

steps.text: Teleport to Zolarea with the portal.
Unequip any items in your main/off-hand slots and jump the rocky edge to the east.
Fly to the large island to the east and jump to the rocky edge to land. Players can Surge and Dive during flight.
Head to the giant crystal towards the centre and talk to Wizard Rosalina. (~)
Jump the rocky edge on the northernmost side of the main island.
Head to the north-easternmost island and inspect the mysterious decay.
Return to the main island and then inspect the mysterious decay south of the rocky edge and west of the flower patch.
Attempt to enter the cave entrance to the west of the giant crystal. (1/12)
Head to the south side of the main island and inspect the mysterious decay (2/12), then talk to Rox. (3/12)
Head west to the southernmost house and lift the woven rug, then talk to Nuub. (4/12)
Talk to Blip near Wizard Rosalina. (5/12)
Talk to Wizard Rosalina. (1•2•1•3•1)
Head to the observatory west of Tree Gnome Village and north of Castle Wars. The fastest teleport is 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport made by Dave's spellbook. See other ways of getting there.
Climb the rope to the south of the observatory attached to the broken stairs, then go up the stairs inside the observatory.
Talk to the Observatory professor on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US]. (1)
After the cutscene, return to Zolarea via the portal at the crash site west of Piscatoris.
Talk to Wizard Rosalina in the centre of the island.
Enter the cave entrance to the west.
Talk to Wizard Rosalina.
Exit the cave.
Gather the dark star wisps that have appeared. Wisps are visible on the minimap as a yellow dot:

substeps.text: A bit north of the cave, west of the mysterious decay. (1/5)
Jump the rocky edge to the north and gather the wisp on the small, north-north-western island. (2/5)
Return to the east side of the main island and gather the wisp near the meteorites. (The mining symbol on your minimap) (3/5)
Go to the south side of the island and gather the wisp near the rocky edge. (4/5)
Jump the rocky edge to the south and gather the wisp on the south-easternmost island. (5/5)

steps.text: Return to the cave and talk to Wizard Rosalina. (1•2•3•4)
Select the star sprites in the following order:

substeps.text: Wave 1: Glorp, Bop, Rox
Wave 2: Zag, Fuz, Nuub, Zorb
Wave 3: Zig, Eetee, Bop, Eetee, Glorp

steps.text: Exit the cave and talk to Wizard Rosalina in the centre. (1)
Talk to Wizard Rosalina back at the crash site.
Quest complete!

items: Access to Zolarea Access to meteorites for meteorite chunks, which can be crushed into dust to create meteorite cannonballs that deal 150% damage. Requires level 85 Mining to mine, 85 Crafting to crush, and 85 Smithing to smith the cannonballs.
Access to a new single flower patch with +25% yield when growing Starbloom.

steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the throne room on the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of the White Knights' Castle. (✓•1•4)
Head to the Varrock Dig Site and enter ancient door leading to Senntisten. (1)
Discover the large footprint downstairs. All discoverable entities in this quest should be marked by a red dot on your minimap. (1/5)
Go up the stairs.
Discover one of the bodies of demon cultists. (2/5)
Discover scratch marks. (3/5)
Discover ancient Zarosian architecture. (4/5)
Discover note from a worker in the western room along the southern part of the building where the wall is crumbled. (5/5)
(You must dismiss followers for the following steps. Talk to Adrasteia again to continue.)
Talk to one of the Khazard guards.
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests. (1)
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests again. (1)
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests once more. (2•1•4)
Head to Menaphos and enter the Grand Library. (1•1)
Talk to Adrasteia in the library. (3)
Discover The Corruption on the first level from top, near the south-eastern corner. (1/3)
Discover The Secret Chamber opposite The Corruption, in the south-western corner. (2/3)
Discover The Living Dead on the bottom level, near the north-eastern corner. (3/3) (1)
Discover the imbued bones on the western side of the chamber. (1/3)
Discover the fragments of an obelisk next to the soul obelisk. (2/3)
Touch the soul obelisk.
Climb the stairs.
Discover the magical residue. (3/3) (1)
Discover the scorch marks. (1/3)
Discover the Soul Altar. (2/3)
Talk to Ka. (3/3)

sections.heading: Vengeance and the Magister
sections.needed: No items equipped or in backpack and no follower

steps.text: You must dismiss followers and have no items for the following steps. Talk to Adrasteia again to continue or bank items.
Defeat the Magister. (1•4)

substeps.text: All prayers are disabled. Use abilities in order to win the fight.
If you die, you will be teleported to Menaphos gate. Enter the gate to return to the quest. (1)
If you fail to defeat him twice, there will be an option to skip the combat phase. (2)

sections.heading: Preparing disguise in the Wilderness
sections.needed: 13 free backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to Adrasteia in the throne room on the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of the White Knights' Castle. (1•4•1)
Mine the argonlike rocks for 28 argonlike ore north-east of Fort Forinthry. (4)
Smelt at the furnace in the eastern ruins. (4)
Smith at the anvil in the building west of the Mage Arena.
Talk to Adrasteia.

sections.heading: Mage Arena
sections.needed: Argonlike battleaxe, argonlike boots, argonlike full helm, argonlike gauntlets, argonlike kiteshield, argonlike platebody, and argonlike platelegs equipped, no other items equipped or in backpack, and no follower

steps.text: Wear or wield all the needed items.
Talk to Adrasteia the Forgotten to the south-east up the stairs leading up to the Mage Arena. (1)
(You must have no additional items for the following steps. If you do, you can deposit them through the dialogue.)
Talk to Vengeance. (3•1•3•1)
Defeat the 3 waves of enemies.

substeps.text: You can use prayers. It is recommended to use magic protection prayers in waves 1, 2 and melee protection in wave 3.
After each enemy is defeated, restore your health with the health orbs.
If you fail a wave two times, the wave can be skipped to continue. (2)

steps.text: Discover the scuff marks. (1/4)
Eavesdrop the defeated forgotten mage in the north. (2/4)
Discover the scorch mark. (3/4)
Eavesdrop the defeated forgotten mage in the south. (4/4). Then talk to Adrasteia.
Talk to Kolodion.
Exit the Mage Arena. (1)

sections.heading: Ritual marker
sections.needed: Argonlike battleaxe, argonlike boots, argonlike full helm, argonlike gauntlets, argonlike kiteshield, argonlike platebody, and argonlike platelegs equipped, no other items equipped or in backpack, and no follower

steps.text: Inspect the modified ritual marker.
Take the rune pouch.
Search the rune pouch in your backpack.
Take the white dust and choose the option empty rune pouch.
Use the one measly fire rune on a sharp rock.
Talk to Adrasteia (2)
Use the pouch of white dust on the sparkling pool to the south.
Sabotage the modified ritual marker and choose the option volatile fire rune fragments.
Conceal the blatantly sabotaged ritual marker and choose the option soggy pouch of grey paste.
Step into the sparkling pool. (1•3)
Talk to Adrasteia. (2•1•3•4•2•~•1)
(Cutscenes appear between the following steps. Clicking out of the dialogue after any of the cutscenes will cause you to rewatch the cutscenes. This will be a roughly 7 minute process.)
Kill 10 forgotten warriors.

substeps.text: Use the abilities via the interface at the top of the screen. Make frequent use of the Blast ability (3) to kill multiple enemies around you. (3)

steps.text: Kill 20 more forgotten warriors.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: Two free backpack spaces

steps.text: Continue dialogue with Adrasteia.
Quest complete!

items: Combat XP lamp (50,000 experience in chosen skill, limited to Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, and Necromancy. Must have at least level 60 in the chosen skill. Reclaimable from Adrasteia if lost before gaining experience.)
Prismatic XP lamp (60,000 experience in a chosen skill. Must have at least level 60 in the chosen skill. Reclaimable from Adrasteia if lost before gaining experience.)
Tier 6 of the Infernal Puzzle Box becomes available, granting the ability to add Infernal Puzzle Box to the tool belt

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Talking to Adrasteia in the throne room of White Knights' Castle allows you to replay the coronation and Moia fight scenes.
Talking to Quoth the Raven with a cheese wheel while having the regular Ravensworn title unlocked unlocks the glorious variant of the title.

Summer's End.name: Summer's End
items_required: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless the player has claimed the reward for completing the hard Morytania achievements)
At least 1 Summoning pouch made with a blue charm. (Bring more in case you make a mistake)
The lowest level pouches are: Albino rat pouch (23 ), Spirit kalphite pouch (25 ) and Giant chinchompa pouch (29 )
For Ironman, Albino rat pouches are easily obtainable, as their tertiary ingredient, raw rat meat, can be bought in bulk from the Rufus's Meat Emporium in Canifis or obtained by killing giant rats.

sections.heading: Luring the beast
sections.needed: Jennica's ring, a ghostspeak amulet, a pickaxe, summoning pouches made from blue charms, and high-healing food (monkfish or better)

steps.text: Equip your ghost speak amulet and Talk to Summer at the Wilderness wall, north-east of Varrock. (✓)
Stand on the white portal. (~)
After the dialogue, equip and right-click operate Jennica's ring while standing on the portal to return to the real world.
Run northwest, past the dead trees to the dungeon, right-click and collapse the entrance.
Go back to the ruins and operate Jennica's ring while standing on the white portal to return to the spirit realm.
Run north and lure the beast to the entrance with your blue charm familiar. Enter the cave before it has a chance to consume your familiar. (1)

sections.heading: Inside the cave
sections.needed: Jennica's ring, ghostspeak amulet, food, multiple backpack space (at least 5 recommended), hatchet (best you can use), full prayer points for the final phase

steps.text: Avoid the beast's ranged attacks by moving away from the missiles.
Chop roots along the walls to obtain cursed willow logs. You will need 15 in total.

substeps.text: (Optional) Right-click use an extra log on the middle fire pit, and then lure the Beast behind it to avoid attacks while cutting the remaining logs.

steps.text: Right-click use 5 logs on one of the fire pits and then light it.

substeps.text: Do not light other fire pits during cutscene.

steps.text: Repeat for a total of three fire pits.

substeps.text: If you die during the encounter your progress will be saved but unlit logs will be cleared.

steps.text: (Optional) Restock your food and return to Summer to continue.

sections.heading: The dark core
sections.needed: Jennica's ring, ghostspeak amulet, food, energy potions and variants

steps.text: Enter the next room by going through the passage in the south-east corner. (1)
Avoid the missiles like before.
Soon a dark core will appear, dig soft soil and lure the core into the hole.

substeps.text: Unlike the previous room, all damage is avoidable in this room.
Run around the beast to avoid its missiles, but allow the beast to continuously attack without having to chase you to get the dark core to spawn faster.

steps.text: Repeat this 3 times until you receive a cutscene.

substeps.text: If you die during this encounter, your progress is saved after each trapping.

sections.heading: The coloured graves
sections.needed: Jennica's ring, ghostspeak amulet, full prayer points, and food

steps.text: Enter the next room by going through the passage to the east. (1)
Take note of which grave the yellow spirit enters.
Wait for the Beast to charge a yellow attack and bless the grave marker.

substeps.text: Blessing a grave consumes prayer points, which may be replenished at the altar in the room.

steps.text: Repeat for the red and blue spirit.
Talk to the spirits (1)
Quest complete!

items: A spirit shield and the ability to wield all Spirit shields
An upgraded version of Jennica's ring which gives access to the new spirit portals
Ability to fight the level 785 Corporeal Beast
Ability to fight the level 42 Tormented Wraith
Ability to bless spirit shields with holy elixirs by using either component at any Saradomin altar

7 bones (can be obtained during the quest)
5 iron bars (can be obtained during the quest, requiring smelting from iron ores)

sections.heading: The Wise Old Man

steps.text: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor. (1)

sections.heading: Battle at the colony
sections.needed: Combat gear and food
sections.recommended: Bring the supplies for the next section to save a trip

steps.text: Head back to the Piscatoris Colony. Talk to the Wise Old Man. (1)
Kill the sea trolls and open the colony gate.
Talk to Herman in the eastern building.

sections.heading: Repairing the colony

Talk to Arnold.

steps.text: Talk to the Wise Old Man and Herman (furthest building to the east). (2)
Talk to Wizard Frumscone in the basement of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. (2)

Talk to any Almost Master Crafter inside the Crafting Guild until one talks to you about crafting pot lids.

Kill the Sea Troll Queen.

Iron spear or better, that you are willing to lose (a rune spear can be bought from Scavvo's Rune Store, other spears can be bought from the Warriors' Guild Armoury)

Inspect the singing bowl in the western portion of the cave.
To the north, attempt to unlock Oaknock's machine and use Oaknock's exchanger.
Talk to Brimstail. (1•1)
Talk to Hazelmere (island east of Yanille, fairy ring CLS) for several cutscenes. He provides you with a violet pentagon.
Return and talk to Brimstail. (1)
Grind mud rune and use on bucket of sap.

Talk to Brimstail. (1)
Talk to him again three or more times to receive more discs (1)
Unlock machine to view the desired number.

Unlock the machine with the correct value disc. Click the small green square to submit the disc.

Unlock the machine again to get 3 different numbers (the second unlock will require many more discs). Use the exchanger as necessary. The second number requires using 2 discs and the third requires 3 discs.

Run past the zombie pirates.
Repair the stairs at the end of the tunnel, then climb them.

Peer-through the peephole on the wall.

Travel to the Edgeville Monastery.

Read the book.
Head back to Brother Tranquillity who teleports you to Harmony Island.
Wear your holy symbol and choose the option Recite-prayer on the prayer book.
Talk to Brother Tranquillity.
Travel to Fenkenstrain's Castle, which is directly north-east of the Canifis lodestone.
Go up on the staircase in the north-western corner.
Go up on the northern ladder behind the jail gate in the centre.
Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain.

Build the crate on the hotspot, east of the ladder.
Add-bottom to the crate.
Fill the crate with the wooden cats.
Take off your fishbowl helmet and Blow the wolf whistle to call Rufus.
Use the shipping order on the crate.

Exit the shifting tombs to any district.

steps.text: Talk to Zarador again and, after some dialogue, he will give you a weapon known as the Kyzaj, the namesake of the tournament. He will tell you that you must use it against your final opponent, General Graardor, the champion of the ourgs. (3)

substeps.text: Rules for this round: You may not bring in your own weapons (you must use the Kyzaj, a tier 70 weapon), and prayer is disabled. You may equip armour and jewellery, although runes and non-combat items (excluding food) are forbidden.
The Kyzaj will automatically equip itself once the fight starts; you will not be able to equip it beforehand.
Fighting General Graardor he has three main mechanics.
The first one is a ground smash that affects the centre of the arena. Being in the centre makes you get hit for up to 5k damage.
The second attack is a cleave animation with no warning. Sidestep a few tiles and go back to attacking.
The third mechanic he will destroy a section of the outer ring. This will hit for 5k damage if you do not move to another outer ring.

steps.text: If you chose to kill Zanik, you must speak to General Graardor to find out his plans (Graardor can be found by going south from Zarador, up the ladder, and taking the first pathway to the west to the bank spot). (~)
If you chose to spare Zanik, you must speak to her and find out her plans (Zanik is standing next to Zarador). (~)

Cross the water eastward over the rocks and go east to search the Needle. (✓)
Search the Needle to obtain the shard of the needle.
After the cutscene investigate the body on the ground.
Commune with the shard.
Enter the word fire.
Go into the house to the north-west and interact/explore the fireplace.

substeps.text: For full completion, find all of the other words listed on The Needle Skips#Chapter 1.

steps.text: Go back to where the Needle is on the hill to the south-east and enter the temporal portal. (1)
Commune with the shard again and enter the word birthday.

substeps.text: For full completion, find all of the other words listed on The Needle Skips#Chapter 2.

steps.text: Descend the stairs to the east and go back to the Needle.
Enter the temporal portal. (1)
Commune with the shard again and enter the word wenla.

substeps.text: For full completion, find all of the other words listed on The Needle Skips#Chapter 3.

steps.text: Go back to the Needle and search it. (1)
Run back towards the house and harvest the buckthorn bush near the river.
Grind and crush both the leaf and berry.
Go upstairs in the house and give Primrose the smelling salts (1)
Go back downstairs, search the bookcase to the north-east.
Talk to Megan and name the demon 'Metum'.
Use the bottle of crushed berries on the stove on the west side of the house.
Return back to the Needle and use the buckthorn salve on Gail. Finish the dialogue and you will be teleported back to the house.
Finish the dialogue with Megan and go back to the Needle and pick up the note from gail.
Read the note then return to Megan inside the house.
Quest complete!

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Discover all chapters to claim a medium lamp.

For full completion, players can find all of the words in each chapter. After the quest is completed, players can replay chapters by searching the Needle (or the rubble that remains after Desperate Times). To get the large XP lamp you need to speak with Megan outside of the quest replays.

The Path of Glouphrie.name: The Path of Glouphrie
items_required: Small crystal seed or crystal saw (tools made from crystal tool seeds will not work)
A crossbow and mithril grapple (tool belt works)
A key (from the Waterfall Quest; can be re-obtained during the quest)

sections.heading: Evil dumplings
sections.needed: Crystal saw or small crystal seed, drop or bring all crystalline discs if you have some of them
sections.recommended: around 10-14 backpack spaces to make room for crystalline discs

steps.text: Speak to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village. (✓)
Squeeze through the loose railing to the west.
Climb down ladder to the east.

substeps.text: If you no longer have a key from the Waterfall Quest, go to the east side of the cave and search the off-colour crate to get one.
Note that the identically named a key also received from the Waterfall Quest will not work.

steps.text: Go to the west side of the cave and talk to Golrie. (2)
Use the key on the northern gate.
Search the chest to obtain crystalline discs.

substeps.text: You may use drop trick to obtain more discs. You should drop all the discs to obtain a new batch of discs.

steps.text: Talk to Golrie again. (2)
Go to the eastern part of the cave and crawl through the tunnel (followers must be dismissed).
Push the monolith north.
Search chest to obtain more crystalline discs.

substeps.text: You may use drop trick to obtain more discs. You should drop all the discs to obtain a new batch of discs.

steps.text: Go to the next set of monoliths and push the south-western one north.
Push the north-west monolith east.
Search the western chest to the north.

substeps.text: Be sure you receive a key to a chest and Yewnock's notes.

steps.text: Push the small monolith south.
Right-click sing-glass on the singing bowl to transform the seed into a crystal chime.

substeps.text: If you have a crystal saw instead of the small crystal seed, right-click revert-crystal on the singing bowl.

steps.text: Push the north-west monolith west.
Open the mahogany chest, then search it to obtain the strongroom key.
Push the south-east monolith west and open the western gate.

substeps.text: If you are stuck, exit using either of the tunnels.
Enter the tunnel again from the other side.
Push south-western monolith north.
Open the western gate.

steps.text: Read the lectern (Chapter 1). Doing so unlocks a music track.

Referencing the table below, insert discs on the left side of the machine to equal the values on the right side. Use Yewnock's exchanger to obtain shapes of lesser values (if you are having trouble, see the full guide here).
Drop all discs and 'A key to a chest' as you no longer need them. They are not the same shapes that will be used in The Prisoner of Glouphrie.
Exit through the way you came or teleport, returning to Tree Gnome Village.
Kill the evil creature near King Bolren. (If it respawns, hop worlds and try again.)
Talk to the king.
Use the Spirit Tree to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

sections.heading: Anima Mundi
sections.needed: Crossbow, mithril grapple, crystal chime, armour and food to fight 3 level 82 bosses
sections.recommended: Prayer potions, super energy potions, ring of duelling and earmuffs/masked earmuffs/slayer helmet

steps.text: Climb to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Grand Tree.
Talk to Gianne Jnr in the north-west corner. (2)
Head south-west of Castle Wars until you reach a bridge crossing a river. Ring of dueling, or fairy ring BKP and head north-west, or Yanille lodestone for quick access.
Just north-east of the bridge, grapple the tree to cross the river.
Talk to Longramble.
Head north and talk to the dying spirit tree.
After the cutscene, use the crystal chime on the spirit tree, or ring the crystal chime when next to the spirit tree.
Go west into the large sewer entrance.

Travel through the dungeon until you reach a room with 4 doors, 2 warped tortoises, and a pit in the centre. (You may want to kill a warped tortoise/terrorbird for the achievement at this point as it is convenient to do so.)

substeps.text: Running through the tar will turn your run off - simply turn it back on.
You can Surge or Dive across the tar to avoid being slowed down.

steps.text: Enter the east room and kill the 3 warped terrorbirds.

substeps.text: If you die, you will have to recreate the crystal chime after reobtaining the small crystal seed.

steps.text: Peek through the hatch door on the east side of the room.

substeps.text: People with sensitivity to light, seizures, or other ailments concerning flashing lights should be cautious during the escape scene (about 3–4 minutes). Recommended to hold spacebar and look away. You must watch the cutscene. In the event you cancel it, simply re-enter the room.

steps.text: Speak to Hazelmere.
Quest complete!

items: Access to Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon
Access to a new spirit tree
Ability to use the spirit trees for direct teleportation, skipping the route of travelling back to Tree Gnome Village
Ability to add the crystal chime to the tool belt.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Bolrie's Diary (read Bolrie's Diary, which is attached to the lectern in Yewnock's machine room in the Gnome Village Dungeon; need to click on any chapter to unlock music)
Healin' Feelin' (healing spirit tree at sewer entrance)
The Longramble Scramble (west of Castle Wars across river)
Storeroom Shuffle (Gnome Village Dungeon storeroom moving monoliths)
Terrorbird Tussle (Cutscene after Warped terrorbird battle)

steps.text: Speak to Golrie in the Gnome Village Dungeon. (2•✓•4)
After asking what is next, you will be transported to the surface for a conversation with Golrana.
Talk with Golrana inside the Gnome Village.

Teleport to Castle Wars (or follow Elkoy out of the maze) and head to the highlighted area north of the Observatory and south of the Ourania altar (just north-east of the crystal tree). Make sure to pass the Observatory on its eastern side, alternatively use a 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport to teleport directly there.
Make sure to dismiss your pet/follower. Talk to Golrana. (1)
Walk up the path north-west until you reach a large dead tree. Search it, then climb-through it.

Investigate the ledge on the south end of the chasm (the wall near the rocks at the south of the room), continue the conversation with Golrana, she then will cross the chasm and throw a rope for you to cross.

substeps.text: If you encounter a bug in which Golrana disappears, simply re-log and continue from two steps prior.

steps.text: Move south and continue through the cave by jumping across gaps.
Travel north-west until reaching a water stream with stepping stones, but do not cross yet.
Before crossing the set of stepping stones, investigate the small crevice in the south wall to your immediate east.
Golrana will enter the crevice and emerge on the other side, she then will move a stone for you to complete the jumping part.
Cross the stepping stones, head southwest until you reach a crevice, then climb-through and out of the cave.
Go west to the ledge overlooking Lletya and investigate the sturdy tree, then climb-down it.
After a cutscene, take the handwritten book on the crate next to you and read it.
Search all crates, lamps, shelves and the picture in the room. You will be notified when you have gathered everything in the room.
Build the crate at the desk north of the ladder, then calibrate it.
Note down the number and colour value for all three.
Use the calculator below to get a working pair of shapes for each of the three value pairs. Note down the pair of shapes for each.
Clear any Skyboxes and filters to see the plain colours for this next part.
To change the colour, rotate the prism near the singing bowl until it reaches the desired colour.
To change the shape, right-click fill or empty the singing bowl. Every time you fill or empty the bowl, the crystal will respectively gain or lose a side.
To finalise the crystal into the shape, sing-glass on the singing bowl.
To obtain more minute crystal seeds, search the crate just next to the bowl.
Once you sing all 6 desired shapes, calibrate the device then insert the correct shapes into their corresponding slots.
Click the green tick mark at the bottom to complete the puzzle.
Climb up the ladder and talk to Golrana underneath the steps just to the east of Lletya centre. (1)
Once back up on the ledge, walk past the large boulder to the east, and Golrana should spot an air vent.
Open the air vent on the rock wall just south of the boulder, then climb-down it.
After the cutscene Climb-up the stairs just next to you.
Head east to the prison and rotate the watcher once.
Enter the prison through the metal doors. Talk to the guard. (~•~)
Pick-lock on the northwest cell door. Talk to Bolrie. (1•2•3•3•1)
Lead Bolrie out of the jail and west to the corridor behind the stairs you just came up.
Continue through the door in the end and watch the cutscene.
After the cutscene, stand north of the big boulder and push it southward to block the air vent.
Talk to the gnomes for a cutscene.
Talk to them again to watch a second cutscene.
Quest complete!

items: A new glider just outside Tree Gnome Village
Golrana will now store spirit tree seeds for you
Ability to plant up to two spirit trees at a time with 86 Farming.
Ability to teleport to the Prifddinas Spirit Tree (after talking to Glouron next to the tree itself and with 89 Farming), plus a Farming XP lamp.
Access to Lletya via a passageway through the mountain range
Easier access to crystal seed enchantment (Ilfeen can be found wandering Lletya shortly after starting the quest)

steps.text: Talk to Father Aereck in Lumbridge Church. (3•✓)
Go through the graveyard's southern exit and follow the shore to a mining site. Head west to a hut in the swamp.
Talk to Father Urhney inside the hut. (2•1)
Go back to the graveyard and open a coffin located south of the catacombs.
Equip the Ghostspeak amulet and talk to the ghost. (1)
Head back through the southern gate of the graveyard, keep walking until you reach the mining site once again.
Look south-east of the mining site, there are some rocks. Search the rocks, you will receive a muddy skull.
Kill the skeleton or run away.
Go back to the graveyard, reopen the coffin and use the skull on the open coffin.
Quest completed!

items: A total of 1,125 Prayer experience: A 125 experience lamp

steps.text: Interact with Kharen on the docks in the north-western City of Um, close to the transportation icon. (✓)
Either:

substeps.text: Speak to Ed in a building to the north-east to rent a boat. (1)
Or choose the option Rent boat on Ed.

steps.text: Rescue four Wayward Souls. They are ghastly sphere shapes floating above the Lake Mnemosyne in each of the four corners of the map. Some may be a good distance away from the coastline.

substeps.text: High contrast mode is beneficial for spotting them.
Dive and Surge can be used to speed up movement. The Mobile perk (must be on an armour piece, as both hands must be free) and using a powerburst of acceleration will also help.
(Optional) Talk to Deano and Sammy when you see them for a reward of 25 souls each.

steps.text: Return back to the docks and disembark in the dock south of Kharen. (Or teleport out of the rowboat.)

sections.heading: Fighting Hermod, the Spirit of War

steps.text: Prepare for combat and don't forget to re-equip your weapons.
Interact with Kharen. (1•1)
Go through the dialogue to travel to Rasial's Citadel.
Speak to Rasial, the First Necromancer.
Fight Hermod, the Spirit of War in story mode.

substeps.text: Kill minions when they appear, otherwise Hermod will be immune to damage

steps.text: Speak to Rasial, the First Necromancer once more.
Return and interact with Kharen with two free inventory spots.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Hermod, the Spirit of War boss encounter
Access to Kharen's ferry system around Um
Ability to learn further Death Skull and Deathwarden equipment upgrades from Kili (available after completion of Kili Row)

The Temple at Senntisten.name: The Temple at Senntisten
items_required: Telekinetic Grab runes (one air and law rune for each cast; you must be on the standard spellbook)

sections.heading: The mysterious archaeologist
sections.needed: 3 backpack spaces
sections.recommended: 1 additional backpack space if you can receive Ali's pendant

steps.text: Talk to Ali the Wise in the northernmost building in Nardah. (1•1•1•✓•2)
Go to the Exam Centre.

substeps.text: If you asked Ali for help getting there, he gave you a Dig Site pendant (or Ali's pendant if you have not unlocked the ability to create Dig Site pendants) to teleport directly there.
Alternatively, teleporting to Varrock Dig Site with either pendant for the first time will grant you the Return to Senntisten achievement.

steps.text: Talk to Dr. Nabanik outside of the Exam Centre south of the Digsite. (1•1•1•2•3•4)
Talk to Terry Balando inside the exam centre for a restoration certificate. (1•1•1•1•1)
Talk to Dr. Nabanik. He will give you a rope.
Use the rope on the winch in the north-east dig site, north of The Stormbreaker ship.
Operate the winch to enter the Digsite dungeon.
Talk to Azzanadra in the southern part of the dungeon. (1•1•1•2•~)
Open the ruined backpack for a battered letter and heat globe.
Read the letter and then talk to Azzanadra. (1•1•1•2•3•4•1•2•4)

sections.heading: Barrows icon
sections.recommended: Combat equipment and food

steps.text: Travel to the Barrows.
Kill the six Barrows Brothers found in their tombs below the ground.

substeps.text: Barrows amulets can be used to skip killing up to three brothers.
Amulets can only be used on the tombs before the brother is summoned.
The final brother must be killed without using an amulet.

steps.text: Once all six brothers are dead, search the chest at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts to get the Barrows icon.

sections.heading: Frostenhorn
sections.needed: Telekinetic grab runes, heat globe from the ruined backpack
sections.recommended: Food and armour, as you will encounter some aggressive high-level (100+) icefiends and waterfiends, even for players with a high-level combat

steps.text: Go to the Ghorrock fortress:

substeps.text: First use the canoe near Erjolf from Tale of the Muspah for a quick access. It is located on the west coast of the Rellekka Hunter area, north of fairy ring code DKS.
Go east and place the heat globe on the pedestal near the ice block entrance.
Squeeze past the ice block.

steps.text: Enter the fortress through the south entrance and climb-up the stairs to the west.
Run to the south-east corner of the castle and climb-down the stairs east.
Scale up the damaged wall north of the door.
Climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
Enter the trapdoor in front of you.
Run east and take the heat globe.
Return to the entrance room of the basement, and place the heat globe on the pedestal on the west side.

substeps.text: A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.

steps.text: Go inside the west room, then right-click the radiant pedestal to cast Telekinetic Grab on it.
Use the globe on this room's pedestal. Go down the trapdoor.

substeps.text: A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.

steps.text: Pick up the globe in the southern room.
Use it on the pedestal back in the northern room with the ladder. 2 waterfiends will spawn.
Loot the crates in the south room for 40 law runes and 300 air runes.
Go to the east room and take the globe from the pedestal for an imperfect heat globe.
Exit the dungeon the way you entered.
Scale the damaged wall to the west, then head to the north-east corner to the destroyed pedestal.
Insert-globe in the smashed globe-holder on the ground.
Choose the push option on the smashed globe-holder on the ground.
After a cutscene, climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
Return to the dungeon by re-entering the trapdoor. (1)
Go down the trapdoor in the western room.
Run through the dungeon and take the heat globe from the pedestal in the southwestern corner.
Head back east through the hallway you ran through until you reach the southeast corner, where the path turns north.
At that corner, look for a pipe on the south wall.
Choose the "Place-globe" option on the pipe.
Choose the "Whack" option on the pipe.
Continue into the southeastern room and climb the ladder to go up.
Head west and kill the ice demon (it cannot be damaged by water spells).
Take the Frostenhorn that it drops.

sections.heading: The big bang
sections.needed: Barrows icon and Frostenhorn

steps.text: Return to Azzanadra with the items back at the Senntisten Temple underneath the Dig Site. (1•1•1•1)

substeps.text: The Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport outside the temple (option 2).

steps.text: Back outside near the winch, talk to the Assassin for a relic. (1•~•~•~)
Return to Azzanadra. (1•5•2•3)
After the cutscene, speak to Azzanadra again. (1•~)
Quest complete!

items: 23,000 Skill experience lamp for any chosen skill (level 50+)
Two 20,000 Combat experience lamps for any chosen combat skill (level 50+)
Access to a new set of prayers, known as the Ancient Curses. You must read the Ancient hymnal, given to you by Azzanadra, in order to activate them.
Access to the Altar of Zaros in the Senntisten Temple, located below the Varrock Dig Site. Praying at this altar boosts your prayer points to 15% over your current maximum level.
Access to Ghorrock - an inhospitable and dangerous fortress to reach, but where iron and steel dragons, waterfiends, and icefiends can be found.
Items obtained from the Barrows Chest

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: 75,000 Combat experience lamp (related to the earlier Fate of the Gods quest). Skill must be level 80 or higher, excludes Prayer/Summoning. Can be used up to three times. Claimed by talking to Azzanadra in the Senntisten Temple near the Altar of Zaros and choosing the 3rd/4th chat option "Zaros's return".

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Horn of Chill (Unlocked when facing the ice demon; also possible to unlock by standing next to the central ice block on the first floor)
Zaros Stirs (Unlocked at the end of the quest after entering the newly-refurnished altar)

There's No Place Like Home....name: There's No Place Like Home...
items_required: Two regular logs (obtainable once during quest)

steps.text: Talk to Alfred Stonemason in Rimmington to learn about Player-owned houses.
Talk to the estate agent to receive a plot of land.
Enter the house portal.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason and use the Remove Furniture option in the House Controls interface to clean up leftover items.
Use the house portal to return to Rimmington.
Cut planks using the sawmill.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason, who will direct you to the furniture workbench.
Use the furniture workbench to create a crude wooden chair. To interact with the workbench, you may need to bank all equipped items and those in your inventory to continue.
Store the crude wooden chair in the furniture storage.
Enter the house portal and talk to Alfred Stonemason.
Enter build mode and place the crude wooden chair.
Click the chair again to change its position.
Talk to Alfred and enter build mode again.
Click on a doorway to add a room, click again to customise it.
Exit the house portal and talk to Alfred Stonemason.
Quest complete!

items: There's no place like home painting
Ability to cast House Teleport spell

Throne of Miscellania.name: Throne of Miscellania
items_required: Log of any kind (excluding Eternal magic logs) (may be harvested when needed)
Flowers (can be bought from the Flower Girl for 15 coins)
Cake (if the player is wooing Prince Brand)

Any bow (if the player is wooing Princess Astrid), excluding the training bow, composite bows, ogre bow, crystal bow, dark bow, chargebow, Kayle's chargebow, boogie bow, and masterwork bow; it will be lost during the quest

Any tradeable, metal ring (some rings, like the opal ring, lapis lazuli ring, jade ring, topaz ring, Ring of Wealth (4), moonstone ring, onyx ring, hydrix ring, and luck of the dwarves, do not work. The gold ring, sapphire ring, emerald ring, ruby ring, diamond ring, dragonstone ring, ring of life, are confirmed to work)

steps.text: Talk to King Vargas, 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] in the castle on the western island of Miscellania. You'll first need to open the throne room door and click through the dialogue with the guard. (✓)

sections.heading: Being the messenger
sections.needed: 1 iron bar, 1 logs

steps.text: Run to the eastern island. On the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the castle, talk to Queen Sigrid.
Go back and talk to King Vargas.
Go back and talk to Queen Sigrid.
Talk to Prince Brand in the bedroom south of King Vargas's room. He will give you an awful anthem.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim in King Vargas's room. He adjusts the anthem, and the awful anthem will convert into a good anthem. (2)
Take the good anthem to Queen Sigrid.
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Derrik at the anvil on the north of the island, and give him an iron bar. (2)
Use the giant nib on your logs.
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim about marriage. (2)

sections.heading: Getting married
notes: The player must complete either of the following:

sections.heading: To marry the princess
sections.needed: 1 flowers (can be bought from the Flower Girl for 15 coins), any bow (it will be lost during the quest), and any tradeable non-enchanted metal ring

steps.text: Go to the room to the north and talk to Princess Astrid. (1)
Talk to Princess Astrid again, read carefully what she says. You must agree with her.
Repeat this about 3 times until the chat options stop appearing.

substeps.text: Hahahaha!
He's been very helpful.
Archery is a noble art!

steps.text: Use the flowers on her. (1)
Perform the Dance emote in her room.
Talk to Princess Astrid to tell her your name.
Talk to Princess Astrid again and agree with her again 3 times.

substeps.text: What happened next?
That sounds like a good idea.
I'm quite fond of it myself.

steps.text: Give her a bow by using it on her. (1)
Talk to Princess Astrid.
Talk to Princess Astrid again and agree with her again 3 times.

substeps.text: I suppose you don't have much opportunity to.
It's a lovely little country.
And what a great bard he makes!

steps.text: Blow a kiss at Princess Astrid.
Use the ring on her. (1)
Talk to King Vargas.

sections.heading: To marry the prince
sections.needed: 1 flowers (can be bought from the Flower Girl for 15 coins), cake, any tradeable, non-enchanted metal ring

steps.text: Go to the room to the south and talk to Prince Brand. (1)
Talk to Prince Brand about 3 more times, trying to impress and/or agree with him.
Use the clap or cheer emote.
Use the flowers on him. (1)
Talk to Prince Brand and agree with him again 3 times.
Listen to his saga.
Use the cake on him. (1)
Talk to Prince Brand and agree with him again 3 times.
When he calls you 'Dear', blow a kiss at him.
Use the ring on Prince Brand. (1)
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim about support. (2)
You need to make the population like you. You can check your approval percentage by talking to the people you're helping. To do this, perform any of the following tasks on the island:

substeps.text: Raking weeds
Chopping trees (logs will not be obtained)
Mining coal (ore will not be obtained but it is the most AFK method here)
Fishing at the docks to the south (fish will not be obtained)
Purchase Flowers (mixed) from the Flower Girl (50% chance of +1% per flower)

steps.text: Once you have 75% approval, talk to King Vargas.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to teleport to Miscellania with a Ring of Wealth, Ring of Fortune, or Luck of the Dwarves
Ability to purchase Miscellania Portrait from Sir Renitee.

TokTz-Ket-Dill.name: TokTz-Ket-Dill
items_required: Adamant pickaxe or better (tool belt will work for the mines, but will only work for the fight if you already have a melee weapon equipped. Otherwise, bring a separate pickaxe for the fight)
A main-hand magic weapon and runes for water spells, or a necromancy weapon
A ranged weapon (the final lava monster can only be damaged with ranged)
A melee weapon (for faster breaking of the TokTz-Ket-Dill armour)
A necromancy weapon can be used to kill the fire and lava monsters. Cannot use necromancy for the last lava monster and the TokTz-Ket-Dill

sections.heading: The TzHaar tourist guide
sections.needed: 2 empty inventory slots

steps.text: After entering the TzHaar City, go east as far as possible along the southern wall, then directly north (just west of Fight Cauldron teleport). Speak to one of the three guards. (1•✓)
Talk to TzHaar-Ket-Grol south-west, at the crack in the wall (with at least one empty inventory slot). (1)
Enter the tunnel to the library north-west of the Main Plaza.
Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Lor. (1)
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock library about TzHaar language. (3)
Along the west wall, in the cluster of 3 bookcases, search the middle one for the TzHaar Tourist Guide.
Read the TzHaar Tourist Guide along with the note inside.
Return to TzHaar-Ket-Grol. (1•5•5•4)
Go east and pass the cave entrance.
Enter the mine directly east and speak with TzHaar-Hur-Brekt on the east side (2•1)
Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Klag on the west wall. (3•2•4)
Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Kol, just north. (3•2•4)
Speak to TzHaar-Xil-Mor, south-east in the mine. (3•1)
Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Brekt. (1•1)
Speak to TzHaar-Xil-Mor. (3•2)
Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Brekt. (3)
Speak with TzHaar-Ket-Jok, south-west in the mine. (1•3•2•3•2•4)
Speak with TzHaar-Xil-Mor. (1•1•2•4)
Speak with TzHaar-Hur-Klag. (1•4•2•3•1•4)
Speak with TzHaar-Mej-Kol. (1•2•3•4)
Finally speak to TzHaar-Hur-Brekt. (2)
Mine the Stone slab vein and craft 4 pillars for the first cave section (you can easily return for more).

sections.heading: Treating the planks
sections.needed: 14 oak planks (bank at Fight Cauldron or the Main Plaza if needed, or store them in a plank box)

steps.text: Go to the quest start location and have your planks treated by the small TzHaar-Hur-Frok. (1•1)

sections.heading: Repairing the tunnels
sections.needed: Magic weapon with runes for water spells, ranged weapon with more distance than just darts, enough pillars and planks for a cave section (there are checkpoints.)

steps.text: Enter the crack in the south wall by TzHaar-Ket-Grol.
notes: Some sections of the walls have caved-in (shown as red corridor sections on the minimap) and some sections of the ceiling have caved-in (shown as piles of rubble, as well as pale brown shapes on the minimap).

steps.text: If the examine info for a cave-in says "The damage in this location is bad / isn't too badly damaged", use a plank on it.

If the examine info for a cave-in says "The damage in this location is very bad/badly damaged/very badly damaged", use a pillar on it. You cannot walk through these, and must place them from 1 tile away. Don't accidentally block yourself off with them, or you will need to push them over and get more pillars. If you run out of pillars, you can simply lobby and you'll end up outside of the cave, near the mine. You can then return to where you left off.
Using the wrong item on a cave-in can cause a few hundred damage.
The first cave requires 6 treated planks and 4 pillars. After fixing the cave-ins, mine the blocked tunnel and proceed to the next checkpoint.
The second cave requires 6 treated planks and 6 pillars. The fire monster can only be harmed by magic with water spells or necromancy.

The third cave requires 2 treated planks and 7 pillars. The first two lava monsters can only be harmed by ranged weapons with an attack range of 5 spaces or higher or by using necromancy. You will need to use magic with water spells or necromancy on the final fire monster. You cannot cross the stones before killing all three lava monsters.

notes: It is highly recommended that lower levelled players bring ranged equipment at this point. steps.text: Purple shading is for the rooms with purple energy that will hurt you.
Cyan shading is for when Senecianus chases you in monster form.

Before entering any door, check if there is smoke emitting from the bottom. If there is no smoke, enter the door normally. If there is smoke, right-click Peek through the door, then click the Enter Room button (the animation is irrelevant). Peeking through doors will negate ALL damage taken from the ghost.

substeps.text: Alternatively, you can click on the smoke doors to go through and quickly go back through them, taking 0 damage and getting rid of Ormod quicker.

steps.text: You do not heal life points over time; only mystery meat heals you. Mystery meat restores all of your life points once eaten. The Eat Food ability does not consider mystery meat to be food, so you must click to eat it. Deaths are safe (safe for hardcore ironmen as well). The Persistent Rage relic power cannot be used to replenish adrenaline for Regenerate during the quest.
Safe rooms save your progress. Dying, exiting the house, or lobbying reverts you to your last saved state with the items and life points that you saved with but not the time.
Temporal chests cannot be opened on the first playthrough when completing the quest itself, so ignore them.

Timers (e.g. 30 minutes remaining) are general guides for the replay challenge. Challenges cannot be completed on the first playthrough, so these should also be ignored. The timer does not pause during dialogue, so players who are trying to do the time challenge should spacebar through the dialogue as quickly as possible. However, players can reset their progress by speaking to Maria outside the mansion. The correct dialogue options are given by the speech bubble icons in the steps below.

You need to have very low latency between your computer and your RuneScape server. Otherwise, the monster will kill you even before the screen shows up, making it impossible to pass this part of the quest.
