substeps.text: Kill the three material ghouls that spawn to collect the last three materials.

steps.text: Construct the bridge near the Raptor.
Cross the bridge and investigate the ancient door.
Push either of the two pillars. Switch to the Raptor and push the other pillar to unlock the door.
Search the ancient door to receive the dragonkin device.
Speak to the Raptor.
Go to the Varrock Library and continue with the portal by the entrance. (1)
Talk to Reldo for a potion of dreamless sleep.
Drink the potion, then inspect the dragonkin device to enter the dream. (1)

The aim is to step on the pressure plates, unlock all the boulders, and enter the final barrier. As the player, you can push and pull boulders one tile at a time. As the Raptor, you can push boulders five tiles, and pull by one tile.

substeps.text: It might glitch and not show the boulder, although it is there and interactable.
For rooms that don't have enough boulders, you need to step on a pressure plate to spawn one.

steps.text: Player steps on a pressure plate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the other pressure plate.
Pull and push the boulder to the middle plate outside boulder gate 2.
The player steps on a pressure plate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the other pressure plate.
Pull and push both boulders to the outer pressure plates at boulder gate 3.
The player steps on a pressure plate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the other pressure plate.
Walk through to boulder gate 4.
The player steps on either of the two furthest pressure plates from the gate. This creates a boulder.
Switch to the Raptor and push the boulder to any pressure plate next to the gate.
Repeat for the other pressure plate.
The player steps on the pressure plate by the gate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the pressure plate by the gate.
Walk through.
The Raptor steps on the western-most pressure plate.
The player pulls the boulder and pushes it to the second pressure plate (going clockwise).
The player steps on the third pressure plate, and the second boulder appears.

substeps.text: If the second boulder does not spawn, exit to the lobby and continue again with the portal at the library.

steps.text: The player pushes and pulls the boulder to the fourth pressure plate.
The player steps on the third pressure plate to open the gate.
Run to the strange girl to start a cutscene.
Go through all the chat options, then delve deeper into the dream.
Interact with the dim light.
Lower the health of the Nightmares as the player, then swap to the Raptor to deal the finishing blow.

substeps.text: Currently this part is glitched if you are in a group, which will prevent the player from progressing as expected. Simply leaving the group and re-entering the instance will allow progress.

steps.text: Interact with the pillar of light and talk with the character that appears.
Continue on the path, and repeat the same process with the dim lights along the way.
Finally, speak to the Raptor that appears.
Read the ancient writings on the wall at the end of the path.

sections.heading: Back to the crypt
sections.needed: 10 free inventory spaces

steps.text: Finish talking to the Raptor, then go back to the crypt in the Wilderness.
Continue with the portal in front of the crypt.
Enter the ancient door, then investigate the map table in the central room.
Kill fetid zombies around the crypt and collect 10 map pieces. Do not leave the crypt.
Deposit onto the map table to start the puzzle.
Complete the map (shown below) using the same strategy as for solving a puzzle box or sliding puzzle, strategy guide here.

substeps.text: Speaking to the Raptor to turn on accessibility mode is advised; this will highlight tiles while they are in the correct position.

steps.text: Finish the following dialogue with the Raptor before continuing.
Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre back at Fort Forinthry. (2)
Talk to the Raptor to finish the quest.

items: 3,000 Skill experience lamp (Skill must be level 30 or higher)
Ability to build all three tiers of the Fort Forinthry Ranger's Workroom.

Dealing with Scabaras.name: Dealing with Scabaras
items_required: Ugthanki dung (requires a bucket, this is not consumed)
10 unnoted gold artefacts from the Pyramid Plunder, including gold seals, golden scarabs, and golden statuettes
1 pyramid top from the Agility Pyramid
Up to 36 bronze gear or bronze bars (See distressing bronze gear)

sections.heading: Running errands
sections.recommended: Rope

steps.text: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem. (1•✓)
Climb the ladder behind the altar.
After the cutscene, talk to Maisa. (1)
Talk to the High Priest.
Go to the south-east of the Agility Pyramid, take the rope shortcut just to the east.

substeps.text: If you haven't unlocked this shortcut, enter to the swamp south-east of Sophanem and go north, then climb the fallen pillar and the low wall. Last, use the rope on the rock.

steps.text: Climb over the low wall and talk to Lead archaeologist Abigail and Assistant archaeologist Kerner by the tents. Read their questions carefully and always round down the answer. (1)
Talk to them again for an empty crate.

sections.heading: Distressing bronze gear
sections.needed: Ugthanki dung, bronze gear, bucket (if you do not have Ugthanki dung)

steps.text: Fetch the bronze gear that are written in your quest journal.
At this point, if you have 60 Crafting, continue with the section Distressing by players.
Use the bronze gear on the crate.
Return to the archaeologists. This will take 3 hours so if 60 Crafting is achievable by any boosts within that time frame it is highly recommended to do that instead. (1•1)
Continue with the section Collecting scabarite notes.

sections.heading: Distressing by players
notes: If you do have Ugthanki dung:

steps.text: While standing in the desert, use Ugthanki dung on the bronze items.
Use the oxidized bronze items on the crate.
notes: If you do not have ugthanki dung:

steps.text: Travel to Pollnivneach (Pollnivneach Teleport or Magic carpet network are easiest).
Enter the kebab shop North-West of the well in the center of the town.
Talk to Isma'il the Kebab seller and purchase Red hot sauce (3)
Head to the building South-West.
Go inside the fenced area with two Jasim the Camels.
Use the Red hot sauce on the trough to the South.
Use a bucket on the dung produced by Jasim the Camel to get Ugthanki dung.
While standing in the desert, use Ugthanki dung on the bronze items.
Use the oxidized bronze items on the crate.

sections.heading: Collecting scabarite notes
sections.needed: pyramid top, 10 Gold artefact, smelly crate
sections.recommended: Weapon

steps.text: Talk to Simon Templeton at the Agility Pyramid. (1•1•1•1)
Talk to the archaeologists (back at the campfire along the shortcut to the east) for a book scabaras research.
Kill undead creatures nearby until you get 4 different scabarite notes. They should have different examine texts.

substeps.text: Dried zombies and skeletons to the north.
Mummies to the west.
Locust lancers, rangers, scabaras lancers, and rangers in the swamp to the south-east.

steps.text: Copy the notes to the scabaras research.
Talk to the archaeologists for a key scabarite key.
Run north and enter the northernmost dungeon.

sections.heading: Dungeon puzzles
sections.recommended: logs according to your Firemaking level, antipoison, food

steps.text: This section is a race against time. Read it fully before continuing. You need to pass all challenges successfully in one go, otherwise you need to tell the clay golem to reset the levers so you can try again.

It is possible to empty the storage box of logs so you might need to bring your own in case you fail at first attempt. If you have a lower Firemaking level, you might not be able to stoke the furnace. For example, the storage box may give you magic logs, but if your Firemaking level is below 95, you won't be able to continue, unless you bring your own logs.
Use the logs on the furnace to stoke the furnace.
Talk to the golem. (3•4•1•2)
Relight the furnace.
Enter the narrow walkway room.

substeps.text: Cross the pipe and pull the lever.

steps.text: Enter the empty room.

substeps.text: Pull the lever.

steps.text: Enter the scarab room.

substeps.text: Kill the level 92 giant scarab.
Pull the lever.

steps.text: Enter the mysterious box room.

substeps.text: Investigate the mysterious mechanism to start the puzzle. Clicking outside of the interface will fail the attempt and you'll have to start the whole process over.
Starting from the upper left corner, note the runes shown, flipping three runes in a row. Do this for all rows until all runes are noted. You should finish with 8 attempts left.

On the right side of the interface to increase your attempts from 20 to 35. Click on the cog, mechanical screw parts and dial (three areas) and you will receive an extra 15 attempts giving 35 in total. If you don't, you will fail partway through the puzzle in the next section!

Flip the rune in the upper left corner. Use your notes to identify the locations of other matching runes and flip them over (You are matching groups of 3 runes). Continue until all runes have been flipped.

steps.text: Once you have completed all 4 challenges in a row, it is possible to teleport out and restock without having to do them again.

sections.heading: Vault area
sections.recommended: antipoison, food

steps.text: Run to the High Priest of Scabaras in the north-west room in the dungeon. Disarm the traps along the way.
Talk to the High Priest. (2•2)
Defeat him.
Talk to him again. (4•1)
Defeat him.
Talk to him once more. (4•2)
Defeat him.
Talk to him once more. (2•1)
Return to the High Priest in Sophanem.
Quest complete!

items: The ability to craft an enchanted water tiara - protects against desert heat

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Talk to Simon Templeton about the job he mentioned during the quest. He sends you to talk to the guardian mummy. After the mummy refuses, return to Simon. Simon will now accept noted pyramid treasures from Pyramid Plunder to exchange for money.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Copris Lunaris - In the Scarabite Dungeon
Scarabaeoidea - Inside the room with the Scabaras High Priest
Tune from the Dune - South of the Agility Pyramid, in the swampland

Defender of Varrock.name: Defender of Varrock
items_required: Blurite ore (can be obtained during the quest from the ice cave near Thurgo)
Armour, weapons, and supplies to survive in the Wilderness

steps.text: Dismiss any followers now.
Talk to Captain Rovin in Varrock Palace, on the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of north-west tower. (1•✓•1)

substeps.text: If he will not give you the quest, make sure you have claimed kudos from Historian Minas at Varrock Museum.

steps.text: Enter the Graveyard of Shadows, then talk to Hartwin. (1)

substeps.text: Make sure Hartwin is following you in this section.
If you lose Hartwin for any reason, he can be found back at the Varrock Palace.

steps.text: Inspect the tree stump just south of the west graveyard entrance (just south of the arch) to uncover more footprints.
Follow the footprints and continue searching bushes, trees, stumps, mushrooms, and bones to uncover more footprints.

substeps.text: Search the small forest of dead trees south of the Graveyard of Shadows, northwest of the Chaos Temple for a grubby key.

steps.text: The trail eventually leads to Simon near the Chaos Temple.
Run south to the trapdoor, unlock it using the grubby key and climb down.

sections.heading: Undead army
sections.needed: combat equipment to kill six or more armoured zombies

steps.text: Run north and look over the balcony.
Run west and take 3 bottles.
Kill 3 armoured zombies, using the bottles on red mist to fill them.
Proceed deeper into the cave through the door.
Run north and kill 3 armoured zombies again, using the bottles on red mist to fill them.
Go through the next door and look over another balcony.
Hartwin will give you a Varrock teleport tablet to return to Varrock quickly.
Return to Captain Rovin in Varrock.

sections.heading: The Sacred Forge
sections.needed: blurite ore, light source, and a spade (tool belt does not work)
sections.recommended: a redberry pie (optional for 1,000 Smithing experience if you give the pie to Ramarno)

steps.text: Talk to Thurgo in Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim lodestone, north of fairy ring AIQ. (3)

substeps.text: If you don't have a blurite ore, now is the opportune time to mine one in the snowy area of the dungeon nearby.

steps.text: Climb Ice Mountain, west of Edgeville.
Dig with your spade 2 steps on the location east of the white tree, next to the material caches, near the dungeon icon ().
Dig the churned-up snow then enter the hole.
Talk to Ramarno. (4)

substeps.text: If you have a redberry pie, give it to Ramarno for 1,000 Smithing experience. (1•4)

steps.text: Use blurite ore on the forge.
Talk to Ramarno for a cutscene (note that pressing escape during the cutscene will reset it).
Return to Captain Rovin, ignoring the zombies. He gives you a restored shield.
Talk to Reldo in the library on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US].
Read the Varrock Census on the lectern.
Search the scrolls on the floor a few steps south after talking to Reldo about the situation.
Read the list of elders.
Talk to the following NPCs until one mentions they are not a blood descendant:

substeps.text: King Roald, southeast corner of the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] (1)
Aeonisig Raispher, next to King Roald. (1•1)
Sir Prysin, west of the king.
Curator Haig Halen, in the Varrock Museum. (1)
Horvik the smith north-east of Varrock Square. (2)

steps.text: Talk to Dimintheis in south-east Varrock where you started the quest Family Crest. (2)
Talk to Captain Rovin.
Quest complete!

items: Access to Chaos Temple Dungeon, where you can kill armoured zombies.
Access to four goldrune material caches
5 Kudos in Varrock Museum and a 1,000 experience antique lamp from Historian Minas on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Museum.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Dream Theatre (In the cutscene with The Sacred Forge)
The Ruins of Camdozaal (Under the Ice Mountain, in Camdozaal)
Undead Army (In the dungeon below the Chaos Temple)
Zombie Invasion (Varrock Palace during the zombie invasion)

Desert Treasure.name: Desert Treasure
items_required: Alternatively, chocolate cake, chocolate bar, cooking apple, or pineapple pizza
Face mask (can be replaced by masked earmuffs, a slayer helmet, a full slayer helmet, or a gas mask)
Up to 100 lockpicks (the lower your Thieving level, the more lockpicks you may require), hair clips, or a master thief's lockpick (which has no chance of breaking)
Ice gloves or another method to defeat Fareed
Silver bar (metal bank will not work)
Climbing boots for the Death Plateau Troll shortcut (or Trollheim Teleport or Trollheim tablet)
Spiked boots for the Ice Path segment (made by bringing Dunstan an iron bar and climbing boots; rock climbing boots will not work)

sections.heading: Asgarnia Smith
sections.needed: One backpack space
sections.recommended: Desert heat protection, Archaeology journal

steps.text: Talk to Asgarnia Smith for some etchings. He is in the Bedabin Camp south-west of the Shantay Pass. (2•✓)
Talk to Terry Balando in the Exam Centre. (1)

substeps.text: If he offers you a Codex Ultimatus, refuse it or talk to him again.

steps.text: Talk to him again for the Translation. (1)

sections.heading: Bandit Camp
sections.needed: 650 coins, 1 charcoal, 1 ashes, 1 bones, 1 blood rune, 6 steel bars (can be noted), 12 magic logs (can be noted), 6 molten glass (can be noted), translation, and one backpack space

steps.text: Return to Asgarnia Smith with the book. (2)
Talk to Asgarnia again and offer to help him. (1)
Run south to the Bandit Camp.

substeps.text: If you're wearing any Zamorak or Saradomin equipment, bandits become aggressive.

steps.text: Talk to the bartender at the pub for a Bandit's brew. (2•1)
Talk to the bartender again. (2)
Talk to Eblis, by or in the eastern-most building of the Bandit Camp. (2•4•1•1)

substeps.text: He will not speak to you if you're wearing any Zamorak or Saradomin equipment.

steps.text: Use all the items on Eblis, then talk to him again. (2)
Run south-east, and talk to Eblis by the Bandit Camp lodestone. (2)
Retrieving the four diamonds can be done in any order. Jump to §Blood diamond Jump to §Ice diamond Jump to §Smoke diamond Jump to §Shadow diamond

sections.heading: Blood diamond
sections.needed: Garlic, silver bar, spice, food, air spells if using magic

steps.text: Enter the pub in Canifis. After a short cutscene, talk to Malak. (5•1•3•3)
Take a silver bar and talk to Ruantun in the Draynor Sewers for a Silver pot.
Take the pot to the High Priest on Entrana for a Blessed pot.
Talk to Malak in Canifis for a blood-filled Blessed pot (this deals 50 damage).
Crush the garlic, use the garlic powder on the blessed pot, then add spice to get a completed Blessed pot.
Prepare for a level 84 boss fight. If you die, you will have to re-do the previous step.

substeps.text: Note: It is recommended to bank your cake or chocolate bar, as a ghast may turn it into rotten food on the journey.

steps.text: Run south-east to the Graveyard (map pictured right).
Use the pot on the tomb, then kill Dessous. Alternating between praying Protect from Melee and Protect from Magic every tick makes Dessous unable to attack.
Return to Canifis.
Speak to Malak to receive the Blood diamond.
Bank the blood diamond immediately. While holding the blood diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.

sections.heading: Ice diamond
sections.needed: A sweet (cake, chocolate cake (partial cakes work), chocolate bar, cooking apple, or pineapple pizza), spiked boots, and climbing boots (or Trollheim Teleport or Trollheim tablet)
sections.recommended: Combat equipment (if using Magic, which is recommended, bring runes for casting your best fire spell), 4 or more regular or super restore potions, a few prayer potions (depending on your combat level), lots of good food or Saradomin brews if using super restore potions, an emergency teleportation method, a God banner (only if all combat tasks have been completed) or overloads, and run energy restoring, Endurance relic power, salt-water spring or a flask of salt water

steps.text: Prepare for combat by getting plenty of food, a few super restore and super energy potions (even at max combat). Also grab a cake or a chocolate bar if not already in your inventory.

substeps.text: Get runes and a magic weapon for fire spells if using Magic. Only fire spells will work if using Magic on Kamil.

steps.text: If you don't have spiked boots, get them first from Dunstan in Burthorpe (requires an iron bar).
If you used your climbing boots to get the spiked boots, then get a new pair of climbing boots from Freda.
Consider using the Endurance relic power in place of energy potions to keep your run energy up.
Travel to Trollheim using Trollheim Teleport.

substeps.text: Otherwise, take the path from the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or the Death Plateau to Troll Stronghold with climbing boots.

steps.text: Take the path that leads to the snow area north-west of Troll Stronghold.
Talk to the troll child a few squares west of the ice gate.
Use a cake or a chocolate bar on him. Talk again to help him. (1)
Enable Protect from Melee, and head east through the ice gate.
Kill 5 trolls, then travel through the cave entrance to your east and keep running.
Kill Kamil when he appears.
After you kill Kamil once, continue the path to the north and walk to the ice ledge. You can use Surge.
Equip your spiked boots and climb the path to the top.
Pass through the ice gate and across the bridge.
Break the two ice blocks at the top (by casting a fire spell or choosing the "smash-ice" option).
Talk to the trolls, the child will give you the Ice diamond.
Bank the ice diamond immediately. While holding the ice diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.

sections.heading: Smoke diamond
sections.needed: Face mask, masked earmuffs or slayer helmet, ice gloves

steps.text: Prepare for combat by bringing plenty of food, few super energy potions, melee gear, or water spells if using magic, or ice arrows if using ranged.
Travel to Pollnivneach.
With your face mask and ice gloves equipped enter the Smoke Dungeon.

substeps.text: If Smoking Kills is complete the dungeon can be entered from the Pollnivneach well and through the dark stairs to the west.
Otherwise the player can enter the smokey well which is located west of Pollnivneach.
Killing a dust devil completes the achievement Drafty in Here.

steps.text: Light the four standing torches, 1 in each corner of the dungeon. This part is timed and torches will go out if you are not fast enough.
Consider using the Endurance relic power in place of energy potions to keep your run energy up.
Open the burnt chest in the middle of the dungeon to receive a Warm key.

substeps.text: Each torch will remain lit for exactly 5 minutes, and you will receive a game message when each one dies out. You will be unable to open the chest if any of the torches have gone out, even if you have lit all 4 torches before attempting.

steps.text: With the warm key, open the gate on the eastern side of the dungeon.
Defeat Fareed for the Smoke diamond.

substeps.text: You must use melee, ranged, necromancy, or water spells.
You must wear ice gloves to wield a main-hand weapon while fighting him, including staves and bows. Off-hand weapons are not restricted.
While ranged weapons are effective on Fareed, any ammunition used by auto-attacks besides ice arrows will drop beneath him as ashes, bypassing the ammo-saving effect of Ava's accumulator.

steps.text: Bank the smoke diamond immediately. While holding the smoke diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.

sections.heading: Shadow diamond
sections.needed: Lots of lockpicks, hair clips, or a master thief's lockpick, earth spells if using magic. See each section for more info
sections.recommended: A few doses of antipoison

steps.text: Travel to Rasolo (north-west from Ardougne lodestone; see the map to the right). (3•1)

sections.heading: Stealing the cross
sections.needed: Waterskins, lots of lockpicks, hair clips, or a master thief's lockpick
sections.recommended: A few doses of antipoison

steps.text: Return to the desert Bandit Camp.
Unlock the secure chest in the southern-most tent. You might consume between 10 to 100 lockpicks.

substeps.text: Hair clips are very useful here, as you can reclaim them from Merlin for free.
You can steal from the level 54 Bandits around the camp to get lock picks and antipoison.
Master thief's lockpick also works and will never break.
Five finger discount upgrades help.

sections.heading: Getting the diamond
sections.needed: Gilded cross, combat equipment, earth spells if using magic

steps.text: Prepare for combat before returning the cross to Rasolo who will give you a ring of visibility.
Equip the ring, run into the nearby triangular fenced area and climb down the ladder. You may equip any other ring now as this was only required to see the invisible ladder.
Run east to Damis and kill him in both phases for the Shadow diamond. See the map below for the path to take.

substeps.text: If Damis despawns, run a small distance back from where you came, then run back.

steps.text: Bank the shadow diamond immediately. While holding the shadow diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.

sections.heading: Jaldraocht Pyramid
sections.needed: All 4 diamonds
sections.recommended: Energy potions, weapon, weight-reducing equipment, antipoison

steps.text: Make sure your weight is less than 5 kg or you'll keep failing traps.

substeps.text: Boots of lightness and any other weight reducing equipment helps.

steps.text: Return to the Bandit Camp, and head directly south of Eblis to the pyramid.
Use the diamonds on the obelisks surrounding the pyramid.

substeps.text: Blood diamond in the north-west obelisk.
Shadow diamond in the south-west obelisk.
Ice diamond in the south-east obelisk.
Smoke diamond in the north-east obelisk.

steps.text: Climb down the ladder at the top of the pyramid.
Run through the pyramid using the map. Don't stand still, or you may be transported back to the start.

substeps.text: There's a possibility that scarabs spawn in Azzanadra's room so bring a weapon, antipoison, and some more food just in case.

steps.text: Talk to Azzanadra.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to use Ancient Magicks You can now also pray either at the pyramid altar or the elven grimoire in Prifddinas (after completing Plague's End) and change between the standard and Ancient Magicks spellbooks. You can also enter the altar room by accessing the back-door of the pyramid. Changing spellbooks at the altar will drain your prayer to 0.
Also requires completion of the quest The Giant Dwarf

Desperate Measures.name: Desperate Measures
items_required: 100 orthenglass (Can be stored in material storage container. Can also be obtained during quest from Anachronia north excavation site.)
The Measure (Obtained during quest if not in bank or inventory. Fate of the Gods not required.)

sections.heading: Finding the dragonkin artefacts
sections.needed: 2 backpack spaces, 100 orthenglass in material storage (can be obtained from Anachronia north excavation site during quest, recommended to bring multiple sign of the porters if collecting there)
sections.recommended: Around 10 backpack spaces, Archaeology journal, activated Anachronia lodestone

steps.text: Speak to Seren on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Burthorpe Castle (north of the lodestone). (~•✓•~)
Head to Anachronia to speak with Mr Mordaut in the base camp. (1•1)
Go north of the base camp, and down the two flights of stairs to the dragonkin gate. Do not begin the Agility course.
Dismiss any pets or followers and then speak with Thok or Charos. (1)
Inside the flashback, go to Charos. Finish all dialogue before continuing else you will exit the flashback and have to start over.
Smash the feral dinosaurs.
Continue east along the path, attacking more dinosaurs as you go.
Talk to Laniakea and then follow her across the bridge. After Kerapac leaves, finish the conversation with Charos. (1•3)
Uncover and excavate the dragonkin remains excavation hotspot that appears 4 tiles south and 3 tiles east of Thok and Charos to obtain a dragonkin device (damaged).
Restore the dragonkin device at an archaeologist's workbench.
Talk to Charos (4)
Excavate the orthen rubble spot, which appears about three paces north of him, to obtain a dragonkin tablet (damaged).

substeps.text: If you do not have enough orthenglass, you can destroy the tablet and excavate again.

steps.text: Restore the dragonkin tablet at an archaeologist's workbench.
Talk to Charos. (5)

sections.heading: Nodon hibernatorium shared memory
sections.needed: Dragonkin device, Dragonkin tablet
sections.recommended: Quick access to Anachronia Dinosaur Farm

steps.text: Head to the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm (from the Manor Farm, go to the top floor of the manor and teleport using the mystical tree).
Speak to Hannibus next to Prehistoric Potterington. (5)
Travel to the Nodon Hibernatorium on the north-eastern coast of Anachronia, east of the Herby Werby entrance and south-east of the Observation outpost (see map).
Enter the southern door next to Hannibus using the dragonkin device you restored earlier.
Talk with Hannibus inside. (1)
Speak with Hannibus again (1)

Eventually, one of the Nodon caretakers will walk to the south-eastern corner of the room. Wait for the Nodon caretaker to finish putting in the passcode on the pylon, and you will be able to cycle the symbols.

substeps.text: You must first click on the pylon in the shared memory.
Talk with Hannibus to exit the dream. (2•1)

steps.text: Cycle each of the three symbols outside of the dream until they match what you saw in the dream. Your character will interrupt when a symbol is input correctly. Continue that dialogue instead of exiting the chat box, otherwise, Hannibus won't recognise the correct sequence.
Re-enter the dream and start the shared dream again. This time, follow the other dragonkin outside.
Follow him until he walks to the door at the front of the ruins and speak a passphrase. Not being close enough to the door will cause you to miss the passphrase.

Speak to Hannibus again and exit the dream (you can lobby and log back to go faster). Return to the front of the ruins and enter the door with the passphrase you heard earlier (should be in the chat box).
Inside the front door, speak with Hannibus (1)

substeps.text: Ensure you rotated three characters on the pylon; one on the left, one on the right, and one in the centre. May need to zoom in to see. Hannibus should also be now standing in front of the door, he wasn't before. Each character will confirm a prompt once it is in the correct position. There will be 3 dialogue confirmations total.

steps.text: Speak with Hannibus, next to a water pool, inside the dream to start a shared memory. (1)
Skip the cutscene on Kerapac's device.
Attack Kerapac until he flies off or watch your party of NPCs try to fight him. It may take about 1 minute. No damage will be done to or by you in the fight.
Return and talk to Seren in Burthorpe.
Speak to Primrose located in the house by the Needle (far west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony).

substeps.text: The nearest fairy ring is AKQ.
Memory strand can also be used to teleport to Memorial to Guthix, which is south of the house.

steps.text: Talk to Primrose and exhaust all chat options (focus on finding the needles weakness). (1•1•1•1•1•2•4•1•1•4)
Return to Seren.

sections.heading: Meeting Jas
sections.needed: 1 backpack space

sections.heading: Dinosaur invasion
sections.needed: Eye of Jas, nothing equipped in your main-hand and off-hand, or enough backpack space to unequip

steps.text: Return to the Anachronia base camp and speak with Charos near the lodestone.
After Kerapac turns up, speak with Thok to start the fight. You can't be wielding anything in your hands. (1)
Follow the instructions set out when starting the fight with your team members (Hannibus, Thok, Charos, and Laniakea).

substeps.text: If you get the message "you need to finish speaking with Charos before you can start the encounter", you also have to change Charos attack type (just choose closest), then you need to move Hannibus one square away and move him back to his original place.

Keep them in their default positions, and stand two squares west of Charos. You should win without moving, but if you struggle then move your character around to get early hits on the bigger dinosaurs.
If you exit dialogue with Charos too early you may need to reset the instance by right clicking Thok and clicking Leave.

sections.heading: Kerapac's laboratory
sections.needed: The Measure (received in first step by speaking to Charos, if Fate of the Gods is not completed), Eye of Jas, 1 backpack space (2 if you didn't already have the Measure)
sections.recommended: food, weapon, armour, and prayer potions for the next step

steps.text: After the fight is complete, speak with Charos next to the lodestone. Go north past the Anachronia Agility Course and speak with Charos once more. (~)

You have to use The Measure near Charos a total of four times in the ruined areas surrounding the volcano. He will speak to you automatically if done correctly. If anytime during this Charos disappears or you are unable to interact properly with him, log out and back in or try hopping worlds. Charos will be standing right at the spot you need to use The Measure at. When you arrive at one of the spots where Charos is at, place The Measure. After placing The Measure, it's unnecessary to fully finish speaking to Charos. Players may proceed to the next location.

substeps.text: The first location is a bit north of the entrance where you talk to him.
The second location is north of the lodestone. Start the Agility course, enter through the cave, cross the roots, and walk north till you reach the camouflaged jadinkos.

The third location can be reached by teleporting to the Anachronia lodestone, then head west past the bridge and north-west past the arcane apoterrasaur until you reach the dragonkin ruins. Alternatively, players that have unlocked the Orthen teleportation device can teleport to the third location.
The last location is directly east of the previous location, up a flight of stairs.

steps.text: Prepare for combat.

Speak with Charos again (north of the base camp). (If he is not there, step into the room north of Thok and step out again. He might appear in the northern room, if so, place a measure in front of him.)
Enter Kerapac's laboratory. (An entrance will have spawned where you met Thok and Charos north of the base camp.)
Enter the correct codes into the pylons on the four corners of the area, as given in the image on the right. The codes are the same for all players.

substeps.text: The south-western room's solution is 2-1-4.
The north-western room's solution is 7-1-5.
The north-eastern room's solution is 4-1-6.
The south-eastern room's solution is 3-1-4.

sections.heading: Black stone dragon
sections.needed: A weapon to kill a level 91 version of the black stone dragon
sections.recommended: food, armour, prayer potions

steps.text: Enter the room to the north that has now opened up and prepare for a battle with the black stone dragon. (If you die while fighting the dragon, it is a safe death.)
After defeating the dragon, talk to Kerapac when he appears.

Choose any chat option, and after the cutscene, the lab will start to collapse and you will get a timer on your screen and have to escape. When you hit a dead end, turn around or interact with a nearby character to continue. Failing restarts the escape.

substeps.text: If you get sent back out before talking to Kerapac or the escape sequence by logging out or being interrupted (such as conjures), you may re-enter Kerapac's lab to trigger the sequence again.

steps.text: After escaping the lab and the following cutscenes, return to Seren in Burthorpe (requires 4 backpack spaces to collect reward).
Quest complete!

items: 20,000 Combat experience lamp in one of: Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, Necromancy or Prayer
The ability to complete the Desperate for Artefacts Archaeology collection

items_required: The stone spirits must not be in an ore box. They must be in the backpack.
Old necklace or necklace of Charos (obtainable during the quest)
Any set of equipment that allows access to the Black Knights' Fortress or a Skull of Remembrance for teleporting directly inside

Go inside McGrubor's Wood. Descend into the mysterious hole just south of the house. (1)

Read the letter from Charos.

sections.heading: Keys
notes: The location of each key is the same for everyone and the puzzle is the same for each key. However, the solutions to each puzzle are random for each player.

sections.heading: First key
sections.needed: old necklace or necklace of Charos

steps.text: Go to the Varrock Dig Site and step on the strange portal near the entrance to the Empty Throne Room. It is found north of the screening station.
Step on the portals until a room with a chest unlocks.

substeps.text: If the room has a note on a recipe: If the amount of each & every ingredient can be represented with a single Roman numeral (e.g. 1000g of Bacon = "M"), those are the code. If not, the code is the first letter of each ingredient.
Note: Roman numerals for some of the steps below: 1=I, 5=V, 10=X, 50=L, 100=C, 500=D, 1,000=M.

If the room has 4 random items, the code for the chest is the first letter of each item (e.g. Plank, Jute Fibres, Catfish and Diamond Bolt). Order is starting from farthest item from the chest to the closest item to the chest. If this doesn't work, try the letters in the opposite order. Due to recent changes Longbows are S instead of L.
If the room has coins on the ground examine each pile, the code is the number of coins in each pile. Go clockwise, as represented in Roman numerals (e.g. 500 coins = "D").
If there is a plaque next to the room's door, the code is the first letter of each lodestone name depicted (e.g. Lumbridge, Falador, Draynor Village and Varrock).
If the room has only one item on the ground with a four-letter word in its name, the combination is those four letters. (e.g. Beer = BEER or Swordfish = FISH).
If the room has a clean herb on the ground, the combination is HERB.

steps.text: When the chest is unlocked, note the order of the icons.
Repeat for as many chests as needed until you have the full solution.

Rearrange the slide puzzle in the middle to match the icons seen from the chests. (North side is up. If you accidentally did the puzzle upside down, just rotate the outer pieces until they are in place.)
Step on the exit portal to the west.
notes: **for help solving the sliding puzzle: https://analogbit.com/software/puzzletools/
Create new grid
Set grid to 3x3

sections.heading: Second key
sections.needed: An outfit to gain access to the Black Knights' Fortress or a skull of remembrance

steps.text: Enter the Black Knights' Fortress, and step on the portal on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] of the Black Knights' Fortress in the south-east room near the entrance to the fortress.
Follow the key rules above again.
Step on the exit portal to the west.

sections.heading: Third key
sections.needed: old necklace or necklace of Charos

steps.text: Step on the portal in the south-east room on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Varrock Palace. The portal is hidden behind the eastern bath screen. King Roald and Sir Amik Varze will be at the table near the stairs.
Follow the key rules above for this part.
Step on the exit portal to the west.

sections.heading: The big reveal
sections.needed: 3 rune bars, 2 runite stone spirits, 10 gleaming energy, 10 mind runes, old necklace or necklace of Charos

steps.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library (the northern-most room of the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] of the palace) (1•~•~•~)
Give Charos 3 rune bars, 2 runite stone spirits, 10 gleaming energy, and 10 mind runes.

substeps.text: Runite stone spirits in an ore box will not work. They must be in the backpack.

sections.heading: The device
sections.needed: Combat gear to defeat 5 level 50 opponents and 5 empty inventory spaces

steps.text: Gear for combat. Deaths here are non-safe.
Return to The Needle. (Phoenix Lair Teleport, fairy ring AKQ, Sixth-Age circuit teleports to Guthix memorial, or via memory strands within the currency pouch)
Talk to Kerapac.
Manoeuver through the paths and kill the 5 Sliske clones, pick up the fragments. Make sure lootshare is turned off.

substeps.text: The Sliske clones appear to spawn from stepping on specific spots, so if the clones don't spawn step through each path comprehensively until they spawn

steps.text: Combine the fragments into Sliske's mask.
Walk to the bottom of the platform, wear the mask, and kill Guthix. (1)
Harvest the five memories on Naragun, each memory shows up as a yellow dot on the minimap, and go through the dialogue until the NPCs teleport away.
Talk to Guthix near the empty fairy ring. (~)
Click each mutable anima once so both the green particles will end up on Kerapac. There are 4 in total.
Go into the room to the west, jump the gap outside the window on the south-east side, run across the planks, drop down the rock face, climb the rock face, and climb through the obstacle.
Run around through each room and open the door at the last room.
Switch all the green mutable anima.

substeps.text: Use temporal rifts to teleport between levels. There are 3 levels in total with the bottom and top floors containing 1 mutable anima each and the middle floor containing 2.

steps.text: Redirect the green mutable anima to Kerapac (refer to the image).

substeps.text: Harvest all three unrefined anima (red dots on the image) to unlock the three frozen anima. Make sure to finish the dialogue with each NPC.
Switch the green mutable anima according to the direction on the image. All of these can be clicked while standing on the main floor.
Disable bloom in graphics settings if it is difficult to see the direction the green mutable anima is facing.

steps.text: After a cutscene, return to the Council of Burthorpe and talk to Seren. (If cutscene doesn't start, talk to Kerapac.)

True or False (if not already unlocked during Hero's Welcome)

Talk to Sliske. (3•~)

Continue dialogue with Zamorak. (~•1•1)

steps.text: Talk to Moia. (4•2•1•1)
Kill the armoured zombies.
Go upstairs and talk to Zemouregal or Enakhra. (1•3)
Search the orange and brown chest for 3 cut gems, 5k coins, and 250 Dungeoneering tokens before leaving the room.

Board the raft.
Talk to Hazeel. (3)
Go down the trapdoor behind Handelmort Mansion.

Search the dead butler for a cell key.
Unlock the cell door.
Talk to Jerrod.

Enter and talk to General Khazard. (3•1)
In the shadow realm, search Palkeera's corpse.
Speak to Khazard.
Search the orange and brown chest for 3 cut gems, 5k coins, and 250 Dungeoneering tokens before leaving the room.
Go to the Black Knights' Base in the Taverley Dungeon.

Via an Archaeology teleport purchased from Ezreal in the Archaeology Guild for 250 chronotes.
Via a hoardstalker ring or dungeoneering cape (0•1)

Talk to the Preaching Black Knight in the middle. (~)

Get the poison from the chest in the north-west corner.
Talk to Lord Daquarius.
Search the orange and brown chest for 3 cut gems, 5k coins, and 250 Dungeoneering tokens before leaving the room.
Enter Death's office.

substeps.text: Home Teleport to the Draynor lodestone and head north.
War's Retreat Teleport and then exit to Death's office via the portal. (2)

steps.text: Continue dialogue with Death and Nomad. (2•~)
If ready for combat, accept the teleport to the hideout. (1)

sections.heading: The plan
sections.needed: Combat equipment and food if lower-levelled

steps.text: Activate the Communication device to return to Zamorak's Hideout. (2)
Continue the dialogue. (1•~)

substeps.text: Via Drakan's medallion (1)

steps.text: Locate the dungeon entrance to the south-east (outside the stone wall).
Search the orange and brown chest for 3 cut ruby gems, 5k coins, and 250 Dungeoneering tokens just North of the lair entrance.
Enter Sliske's lair (you cannot enter with a familiar summoned).
From the first room, enter the cave entrances as follows:

substeps.text: Blue (blue paint above the entrance) (western door)
5 (V) (on the floor) (south door)- players that use "low detail" may have some trouble seeing the V-shape. You can examine the slabs to be told which number is engraved on it, if it is unclear.
A sinister green face (northern most door).
Triangle (north-eastern most door).
Red (red paint above the door) (south-eastern door).
Complete face (On the floor) (north-eastern door).
Grey (may also appear as a white colour; western door in the north-eastern corner).

steps.text: Watch a cutscene. (~)
Wait for the Wight to face away from you and forward dive behind them to close the gap. Left-click to assassinate them.
Wait for the masks to scan 3 times.
Move quickly to the middle of the room and pull the lever.
Get caught, walk west to room 2 (pull the lever).
Stand on the right side of the hallway with the shadow and forward dive to the doorway on the east, avoiding the shadow along the way (use the crevices on the sides of the hallway to hide).

substeps.text: It may be very hard to see the shadow. It is a pulsating black light on the floor, moving up and down the corridor.

steps.text: Assassinate the Wight and pull the lever.
Go through the passageway now open at the beginning of the room, forward dive past the Wight, and assassinate them.
Proceed up the hallway and dive past the last two masks to the lever.
Enter room 3.
Forward dive past the guard (1) to the east and assassinate him. (1)
Continue north and dispatch the next guard (2). (2)
Stand in the doorway to the main hallway and wait for the guard (3) to come to you and dispatch him (watch for the shadow on the floor). (3)
Continue across the hallway and dispatch the guard walking around the pillar (4). (4)
Go north to the lever (2) and pull it. Rocks will fall, distracting the guard (5). Dispatch him and pull the lever (3). (2)
Return to Jerrod. You can get caught to get back quickly.

Go back east and then down the narrow hallway and stop before entering the main hallway, wait for the shadow to go to the far end and cross the main hallway, enter the room across from you and assassinate the guard (6). (6)
Return to the south-east corner and pull the lever (1). (1)

Head to the north-east lever, avoiding the shadow. Stand in the south-east corner of the hallway where the shadow is patrolling; when the shadow moves away, move one space north, click the option to turn 45 degrees left, then forward dive. Assassinate the guard (7). (7)
Go behind the shadow and pull the lever (4). (4)
Jerrod will kill the last guard (near lever 5) by the doors. Pull the final lever by the door, watching for the main hallway shadow.
Once inside, finish the dialogue. (1)
Right click track with Jerrod. Use chat options 1 or 2 to direct the camera to face the footprints. Then select option 3 to track. If done correctly, Jerrod will start following the footprints.
Right-click read mind with Moia in the centre. If she doesn't let you, wait for Jerrod to be in position.

substeps.text: Mouse around the interface until you find the position such that the probe blinks fast (approximately twice per second), then left-click to probe the memory. Turning on sound effects can help.

steps.text: After reading the first wraith's mind, light and shadow levels will show up on the top of the screen, trending in opposite directions. To maintain their balance, right-click switch on either Nomad or Enakhra to make it go the opposite direction.

After reading the second wraith's mind, the passageways on the western and eastern walls will show glowing yellow eyes. Talk to Zemouregal to move the purple portals to the two spots with eyes. Note the compass to make sure you are selecting the correct location.

Keeping an eye on the light and shadow levels, repeat this process for 5 total memories: track with Jerrod, read mind with Moia, then select the corresponding locations for the glowing eyes with Zemouregal.
Open the large vault door.
Watch the cutscene. (~•~)
Fight and kill your shadow apparition.

substeps.text: Run off the platform when teleported to the centre and move out of the path of the smoke. It travels straight down the stairs.
Stand near the boss when he summons darkness or you will take massive damage.
Click rapidly to escape cocoons.

steps.text: Kill 30 wights around the room.
Use Nomad's special attacks to kill multiple wights with a single hit.
Touch the Stone of Jas. (1)
Kill everyone's apparition.
All damage is increased to 10,000 and above, capping at 25,000.

substeps.text: As such, bleed attacks are helpful here as well as AoE.

steps.text: Stop Nomad. (1•1)

substeps.text: You must choose to stop him, otherwise he becomes powerful in future quests.

sections.heading: Three Wise Monkeys
sections.needed: Any monkey greegree, a monkeyspeak amulet, at least 10 coins, and a lot of backpack space (20+ to make it easy in one try)

steps.text: Head to Ape Atoll and equip the monkey greegree and monkeyspeak amulet, then speak to three wise monkeys in the Temple of Marimbo (north-easternmost temple). (1•1)

Fill your entire backpack with Green bananas by using take banana from the pile of bananas crate to the east and lay a trail to lure the guard to the crate (you can place bananas every few squares to ensure the guard does not give up. Key-binding the Green banana will make this step easier). You will have to go counter-clockwise around the building due to the large gorilla posted on the north side. See the full guide for advice on luring the guard efficiently.
Return to the three wise monkeys and talk to them.
Remove your greegree and speak to them in human form.
Equip your greegree and speak to them again. (2•4)
Talk to Awowogei, who is in the building south of the temple. (1•5•3)
If you don't have a monkeyspeak amulet mould, Hamab's crafting stall sells one, which is needed for the next step.

sections.heading: Chimp ice
sections.needed: 1,000 coins, Monkey greegree, rope, Monkeyspeak amulet, Monkeyspeak amulet mould, Ancient Magicks spellbook, runes for either Ice Burst, Ice Blitz, or Ice Barrage
sections.recommended: Anti-poison potions, good armour, energy potions, and food

steps.text: Talk to Rokuh in Nardah next to the fountain. (1•1•2)
You should receive one chimp ice. If it melts, right click on Rokuh to buy another. Click to stop it from melting. Higher level spells, like Ice Barrage, will last longer.

substeps.text: Unlike standard ancient spell casting, you do not need a staff/wand and orb/book for this. Only the runes are enough.

steps.text: Helpful things to keep in mind:

substeps.text: Looking at the world map prevents the chimp ice from melting.
If you are out of run energy, rest and pull up the world map.
Talking to NPC's prevents the chimp ice from melting.
Using transportation such as magic carpets and eagles prevents the chimp ice from melting.

steps.text: Take the chimp ice to King Awowogei without teleporting (this route requires completion of Eagles' Peak. For a full list of routes, see the in-depth quest guide):

substeps.text: From Nardah, use the magic carpet to Uzer.

Run north-west to the desert eagle lair located north of the Uzer Hunter area and north-east of the Dominion Tower. Enter the tunnel shown in the picture, and use the rope that spawns nearby on an eagle to be transported.
Exit the cave via the north-west entrance and climb down the mountain.
Run east into Tree Gnome Stronghold, up 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Grand Tree and find Daero to the east to travel to the Secret Hangar.
Talk to Waydar to travel to Crash Island.
Talk to Lumdo to travel to Ape Atoll. You get a checkpoint here where you can restart if the chimp ice melts.

Run to King Awowogei. The chimp ice can't be frozen while transformed as a monkey, so choose your moments carefully. An easy method is to freeze it at the mahogany tree before the main gate, turn into a monkey, and enter the gate. Run east to the small obelisk across from the agility course and hide in the grass to freeze it again. Then turn back into a monkey, and run to King Awowogei.

steps.text: Go to the wise monkeys and add them to the barrel.
