sections.heading: Building the colony
sections.needed: 1 hammer & 1 saw (toolbelt works for both), 6 teak planks (protean planks and planks stored in the plank box will not work), 10 bolts of cloth, 1 rope, 1 uncut sapphire, 1 uncut emerald, 1 uncut ruby, 1 uncut diamond (gems are obtained during quest), 1 pair of desert boots, 1 desert robe, 1 desert shirt and 1 Monkeyspeak amulet, 10 noted bananas, 3 noted knives, 3 noted waterskins (4), and a spade. The desert equipment, knives and waterskins can be bought at the Bandit Camp general store nearby

steps.text: Clear Rubble from the four building spots in the colony.
Build-on the 3 stall plots using your supplies.
Stock the stalls.

substeps.text: Careful not to stock a stall twice - each one needs to be stocked with one set of items.

steps.text: Build-on Tent plot
Talk to the wise monkeys.
Talk to them again. (2)

sections.heading: Arming the colony
sections.needed: gorilla greegree (also a ninja monkey greegree (small) if using the fairy ring), 1 Monkeyspeak amulet

steps.text: Head back to Ape Atoll and find the building with the monkey knife fighters; it is located just east of the building with the Monkey Child.
Punch and then quickly pickpocket the monkey fighters for 6 Monkey knives. The success rate is fairly low, so be prepared to punch at least 30 monkeys.

substeps.text: If you are fast enough, you can get three pickpockets until the monkey wakes up again

steps.text: Return to the three wise monkeys and hand the knives over.
Talk to the monkeys again.

sections.heading: Boss fights
sections.needed: Ghostspeak amulet and Monkeyspeak amulet

steps.text: Return to the pyramid south of the Ruins of Uzer, east of DLQ, and click the door for a cutscene.
Enter the pyramid and speak to Senliten. (2•~)
Teleport to Bandit Camp and head back to the colony.
Investigate any Corpse to make a ghost monkey appear.
Try to talk to the ghost monkey.
Use one of the amulets on the other to create a cramulet.
Talk to the ghost monkey. (3)

sections.heading: Leeuni
sections.needed: masked earmuffs or a slayer helmet, a cramulet and combat gear
notes: For information on how to defeat this boss, click here.

steps.text: Climb down the well in the middle of Pollnivneach, pass through the Wavering mystic barrier to the north (2)
Kill Leeuni (50,000 life points).
After defeating Leeuni, talk to Iwazaru.
Return to the monkey colony and speak to the ghost monkey again to unlock the next boss.

sections.heading: Ayuni
sections.needed: 2 ropes if you have never entered the Kalphite Queen's lair, a cramulet and combat gear
notes: For information how to defeat this boss, click here.

steps.text: Kill Ayuni (50,000 life points), who is accessed through a tunnel north of the Kalphite Queen within the Kalphite Hive (not the Exiled Kalphite Hive).

substeps.text: The Kalphite Queen can be avoided if you set up a custom encounter, as her spawn will be delayed initially. Use practice mode to avoid paying.

steps.text: After the battle, talk to Mizaru. Leave through the east exit to unlock a shortcut or get transported (5)
Return to the monkey colony and speak to the ghost monkey again to unlock the next boss.

sections.heading: Eruni
sections.needed: a cramulet and combat gear
notes: For information on how to defeat this boss, click here.

steps.text: Warning! Eruni hits much harder than the other two. Although she has lower defence. Be prepared for an intense fight. Protection prayers and high-healing food strongly recommended.
Head to the ruins of Uzer, down the steps and through the door to the north into the demonic realm.
Eruni will be invincible whenever she summons lesser demons; they must be killed immediately.
After defeating Eruni, speak to Kikazaru, who will take you to the colony.
Speak to the three wise monkeys at the colony - Apmeken will appear and speak to you. (2)
Return to Senliten. (2)
Quest complete!

items: New magic carpet destination at the monkey colony.
Cramulet and the ability to add other speaking amulets to it (catspeak amulet, camulet, cabbagespeak amulet, crocspeak amulet, and crabulet).
The ability to upgrade Ava's accumulator to Ava's alerter.
Ability to run chimp ice for further rewards.
Ability to pickpocket monkey knife fighters.
Access to a passageway from the desert (rockslide south of the Kalphite Hive entrance) to a new area with kalphites. This is unlocked if you left the Ayuni room from the hole while you were in it.
One "free" clue scroll (elite) with Ava's alerter. This clue scroll can be found in either Meiyerditch, on the Iceberg, in Isafdar or on Lunar Isle.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Players with level 80 (boosts may be used) can enter (climb exit) a cavern on the cliff that makes up the south wall of the Monkey colony for 20,000 Agility experience (not affected by xp boosts), and access to a secret treasure room, which contains an Apmeken mask and an ankh.

Dragon Slayer.name: Dragon Slayer
items_required: A crayfish cage or lobster pot (tool belt does not work)
To obtain one of the map parts, specifically map part (Lozar), you need to do one of the following:
A weapon to kill Wormbrain. You can either use Telekinetic Grab or utilise area loot to obtain it.
90 steel nails (other metal nails will not work)
An anti-dragon shield (will be obtained during quest) or super antifire potion

steps.text: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. (2•✓)
Talk to Oziach in the house directly north of the Edgeville lodestone. (1•1•1•1)
Go back to the Guildmaster and talk about the map pieces to get the key, about protection against dragon breath, and about buying a boat. (2•1•1•1•2•3•2•3)

sections.heading: First map part
sections.needed: Maze key
sections.recommended: Food and combat equipment, 2 backpack spaces

steps.text: Go to Melzar's Maze, north-west of Rimmington.
Enter the door with the maze key.
Kill the small zombie rat with the long tail, pick up the red key and use it on the north-west door, then go up the ladder.
Kill the thin hooded ghost with the patterned robe to receive the orange key, go through the door second from the north on the eastern wall and climb the ladder.
Kill the skeleton with the small round shield and pick up the yellow key. Use the key on the south-western most door and climb down until you get to the zombies.
Kill the zombies. One of them will drop a blue key. Pass through the blue door.
Kill Melzar the Mad, pick up the magenta key and pass through the magenta coloured door.
Kill the lesser demon, pick up the green key, and go through the green door.
Open the chest and search it for the map part.

substeps.text: Note: Make sure you finish the dialogue, or you will not receive the map part.

sections.heading: Second map part
sections.needed: Unfired bowl, wizard's mind bomb, lobster pot or a crayfish cage, and silk

steps.text: Talk to the Oracle on Ice Mountain. (1)

Travel south into the dwarven mines. Find the room with a sealed door in the north-eastern area of the mine and use all the items on the "Magic door". (Unfired bowl, wizard's mind bomb, lobster pot or a crayfish cage, and silk)
Open the chest in the room and search for the second map part after opening. You need to click again to search after the dialogue, it does not automatically loot or search.

sections.heading: Third map part
sections.needed: Either 10,000 coins, or a halberd, Ranged, Magic or Necromancy weapon

steps.text: Head to Port Sarim Jail and talk to Wormbrain in the cell.

substeps.text: You may need to speak with the Guild Master at this point before you can attack Wormbrain.

steps.text: There are two ways to obtain the third map part:

substeps.text: Talk to Wormbrain and pay him 10,000 coins for the map part. (1•3•2)
Attack Wormbrain and use the loot interface or Telekinetic Grab to get the map part that he drops. You may need to drop an item in order for the loot interface to open.

steps.text: Use a map part on any one of the other parts to form the complete Crandor map.
Talk to Duke Horacio on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Lumbridge Castle. (1•1•1•2)

substeps.text: You can also buy an anti-dragon shield from the Grand Exchange to skip this step entirely.
If the dialogue option for the anti-dragon shield doesn't appear, you need to talk to the Guildmaster about protection from dragon fire

sections.heading: Obtaining a ship
sections.needed: Crandor map, 2,000 coins, 90 steel nails, 3 planks, and a hammer (tool belt works)

steps.text: If you haven't already, ask the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild about the boat and the captain of the ship.
In Port Sarim, buy the ship Lady Lumbridge from Klarense, by the Void knight Squire. (4•1)
Repair the damaged deck of the ship.
Go to Draynor Village. In the house north-east of the bank talk to Ned. (2•1)

sections.heading: The fight
sections.needed: Food, potions, combat equipment, anti-dragon shield
sections.recommended: Antifire potion, amulet of glory with at least 1 charge to teleport to Edgeville

steps.text: Prepare the battle against Elvarg.

substeps.text: Melee is recommended due to how hit chances are calculated.
Players with level 37 Prayer can use Protect from Magic.

steps.text: Board your ship and talk to Ned. Tell him you're ready to sail to Crandor Isle. (1)
After crashing on the island, follow the light grey path around and up to the top of the mountain. Climb down the hole.
Move past the skeletons until you see Elvarg behind a short wall of spikes protruding from the ground on the east.
Before you climb over to Elvarg its advisable to open the shortcut in the wall south of the short wall.
Climb over it and kill Elvarg.

substeps.text: Wear your dragonfire protection before hopping over, or your stats will get drained resulting most likely in a failed kill.
If you leave Crandor before killing Elvarg or opening the shortcut, you will need 3 planks and 90 steel nails to repair the ship to get back.

steps.text: Take Elvarg's head to Oziach in Edgeville.
Quest complete!

items: Maze key, giving access to Melzar's Maze
Access to the dragon crest on herald capes

Eadgar's Ruse.name: Eadgar's Ruse
items_required: Climbing boots or rock climbing boots (not required if the player has completed Love Story, and has the ability to make Trollheim teleport tablets)
A bottle of vodka (can be bought along with a pineapple from Heckel Funch at the Gnome Stronghold, or from the Grand Exchange)
Pineapple chunks (right click on pineapple, slice, and select the option for pineapple chunks)
5 raw chickens (unnoted, there are chickens in Freda's backyard)

steps.text: Start the quest by speaking to Sanfew, who lives on the east side of Taverley, south-west of the summoning shop. (2•1•✓)

substeps.text: If Zogre Flesh Eaters is not complete, use the following option: (1•✓)

sections.heading: The troll cook
sections.needed: Climbing boots
notes: If you have killed a God Wars Boss, it is much faster to teleport to that boss, exit via the rope and head to the Stronghold SW than navigating from Burthorpe.

steps.text: Equip your climbing boots and make your way to the Troll Stronghold via either the main entrance or the secret entrance.

substeps.text: From the main entrance, go south and then climb down the stairs into the Troll kitchen.
If using the secret entrance, go to the ambush commander and climb the nearby wall, then head west.
Once inside, go all the way north and climb up the stairs.
Go south into the Troll kitchen.

steps.text: Speak to Burntmeat.

sections.heading: Tricking the trolls
sections.needed: Climbing boots, vodka, pineapple chunks, 10 wheat, 5 raw chickens, logs, ranarr potion (unfinished)

steps.text: Walk out of the stronghold's main entrance and head east to the top of the mountain (Eadgar's cave). Located on top of the mountain with the thrower trolls, the world map marks this as Trollheim.
Enter the cave.
Talk to Eadgar.
Talk to Parroty Pete at the Ardougne Zoo. He is located at the northern end by the wolves. (3)
Talk to him again. (2)
Use the pineapple chunks on the vodka to obtain alco-chunks.
Use the alco-chunks on the Aviary Hatch on the west side of the parrot cage for a drunk parrot.
Return to Eadgar. (3)
Go back to the stronghold and climb down the northern Stone Staircase.
Unlock the Prison Door to the east and climb down the staircase.
Use the drunk parrot on the rack north of the prison cells.
Talk to Tegid in Taverley for a dirty robe. He is located south of Sanfew, washing laundry in the lake. (2)
Talk to Eadgar with the wheat, raw chickens, logs and the dirty robe. (3)

sections.heading: Truth serum
sections.needed: ranarr potion (unfinished)
sections.recommended: Any type of logs for a fire

steps.text: Exit the cave and find a grassy area and pick the thistle.
Use the troll thistle on a fire.

substeps.text: If you didn't bring logs, there are two fires just west in the encampment.

steps.text: Grind the dried thistle.
Use the ground thistle on ranarr potion (unfinished) to obtain a troll potion.
Talk to Eadgar to give him the potion.
Go back to the prison in Troll Stronghold.
Search the rack to retrieve the drunk parrot.
Talk to Eadgar (3)

substeps.text: Speak to him again if you don't receive the fake man the first time.

sections.heading: Obtaining goutweed
sections.needed: Fake man

steps.text: Talk to Burntmeat back in the kitchen of the stronghold. (2)
Open and right-click search the Kitchen Drawers along the south wall for the storeroom key.
Climb-down the stone staircase directly north of the kitchen drawers to enter the storeroom.
Open the Storeroom Door with the key.
Obtain goutweed:

substeps.text: At the next door, wait until the guard patrolling the northernmost lane goes south.
Open the door and run west, then surge directly south to search the Goutweed Crate.
If done correctly, you will surge through the western most guards and be able to immediately obtain a goutweed.
Alternatively, use safe spots (U-shaped areas with boxes on three sides) to pass the guards.
Run to the first safe spot, the middle safe spot in the third row of boxes from the entrance, after the trolls patrolling the first row and the eastern second row just pass you.
Wait for the troll which travels north on the western side to make the turn to the east, then run to the safe spot on the southern side of the third row.

Wait until the troll guard approaching you from the south has turned the west, then run to the crate with the goutweed. Make sure that you are standing to the side of the crate or you will get caught.

steps.text: Return to Taverley and talk to Sanfew with the goutweed.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to grow and steal goutweed, which can be traded to Sanfew for herbs
Ability to use the Trollheim Teleport spell

Elemental Workshop II.name: Elemental Workshop II
items_required: 8 coal (12 if you wish to also make a mind shield)
Battered key (May be in steel key ring; can be obtained during quest)

steps.text: Go to the Exam Centre in the south of the Archaeology Campus and search the bookshelf on the eastern wall in the Exam Centre. (✓)

substeps.text: Use Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Campus just north of the Exam Centre.
If you end up with Varmen's notes, you searched the wrong bookshelf.

steps.text: Read the scroll inside the beaten book and keep the book.
Head to the building with an anvil west of the Seers' Village bank.
Click on the odd-looking wall to enter it.

substeps.text: If it says "You see a small hole in the wall but no way to open it", go to the building directly south and search the bookcase on the east wall for a battered key.

steps.text: Go down the stairs.
Go north to the water elemental room and search the machinery in the southwest of the room to get a key.
Obtain 2 elemental ores from the west room by attempting to mine the elemental rocks, and defeating the earth elementals that spawn.
Go back to the north room (where you got the key) and pull the lever to start the water wheel (if the wheel is already turning, this step can be skipped).
Go to the east room and pull the lever to start the bellows (if the bellows are already working, this step can be skipped).
Smelt two elemental bars in the south room. ('Use' the ore on the furnace.)
Open the hatch in the middle room, and climb down it.
Take from the schematic crate south of the stairs and take both options.
Go back up the spiral stairs and smith a crane claw on the workbench using an elemental bar.
Go back down and lower the Old crane using the lever directly next to the schematic crate.
Use the claw on the crane to repair it.
Place an elemental bar on the jig cart.
Pull the west lever by the schematic crate.
Pull the east lever.
Pull the west lever twice.
Pull the east lever.
Pull the west lever twice.
Pull the lever behind you, by the mine cart sign.

substeps.text: If the lever is pulled and it says the system is not pressurised, go upstairs and activate the water wheel and bellows.

steps.text: Climb the staircase in the south-west corner.
Move to the west side by the steam press.
Open the junction box and connect the pipes by clicking on a pair of pipe holes. Refer to the solution on the right.

substeps.text: Top left and bottom right.
Top middle and top right.
Bottom left and bottom middle.

steps.text: Go downstairs and pull the lever next to the three small pipes.

substeps.text: If successful, you will get a message that the bar has been flattened.

steps.text: Pull the lever by the mine cart sign.
Search all of the crates in both the area with the track and the upper level with the junction box to find 3 cogs and a pipe.
Go back up the northeast platform stairs.
Go north of the water tank and 'use' the pipe item on the piping with a hole in it.
Go back down to the water tank and pull the 'old lever' in front of the tank's door to open it.
Turn the corkscrew lever (to the east) twice to load the elemental sheet into the water tank.
Pull the old lever to close the door.
Turn the water valve west of the old lever to open the valve.
Turn the water valve east of the old lever to raise the water level.
Wait for the water to fill the tank, then turn the east valve again, to lower the water level back down.
Turn the water valve west of the old lever to close off the water valve.
Pull the old lever to open the door.
Turn the corkscrew twice.
Pull the old lever to close the door.
Pull the lever by the mine cart sign.
Go over to the machine on the east side.
On the side of the machine are three pins, place the cogs on the correct pins.

substeps.text: The small cog goes on the upper left pin, the medium cog on the lower left pin, and the large cog on the right pin.

steps.text: Pull the lever just to the south to start the fan.

substeps.text: If the message says the fan is sucking, the cogs are not on the correct pins. Turn the fan off and position the cogs correctly.
If the machine says "It must be powered somewhere else", head upstairs and make sure the water wheel to the north is rotating. If not, pull the lever near the wheel.

steps.text: Pull the lever again.
Pull the lever by the mine cart sign.
Go by the claw and pick up the primed bar.
Go down another level in the workshop (north west stairwell).
Enter the east door (mind door).
Place the bar on the extractor gun. If you miss this step, you will take 10% damage by doing the next step.
Operate the extractor hat.
Take the bar from the extractor gun.
Go back up to the top floor of the workshop.
On the workbench, smith a mind helmet, with the beaten book in the backpack. (If you have another Elemental bar in your inventory you may have to drop it)
Quest complete!

items: Ability to make elemental helmets, mind shields, and mind helmets

Elemental Workshop III.name: Elemental Workshop III
items_required: 12 pieces of coal (can be mined west of Seers' Village, at the coal trucks; these cannot be noted or in an ore box)
3 elemental ores (can be obtained during the quest)
Soft clay (you can mine clay in the mine in the north-western room and use it on the sink in the northern room to soften it, or automatically mine one by wearing a bracelet of clay)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: 12 coal, 1 soft clay

steps.text: Search the north-east bookcase in the Seers' Village church. (✓)
Read the ragged book.
Use soft clay on the book to get the key mould. If you do not have soft clay, you can mine some from the clay rocks in the western mine of the workshop then use it on the sink in the northern room.

Enter the Elemental Workshop and go into the mine to the west. Mine 3 elemental rocks, killing the earth elementals that appear, then pick up the 3 elemental ores that they drop. Simply killing the earth elementals wandering around the mine will not yield the ore.
In the fire elemental room (south), use the elemental ore on the furnace to create 3 elemental bars. 4 coal is required per bar.
Use 1 elemental bar on the furnace again to make a ragged elemental key.
Climb down the hatch in the centre of the middle room.
Prime the remaining two elemental bars (see primed bar on how to do this) using the jig cart, but don't infuse them with the Mind machine.
Go down the northwest stairwell.
In the middle of the hallway, open the 'Body door' on the western wall with the ragged elemental key.
Head down the stairs.

Label the levers as follows and use the interface to move them. The levers on the north and south are the same, and the levers east and west are the same so feel free to use the closest lever to your current orientation. You can use the Minigame window to hit the levers, you don't need to run to each one.
The "Reset" and "Undo" levers can be found on the west wall (when the camera is not locked into the fixed overhead view; otherwise, they're to the north)
Pull the levers in the following order:
A cutscene will play. Pull the reset lever.
Pull the levers in the following order:

substeps.text: F, 4, E

steps.text: No cutscene will play. Pull the reset lever.
Pull the levers in the following order:
A cutscene will play. Pull the reset lever.
Pull the levers in the following order:
A message appears: "you hear a crunching of gears". Pull the reset lever.
Pull the levers in the following order:
Many of the gears start moving and the machine makes a noise.
Pull the reset lever.
Pull the levers in the following order:
Many of the gears start rotating and the central column stats rotating.
Do not pull the reset lever.
If your puzzle looks exactly like Figure 1, pull the levers in the following order:
If your puzzle looks like that image, but with the left and right sides reversed ("inverse position"), pull the levers in the following order:
A message appears: "As the machine raises, you hear a whirring noise from the level above". Do not pull the reset lever.
Go upstairs (click the metallic stairs on the bottom-left or bottom-right of the screen), and make a body bar.
The metallic stairs may be blocked by your interface due to the camera angle, so closing out or resizing your interface may be needed.

substeps.text: Put a primed bar in the slot next to the door.
Enter the room and flip the lever.
Push the button.
Flip the lever.
Retrieve the body bar from the slot.

steps.text: Go downstairs.
If your puzzle was in the "guide position" mentioned above, pull the levers in the following order:

substeps.text: 2 (The tower drops)
4, B (The tower spins)
C, 3 (The tower rises)

steps.text: Or if your puzzle was in the "inverse position", pull the levers in the following order:

substeps.text: 4, 3 (The tower drops)
4, B (The tower spins)
C, 3 (The tower rises)

steps.text: Go upstairs and make a second body bar.

substeps.text: Put a primed bar in the slot next to the door.
Enter the room and flip the lever.
Push the button.
Flip the lever.
Retrieve the body bar from the slot.

steps.text: Use a workbench on the first-level basement (the level with water, air, and fire elementals where you can obtain elemental ore) to create a body body. The ragged book must be in your inventory.
Quest complete!

items: A total of 8,500 experience: 2,000 Smithing experience from finishing the quest
A Book of knowledge worth 6,500 Smithing experience (two charges of 3,250 experience each)

Elemental Workshop IV.name: Elemental Workshop IV
items_required: About 5 each of water, earth, air and fire runes. (Only 1 of each will be used in the final riddle)
A knife (knife on your tool belt won't work; can be obtained during quest)
2 pieces of elemental ore to complete the quest, or 7 if you want the full chaos equipment set (obtainable during the quest)
8 pieces of coal (or 28 for the full set of chaos equipment; must be carried and cannot be noted or stored in an ore box)

steps.text: Search the north bookcase on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] of the Sorcerer's Tower to find a notched book. (✓)
Read the book completely. (8 pages).
Pick up the knife on the ground next to you in the Sorcerer's Tower then head to the anvil near the bank in Seers' Village.
Use a knife on the whetstone in the building of the Elemental Workshop, west of the bank, to receive a keyblade.
Head down into the workshop.
Make 2 primed bars in the same way you did in the previous Elemental Workshop quests.

substeps.text: Optional: Make 5 more if you want a full set.

steps.text: Head to the basement.
Use the keyblade on the southern door.
Head through the door and east to the pillar room via the cosmic door (dismiss any followers).
Solve the first puzzle (solution pictured below).

substeps.text: Place the runes into the correct emitter locations.
Operate the control panel south-east.
Rotate the pillars using the controls interface (bottom right).
Pressing the circle on the control interface grid rotates the pillar. They have to match with the picture shown below.
Press "Power Up".

steps.text: Solve the second and third puzzles.

substeps.text: Adjust the height of the emitters using the same control panel.

steps.text: First puzzle solution
Second puzzle solution
Third puzzle solution
Operate the draining machine in the south-east corner of the room.
After the cutscene, use a primed bar on the Machine directly south of the control panel.
Correct the pillar that has changed position.
Power up the control panel again.
Operate the draining machine.

substeps.text: Note: you might need to drink a dose of restoration potion (operating this machine drains your Runecrafting level).

steps.text: Take the cosmic bar.
Head upstairs to the workbench to make cosmic gloves. You can log out and log back in to quickly be placed back in the first room of the Elemental Workshop.
Head back downstairs into the newly-opened chaos room.
Take the shabby book from the table in the north-west corner. Read it and keep it in your inventory during the quest.
notes: This portion of the quest involves entering instruction cubes (red symbols) and rune cubes (white symbols) to control the automaton. There are 2 plungers which will push the cubes in to the CPU portion of the machine, controlled by the northern 2 levers. Either cube type can go on either side of the CPU - there is no positioning requirement.

There is no specific order in which you need to pull the levers, just shift the conveyor around either clockwise or anti-clockwise until you can push the 2 relevant cubes in to the CPU by aligning them separately with the 2 plungers and pushing each when aligned one at a time. If you make a mistake, you can flush the CPU with the machines southern button.
You can hover over the cubes to see precisely what they are.

steps.text: Operate the CPU (using the 6 levers) and input the following commands in order:

substeps.text: Get + Nature (Automaton should grab cube from shelf)
Put + Mind (this puts whatever he is holding onto the machine)
Get + Cosmic
Put + Mind
Break + Law (Automaton breaks down wall to blank tokens)
Get + Fire (Automaton picks up a blank token)
Put + Water (Automaton put a blank token on the workbench)

steps.text: Go to the workbench and carve the token.
Take the new astral token and use it on the broken astral token to replace it.
Return to the levers and continue with commands:

substeps.text: Get + Body
Put + Mind (Automaton puts the cube with the astral rune on it onto the conveyor belt)
Get + Astral
Put + Mind
Break + Earth (Automaton breaks the second wall, then turn the chaos machine on)
Operate + Chaos (Automaton turns the chaos machine on)

steps.text: Equip your cosmic gloves.
Use a primed bar on the machine, in the room with the Automaton.
Operate the draining machine (drains Thieving level).

substeps.text: Requires level 39 Thieving. Use Super restore if needed.
If it says "machine unpowered" input "Operate + Chaos" again then try again.

steps.text: Take the chaos bar.

substeps.text: Optional: repeat the last 3 steps for each primed bar if you want to make more chaos pieces for the Whoa, Double Chaos achievement.

steps.text: Head upstairs to a workbench to make chaos boots. Lobbying will automatically put you right next to the anvil.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to make and equip elemental cosmic equipment, and chaos equipment.
Ability to make boots and gloves from all known elemental metals.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Logical Progression - In the cosmic and chaos rooms.

steps.text: Talk to Veronica located just inside the gate to Draynor Manor. (✓)
Enter the manor. (1)
On the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US], grab the fish food in the room south of the staircase.
On the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US], take the poison from the room south of the kitchen, in the northwest of the manor.
Use the poison on the fish food.
Exit the manor through the eastern-most room (or teleport to the Draynor lodestone) and walk to the fountain in the southwest corner of the yard.
Use the poisoned fish food on the fountain.
Search the fountain for the pressure gauge.
Walk along the west side of the manor until a compost heap is found.
Search it for a grimy key.
Go inside the manor and enter the small room behind the staircase.
Take the rubber tube.
Return to the entrance hall of the manor and go into the room to the west.
Search the candle sconce on the western wall to open the wall.
Climb down the trap door ladder to the north in the new room.
There will be a puzzle with the solution as follows.

sections.heading: Puzzle solution
notes: All levers start in the "down" position.

steps.text: Pull levers A, B up
Enter Door 1
Pull lever D up
Enter Door 1
Pull levers A, B down
Enter Doors 3, 4 & 5
Pull levers E, F up
Enter Doors 6 & 7
Pull lever C up
Enter Doors 7 & 6
Pull lever E down
Enter Doors 6, 8 & 3
Go through Door 9 and obtain the oil can.
Leave the basement.
Pull the lever on the eastern wall.
Go up the stairs, then up the ladder, and talk to to Professor Oddenstein. (1•2)
Talk to him again.
Quest complete!

sections.heading: Powering the World Gate
sections.needed: combat gear and a face mask (alternatively, a masked earmuffs, or a slayer helmet not on slayer helmet stand)

steps.text: Optional: Equip a ring of visibility to skip some dialogue.
Find the World Gate, south of the Eagles' Peak lodestone.
Talk to Azzanadra. (✓•2•~•4•~•~)

sections.heading: Combination lock
notes: The following part can be skipped if you already activated the World Gate after Mahjarrat Memories.

A current bug causes the gate symbols to display incorrectly whilst rotating the controls. Use audio cues instead: when you rotate to the correct symbol, the gate shows a line of bright glow (use the High Contrast Mode for easier visibility) and a distinct sound effect. Advance to the next symbol only after you see the glow and hear the sound.

steps.text: Rotate the right controls near the gate until you reach .
Rotate left until you reach .
Rotate right until you reach .
Step away from the controls, and speak to Sliske.
Put on a face mask or equivalent protection to avoid taking 50 damage every 15 seconds while in Freneskae.
Enter the World Gate to enter Freneskae.

sections.heading: Freneskae
notes: Do not log out while inside Freneskae or you will restart just outside the World Gate. There is a checkpoint after each section.

steps.text: Run through Freneskae using the map below to reach the Sanctum. Move fast and avoid the hazards. There are healing points along the way if needed.
Optional: collect the memoriam crystals along the way. They are numbered on the map below; for efficiency, start with collecting number 9, then 2, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
Optional: Deposit collected Memoriam crystals in the middle to see memories.
Go to the north side of the room to the door puzzle.
Match the symbols up together to light up the lines in between them three times to open the door, then enter.

Kill the four nihils then enter the next area to the north. All nihils use a special attack after hissing. Each nihil always runs in the same direction. Therefore, a pair of nihil (ice and shadow or smoke and blood) can be killed first, leaving areas between the tracks unused and safe. Don't stand in the middle, as you might be dashed by multiple nihils at once.

substeps.text: Killing the nihils while all 4 are attacking you will unlock the title [Name] the Annihilator and the achievement Annihilator.
The smoke nihil attacks with Magic. Its special attack will decrease Attack, Strength, Magic, Ranged, and Defence by 15. Its charge will decrease these stats by 5.

The shadow nihil attacks with Ranged, and its special attack creates Nex-like shadow bomb at the position of player that deals rapid damage. Players should move away as soon as the floor below them is darkened by a circular spot. Shadow nihil darkens the whole screen whenever it approaches the player, both when charging or fighting the player, but this causes no gameplay difference.

The blood nihil attacks with melee. Its special attack causes all incoming damage to heal it, indicated when the creature lowers its head and begin to glow. It also will passively heal other nihil if it is damaged. Its charge inflicts a bleed similar to Slaughter that begins at 100 damage.

The ice nihil attacks with Magic, and its special attack applies a six second stun and drains player's Prayer points by 50% of its maximum. Its charge drains the player's Prayer points by 25% of its maximum.

sections.heading: Meeting Zaros
sections.needed: good equipment and a lot of food
sections.recommended: a beast of burden and a quick teleport

steps.text: Attempt to descend the ledge to the north then speak to Zaros. (~•5•2•2)

substeps.text: If you accept Zaros' help against Mah, he will provide you with full prayer for use with Ancient Curses along the fight and less damage from Mah.

steps.text: Defend against monsters while Mah has her nightmare (progress displayed at the top of the screen).

substeps.text: Use Freedom or Anticipate after Mah clenches her hands to avoid being stunned when she screams in agony (though you will still take damage).

steps.text: When the progress is 0%, climb down the ledge next to Mah's hand.

Collect The Measure and place it on the ground near faint wisps to activate them for harvesting (wisps can be found on the centre and edges of the cave. After revealing one, it will be a yellow dot on minimap).

Convert Mah memories into Mah Energy using the Energy rift. When you gather 250 energy, weave it into a simulacrum (dark to help Zaros, light to hinder Zaros). Hop worlds if you are having trouble finding wisps. You will be outside of the World Gate, enter again using the checkpoint option.
Return and speak to Zaros by exiting the rock face on the wall between two hallways (west of the energy rift). Speak to Zaros again after the cutscene. (~)
Talk to Azzanadra through the world gate. (1•~)
Quest complete!

items: The Shard of Zaros, which when equipped grants protection from all factions in the God Wars Dungeon
Access to Freneskae via the World Gate The ability to fight bladed, force, and throwing muspah in the Cradle
The ability to fight blood, shadow, ice, and smoke nihil in the Pit
Access to the Elder Halls, with a level 75 training spot
The ability to collect elder energy and to create portents of degradation, signs of death, and portents of death, as well as elder charm summoning pouches

Near the Oracle atop Ice Mountain

Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf.name: Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf
items_required: 2 barley malt (made by using barley on a range)
2 buckets of water (cannot be substituted by refilling the bucket)
A beer glass (you could simply buy a third beer and drink it, provided 'Destroy empty beer glasses when drinking' is unchecked in your Inventory settings)
A kebab (can be bought in Keldagrim)
An empty pot (can be obtained easily during the quest)

sections.heading: Quid pro quo
sections.needed: Beer, 2 barley malt, 2 buckets of water, beer glass, empty pot

steps.text: Talk to Commander Veldaban west of the Keldagrim bank. (✓•~•1)

substeps.text: If you did not bring beer, go to the bar south of the bank prior to speaking to Commander Veldaban. Purchase 3 beer by speaking to the Barman (one to empty out).

steps.text: After the cutscene, speak to the Drunken Dwarf. (2)
Speak to him again with a beer in your inventory. (2)
Collect the four Kelda seeds:

substeps.text: The drunken dwarf gives the first seed.
Fulfil the rowdy dwarf's request for the second seed. He walks a circle around the brewery in east Keldagrim. Give him the random item he asked for.

If you can't find the item he asks for or it is difficult to obtain (e.g. flier for Bob's Axes), talk to him again multiple times until there is a dialogue option that will change the item he asks for. You may need to lobby.
If you have accepted a task to fetch an item for the dwarf before this point in the quest, fulfilling that task now may not count towards the quest and you will have to perform another one.

Talk to Khorvak in a cave north of the Taverley lodestone (under White Wolf Mountain, not on the top). There is a convenient cart to the south of the rowdy dwarf that will take you straight to the cave. The cave is also accessible northeast of the Catherby lodestone. (2)
Talk to Gauss to have a beer with him, located in the bar south of the Keldagrim bank for the fourth seed.

steps.text: Talk to Rind the gardener, east of the pub where you have just talked to Gauss.
Plant the four seeds in the nearby Kelda Hops Patch.
Wait 20 minutes and harvest the Kelda hops.

substeps.text: A supreme growth potion (sundry) will not work here. If you choose to spend the waiting time logged out or in lobby, upon login the hop patch may appear weedy as if nothing was planted in it. Simply click the patch and you will receive your hops all the same.
Optionally, talk to Rind and he will ask you to deliver a letter to Elstan at the allotment patches south of Falador. Upon returning to Rind, he will reward you 2 marrentill seeds.

steps.text: Go to the brewery, upstairs in the pub, on the eastern side of Keldagrim.
Pick up the empty pot in the corner of the room and ask Blandebir to fill it up with ale yeast for 25 coins. (4•1)
Select "Brew" option on fermenting vat and select "Kelda stout".
Wait up to 5-20 minutes, until you get a notification in your chatbox.

substeps.text: "Perhaps I should have a look and see if my Kelda Stout has brewed..."

steps.text: Turn the valve on the connected pipe behind the vat and then use the empty beer glass in your inventory on the barrel to drain it.

substeps.text: If you are drinking your beer to empty it, ensure you have "Destroy empty beer glasses when drinking" disabled in the Settings/Interfaces/Inventory menu, or you will have to buy another.

steps.text: Return to the Drunken Dwarf in the eastern-most of the two houses between the two wells in east Keldagrim and talk to him about the Red Axe. (2)
Talk to the southern most cart conductor that is near the closed tunnel in south-east Keldagrim, the other cart conductor in the area will not work. (1)
Talk to the director of the Consortium mining company you joined during The Giant Dwarf. If you don't remember, you can talk to Commander Veldaban and he will tell you. (3)
Un-equip any weapons you are holding, and if you have a familiar out, pick it up. Then ride the southern cart into the tunnel.
Collect the square stones from the box.
Operate the controls: To place/rotate stones, click the corresponding nodes, once for green, twice for yellow, and three times to remove the stone.

substeps.text: There will be no confirmation prompt after you've set the route. Just click on the minecart or walk away once you've added the stones.
Alternatively, place all of the Green stones then the Yellow stones, or vice versa.

steps.text: After each part, ride on the cart, search the newly found box, and take the cart back to the initial platform.
Part 1
Part 2
Part 3
After the dialogue, crawl along the southern path, and through the cave entrance to the east.
Take the stones from the box and follow the patterns below.
Part 1
Part 2
Part 3
Search all three crates with papers on top of them.
Search the bookcases until you find the "Red Axe Employee Records" book. Read it.
Enter the cave entrance to the east. (1)
Take the stones from the box and follow the patterns below.
Part 1
Part 2
Part 3
Watch the entire cutscene as you enter the last room.

sections.heading: Kebabs and beer
sections.needed: Beer, kebab

steps.text: Go back and speak to Commander Veldaban west of Keldagrim bank.

Head to the Laughing Miner Pub in eastern Keldagrim. While inside, consume either your beer or kebab, though you'll need both in your inventory. If you don't have a kebab yet, talk to Kjut in his shop south-east of the northern bridge.

substeps.text: You must watch the entire cutscene!

steps.text: Quest complete!

Equip the ghostspeak amulet. You need to equip the amulet when you talk to the ghost residents in the town.
Talk to Velorina at Port Phasmatys, in the northernmost building just east of the entrance. (1•1•✓)

If you intend to proceed with the quest Vessel of the Harbinger after this quest, obtain the second one.

steps.text: Talk to Velorina. (1)

sections.heading: Getting help
sections.needed: nettle tea, silk, thread, bucket of milk

steps.text: Teleport to Canifis lodestone.
If you haven't already made nettle tea, pick some nettles just east. Use the nettles on the bowl of water to get nettle-water.

Talk to Netty again. (1•1)

sections.needed: 3 red dye, 3 blue dye, 3 yellow dye, combat equipment

steps.text: Go inside the shipwreck just north of Alice's farm, east of the Canifis lodestone.
Climb the ladders to reach the top deck (there is a ladder on the outer cabin wall).

Wait for the "wind speed" to become "low", which is shown on the top of the screen. Search the mast to determine the colours and their positions. You need to search for 3 different results, take note if needed.

Dye the model ship with the same colours and position as the mast. Orange dye is made from red and yellow; green dye is made from blue and yellow; purple dye is made from red and blue dye. If you make a mistake when painting, simply paint over the piece again.
Climb down a ladder and enter the captain's cabin.
Talk to the old man. (3)
Use the key on the chest by the Captain and open it for a map scrap.
On the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] of the ship, open and search all unlocked chest in the eastern end of the ship until a giant lobster spawns.
Kill the giant lobster.

substeps.text: You can safespot the lobster by moving all the way east.

steps.text: Search the chest again for a map scrap.
On the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the ship, go to the northwest part of the ship's deck.
Cross the gangplank to the rocks.
Jump to the rocks on your side until you find a chest. Open it for another map scrap.
Put the pieces together to get the map.

sections.needed: spade in the backpack, treasure map

steps.text: Go back to Port Phasmatys.

Dig with a spade at the location (Show map) shown to the right to obtain the book of haricanto.
Right-click and choose "Travel" on the ghost captain to go back Port Phasmatys.

sections.heading: Revolution

Wear your bedsheet.
Ask the ghost villager for signatures until you have 10.

Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus. Take the bone key he drops on the floor.

Open and search the coffin for Necrovarus' mystical robes.
Head north-west of the Canifis lodestone and talk to Netty in her shack (east of the Slayer Tower).
Equip the enchanted ghostspeak amulet.
Talk to Necrovarus near the Ectofuntus. (1)
Talk to Velorina in northern Port Phasmatys.

2. Fill it with oil from the vat of oil.

6. Take wolf's tongue from the sack of mushrooms, weigh out 30g on the desk, and mix the wolf's tongue (30g) with the vial of oil (crushed hedgehog spine, pressed Wendlewick poppy).

steps.text: Talk to Esther. (1)

steps.text: Enter the cave, drink the antisanguine.

substeps.text: You may reclaim it from Anya.

steps.text: Attack the Sanguine heart.

substeps.text: It will spawn sanguine tumours 3 times during the fight which will make the heart immune to damage until they are destroyed.
It will periodically launch an exploding pustule to the tile you are standing on, you need to move before it explodes to avoid damage and removal of antisanguine protection effect.
It may be beneficial to take additional doses of antisanguine during the fight if damaged.
Death here is safe, placing you outside the cave.

steps.text: Once the heart reaches 1 life point, attack it again.

steps.text: Travel to the Ancient Cavern.

substeps.text: If using a games necklace, travel to the barbarian outpost and run south to dive into the whirl pool. Then climb-down the rough hewn steps to the north-east.

steps.text: Go to the south-west corner of the cavern and climb-up the rough hewn steps.

Go to the mithril dragons. (Head north, go down the rough hewn steps, then up the stairs to the north-east.) Attack a mithril dragon, then use your key mould on the dragon.
Go back south west up the rough hewn steps.
Open the ancient door with the key. (1)
Kill the dragon.
After the cutscene, run west to the stepping stones.
Jump diagonally to the chest and open it, then continue north.
Don't step on any pressure plates. Push the crates out of your way (you are able to push the 2 crates in a line).

substeps.text: Push the first eastern crate north twice.
Walk around to the middle and push the two crates north twice.
Push the eastern crate to the east twice, then push the northern-most crate to the west once.
Push the crate to your south once, and walk to the door.

steps.text: Open the eastern door and search the chest.
Read the notes and equip the dragonkin protection charm.
Enter the bottom floor of the Grotworm Lair near Port Sarim. (There's an agility shortcut from the entrance requiring level 50 Agility.)
Climb the stairs in the centre of the open area, west of the Queen Black Dragon entrance.
Defeat Tarshak, avoiding his charge attack by moving out of the way.

Repeat until all 4 pillars are broken.

Lure Tarshak into the falling rocks, don't stand too close yourself.
You may also attack with a regular weapon at the same time.

sections.heading: Starting out

Open the doorway of the western room.
Solve the puzzle.
