After the cutscene, continue dialogue with the Wise Old Man. (2)
Craft via on the Clockmaker's bench in the workshop room. (1)
Use the bench again to create a dummy. (1)
Enter the dungeon. During this part, there will be a pulsating purple light around your screen. Any players sensitive to flashing lights should proceed with caution.
Traverse through the dungeon, deactivating all the traps by walking on them and then return to the surface.

substeps.text: Pit guardian rooms have 2 traps each, except for the scabarite room, having only one.

steps.text: Climb the staircase. (1)

sections.heading: The dungeon pit
sections.needed: combat gear/supplies
sections.recommended: Dragonfire protection

steps.text: Enter the dungeon. (1)
Traverse through the dungeon, killing all the enemies (high-level players need not worry about using super antifire for the iron dragon as it is fairly weak and may be killed quickly).
Enter the final door, talk to the Wise Old Man. (~•2•4)
Climb the stairs.

Talk to Zenevivia to start the battle. If you fail your first attempts, return to the Wise Old Man at the house in Rimmington. Right click on the house teleport tabs to modify them for another teleport to the fight.

substeps.text: Avoid the flames on the floor, they deal low damage.
Zenevivia uses magic spells and flames on the floor that can quickly deal around 600 damage.
She will sometimes use protection prayers so prepare to switch attack styles or just use Necromancy.
She can be knocked off pillars using abilities that knock back enemies, such as Kick.

steps.text: After she is defeated, talk to her.
You will return to Draynor Village.
Talk to Zenevivia in the Wise Old Man's house. (4•2•1•1)
Go upstairs and look through the telescope and watch the Wizards' Tower Robbery.
Head downstairs, talk to Zenevivia again. (1•1)
Quest complete!

items: Any unused Teleport to house tablets (as many as 99)
Ability to chip Teleport to house tablets
Ability to use the Dark Stone exterior style for a player-owned house
Ability to use the dark stone slabs floor style in a player-owned house
Zenevivia can be faced in the Dominion Tower

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: After returning Mabel's ring, Mabel gives a bankable lamp, which grants 10,000 Skill experience in any skill over level 60. Mabel may be found hiding in a sack in the barn where you originally found her.
After the quest, you can talk to the Draynor tree guard at Draynor Village and offer to chop down the tree to help him down; he will then reward you with 5,000 coins.

Adventurers who have completed the quest may wish to travel to Keldagrim to talk to a dwarf called Runvastr, who lives on Keldagrim's east side in the house directly south of the pickaxe shop. If you deliver his diary to the Wise Old Man back in Draynor Village, you’ll earn the ability to chip House teletabs to take you to Trollheim as well.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Love Story (During the cutscene of the couple's previous love life)

Lunar Diplomacy.name: Lunar Diplomacy
items_required: Coins (1,000 should be enough, there is a bank on the island)
Runes for combat spells (preferably fire spells, elemental staff not equippable)
Air, earth, fire, and water talismans, or alternate methods of accessing the respective runecrafting altars (e.g. a wicked hood consumed the aforementioned talisman)
Two spools of thread (can be obtained during the quest - Crafting cape perk works as well)
Clean guam (may be obtained from dropped grimy guam during the quest, common drop)
Clean marrentill (may be obtained from dropped grimy marrentill during the quest, common drop)

steps.text: Choose the 'talk to' option on Lokar Searunner on Rellekka's westernmost dock. (2•1•✓)
Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage. (1)

substeps.text: You will need to keep the seal on you while on the island. Talking to anyone without it will teleport you back to Rellekka.

steps.text: Return and talk to Lokar. (1)
Climb the ladder and board the pirate ship. Talk to Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle. (4)

substeps.text: Make sure to be sufficiently on the pirate ship, otherwise the quest will not progress.

steps.text: Climb down the central ladder.
Below deck, talk to 'Bird's-Eye' Jack to the south-west.
Talk to Captain Bentley again. (2)
Return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.
Must talk to them in this order.

substeps.text: Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front of the ship (back upstairs).
Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship.
Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee on the very top level, at the south end of the ship.
Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy' on the southern end of the deck near the stairs.
Climb up to the top level at the south end of the ship and talk to the cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required). He is next to Lecherous Lee.

steps.text: Use the lens on the lantern. Light it.
Use the lantern on the following objects and rub away the symbols:

substeps.text: Cannon: Climb the ladder in the middle. The cannon is on the middle level at the south end of the ship. Show map (1)
Wallchart: Climb back up and enter the southernmost room. The wallchart is on the northwestern wall. Show map (1)
Chest: Climb down to the lowest level of the ship. The chest is on the ground at the northern end of the ship, just as you come down. Show map (1)
Barrel: On the same level, the most southern stack of three barrels. Show map (1)
Support: Same level big support column in the middle of the ship. Show map (1)

steps.text: Talk to Captain Bentley.

sections.heading: Lunar Isle
sections.needed: clean guam, clean marrentill, and ground suqah tooth

steps.text: Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cutscene).
Go north-east outside the city and kill suqah until these items are obtained:

substeps.text: One suqah tooth.
4 suqah hides.
If not already in the backpack, one grimy guam and one grimy marrentill. Clean the herbs.

steps.text: Mine a lunar ore at the mine north-east of the city. Climb down the ladder and mine a stalagmite to the West of the rune essence rock. It looks like a rock jutting out of the ground.

substeps.text: Optional: Mine Rune Essence to complete Runes on the Moon, which is a Hard Fremennik achievement.

steps.text: Run to the south-east part of the island. Talk to the Oneiromancer near the astral altar.
Return to the city and enter the walking house in the northern section. Talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required). (2)
Use the vial on the sink.

substeps.text: Add a guam and a marrentill to the vial of water.
Grind the suqah tooth and use it on the vial to complete the potion.

steps.text: Return to the Oneiromancer with the potion.

sections.heading: Lunar staff
sections.needed: Dramen staff

sections.heading: Travelling options
notes: Access to the Abyss or

steps.text: Skull sceptre or Edgeville lodestone for the air altar
Ring of duelling or Al Kharid lodestone for the fire altar
Enlightened amulet or Lumbridge lodestone for the water altar
Fort Forinthry lodestone, Invitation box, or Archaeology journal for the earth altar
Use your dramen staff/staves on the following altars in the listed order (you may need talismans to access if you do not have alternate teleports):

substeps.text: Air (west of Varrock)
Fire (north of Al Kharid)
Water (Lumbridge Swamp)
Earth (south of Fort Forinthry)

steps.text: Before returning to the isle, smelt the lunar ore at any regular furnace and make a lunar helmet at a regular anvil.
Travel back to Lunar Isle by selecting "travel" from Lokar Searunner in Rellekka at the westernmost dock.
Travel with Captain Bentley to Lunar Isle.
Give a lunar staff to the Oneiromancer.

sections.heading: Smithing lunar helm
sections.needed: 1 backpack space

steps.text: If you have already made the lunar helm, you can skip the next 4 steps.

substeps.text: Climb down ladder north-eastern part of the isle.
Mine a stalagmite for a lunar ore.
You have to use a furnace to smith the ore (the forge in the southern building will not work).
Use an anvil to make the helm, such as the one in the southern building.

sections.heading: Crafting lunar gear
sections.needed: 400 coins, thread or Crafting cape, four suqah hides, 1 backpack space

steps.text: Talk to Pauline Polaris in the north-western-most building in the city. (2)
Talk to Meteora south in the city.
Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara. If you haven't already, pick up their hide as well as you'll need four hides later on.
Give Meteora the tiara.
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis in the clothing store south of the bank about ceremonial clothes. (2)
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again, she will tan your hides. (2•1)

substeps.text: If you didn't bring thread, Rimae's shop sells some.

steps.text: Craft a lunar torso, trousers, gloves, and boots from your hides.

sections.heading: Looking for lunar ring
sections.needed: 1 backpack space, and a spade

steps.text: Go to the biggest building in the city (west of the lodestone) and talk to Selene (she might be outside). (2)
Exit the city and run south. Dig up near blue flowers with a spade (tool belt doesn't work), they are the flowers to the furthest south west across the bridge.
Give the Oneiromancer all your lunar gear.
Talk to the Oneiromancer again with 11 free inventory slots.

sections.heading: Dreamland
sections.recommended: Runes for combat spells (preferably fire spells, elemental staff not equippable)

steps.text: Use the vial on the kindling Oneiromancer just gave you to create soaked kindling.
Get your combat runes and supplies, dismiss your follower, and wear all your lunar items. Four backpack spaces are required.
Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet in the backpack to avoid a bug later in the quest.
Run to the biggest building in the city (west of the lodestone).

Make sure you're wearing all 8 pieces of Lunar equipment; if you exit to lobby or logout, or are not wearing them all when you add the soaked kindling, you'll have to return to the Oneiromancer to get a new kindling.
Light the ceremonial brazier then use the Soaked kindling on it to enter Dreamland.
Talk to Ethereal Man or Ethereal Lady.
Step on the yellow/green platform south-west of the island.
Talk to Ethereal Fluke.

He will call out a number. You need to make the dice add up to the number he called. When you "roll" one of the dice, it will turn the die upside down, so each die only has two possible numbers (1 and 6, 2 and 5, 3 and 4).
He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head south-east and step on the pink/purple platform.
Talk to Ethereal Numerator.
Click on the numbers to complete the patterns for four times.
notes: Here are sequences the Ethereal Numerator may possibly give you, with the next two numbers in the patterns highlighted:

steps.text: He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head north-east and step on the blue platform.
Talk to Ethereal Perceptive. He might give you a hatchet. (1)
Run west and chop 20 dream logs, depositing them on your log pile.
He will teleport you once you've won the competition.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head north-west and step on the grey platform.
Talk to Ethereal Guide.

Cross the chasm by jumping on the correct combination of Dream Puffs. Keep a note of the correct steps! You can use the table below to track your path: click cell to highlight it. Click again to cancel a highlight.
Once complete, talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.

sections.heading: The hurdles
sections.recommended: Agility cape to prevent you from being electrocuted

steps.text: Head east and step on the yellow platform.
Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the race. (1)
Jump over the hurdles. If you fail three times, you will lose the race. Run and stop before each hurdle, before clicking the orb to jump over.
After you have won talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head south-east and step on the green platform.
Talk to Ethereal Mimic. (1)
Click on them and then copy the emote that they perform. They teleport after each correct emote.
After five correct emotes, they'll teleport you back.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady to begin the final fight. (1)
Kill Me (6,000 life points, weakness to fire spells). You can safe-spot them behind the dream tree.

substeps.text: Should you forget your runes after entering the fight, you will not be able to leave the fight in any way unless you log out and back in. This will take you back to Lunar Isle where you can bank to get the runes.
Be sure to equip your Seal of passage before speaking to a banker.
Go back to the Oneiromancer again to get the kindling and potion to return back to the dream.
Re-equip your Lunar amulet before attempting to enter the dream.

steps.text: Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle. (1)
Talk to the Oneiromancer.
Quest complete!

items: Full access to Lunar Isle Use of the Astral altar
Ability to buy astral runes from Baba Yaga

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Isle of Everywhere (on the northeast coast of Lunar Isle)
The Lunar Isle (on the Moonclan Isle)
Waking Dream (when at one of the challenges in Dream World)
Way of the Enchanter (in the Lunar Isle mine)

Meeting History.name: Meeting History
items_required: Enchanted key from Making History (if you no longer have that key, you will receive it again by talking to Jorral)
Nothing else equipped or in your inventory

steps.text: Go to the Outpost.
Speak to Jorral. (2•✓)

substeps.text: As needed, accept his offer to bank your items.

steps.text: Run east to the sheep pen across the river, or run north-west from Ardougne lodestone.
Right-click rub the key in the location shown right (stand on the flowers west of the sheep pen west of the lodestone).
Talk to Laura.
Rub the enchanted key again.
Return to Jorral and talk to him.
After the cutscene, go back to the location shown above and rub the key again, choosing "Past - A." (Don't forget to bank your traveller's necklace if you used it to get back to the outpost.)
While in Past A, talk to Jack.
Rub the key, go to Past B, talk to Jack. (2)
Answer with the following: (1•2•3•2•3•1•1•3)
Go to Past A, take a spade and 6 plant pots from the backyard.
Use the spade or a plant pot on each seedling.
Use the seedling pots on the correct tree spots using this image.
Go to Past B, talk to Sarah about the trees.
Talk to Jack for a cutscene.
Go to Past A, talk to Roger.
Go to Past B, talk to Sarah.
Go to Past A, search the south-east side table inside to find a pestle and mortar, bucket of milk and a clean guam.
Search the middle shelf (south side) for a bowl.
Use the bowl on the beehive just west of the house.
Use the pestle and mortar on the clean guam.
Use the bucket of milk on the bowl of honey.
Add the ground guam.
Use the bowl of milk, honey and guam on Baby Sarah (right click so that you don't use the bowl on the basket).
Talk to Roger again for a cutscene.
Go to Past B, talk to Laura.
Go to Past A, search either the south-western or south-eastern shelves in the house for a papyrus and charcoal.
Use the charcoal on the papyrus.
Give this to Laura.
Go to Past B, talk to Laura.
Go to Past A.
Inside the house, search the 3 stone bedside tables (One of them should contain the brooch)
Use the brooch on the soil mound west of the shed Laura is building.
Go to Past B, take the spade from the shed.
Dig up the brooch.
Talk to Laura for a cutscene.
Return to the present.
Talk to Jorral.
Quest complete!

items: An old tome giving a total of 2,500 experience across up to 3 skills with level 25 or higher (1,000 experience for the first chapter, 1,000 experience for the second, and 500 experience for the third).
Even more treasure hunting with the enchanted key miniquest.
Speak to Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum to earn 5 Kudos.

steps.text: Speak to Brother Samwell (west of Paterdomus and east of Varrock). (~•~•✓)
Search for the following clues.

substeps.text: Investigate northernmost slaughtered monk. (2)
Investigate nearby plant (east of the chest).
Investigate the tree with the arrow stuck in it (south of him).

steps.text: Talk to Brother Samwell. (2•~)
Up the limestone quarry, speak to Odd Old Man. (2•1•1•2)
Talk to Brother Samwell. (1•1•~)
Search for additional clues by following the crystals to the east.

substeps.text: Investigate the killed elf ranger (southeast of the Temple). (1•4)
Investigate the plant west of her, near the middle pile of crystals next to the stairs.
Investigate the clothing on the fence, to the south of the tree.

steps.text: Talk to Blaze Sharpeye by the beacon. (2•2•2•1)
Return to Brother Samwell. (2•~)
Go to the Wizards' Tower and speak to Wizard Valina inside the entry way on the lectern. (2•1•2•~•3)

sections.heading: Fighting with Icthlarin
sections.needed: Combat equipment

steps.text: Return to Brother Samwell. (~•5)
Learn from Icthlarin about Death's disappearance. (~•2•1•1•4•1)
Defeat attacking wights.
Finish the conversation with Icthlarin. (~•~)
While standing next to Icthlarin, open the invitation box. (1)
Once in the citadel, talk to Icthlarin. (1)
Enter the door to the west then north to the window to watch another cutscene.
Walk out the south window; jump the gap; run across the planks; drop down the rocks; climb up the rock face; walk in the western window.
Climb through the obstacle to the north.
Open the north door, then continue north into the next room.
Pull all three levers in the room (on the west, south, and east walls) to create light.
Lead all the wights that spawn (a group of 3, then 4) into the light to be able to damage them.
View the east window for another cutscene.
Open the door to the north, then continue east into the next room.
Use the viewing panel. (3•2•~)
View the south window for another cutscene.
Open the door to the east, then continue south into the next room.
Talk to the statue of Death. (2•~•3)
Open the chest and take the correct item, then place on the answer plinth pedestal.

substeps.text: First chest (east) (3)
Second chest (middle) (2)
Second chest, again (1)

steps.text: View the west window for another cutscene.
Open the south door, then jump off the drop.
Speak to one of the Barrows brothers to enter the main room. (1)
After a cutscene, walk forward to continue talking with the Gods. (1•~•~•~)
Run around rear of other gods and stamp out the smaller flames on the ground to reach Death's cage while avoiding the fireballs from Strisath. Free him from his cage.

substeps.text: The flames might be difficult to see with low graphics settings, especially with shadows turned off.

steps.text: Run back behind Icthlarin.

substeps.text: Getting hit by the fireballs will reset your progress.

steps.text: Speak to Icthlarin.
Speak with Brother Samwell.
Quest complete!

items: Mask of Sliske, Light/Mask of Sliske, Shadow cosmetic headgears
Invitation box, used to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Two new death animations, one featuring Death and one featuring Icthlarin
50,000 Constitution experience lamp (requires level 75 Constitution to use)
30,000 Skill experience lamp (requires level 75 in the chosen skill to use)
50,000 Thieving experience lamp (requires level 75 Thieving to use)
30 barrows amulets (requires level 80 Combat to claim)

Monkey Madness.name: Monkey Madness
items_required: Monkey bones from Karamja (or a monkey corpse or monkey skull)
5 bananas (can be obtained in Ape Atoll)

steps.text: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree. He will give you a gnome royal seal. (✓)
Right-click the ladder, select Top Floor, and take the glider from Captain Errdo to Karamja - 'Gandius'. (5)
Head north along the coast to reach the shipyard and try to enter through the gate.
Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the hut southeast of the gate.
Return to King Narnode. He gives you Narnode's orders.

substeps.text: You can return to Captain Klemfoodle to take the glider to The Grand Tree - 'Ta Quir Priw'

steps.text: Talk to Daero, found on the east side of the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Grand Tree. He is at the Blurberry bar platform. (1•4•2•4•3•4•4•1)
Talk to Daero.
Begin the puzzle by clicking on the Reinitialisation Panel to the south-east in front of the long pipe.

Unscramble the puzzle. Caution: The A3 and A5 pieces look near identical and can make the solving the puzzle difficult (A3 should have a straight cloud bottom on the tile and A5 should have a small curve at the bottom right corner of the tile).

substeps.text: You can use this sliding puzzle solver.
Or pay Glough 200,000 coins. He's located in the tree house south-east of the Grand Tree. (1•1•1)

steps.text: There is a cutscene when the puzzle is correct. Speak to Daero and then to Waydar (1)
Speak to Lumdo.
Speak to Waydar who will convince Lumdo to follow orders. (4)
Recommended: turn off auto-retaliate and leave it off until the final battle (Can be toggled on/off by clicking the button left of the adrenaline gauge on the Action Bar).
On the island, travel west then north to a bamboo gate. Stand there getting pelted by poisoned arrows until you are brought to a prison. You will take some damage and be poisoned.
Picklock the cell when there is no guard outside and escape the prison.

substeps.text: Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards (even while in the cell) otherwise they will attack and damage you.

steps.text: Stay in the grass to hide from archer monkeys and travel south against the western wall of the Temple of Marimbo.
Go east along the wall of the temple and around the monkey palace. Speak to Garkor.

sections.heading: Zooknock
sections.needed: gold bar, ball of wool, monkey bones
sections.recommended: food, antipoison, prayer potion, energy potion

steps.text: Head to the U-shaped building in the southern side of the monkey village. Enter through the southern door otherwise you will be knocked out.

substeps.text: Stay on the dark brown ground at the perimeter of the room.

steps.text: Search the stacked crates two tiles east of the trapdoor for monkey dentures (you can grab another for making a tooth creature).
Search the south-easternmost crate (which is a different style and slightly darker brown) to crawl down into the basement - you may fall and take up to 50% of your life points in damage. (1)
In the northwest corner there's a cluster of crates around a stalagmite; search the crate directly south of the stalagmite for a monkeyspeak amulet mould.

If you needed to leave to obtain items, teleport to Al Kharid, go north, talk to Captain Dalbur to glide to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, then talk to Daero at Blurberry's Bar to return to the hangar (1)
If you didn't need to leave to obtain items, go to the area where you first landed on Ape Atoll. There is a one-way shortcut south of Garkor.
Travel west until you see a dungeon on your mini-map. Climb down.
Run through the long dungeon.

substeps.text: Protect from Melee is highly recommended here, as are antipoison and energy potions. Make sure to have several pieces of food (and/or Enhanced Excalibur) for healing from the traps and mobs.

steps.text: At the end of the dungeon (the most north-eastern part), speak to Zooknock first.
Use the gold bar on Zooknock.
Use the monkey dentures on Zooknock.
Use the monkeyspeak amulet mould on Zooknock. He will give you an enchanted bar and your mould back.

substeps.text: If you use the monkey bones on him here you don't need to get new ones when turning in the talisman. Monkey bones from the monkey zombies in the cave do not work. Keep your monkeyspeak amulet mould as it used in Do No Evil.

Make sure you finish the dialogue after giving him the three items and the bones; otherwise, you will not receive the enchanted bar and your mould back. If you leave the area, you will have to run all the way back through this cave to finish the dialogue to get the enchanted gold bar.

sections.heading: Monkey's uncle
sections.needed: monkeyspeak amulet mould, enchanted bar, ball of wool, monkey corpse or monkey bones, 5 bananas
sections.recommended: antipoison, food, other types of monkey bones

steps.text: Return to Marim (Ape Atoll) (protect from missiles and surge to gate).
Escape prison and run east into the temple.
Take the southern ladder up, the eastern ladder down, and then the trapdoor down into the dungeon.

substeps.text: Alternatively, you can kill one of the two gorilla guards blocking the trapdoor and climb down that way.

steps.text: Use the enchanted bar on a pillar of fire and use the amulet on a ball of wool to create an monkeyspeak amulet.
Go to the banana garden west of the prison.
Wait for the monkey's aunt to leave and quickly go into the garden through the corridor at its north-east corner.
When she returns, run back into the corridor.

substeps.text: You can stay in the area with red monkey knife fighters if the guards are called and climb the ladder to the south up and back down again.

steps.text: Equip the monkeyspeak amulet, talk to the monkey child, and talk to him again (4)
Talk to Monkey child again. (2)
You will have to wait for The Monkey's Aunt to pass by the child once again before the child gives you the Monkey talisman.

substeps.text: If you're obtaining multiple for Recipe for Disaster: Freeing King Awowogei, Do No Evil or Monkey butler then repeat the same step as before (2•1)

steps.text: Take your monkey bones and Monkey talisman and use it on Zooknock at the end of the dungeon under Ape Atoll.

substeps.text: Make sure to make the standard Monkey greegree for the next steps as other forms will not work.
Bring other monkey bones and multiple talismans if you want to make more greegrees and (2•1)
You can use multiple greegrees on each other to save bank space.

steps.text: Watch the cutscene. Talk to Zooknock to receive your greegree.

sections.heading: King Awowogei
sections.needed: Monkey greegree, monkeyspeak amulet, 1 backpack space
sections.recommended: antipoison, food

steps.text: During this section, do not teleport while you're carrying the monkey or you will have to re-obtain the monkey. This includes spirit tree teleportation.
Enter Ardougne Zoo and equip your greegree near the monkey zone. Speak to the monkey minder.

substeps.text: If you have other monkeys types on your monkey greegree, make sure to swap it to the Karamjan monkey (brown with red cap). Otherwise the monkey minder will say to you that you aren't getting anywhere near his monkeys.

steps.text: Talk to any level 3 monkey. Unequip the greegree and talk to the monkey minder again.
Run to the Grand Tree and talk to Daero, (1)
Equip the greegree, pass through the gates.
Return to Garkor by the kings palace (as a monkey) and speak to him.
Talk to the elder guard west of Garkor, they will say you need permission from Kruk.
Head west from the main gate, walk round and up the hill and then cross the bridge to end up on the other side of the hill.
Talk to Kruk, who will grant you an audience with Awowogei.

substeps.text: You may need to talk to Garkor, then with the Elder Guard outside of the throne room first.

steps.text: Inside the throne room, talk to Awowogei.
Talk to him again to give him the rescued monkey.
Talk to the southern Elder Guard to exit the throne room.
Talk to Garkor, this will start a cutscene.
Talk to Garkor again after the cutscene for the 10th squad sigil.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: a weapon to kill a level 70 demon, 10th squad sigil
sections.recommended: food, armour, prayer potions

steps.text: Right-click 10th squad sigil teleport when you are ready to kill Jungle Demon.

substeps.text: If you rub the sigil with your greegree equipped and with a full inventory, your greegree will drop on the ground.

steps.text: Kill the Jungle demon.

substeps.text: Prayer flicking between Protect from Melee and Magic (or Deflect Melee and Magic) can prevent most damage. Begin on Protect From Melee, and as the demon begins the animation for the magic attack swap to Protect from Magic, then wait for the hit and switch back to Protect from Melee. Otherwise, remain on Protect from or Deflect Magic.

steps.text: Speak to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.
Quest complete!

items: By speaking to King Narnode and Daero after the quest, you can obtain a total of 110,000 experience, with the choice to focus 35,000 experience each in your chosen pair between either Strength and Constitution or Attack and Defence, and 20,000 experience each in the other pair.
The ability to use the Ape Atoll Agility Course
The ability to wield the dragon scimitar

The ability to create more monkey greegrees to transform into different versions of the primates. You must bring the bones of the type of desired monkey, and a monkey talisman, to Zooknock in his tunnel.
The monkey in your backpack can spit out a medium clue scroll when it is fed bananas. This is a 1 in 256 chance and is a requirement for obtaining the master quest cape.

Mourning's End Part I.name: Mourning's End Part I
items_required: Items marked with † can easily be obtained during the quest.
2 pieces of silk (bring 4 if you plan on doing Within the Light)
1 toad crunchies (premade ones will work too, bring extras in case of errors)
Red, yellow, blue, and green dye †
Or at least 30 coins to buy them from Oronwen during the quest (it is advised to get 3-4 of each)

steps.text: Talk to Eluned in Isafdar and agree to get teleported. (1•✓)
Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya. If you leave the town, the fastest way back is to use the crystal teleport seed you were given.

sections.heading: Mourners in the mountains
sections.needed: Combat gear, two pieces of silk, crystal teleport seed, some bear fur, a bucket of water, and 8-14 free backpack spaces

steps.text: Make your way to Arandar. Some ways of getting there are;

substeps.text: Teleporting to the World Gate using the Sixth-Age circuit or teleporting to rune dragons with five metallic dragon trinkets.
Heading to the entrance on the Kandarin side.
Exiting Lletya and heading north on the Tirannwn side.
Using a Traveller's necklace to the Outpost and running west.
Using Home Teleport to Eagles' Peak lodestone and running south.

steps.text: Kill a mourner. Pick up all pieces of the mourner outfit including the gas mask and mourner letter.

substeps.text: You may now want to unequip and bank any combat equipment(unless you want to gather bear fur later) as you will not need it to progress the quest any longer.

steps.text: Read the letter.
Go to Taverley and talk to Tegid at the southern lake, south of Jatix.
Search the laundry basket near him to steal the soap. (1)
Use it on the bloody mourner top with a bucket of water in your backpack.
Return to Lletya with your crystal teleport seed.
Talk to Oronwen in the clothing shop (3)

substeps.text: Be sure to bring your bear fur and silk. Kill a grizzly bear just west of Lletya if you need bear fur.
This is an opportune time to trade with her and buy dyes while she is fixing the trousers. It is highly recommended you purchase at least 3 of each.

steps.text: After one minute has elapsed, talk to her again for the trousers.

substeps.text: If your backpack is full, they will be dropped on the floor.

sections.heading: Amongst the Death Guard
sections.needed: Mourner gear, the mourner's letter, a feather, some toad crunchies, leather, a mahogany log, and one backpack space

steps.text: Unequip everything except the mourner suit and gas mask, head to the the Mourners' headquarters (north-east corner inside of West Ardougne).

substeps.text: If you cannot enter the headquarters, re-equip your mourner suit.

steps.text: Descend the trapdoor and talk to the Head Mourner in the south-east room of the basement. (1)
Talk to the gnome on a rack in the west room. (3)
Use a feather on him twice with the toad crunchies in your backpack.
Talk to the gnome again with a mahogany log and leather in your backpack.
Release him.
After one minute has elapsed, talk to the gnome again for a fixed device. If he disappeared, simply lobby.

sections.heading: Dyeing the non-dying
sections.needed: Ogre bellows, fixed device, mourner gear, and at least one bottle of dye of each colour: red, blue, yellow, and green
sections.recommended: at least 3 of each dye (including green dye)

steps.text: Travel to the Feldip Hills (fairy ring AKS).

substeps.text: Fetch an ogre bellows from Rantz's cave if you need one. If you already have one, you won’t be able to obtain another from the chest.

steps.text: Go to the small swamp slightly south-west of Rantz and make the coloured toads.

substeps.text: Do not fill up your ogre bellows, make sure it is empty. If you need to empty it, bloat toads until it is empty before following the next steps.
Use the bottle of dye on your ogre bellows.
Use your ogre bellows on a swamp toad.
Repeat the process for each bottle of dye.
(it is highly recommended that you make multiple of each toad).

steps.text: Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone, and head to where Brumty's sheep roam to the west.
Use a toad matching the colour of the nearby sheep on the fixed device in your backpack, equip it.

substeps.text: If you are unsure of the colour of the sheep, you can examine it for a description of the colour (red tinge, green tinge, blue tinge, yellow tinge).

steps.text: Open the equipment tab and fire the fixed device. (Get out of firing mode to see which direction your character is looking at. This way you can avoid having to struggle with finding the sheep with the arrows.)
Use the arrows to aim at a sheep and then press the middle "FIRE!" button once it is in the middle of the screen.
Do that for the three other sets of sheep, making sure to match the colour of the toad to the colour of the sheep.

substeps.text: If done correctly, you will no longer be able to prod the sheep.

steps.text: Go back to West Ardougne and take a rotten apple from the ground west of the headquarters, if you don't have one.
Return to the Head Mourner and talk to him.

sections.heading: Elena's advice
sections.needed: Rotten apple and approximately 20 pieces of coal, you do not need coal if you already have a barrel of naphtha if you made one extra during Regicide

steps.text: Talk to Elena, who lives slightly north-east of Ardougne Castle.
With a rotten apple in your inventory, talk to her again.
Wait one minute or world-hop, then talk to her again.
Go to the fenced-in apple orchard Northwest of Ardougne, west of the combat training camp.
Take an empty barrel, use it on the Rotten Apple Pile.
Then use the Apple Barrel located in the middle of the orchard to make apple barrel.

substeps.text: If you don't already have a barrel of naphtha, take one more empty barrel.

steps.text: Skip this section if you have an extra barrel of naphtha from Regicide.

substeps.text: Return to Isafdar, head to the Poison Waste a few steps south of the Tirannwn lodestone.
Fill your barrel with coal-tar.
Go to the fractionation still in Rimmington outside of the chemist's house.
Use the barrel of coal-tar on the still.
Rotate the tar regulator clockwise twice (don't do a complete rotation), to make the tar flow at maximum. The 'pressure' indicator on the left should go up.
When the pressure enters the green region, rotate the pressure valve clockwise once to let out some pressure. This should stall the pressure indicator.
Start adding coal. This raises the 'heat' indicator on the right. If it's below the green region, add more coal. If it's above, don't add coal until it gets lower.
If the heat reading reaches the dark orange portion, you've spoiled your compound and must start again.
If you run out of coal, your progress will be saved, but you will have to re-set the pressure to add more coal to it.
Exit the interface once the green bar is full.

steps.text: Use the barrel of naphtha on the Apple barrel in your Inventory.
Use the apple mix on your sieve. This was given to you by Elena when she identified the toxin.
Use the toxic naphtha on a cooking range to get 2 toxic powder. A range can be found in the Mourner Headquarters.

substeps.text: Do not use it on an open fire, as the naphtha will explode.

steps.text: Enter the largest building in the centre of West Ardougne.
Use one of the toxic powder on the sacks in the west room.
Head to the Church (to the south) and poison the second set of grain (located upstairs).
Return to the Head Mourner in the headquarters.
Quest complete!

items_required: A full set of mourner gear

steps.text: Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya to report your earlier findings if you haven't done this before.
While wearing your mourner outfit (and with nothing else equipped), talk to the Head Mourner under the trapdoor in the Mourner Headquarters located in West Ardougne who will give you the new key. (✓)

substeps.text: If you have completed One Small Favour, add the new key to your key ring to save an inventory slot.

steps.text: Run west through the cave, keep going until you find the dead bodies. Watch the cutscene.
Search the bodies until you find a colour wheel and Edern's journal.
Enter the temple and climb the staircase to the west of the entrance.
Run south and climb up ladder on the south wall.
Run north and climb down and back up the northern staircase.
Run east to the wall, and then south to the crystal.
Search the crystal to receive a blackened crystal. (1)
Make your way back to Arianwyn in Lletya and speak to him. (Use a charged crystal teleport seed if you have one.)
Use the blackened crystal on Eluned who will have appeared next to Arianwyn after talking to him.
Talk to Eluned again to get a newly made crystal.
Talk to Arianwyn again.
At this point you can drop the colour wheel and Edern's journal to save on inventory space.

substeps.text: If you are a high combat level (130+) and have tier 80 gear or higher, you will likely kill him easily without worrying about his final stun ability. Bring high-healing food like shark or sea turtle and just keep attacking him and healing while standing directly beside him.
In short; bombs laid on the floor deal 4,000 damage when stepped on.
Avoid them by walking DIRECTLY south, he does not place one there.
"You cannot hide from my wrath" deals 7,500 damage. Either eat above that or hide behind a pillar.
If he summons clones, the real one attacks you last, otherwise kill them all.

An alternative is hide from them, after about 90 seconds the three fake ones will despawn. Make sure to re-attack him quickly after this so he does not reset, he does not use "Face me!" while clones are present.
"Face me!" if he doesn't hit you in time, he restores his life points and teleports you. For example, if you were hiding behind a pillar.
Towards the end of the fight he teleports you to the centre and stuns you. The next attack deals all your maximum life points, minus 1. So eat to full.
If you bring a shield, swap to it and use resonance. This blocks the attack 100% but does not heal you.
"This. Ends. Now" starts attacking you rapidly. It's important to finish him off at this point and not hide, otherwise he will restore his life points and you'll have to restart the fight.

Once Upon a Time in Gielinor.name: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor

sections.heading: Foreshadowing
notes: Celebration rings out from the Blue Moon Inn, a gathering to honour the tales of The World Guardian, led by the ever faithful groupie of Sliske, Relomia. She offers the hero a special hat and brew of her own creation, which are laid out on a table nearby. Later she begins her tales, personally recounting her adventures saving those across Gielinor. Relomia recalls how she chopped the heads off of a three-headed green dragon, used Darklight to banish Delrith, and the time she staked Count Draynor with an iron stake. The player quickly comes to understand that the two of them must have switched personalities, as everyone in the bar take Relomia to be the player. Eventually they recount the true events and the other townspeople agree. Relomia gets angry and attacks the player, sending them to Death who then greets them also assuming them to be her. The player eventually convinces Death of their true identity and work with Closure to break the spell that's been cast. The player convinces Relomia to sign a contract written by Closure, which breaks the illusion. Now angry with Sliske for leaving her alone as well as the player for foiling her plan, Relomia declares that she has more plans in store for the future and leaves.

sections.heading: Flashback
notes: Closure in his office tells the player that Relomia has recently visited. During that visit she stole and vandalised a number of biographies. Due to the nature of Closure's biographies these vandalisms end up having real consequences to the characters involved (Ava, Merlin, and Ozan). The player is tasked to correct these vandalisms by visiting instances of interactions between the player and the characters involved, one each per character.

sections.heading: Fortunes
notes: With all her interfering, Closure has started taking interest in Relomia's story to better understand her. But upon looking into it, he can't help but feel sorry for her. The player's life of questing and being a hero is all Relomia ever wanted. To make amends, the player, with the help of Closure and Death, creates a quest for her to complete, letting Relomia be the hero for once.

sections.heading: Finale
notes: Just when Closure wants to tell the player about their story, they get interrupted by Relomia from the future who died. The player is asked to help Relomia solve the reasons why she died in three separate memories. The memories involve aiding three teams in completing their missions. After doing so the player completes this subquest and subsequently the entire quest by speaking with Closure once more.

One of a Kind.name: One of a Kind
items_required: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless the hard Morytania achievements have been completed)
875 coins to enter Brimhaven Dungeon (unless the hard Karamja achievements have been completed)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.recommended: 2 backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to Mr. Mordaut in his office in the basement of Varrock Museum that is accessed behind the stairs. (1•~•✓)
Read the book Hannibus Hunted.
Talk to Mr. Mordaut. (~•~•2•~)

sections.heading: Bob the Cat
sections.needed: Catspeak amulet (e)

steps.text: Locate Bob the Cat with the catspeak amulet. An easy method to locate him is to hop worlds at the west Varrock anvils or searching nearby the Burthorpe lodestone. Most of the time he is inside Carwen Essencebinder Magical Runes Shop
Talk to Bob.
Travel to Unferth's house east of Burthorpe lodestone.
Talk to Unferth. (1•3•1•1•2)
Search the bookcase.
Investigate the fireplace.
Inspect the table.
Remove the carpet.
Enter the trapdoor.

sections.heading: Robert the Strong's library
sections.needed: Emerald

steps.text: Search the desk in the centre of the room.
Investigate the weapon rack to the north. (1)
Use iron oxide on emerald to get Animate Rock scroll.
Read the Animate Rock scroll by the statue to the south.
Talk to Hannibus. (1•1•~•1•1•4•2)
Search the bookcase for the Dragonkin Primer to the east and Flight of the Dragonkin to the west.
Click the map in the south of the room to update location names

sections.heading: The mysterious statues
sections.needed: Animate Rock scroll
sections.recommended: Portable fairy ring or Ardougne cloak and a law altar teleport

steps.text: Head to the mysterious statue east of the Seers' Village bank.
Read the Animate Rock scroll by it. (3•1•2)
Repeat for the next 3 statues. Rotating all 4 statues gives access to 10,000 bonus experience in any skill. At least one is required to continue.

substeps.text: North-west of the Karamja lodestone. (1•2)
North-west of the Ardougne lodestone. (1•2)
North of the Tower of Life (fairy ring DJP, Ardougne cloak for east of Kandarin Monastery, or Kandarin Monastery Teleport). (1•2)

steps.text: Travel to the north-west corner of Entrana.
Read the animate rock scroll by the submerged statue. (3•3•4)

sections.heading: Forinthry Dungeon
sections.needed: Dragonkin Primer
sections.recommended: Wilderness sword 2

steps.text: Run to the green dragons in the south east corner of the Forinthry Dungeon. Hannibus will talk to you if you brought the Dragonkin Primer book. (1)

substeps.text: This dungeon is located in the Wilderness, so make sure that you are not opted in to PvP combat by talking to Vala.
A quick method is to use the Wilderness sword 2 teleport to the dungeon, or run east to the Wilderness Crater lodestone and run straight west to the dungeon entrance.
If you don't see Hannibus, exit the dungeon and re-enter it, then run towards green dragons, it will give you an option to continue the quest. Make sure you brought the Dragonkin Primer book.

steps.text: Run close to the east wall of the room, near the lava. (2)
Study the rock (on the ground east of the green dragon).

sections.heading: Brimhaven Dungeon
sections.recommended: Combat equipment method to kill three iron dragons (weak to water spells), Antifire potion or other means of dragonfire protection, Dragonkin Primer, 875 coins (unless you use a Dungeoneering cape to enter or have the hard Karamja achievements completed)

steps.text: Travel to the iron/steel dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon. (1)

substeps.text: A quick method is using the Dungeoneering cape and selecting "Brimhaven metal dragon dungeon"
A slower method is walking west from the Karamja lodestone, entering the dungeon, and walking to the iron and steel dragons
If you don't get the question about 'One of a Kind' go back to the entrance of the room and walk slowly into the room again.

steps.text: Kill 3 iron dragons. (~•~)
Head to the west wall by the mysterious entrance to study the dragonkin writing.

sections.heading: Grotworm Lair
sections.recommended: Remora's necklace

steps.text: Travel to the Grotworm Lair north-west of Port Sarim lodestone.

substeps.text: Remora's necklace will take you directly outside of the portal.

steps.text: Enter the bottom level of the Grotworm Lair. You can use the shortcut to the south-east of the first floor to get there quickly. (1)
Investigate the summoning portal. The portal is right next to the shortcut, a square hole in the wall gleaming green. (1)
Talk with Hannibus. (3•1•1•1)

sections.heading: Dragontooth Island
sections.needed: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (if hard Morytania achievements is not complete or Big Book o' Piracy isn't used)
sections.recommended: Ectophial to get to Port Phasmatys or Big Book o' Piracy, or Dungeoneering cape for Dragontooth Island teleport, antifire potion and food to survive fighting celestial dragons for 2 minutes

steps.text: Travel to Dragontooth Island by talking to the ghost captain east of Port Phasmatys (south of those ships, in the small boat). (1)

substeps.text: The fastest method is teleporting to Dragontooth Island directly, using the Dungeoneering cape teleport, or using the elder divination outfit to teleport to the "Radiant Wisp Colony".
A quick method to Port Phasmatys is heading to Port Sarim and taking a charter ship to Port Phasmatys (talk to Trader Stan south-east of the lodestone).
There are two ghost captains, you need to talk to the southern one who is standing next to a rowboat, not a ship.

steps.text: Enter the mysterious entrance to the south.
Fight or tank a celestial dragon until Hannibus's bond reaches 100% (approximately 2 minutes).

substeps.text: Attack multiple to reach 100% faster.

steps.text: Talk to Hannibus again.

sections.heading: The white dragon
sections.recommended: Combat gear, food and potions to fight 3 dragon-hunters (Ranged/Magic/Melee)

steps.text: Activate the Artefact north of Edgeville Monastery to meet with Hannibus in the King Black Dragon Lair. (1•1)

substeps.text: You will not enter a player-versus-player enabled area despite the warning.

steps.text: Talk with the King Black Dragon. (1)
Enter mysterious entrance.
Talk with Therragorn. (1•1)
Kill the 3 dragon-hunters.
Talk to Hannibus for a cutscene.
Kerapac will talk to you. (3•2•1•1•1)
Head into the far northern room. Kerapac will talk to you. (2)
Harvest 25 dragonkin memories from the protoplasmic wisps and channel them into the cage.
Talk with Kerapac to fight Echo of Jas. (1)
Kill the Echo of Jas and then talk to it after you defeat it.

sections.heading: Wrapping up
sections.needed: 5 free backpack spaces

steps.text: Kerapac will talk to you. (4•1•1•~)
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Dragontooth Island resource dungeon, containing celestial dragons
Rotate all four mysterious statues during or after the quest to gain 10,000 bonus experience in a skill of choice
The dragon-hunters (archer, mage, and warrior) and Echo of Jas can be faced in the Dominion Tower
If Ritual of the Mahjarrat has been completed, speak to the Submerged Statue on Entrana again to receive 25,000 bonus experience in any non-elite skill (12,500 if elite)
The ability to translate murals in the Adamant dragon dungeon and on Mount Firewake with the Dragonkin Primer

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Contemplation (in Robert's library, if not already unlocked during Curse of the Black Stone)
Awoken (only if you had not previously entered the Queen Black Dragon's lair)
Queen Black Dragon (only if you had not previously entered the Queen Black Dragon's lair)

Osseous Rex.name: Osseous Rex
items_required: 20 orthenglass (some obtainable during the quest, can be in material storage; players with low Archaeology levels will likely obtain all during the quest)

steps.text: Talk to the 'Calm' Archaeologist at the rex skeleton in Anachronia base camp to begin the quest. (✓•1)
Head to the teleportation device in the spirit grove.
Activate the teleportation device.
Head east and talk to the 'Calm' Archaeologist.

sections.heading: Finding a teleportation crystal
sections.needed: Free backpack space to excavate an artefact
sections.recommended: Excavation equipment such as mattock, archaeology outfit, and porters

steps.text: Go north-east towards the Matriarch lair entrance, and then through the archway to the north and follow the path anti-clockwise until you reach an Ancient Artefact (Inactive).
Activate the Ancient Artefact (Inactive) to unlock the first gate.
Go back to the area near the archaeologist and Pass Through the gate.
Go south, then east, then north through the arch, and activate the second Ancient Artefact (Inactive).
A cutscene ensues, unlocking two more gates.
Go south, looping around to the immediate west and Pass Through the gate.
Go east, following the path south and around anti-clockwise up a hill.
Pass Through the gate.
Uncover the soil.
Excavate the crystallised rubble for a teleportation crystal (damaged).

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: Teleportation crystal (damaged), 20 orthenglass in material storage container

steps.text: Restore the teleportation crystal (damaged) at an archaeologist's workbench.
Talk to the 'Calm' Archaeologist in the Rex Matriarch lair with the restored teleportation crystal.
Watch the cutscene.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Osseous boss fight

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Rex Matriarchs (if not already unlocked)

Pieces of Hate.name: Pieces of Hate
items_required: The following items are required, but will need to be retrieved from your bank once you escape prison as you will be forced to deposit all of your worn/inventory items before the Customs Sergeant will send you to jail:

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.needed: 1 free inventory space

steps.text: Enter the player-owned house portal. Postie Pete will appear and give you a letter from Bill Teach.
Read the letter. (✓)
Deposit all items.
Go to the Rimmington Customs Office without any items, then talk to the Customs Sergeant. (1•4•~)
Talk to Bill Teach about Pieces of Hate.
Talk to Two-Eyed Eric through barred window. (1•3•4)
Use the hook on the bed, then combine the cloth with the hook.
Go outside and use the cloth-hook on the fishing spot.
Use the fish on the perch rock to attract a seagull.
Use the fish on the door, then use the hook on the door.
Push the barrels by the door to block out the guards.
Use the hook on Bill Teach's cell door.
Search the desk and locker. Put the customs uniform on.
Investigate the pile of crates to take a small crate.
Use the spoon on the crate to make a trap, then use the sandwich on it to bait it.
Use the trap on the rat hole in Bill Teach's cell. (3•4•2•4)
Use the guard's keys on any remaining prisoner's cell door.
Attempt to open the door in the middle of the prison (leading to the stairs).
Talk to Madame Shih.
Talk to Jimmy the Parrot (one of the pirates).
Open the door in the middle of the prison (leading to the stairs).
Investigate the poster next to the stairs, then climb the stairs wearing the customs outfit.

substeps.text: If the "investigate" option doesn't appear on the bed, make sure you have checked the poster downstairs.

steps.text: Search the lockers (to the north). Use the pineapple on the puddle of slime in the corner, then use it on Wilson (the rat).
Use Pineapple Wilson on the door to the south room.
Enter the room and investigate the east bed to find first floor keys.
Open the north door between the beds.
Right-click "Use" the 'rum' on the strange egg. (1)

substeps.text: If you drink the 'rum' accidentally, then you can get a new one from the lockers to the east.

steps.text: Climb up the stairs to the east.
After the cutscene, dive off the pier.
Speak to anyone. (~•1)

sections.heading: Finding a friend
sections.needed: 2 pieces of leather, 1 gold bar, 1 free inventory space
sections.recommended: Varrock teleport

steps.text: Sit in the chair in the north-east corner of Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum'. (1)
Speak to the Zombie pirate head. (~•2•3•~•1)
Go to the west of Varrock and speak to Gertrude in her house. (4)
Talk to Philop or Kanel inside Gertrude's house.
Go to the abandoned house northwest of the apothecary in south-west Varrock and search the jiggling crate to find Wilson. (1•1)

sections.heading: Seeing the sunset
sections.needed: Blurberry special, Drunk dragon, Chocolate saturday

steps.text: Travel to the Karamja lodestone and head south to the beach just north of Jiminua's Jungle Store; the head will tell you to stop. (1)
Talk to the head again. (1•1•1•1)

sections.heading: Zogoth
sections.needed: Combat gear
sections.recommended: Food and prayer potions

steps.text: Prepare for combat. Return to Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' and return to the Interrogation Room by sitting in the north-east chair. (1)
When ready for the fight, head south-west of Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' and row the rowboat. (1)
Enter the door to the south.
Kill all four tentacles; a cutscene follows.
Kill Zogoth; a cutscene follows.

substeps.text: Stay within melee range to avoid a typeless damage attack from the tentacles.
Move away from the water jet attack to avoid being pushed to the back of the boat.
Move away from shadows when Zogoth shields itself to avoid acid spray attacks (occurs at 50% and 25% health). The acid will follow you around until the attack ends.

sections.heading: Rabid Jack's invasion
sections.needed: Combat gear
sections.recommended: Food and prayer potions

steps.text: Once on Mos Le'Harmless, during Rabid Jack's Invasion, the player must clear two waves of enemies.
Wave 1 (initial attack):

substeps.text: Kill the barrelchest and zombie captains at the main gate to the north and repair the barricades.
Kill the zombie captains up the ramp (on the western wall), then help up the pirate on the wall.
Kill the zombie captains at the south-east coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
Kill the zombie captains at the south-west coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.

steps.text: Wave 2 (next attack):

substeps.text: Kill the DKS and the zombie captains at the main gate and repair the barricades.
Kill the zombie captains up the ramp (on the western wall), then help up the pirate on the wall.
Kill the zombie captains at the south-east coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
Kill the zombie captains at the south-west coast of the town, then repair the cannons and sink the zomboats.
Kill the zombie captains at river east of the town, then destroy the makeshift bridges.
Kill the DKS and the zombie captains at the wheat field north of the town, then destroy the cannon.
Kill the DKS and the zombie captains at the coast north-west of the town, then destroy the grounded ship. This should be done last.

steps.text: Finish the conversation with the pirates in the invasion. You will not be able to progress without doing so.

sections.heading: Braindeath Island
sections.needed: Four free backpack spaces

steps.text: Head to Braindeath Island via Pirate Pete north of Port Phasmatys. (1)
Head south, and down the wooden stairs. Run west along the building and up the wooden stairs on the west of the bunkroom.
Head through the bunkroom to the east side, then north-east. Listen at the window to the room with Captain Braindeath.
After the dialogue, head back to the bunkroom, and talk to Davey.
Head down the wooden stairs, put on the barrelchest disguise then talk to Captain Donnie south-east. (3)
Head up the nearby wooden stairs, and talk to the Barrelchest Mk I.
Return to Captain Donnie again to learn the passphrase (2)
Head back up the wooden stairs, and once again talk with the Barrelchest Mk I. (5)
Remove the disguise, for speed.
Climb the ladder in the south-east corner of the building.
Head west, and take the Barrels of 'rum' from on top of the crate, head north and do the same again.
Block the pressure barrel (just south-east of the second of the barrels of 'rum'), then overload the pressure lever beside it.
Return down the ladder, and then the stairs.
Head north-west and pass through the gate by 66.6...% Luke.

substeps.text: You cannot use the dungeoneering cape teleport here to get to the north of the island.

steps.text: Head north, up the mountain to the pool (marked with on the minimap) and investigate the perch rock.
Baron von Hattenkrapper will appear. Complete the dialogue, then select Unleash! (1)
Guide Baron von Hattenkrapper and hit the mysterious entrance to the south-west 3 times; a cutscene follows.
Talk with Mi-Gor, and set sail. (1)

sections.heading: Underwater
sections.needed: Combat gear
sections.recommended: Food and prayer potions

steps.text: Head south and equip gear from the crate of diving gear, then head north and dive into the cracked hull.
Head south-west, and jump off the edge.
Head south, then west, then north to the shimmering barrier.

substeps.text: EPILEPSY WARNING: If you suffer from epilepsy, talk to the shimmering kitten to prevent aggravating symptoms.
You need to prepare for combat for the next part.

steps.text: If well-prepared for combat, pass through the shimmering barrier; a cutscene follows.

substeps.text: Note: If you choose to re-gear use the rowboat in the south-west of Mos Le'Harmless to get back to the temple.

steps.text: Reduce Jack's health to 0.

substeps.text: Stand at the north, south, west, east walls or doorway to avoid being damaged and stunned by the black hand in the centre of the room.
Use Freedom or Anticipation if stunned by Jack's stun attack. Avoid running from Jack to reduce the frequency of this attack.

Drink 'rum' from barrels in the room to reduce "insanity". Insanity is indicated by the black cat debuff icon and will cause Jack hallucinations to spawn and the camera to spin if it becomes too high. Drink as soon as the debuff icon appears.
If you die you can return to fight Rabid Jack by travelling back to Mos Le'Harmless and taking the small rowboat.

steps.text: Loosen an ancient chain.
Repeat this process for the 3 other chains; a cutscene follows.
Speak with Madame Shih. (5)
Sit in the chair in Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' (1)
Talk to Bill Teach with 6 free inventory spaces; a cutscene follows.
Quest complete!

items: Rabid Jack hat, sword and off-hand variant cosmetic overrides
Chance to get a master clue from the Skeletal Horror improved to 1/12[1]
Holy wrench will now work with Dungeoneering prayer necklaces and the Ectoplasmator

rewards.label: Early bird bonus
items: Gold Premier Club members could obtain 500 pieces of eight from the Guardian of the Premier Vault after completion of the quest until 1 April 2018.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: You may return to Ulthven Kreath to decipher four murals in the following order: Thieving, Agility, Firemaking, and Construction. Each mural grants 50,000 experience and requires level 85 in its respective skill. This completes the Roake Kal achievement and is a requirement for the master quest cape.
Completion of Pieces of Hate is a pre-requisite for creating the hatchet of bloom and blight.

Pirate's Treasure.name: Pirate's Treasure
items_required: White apron (an apron spawns on the wall of Gerrant's shop, in Port Sarim)
60 coins, or a ring of charos (a) and 30 coins

steps.text: Talk to Redbeard Frank just outside Port Sarim's pub. (1•✓)
Walk south along the docks, pay 30 coins to Captain Tobias to go to Karamja. (1)
Head inside the pub.
Buy one Karamjan rum from Zembo.
Do not leave the island yet or more rum will have to be obtained.
Pick 10 bananas from the Banana Trees to the north-west.
Go east to the house by the docks.
Talk to Luthas about the officer. (2)
On the east side of Luthas' house will be a wooden crate.
Use the Karamjan rum on the crate, then right-click Fill the crate.
Talk to Luthas.
Head to Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim.
Equip your white apron and attempt to open the door to the back room. (1)

substeps.text: A free white apron can be obtained from the back wall in the fishing store.

steps.text: Search the crate with the banana on it.
With the rum, return to Redbeard Frank for a chest key. (1)
Go upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in south Varrock.
Open the chest in the south-west room for a pirate message. Read it.
Go to Falador Park and stand on the east end of the pond, directly west of the statue of Saradomin, indicated by X on the ground.
Right-click Dig using the pirate message. Kill the gardener. Alternatively, leave the site for a while and the gardener will be gone.
Right-click Dig using the message again.
Quest complete!

items: A casket containing 450 coins, an emerald and a gold ring
Ability to work as a menial labourer on a banana plantation (30 coins for each export crate the player fills with 10 bananas)

Plague's End.name: Plague's End
items_required: A full set of Mourner outfit (gas mask, mourner boots, mourner cloak, mourner gloves, mourner top and mourner trousers)
Plant cure or runes to cast Cure Plant (requires access to the Lunar Spells and 66  Magic)
1 gold, green, crimson and blue charm

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: Mourner outfit
sections.recommended: Combat equipment

steps.text: Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya. (1•✓•1•1)
Enter western door.

sections.heading: Infiltration
sections.needed: 1 backpack space

steps.text: Open northern door. (3•2•1)
Head to the north-western room.
Talk to a Mourner.
Talk to Iestin Edern. (2)
Climb up the nearby stairs (north wall).
Talk to the Mayor of Prifddinas in the house north of the camp. (2)
Talk to the Mourner at the bridge, south of the camp. (1)
Return to the Mayor. (1)
Take Iorwerth master plan from the desk.
Head south-east back downstairs and talk to Iestin Edern. (1•3)

sections.heading: Incite an uprising
sections.needed: Iowerth master plan, 3 backpack space

steps.text: Talk to Councillor Halgrive outside the East Ardougne church (south west of lodestone), located just west of the main square. (1)
Talk to Bravek in the upper floor of Civic Office of West Ardougne. (1•2•2)
Unequip 1 mourner piece. The people won't speak to you with a full set of mourner outfit equipped.
Talk to the 6 people on the list:

substeps.text: Ted or Martha Rehnison - In a building north of the civic office. (1)
Jethick - On the eastern side of the large paved area outside the civic office. (1)
Nurse Sarah - In a building south-west of the church. (1)
Carla - In an open area, north of the graveyard to the west of the church. (1)
Koftik - Entrance to the Underground Pass. (1)
Elena - Found in the house just west of the log balance in the northern part of East Ardougne (from the lodestone run south-west and then take log balance to cross the river). (1)

sections.heading: Time to attack
sections.needed: 1 backpack space, Mourner outfit
sections.recommended: crystal teleport seeds, Halgrive's proclamation, combat equipment, food, and 10 magic logs in the bank

steps.text: Go to the church in West Ardougne.
Talk to any of the 6 NPCs at the church (not the priest). (1•5)
Head to the Mourner Headquarters (north-east).
Kick down door and kill the mourners. (If door is not closed, transport away and come back. No mourner gear needed.)
Open trapdoor in north-west corner and kill the mourners.
Defeat then talk to Head Mourner. (1•2•3•~)
Talk to Elena with one free inventory space.
Go up to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] and replace the Mourners standard.
Head to the entrance of Ardougne Castle.
Talk to Sir Edmond at the entrance. (1)
Head upstairs, talk to King Lathas.
Kill Sir Hugo.
Talk to King Lathas. (3)
Talk to Sir Edmond.
Return to Lletya, switch back into full mourner's gear and talk to Arianwyn to go back to the undercity. (1)
Talk to Iestin Edern. (3•2•1)
Talk to Gwir, just north. (1)
If you don't have 3 free inventory spaces, use the bank in the building
Search a bookcase for The Lost Elders book. (1)
Read the book.
Talk to Gwir for 2 items. (1•4•5•2•5)

sections.heading: Finding Lady Ithell
sections.needed: 10 magic logs

steps.text: The blue symbols you need to inspect are on the walls, near the floor, in Lletya. Ground level:

substeps.text: Ranging shop (south west building), along western wall
Southern building, south wall.
Bank, east wall, south of the table.

steps.text: Upper level:

substeps.text: Up the central stairs, outside altar room, north wall
Up the clothing store stairs, west wall.

steps.text: Head to the centre of Lletya and build the statue hotspot.
Climb upstairs.
Speak to Kelyn. (4)

sections.heading: Finding Lady Trahaearn
sections.needed: Rune bar, combat equipment, 1 empty summoning pouch, 200 spirit shards, 1 gold charm, 1 green charm, 1 crimson charm, 1 blue charm, and 1 Amlodd charm
sections.recommended: Plant cure (you can buy a plant cure at the fruit tree patch elf), Meilyr potion recipe (to avoid banking later)

steps.text: Make your way to the Well of Voyage:

substeps.text: Exit Lletya, pass tree (north-west).
Step-over tripwire (west).
Enter dense forest (west).
Jump leaves (north).
Head east until you find a cave entrance and enter it.

steps.text: Head east, mine cracked wall (south of the well).
Enter tunnel.
Kill 3 level 70 automatons (each automaton uses a different side of the combat triangle).
Wake Lady Trahaearn. (1•3)
Go north back into the room where you mined the wall.
Use the Amlodd Charm on the obelisk to the north-west. (1)
Summon Amlodd pouch. (1•3)

sections.heading: Finding Lord Crwys
sections.needed: Plant cure, Meilyr potion recipe

steps.text: Home teleport to Tirannwn Lodestone.
Pick a blue mushroom (you must have the Meilyr potion recipe in order to pick the mushrooms).
Enter Dense Forest (west of Tirannwn Lodestone).
Pick a red mushroom (these mushrooms are for later. Might appear very light shade of red).
Step over trip-wire (north-west).
Enter dense forest two times (north - do not pass the third one).
Chop down tree (east).
Inspect tree (west).
Use plant cure on the tree.
Talk to Lord Crwys. (4)
Make your way to the Poison Waste:

substeps.text: Take Fairy ring code DLR to the small island in the swamp. Head west once arriving onto the island via fairy ring.
Alternatively, go to Lletya:
Exit Lletya, pass tree (north-west).
Head far south to the large swamp area, past the magic trees.

steps.text: Jump the small rocks to each island, going west, referencing the map captioned right (read map from right to left).
Talk to Elf Hermit. (2•2•1•3•4)

sections.heading: Finding Lady Meilyr
sections.needed: blue Isafdar mushroom, red Isafdar mushroom, super defence (3)
sections.recommended: Ring of kinship

steps.text: Grind your red and blue Isafdar mushrooms.
Use on super defence (3) potion. (3)
Teleport to Daemonheim by using ring of kinship or taking the ferry by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir in Taverley.
Drink Meilyr potion in the Dungeoneering lobby at Daemonheim.
Enter the portal that appears on the west side.
Talk to Lady Meilyr. (4)
Return to Lletya.
Talk to Arianwyn. (1)
Talk to Iestin Edern. (3)
Travel to Tyras Camp (west of Tirannwn lodestone) or charter ship to Tyras Camp via Port Sarim.
Talk to General Hining. (4)
Prepare for combat (fire-based spells preferred).
Return to Lletya.
Talk to Arianwyn. (1)
Talk to Iestin Edern.
Enter the Grand Library and walk west to the puzzle. (2)
Talk to Lord Crwys to begin stage 1.
Direct light into the centre (place/rotate mirrors as needed).
Use Protect/Deflect Magic and keep moving when Dark Lord is alive. You can either kill the enemies between puzzles or tank their hits.

substeps.text: Each puzzle completed saves, so you can leave for more food and return between puzzles/fights.

steps.text: After directing the beam into the Crwys Crystal, there will be some dialogue.
Quest complete!
Recommended: exit the Grand Library and speak to Arianwyn to teleport to the entrance of Prifddinas, or walk there yourself. After a skippable cutscene, the city of Prifddinas will be unlocked.

items: Experience in 10 skills (if you lose any of the reward lamps for any reason, you will not be able to re-obtain them): 50,000 Agility experience lamp

steps.text: Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in the Falador Park about the void knights. (1•✓)

substeps.text: Or, if Slug Menace isn't complete (2•✓)

steps.text: Go to the Void Knights' Outpost.

substeps.text: To get there, speak to the Squire on the pier at Port Sarim to travel to the island by ship free of charge. (3)

steps.text: Speak to Commodore Matthias in the north-east building.
Talk to Captain Tyr just south of the building.
Talk to the following people about escaping pests:

substeps.text: Knight Ami (4)
Knight Bernard (3•4)
Knight Diana (3•4)
Knight Mikhal (3•4)
Jessika (4•5)
Mariah (4)
Mrs Gord (3•4)
Squire Sam (1•2)
Terry Gord (3•4)

steps.text: Talk to Captain Tyr.
Talk to Jessika about the crimes she has committed. (5•3)
Talk to Captain Tyr.
Talk to Commodore Matthias.
Agree during the cutscene. (1)
Solve the 3x3 slider puzzle. The border helps you find their correct positions.

substeps.text: The centre piece will appear when you have placed the border pieces.

steps.text: Watch the cutscene and continue the dialogue with Commodore Mathias.
Bank all your items, both equipped and in your inventory. Dismiss any pets or familiars.
Return to Sir Tiffy and talk about Void Knights. (1)

substeps.text: Or, if Slug Menace isn't complete (2)

steps.text: Talk to Commander Korasi. (1)
Talk to the toll booth to start the puzzle. (2)
Complete the puzzle:

substeps.text: Talk to Bernard and cross with him. (1)
Talk to the toll booth to send yourself over. (1•1)
Talk to Ami or Diana and have them cross together. (2)
Talk to the toll booth to send Bernard over. (1•1)
Talk to Bernard and cross with him. (1)

steps.text: Right-click assign the people to the following:
Completing the puzzle correctly triggers a cutscene.
Kill the torcher.
Go up the ladder.
Kill the shifter and wait for another cutscene.
Once teleported, talk to Sir Tiffy.
Speak with Captain Tyr at the Void Knights' Outpost.
Quest complete!

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Void Knights' Theme (At the Temple Knights' HQ)

Rat Catchers.name: Rat Catchers
items_required: A kitten works, but it catches rats very slowly and needs to be fed. An overgrown cat does not work.
Your cat may die on this quest.
1 rat poison (can be found in the Clock Tower Dungeon)
Alternatively the ingredients to make it during the quest are:
1 clean kwuarm (if needed, Zahur in Nardah cleans grimy herbs for 200 coins)
1 clean marrentill (if needed, Zahur in Nardah cleans grimy herbs for 200 coins)
1 catspeak amulet (or cramulet containing a catspeak amulet)
1 pot of weeds (use an empty pot with weeds)
About 600 coins (about 300 with ring of charos (a))
Snake charm (can be obtained during quest if not already in bank)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: a cat, hellcat or kitten, 1 backpack space

steps.text: Talk to Gertrude in west edge of Varrock. (3•✓)

substeps.text: If you have a Hellcat out (4•✓)

steps.text: Take out your cat or kitten.
Talk to Phingspet or Grimesquit in the Varrock Sewers right next to the eastern entrance of Varrock Palace (down the manhole).
Catch 8 rats with your cat or kitten by choosing the "interact-with" option. (2)

substeps.text: The "Hide familiar options" setting must be off in the Gameplay settings.

steps.text: Talk to them again to obtain a rat pole.

sections.heading: Just the ticket
sections.needed: 1 free inventory space

steps.text: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler in the house in East Ardougne, directly west of the Flying Horse Inn, north-west of the Ardougne Castle. Ensure you finish the dialogue, or you will not be able to follow the next step.
Read the "directions" scroll he gives you. (1)

sections.heading: Breaking in
sections.needed: cat, rat pole
sections.recommended: No other weapons are wielding

steps.text: Avoid guards whilst traversing throughout. You can use Surge or Dive to navigate quickly.
Hide behind the hedges directly west of the mansion when the southwest guard walks toward the bridge.
Run to the north-west corner when the guard is behind the hedges.
Run to the hedges directly north of the mansion.
Climb up the nearby trellis on the northern of the mansion.

sections.heading: Catching the rats
notes: In this section, if you stand in a narrow passage, your cat may not be able to reach its prey. After cleaning the room, you can pick up the cat to prevent it from getting trapped outside.

steps.text: Once inside continue to avoid guards. You can hide by the potted flower on the balcony first.
Wield your rat pole.
Catch 1 rat with your cat in the north-west room. You may pick up your cat to prevent stuck outside. (1)
Find your way into the opposite bedroom across the hall and wait (or wait for one guard to be on the balcony and the second have his back appropriately turned to dash to the next room).
Catch 2 rats with your cat in the south-east room. (1•1)
Go down the ladder in the north-east of this room.
Catch 3 rats with your cat in this room and the room to the north. (1•1•1)
Leave the area by using Home Teleport to Ardougne lodestone.

substeps.text: You can also return to the trellis and climb down it to return directly to Jimmy.

steps.text: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler.

substeps.text: You can destroy your directions scroll now.

sections.heading: Hooknosed Jack
sections.needed: a cat, 4 pieces of cheese, a bucket of milk, clean marrentill, unicorn horn dust, rat poison (alternatively, clean kwuarm, red spiders eggs and an empty vial), 5-10 raw or cooked fish for your cat (even if you're using a fully grown cat)

steps.text: Talk to Hooknosed Jack in south-east Varrock, inside the fenced area past the guard.
If you need to make the rat poison and do not have the ingredients (clean kwuarm, red spiders eggs and an empty vial) in the backpack on the first talk, talk to him again. (1)
Climb up the ladder in the warehouse directly south of the Dancing Donkey Inn.
Use rat poison on all 4 pieces of cheese.
Use poisoned cheese on all of the rat holes.
Talk to Hooknosed Jack. (2)
Talk to the Apothecary in south-western Varrock for cat antipoison. (5)

substeps.text: If the first option is not 'Can you make a strength potion?',

steps.text: Talk to Hooknosed Jack. Finish the dialogue or you will not be able to progress.
Climb up the ladder in the warehouse.
Pick up your cat and use it on the hole in wall (not the rat holes). (1•1)
Keep using fish on the hole in wall (not on the cat) to restore the cat's life points until the king rat dies.

substeps.text: If you lose your cat by going down the ladder, exit to lobby out and join the world should return it to you.
If you are in a group or have lootshare active, then the kill will not register and you will need to go down the ladder to reset the king rat.

steps.text: You may retrieve your cat by calling your follower or by climbing down the ladder.
Talk to Jack to tell him the king rat is dead.

sections.heading: Smokin' Joe
sections.needed: a cat, a catspeak amulet, an empty pot, weeds

steps.text: Talk to Smokin' Joe in east Keldagrim, just east of the mining shop. (1)

substeps.text: Enter the tunnel north-east of Rellekka and Fremennik Province lodestone.
Go-through the cave entrance between the two dwarven statues.
Talk to the Dwarven Boatman and get him to take you into Keldagrim, this may cause you to automatically start the quest The Giant Dwarf.
Proceed to the east part of Keldagrim and talk with Smokin' Joe.

steps.text: Use some weeds on an empty pot and light the pot of weeds.
Use the smouldering pot on the rat hole near the crates on the southern wall.
Use the pot on the same hole again with your cat out and your catspeak amulet on, your cat will offer to help.

substeps.text: If your cat doesn't automatically initiate a conversation with you, you may have to attempt this a third time.

steps.text: Talk to Joe again.

substeps.text: You can drop the smouldering pot now.

sections.heading: The Face and the Felkrash
sections.needed: 101 coins (51 coins with the ring of charos(a)), and one free inventory space
sections.recommended: Pollnivneach Teleport Scroll and/or ring of charos(a)

steps.text: Talk to Felkrash, north of Port Sarim lodestone.
Talk to The Face nearby.
Head south of the bar in Pollnivneach.
Throw a coin into the money pot next to Badir the Snake Charmer (1)

substeps.text: He will give you a music scroll.

steps.text: If you have a snake charm in bank, retrieve it.
Return to Port Sarim.
Play the snake charm. Only 1 note can be set per page.

substeps.text: Go through the pages and click the correct notes (one note per page). The red dots in the music scroll correspond to the black dots on the flutes.
On page 5, click the <) icon in the top left before you play the note. You can go back and make corrections to the pages if needed.
Click play once all the notes are correctly selected.
There will be short cutscene upon completing correctly.

steps.text: Talk to Felkrash.

substeps.text: You can destroy your music scroll now.

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: Able to train Overgrown Cats into wily and lazy cats
The ability to name a lazy or wily cat (up to 6 letters long)

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Noble Rodent (while fighting the King Rat)
Bubble and Squeak (when speaking to Felkrash at quest's end)
Sarim's Vermin (when speaking to Felkrash at quest's end)
Rat a Tat Tat (when speaking to Felkrash at quest's end)
Catch Me If You Can (when speaking to Felkrash at quest's end)

Regicide.name: Regicide
items_required: Items to get through the Underground Pass (other items can be banked until the lodestone is active):
A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows
A plank (can be obtained in the underground pass)
1-5 ropes (you won't necessarily use all of them)
6-30 pieces of coal (coal in an orebox will not work)
An empty pot (can be obtained in the elf camp)
A strip of cloth (made by using 2 balls of wool on a loom)
