A cooked rabbit (can be obtained from charter traders or in Tirannwn after killing a rabbit and cooking the meat)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: Any bow, arrows, 1-5 ropes, plank

steps.text: Talk to King Lathas on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Ardougne Castle.

Travel through the Underground Pass which can be found on the far west side of West Ardougne. You do not need to find another Iban's doll or complete any of the steps from Underground Pass quest. You only need to reach Iban's temple.
Refer to this guide for instructions navigating the Underground Pass.
Enter the well in Iban's Temple.
Exit the cave to the west.

sections.heading: Tirannwn
sections.needed: Limestone

steps.text: Run through the forest, talk to Idris. Watch him die then continue.

substeps.text: If Idris does not spawn, log out and back in to trigger the scene.

steps.text: Go west to jump the leaves trap (a dark green patch on the ground).
Proceed southwest of the musician. Between some trees find a trap of sticks on the ground, click the sticks (choose the "pass" option, clicking beyond the sticks has a 100% failure rate).

substeps.text: This may take a few tries (if you spam click the trap, it will let you pass - make sure you're clicking the trap itself, as it has a small hitbox. If you're running low on health, return to the musician to recuperate before trying again.

steps.text: Continue south towards the lodestone.
Activate the Tirannwn lodestone once you find it.
Run back north-west towards the elf camp.
Jump another leaves trap, run past the bears and cross the log into the elf camp.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth.
Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone, talk to the elf tracker.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth again which requires at least one free inventory space.
Talk to the elf tracker back at the Tirannwn lodestone.
Follow the tracks just west of the lodestone in front of the dense forest entrance.
Talk to the elf tracker.
Enter the dense forest and kill the guard that appears.
Go north, step-over the tripwire and go through more dense forest.

substeps.text: Stepping over avoids taking damage as opposed to walking through.

steps.text: Continue north through the dense forest and west, then once again through dense forest to enter Tyras Camp.
Talk to General Hining in the camp.
Take two barrels behind the largest rectangular tent.

substeps.text: The second is required for completing Mourning's End Part I.

steps.text: Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone again and head south to reach the shoreline of the swamp.
Use the barrels on the tar to fill them into barrels of tar.

substeps.text: There are only two clickable tiles near the corpse and trees. Mouse over along the shoreline until you find the clickable area.

steps.text: Take some sulphur from the floor, then grind it into ground sulphur.
Head north-west into the elf camp and talk to Lord Iorwerth.
Read the Big Book of Bangs he gives you and pick up the empty pot north of him if you need one.
Go to a furnace and use the limestone on it (1)

substeps.text: You need a pot if you wish to grind the quicklime now, otherwise it will be destroyed.

sections.heading: Sabotage
sections.needed: The Big Book of Bangs, empty pot, quicklime, strip of cloth, cooked rabbit, barrel of coal-tar, ground sulphur and at least 10 pieces of coal (cannot be in an ore box, noted or Furnace - more may be required as you fail to operate the still)

steps.text: Talk to the Chemist in Rimmington. (3•1•2•3)

substeps.text: The book must be in your inventory, otherwise your Quest Journal will not update.

steps.text: Use your barrel of tar on the fractionation still outside.

sections.heading: Operating the still
notes: To operate the still:

steps.text: Click the tar regulator side twice.
Wait until the arrow gauge is within the green on the pressure valve side, then click the pressure valve once. This should keep the pressure indicator in the green without fluctuating.
Now add coal in 2x increments using the middle "Add coal" button to get the tar regulator indicator in the green.
Now that the pressure valve and tar regulator are both in the green, the distillation bar at the bottom of the interface will begin to fill up.
When the distillation bar is full, you may exit out of the interface, You should now have a barrel of naptha in the backpack.

substeps.text: If you plan on completing Mourning's End I a barrel of naphtha is required for that quest, repeat this process for a second barrel.

steps.text: Make the bomb:

substeps.text: Use ground sulphur on the barrel of naphtha for naphtha mix.
Grind the quicklime with an empty pot in your backpack.
Use the pot of quicklime on the naptha mix.
Use a strip of cloth on the barrel bomb.

steps.text: Teleport back to the Tirannwn lodestone.

substeps.text: Kill and cook a rabbit just north if you didn't bring a cooked rabbit.

steps.text: Head to the catapult north of Tyras Camp (west through the dense forest and tripwires if you used the lodestone).
Right-click use the cooked rabbit on the Tyras guard standing next to the catapult.
Use the barrel bomb on the catapult.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth at the Elf Camp.
Attempt to enter Ardougne Castle. Arianwyn will talk to you.
Talk to King Lathas.
Quest complete!

items: Access to Isafdar and the overpass of Arandar
Access to Port Tyras by using charter ships
Ability to wield and use a dragon halberd (bought for 325,000 coins from the quartermaster in Tyras Camp)
Ability to have elves assigned as a slayer task by Chaeldar, Sumona, Morvran, and Laniakea.

Ritual of the Mahjarrat.name: Ritual of the Mahjarrat
items_required: Spade (Can be acquired during the quest; the one on your tool belt will not work)

steps.text: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park about the Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
Accept the teleport. (1•1)
Talk to Sir Tendeth in the southern pub on Mos Le'Harmless. (1)
Talk to Sir Tendeth again after the cutscene.
Talk to the injured pirates outside and other pirates outside.

sections.heading: The mighty jungle
sections.recommended: Food and armour as well as protection against dragonfire

steps.text: Go north past the walls, to the blue area marked on the mini-map.
Using the western side of the trees as cover and following the burnt areas, head to the east side of the island.

substeps.text: Hide west of tropical trees and jungle grass with the examine Looks good for hiding in.... Once north of Trouble Brewing, you must keep hiding on the west side of the trees or grass. Do not move too quickly. Count at least 1 or 2 seconds before moving to next square.
Surge, the Magic ability may be used.
The music will change when you are not behind cover.
If hit by a fireball, heal by entering the nearby bank.
Remaining in the open for too long will cause a fireball to do damage and reset the player to the town gates.
If you misclick while going through the dialogue during the cutscene, you will exit it. Take one step to the west then step back behind the tree to re-trigger the cutscene.

steps.text: After the cutscene, report back to Sir Tiffy.

sections.heading: The archives
sections.needed: Catspeak amulet (e) or Cramulet

steps.text: Talk to Sir Tiffy and explain the situation to him. (2•3)
Talk to Lady Table or Sir Tiffy. (1•2•1•3)
Use the Catspeak Amulet to find Bob back on the surface, who will be roaming anywhere in Asgarnia or Misthalin. Or can be easily found in Apprentice Clara's Shop in Burthorpe.
Once found, ask him for his collar.
Study Bob's collar — the back, too!

sections.heading: Traversing Isle of Sann
sections.needed: Bob's collar, a spade (tool belt does not work), eight empty inventory spaces
sections.recommended: Food and weight reduction gear for the Agility course

steps.text: Go through any fairy ring, dial DIR and teleport to the Gorak Plane.
Right-click on the fairy ring and click "Select Destination", dial AKS and teleport to Kethsi.
Head north-west and search the rubble west of the mural to get tetrahedron 4. (If you do not receive the tetrahedron 4, check the bank for it.)
Go south-east and climb up the ramp.
Use Bob's collar on the wall design and solve the puzzle by positioning Bob's collar, pictured right.
Press the up arrow once to submit your puzzle solution.
Investigate the wall design to get tetrahedron 1, statue arm, note to you, note to Robert and Robert's necklace. Robert's necklace has no purpose in the quest and may be destroyed or banked.
Go south-west and jump across the ledge.
Use the Statue arm on the statue.
Cross the fallen spire that appears and go down the ladder.
Go east and up the wall jump.
Climb the wall to the west.
Use the swing pole to the north.
Walk across the beam.
Jump east over the gap.
Jump from the floor to the south.
Go down the southern ladder twice.
Squeeze through the pipe to the northeast of the ladder.
Use a pickaxe to mine the rocks or right-click and choose mine if using the pickaxe on your tool belt.
Climb the nearby wall and run across the walls to the west. If you fail either wall run or the handholds, go back to the pipe.
Climb across the handholds then go down the ladder.
Go east (along the northern coast) and search the rubble to find tetrahedron 3 and a strange device.
Go back up the ladder twice and jump from the floor to the south. If you fail this jump, go back to the pipe.
Slide down the roof to the south

substeps.text: Grab the nearby spade if you didn't have one with you.

steps.text: Walk across the plank to the south.
Search the rubble to find tetrahedron 2.
Once all four tetrahedrons are collected, go down the stairs north of the area where tetrahedron 2 was located.
Use each tetrahedron on an indentation (on the walls close to the entrance, also a second spade spawns by the stairs)
Check the quest journal for the code that must be found.

Find the coordinates received and dig there with a spade to receive a Kethsian key. The strange device tells you your current location. Below is a map of Kethsi with coordinates. The coordinates are arranged in a grid.
Go back to the dungeon and through the door to the south.
Search the southern bookcase for Dathana's message.

substeps.text: Optional: Search the south-east bookcase for the tune bane scroll.

steps.text: Read the message, then take it to Sir Tiffy. (2)
Go to the White Knights' Castle and talk to either Idria, Thaerisk Cemphier, or Akrisae. (3•1•2•3)
Make sure to get Arrav's heart before going to speak to Azzanadra or he will not talk to you about this quest.
Go to the north-eastern Varrock Dig Site winch, climb down and talk to Azzanadra. Ask him about the quest. (1)

sections.heading: Setting up the site
sections.needed: Ring of visibility, rope, all items from the previous step, and at least one free inventory space
sections.recommended: Super energy potions, food, and weaponry

steps.text: From the Rellekka Hunter area (fairy ring code: DKS) take the canoe (north-west from fairy ring code: DKS, north of Larry and past the hunter area) to the Mahjarrat Ritual Site Cavern, then squeeze-past the ice block to the east (do not enter the cavern itself). This allows one to skip the Wilderness.

substeps.text: If there is no heat globe on the pedestal, you may reclaim it from Azzanadra and place on it.

steps.text: At the Ghorrock Fort, jump over the pillar to the south (it is outside of the walls of the fort, there is no red line to indicate it, the obstacle is to the south along a line of trees and pillars.) then go through the tunnel.

substeps.text: Avoid the undead Broavs or the player will get thrown into Zemouregal's dungeon. To escape, search the bed and lift up the tiles to the east of the cell. Enter the tunnel to escape.

steps.text: Several items will need to be placed around the ritual site:

substeps.text: Northern Beacon: Run west from the ice entrance at the north of the plateau. Place the beacon on the closest tree.

Southern Beacon: Run directly south, and place the second beacon in the tree south-south-west of the ritual stone. If this is done correctly, you should have a message saying the south beacon is opposite the northern beacon.

Arrav's Heart: Place Arrav's heart in the rocks south of the ritual marker. The site is several paces south of the marker and just a pace or two east. If you cannot place the heart in a pile of rocks, you are at the wrong place.
Western Beacon: Run up the west side of the plateau until you find a tree just north of a central line. Place the beacon here. Using the tree just south of the central line will not work.
Eastern Beacon: Run straight east and place the beacon on the tree directly opposite the western tree. You should have a message saying the east beacon is directly opposite the west beacon.

Go to the north-west corner of the plateau and look for an Overhanging Tree above the Cavern entrance. Use a rope on it to create a rope climb from the beach to the plateau, turning it into a Snow-covered Tree with an attached rope. This will be used for your allies to climb to the ritual. (From now on, you can also use the rope yourself to get between the canoe landing site and the plateau without having to go past the dragons around Ghorrock.)

steps.text: Head to Zemouregal's fort which is south-west of the ritual site.
Kill the Armoured zombie outside of the main entrance and pick up the Code key and Decoder strips.
Read the code key and open the main entrance by obtaining the code from the key and strips. (In this example we take the code "EIHC", see the image on the right for the solution)

substeps.text: Drag the red strip number 1 to the first letter of the code key (example: "E").
A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "E" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
Drag the red strip number 2 to the second letter of the code key (example: "I").
A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "I" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
Drag the red strip number 3 to the third letter of the code key (example: "H").
A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "H" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.
Drag the red strip number 4 to the fourth letter of the code key (example: "C").
A single number will be revealed by the code strip (example: "C" row). Enter that number in the code box using the controls.

steps.text: Go through the front door and search the crate by the north-eastern weapon rack for the storeroom's Code key.
Read it and use it to open the storeroom door to the west in the same manner as the front entrance.
In the northern part of the storeroom, search the crates (2 empty spaces required).
Read the Heart magic notes.

Exit the room, head up the western stairs, and stand next to the southern door to listen to Zemouregal and Sharathteerk (you may have to move to the tile east of the door to allow the dialogue to play).
Head back downstairs, then go up the eastern stairs. Use the previously acquired Code key to enter the reliquary.
Smash the black stone in the southern half of the room.

sections.heading: Searching for the Stone of Jas

steps.text: Exit the fortress and head to the south-eastern part of the ritual site.
Talk to Movario. (1•1)
With the ring of visibility equipped, run west from Movario along southern wall of the site to find a shadow pedestal (almost directly south-east from the ritual marker).
Go back inside the centre of the Ghorrock Castle courtyard (past the dragons), and climb the western stairs next to the statue of Khazard.
Go east and climb down the stairs.
Scale the Damaged Wall next to the door.
Run past the smashed pedestal, and climb down the smashed rampart on west side of the trapdoor in the courtyard.
Enter the trapdoor. The icefiends encountered here will hit hard and there will be a good number of them. Bring high level food (sharks or swordfish) just in case for comfortable exploration.
Enter the room to the west and then head south.
Take the Heat globe and exit the same way you came.
Return to the shadow pedestal, south east of the ritual marker.
Put the globe on the pedestal.

substeps.text: If you try to put heat globe on the shadow pedestal and it says "That could be a good idea, but you've got other things to do first.", it means either that the beacons are not aligned properly, you have not placed Arrav's heart in the rocks to the south of the Ritual marker, you haven't placed the rope to the north-west of the tunnel or you have not talked to Movario after having done so. If you are completely sure you have done all of these things, talk to Movario to the east of the shadow pedestal, and he will place the heat globe in the pedestal. A few players have removed a beacon from a tree and put in back in the tree—this also has worked. Some report that reading the notes/Dathana's message also fixes this.

sections.heading: The ritual
sections.recommended: Food and Prayer Potions (Certain sections of this battle will call for no Prayer, and others will work with prayer just fine. Read ahead to understand the fight and allocate resources as necessary.)
notes: Before doing this part, make sure to prepare for the final fight.

steps.text: Enter the newly opened entrance, south of the shadowy pedestal.
Follow the open passageway and touch the Stone of Jas.

sections.heading: The battle
notes: Using an overload or any damage curses or normal damage prayers will cause you not to be able to hit, as it interferes with the Stone of Jas buff.

steps.text: After the cutscenes, defeat Khazard.
It helps to pray against magic and when Bouncer is summoned, lure him to Wahisietel so that he dies.
Defeat the Enhanced ice titans.

substeps.text: Lucien will be casting spells at the player whilst fighting the ice titans. If a smoking black skull is flying towards you, move at least two squares away from your current position. Also, praying melee completely negates damage from the titans' normal attacks. If ice starts encasing the player, they should click rapidly on the ground around them to escape.
You will only be able to damage the two enhanced ice titans that run at you; your teammates must kill the rest.
Avoid attacking Lucien, as doing so causes Lucien to hit you with a high damage attack.

steps.text: Defeat the Ice Demons

substeps.text: Praying against magic helps limit the damage the demons can cause. They will also summon icicles which will fall around the player. When this happens, run out of the icicles to avoid being trapped due to Lucien still casting the skull spell at the player.
You will only be able to damage the two ice demons that run at you; your teammates must kill the rest.
You are able to use Split Soul on the two that your teammates are meant to kill to speed up the process.

steps.text: Attack the armoured zombies until Arrav is summoned.
Attack Arrav until he follows you. You may have to attack the zombies before Arrav will follow you.
Lure him over to where his heart is placed and wait for Arrav to fight Zemouregal before proceeding.

substeps.text: If you have a combat follower out, it is best to dismiss it when Arrav starts following you. Otherwise, it is possible that the combat familiar and Arrav will fight. If this occurs when Arrav gets his heart back, the familiar's attack may distract Arrav from attacking Zemouregal. Instead, Arrav will stand near the rockpile where his heart was hidden and will not move. This is a glitch, and the only way to overcome it is to leave the battle, return, and fight the fourth battle again from its start.

steps.text: Head to where the southern beacon was.
Turn on a prayer against ranged or magic attacks and pick up the beacon pieces.
Click on a piece to assemble all of them and then place the beacon back into the tree.
Watch the cutscenes and pick a number for the new hiding spot for the Stone of Jas.
Go to the stalls area of the town (north-west of where the bank would be in Draynor Village) in the destroyed version of Draynor Village.
Watch the last cutscene.
Talk to Sir Tiffy. (1)
Quest complete!

items: Three 80,000 Skill experience lamps (only available for skills level 72 and higher).
Access to a new Barrows brother, Akrisae the Doomed, and his equipment.
Access to a banite ore mining site, the spell Tune Bane, and the ability to fletch bane arrows and bane bolts.
Access to the Glacor Cave and the DKQ fairy ring. After entering the cave, the Stone of Jas will give the player a 3-6% damage bonus in the surrounding area.
Glacors will now drop Shards of Armadyl, which can be used to craft Armadyl runes and the Armadyl battlestaff. Ability to create Armadyl runes and the Armadyl battlestaff.
Returning to the ritual site and speaking to Arrav near the location of the northern beacon will grant the player 3,000 Prayer experience.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: A large prismatic lamp (related to the earlier Fate of the Gods quest) by talking to Wahisietel (Ali the Wise) in the northern most building in Nardah and choosing the third chat option "Zaros's return".

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Records Chamber (in the Temple Knights' archives, can also be unlocked during the King of the Dwarves quest)
Kethsi (upon entering the plane of Kethsi, can be unlocked before even starting the quest or during Curse of the Black Stone)
Strength of Saradomin (if not already unlocked, when Saradomin heals Zilyana)
Return of Lucien (when Lucien summons the ice titans)

River of Blood.name: River of Blood
items_required: Guthix balance potion or flask (any dose)
Any weapon that can harm Vampyres (e.g. Blisterwood weaponry)
Blisterwood polearm (Craft another one if you want to use the polearm for combat. This one will be given to an NPC)

sections.heading: Preparations for Aeonisig
sections.needed: 3 steel med helms, 3 steel platebodies, 3 steel platelegs, 2 blisterwood sickles, blisterwood polearm, food, any combat gear of your choice with a blisterwood weapon for killing the vyrewatches

steps.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace. (1•✓)
Talk to Drezel in the Paterdomus mausoleum west of Canifis (fairy ring CKS, invitation box or Skeletal horror Teleport for quick access). (2•~)

substeps.text: Reclaim the wolfbane dagger if you had previously destroyed it.

steps.text: Talk to Aeonisig south of the temple. You can use the invitation box to get there. Otherwise, exit the building on the west side and head towards the beacon (or exit east side and use agility shortcut). He is at the bottom of the stairs.
Defeat the 3 Vyrewatches using blisterwood weapons.
Talk to Aeonisig. (~•4)
Talk to Captain Rovin (one of the three guards slightly north east) to supply him with armour.
Kill all Zamorak monks in the temple - you can use any combat style/gear here.
Kill the Zamorakian leader and bodyguard on the top floor - you can use any combat style/gear here.
Return and talk to Aeonisig. Go through all the chat options. (~)

sections.heading: Finding the scroll
sections.needed: blisterwood logs, super restore (3), Guthix balance, Ectophial, 4 empty inventory spaces

steps.text: Talk to Drezel. (2)
Climb-down the nearby trapdoor.

substeps.text: If the trapdoor isn't open, use the temple library key (obtainable from Drezel) on the keyhole.

steps.text: Pull 7 books off the bookcases in the correct order until you find the Blood of the Covenant:

substeps.text: Lumbridge
Varrock
Edgeville
Falador
Rimmington
Taverley
Draynor
"Blood of the Covenant"

steps.text: Read the book.
Climb-up the ladder.
Talk to Ivan Strom.
Enter the trapdoor behind Canifis pub, search the southern wall in the room and take the first cave entrance on the east side of the tunnel.

substeps.text: If players are taken to Mort'ton they need to go to the Temple Trekking noticeboard next to the temple west of Canifis, click on the medium NPC and on the right hand side, they'll see the NPC with level 99, which is rewarded with the ability to toggle a shortcut from the trapdoor. After toggling it the door will function as normal or the boat can be taken back to the swamp and run to the cellar doors from here to access the tomb without toggling the function.

steps.text: Use a Guthix balance on the tomb and open it. (1)
Open the scroll case and read the Scroll of Balance.
Burn a Blisterwood log and take the ashes. They spawn immediately upon lighting the fire.
Grind the silvthril bar at the ectofuntus grinder. (1)
Use the silvthril dust on the Altar of Nature in the Nature Grotto.
Use any of the three ingredients on a super restore (3) to make a super Guthix balance potion. Keep the Ivandis's serum in your inventory for later use. (3)

sections.heading: Clash of armies
sections.needed: Super Guthix balance, blisterwood weapon, food, and combat supplies for battle with a Level 117 Wyrd

steps.text: Talk to Drezel. (2)
Pour the Super Guthix balance into the well in the main room to the west.
Talk to Aeonisig south of the church. (3•2•~•1•3)
Talk to Vanescula on the bridge. (~•~)

substeps.text: Use the the broken Saradomin statue shortcut to the east if you have 65 Agility or teleport to the fairy ring CKS.

steps.text: Kill the feral vampyres.
Kill the Wyrd while stepping away from its special attacks.

substeps.text: The Sonic Wave attack deals 7,500 damage when praying melee. Otherwise, it will deal 15,000 damage. This can be avoided by stepping at least two squares back. It is also important to note that if you step off the bridge at any time you will have to redo the fight.

steps.text: Talk to Ivan Strom on the bridge over the salve river.

sections.heading: Combatting haemalchemy
sections.needed: Sunspear, wolfbane dagger, blisterwood logs, Ivandis's serum, food/armour and 1 free backpack space. optionally vampyre disguise

steps.text: Travel to Burgh de Rott via Drakan's medallion. (2)
Travel on the boat south of Burgh de Rott to the Icyene graveyard. (2)
Talk to Efaritay.
Inspect the Queen Efaritay statue within the northern crypt, and take the pendant.
Talk to Efaritay.
Craft a Blisterwood shaft from blisterwood logs.
Use the shaft on the sunspear with the wolfbane dagger and blisterwood shaft in your inventory.
Talk to Efaritay.
Teleport to the Meiyerditch Laboratories via Drakan's medallion. (5)
Talk to Sarius.
Run through the tunnel to the room with the mutated bloodveld.
Take the book from the research table on the north side and read it.
Talk to Sarius.
Climb the stairs and run north-west into the mine.
With your vampyre disguise on, talk to a guard about the refinery. (if you don't have your disguise on you must manually fill the cart up with 15 ores yourself)
Talk to one of the Juvinate guards. (1)
Push the cart.
Kill the juvinates.
Open the 5 cell doors.
Run north and talk to Emilia. (5)
Talk to Sorin. (4)
Talk to Ileana. (3)
Talk to Razvan. (2)
Talk to Florin. (1)
Tithe the Shadum blood lock located on the south western part of the wall. (6)
Extract the refined daeyalt from the refined daeyalt mine.
Inspect the rejuvenation tank.
Climb the stairs and talk to Safalaan.
Kill the Skeleton Hellhounds.
Climb the stairs.
On the northern end of the room, go into the eastern door into a long, narrow hallway.
Go into the Library through a door on the southern wall of the hallway.
Take the bottle of holy water from the table (red dot on the map).
Continue east through the narrow hallway.
Throw the bottle of holy water on Harold and climb the stairs.
Cut a log from the blisterwood tree.
Light the firepit in front of the Stone of Jas. It is a small black ring immediately in front of the stone, easy to miss.
Roll the barrel of gunpowder.
Unlock the blood seal in the northern room.
Climb the stairs.

sections.heading: Wyrd's woe
sections.needed: Ivandis's serum, Refined daeyalt
sections.recommended: Combat equipment and food

steps.text: Defeat Safalaan with the Sunspear.
Talk to Efaritay.
Use the daeyalt and Ivandis' serum on Safalaan's blood.
Talk to Efaritay.
Pour the extreme Guthix balance potion into the Paterdomus well.
Talk to Vanescula on the bridge.
Watch the cutscene and then talk to Vanescula once more.
Talk to King Roald. (1)
Quest complete!

items: Tome of XP 5th ed, which contains three chapters worth 75,000 experience each, redeemable on a skill equal to or higher than level 75
A Sunspear (melee), which can be changed into a Sunspear (magic) and Sunspear (ranged), along with a cosmetic override of each accessible via the Customisation interface.
Ability to make blood essences by talking to Vanescula Drakan on the roof of Castle Drakan.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: One blood essence of your choice by talking to Vanescula Drakan after learning the ability to craft blood essences.
A bloodstone by talking to Vanescula Drakan on the roof of Castle Drakan.

Rocking Out.name: Rocking Out
items_required: You can buy pirate clothing from Dodgy Mike in Mos Le'Harmless, east of the bank
Book o' piracy (can be obtained during quest)

The following items are required, but will need to be retrieved from your bank once you escape prison as you will be forced to deposit all of your worn/inventory items before the Customs Sergeant will send you to jail:
Ghostspeak amulet (or cramulet) (unless you have completed the Hard Morytania achievements)
20 coins (or more, depending on how you travel to Port Phasmatys)

steps.text: Travel to Mos Le'Harmless (fairy ring DIP if you have repaired the bridge with 8 planks and 16 nails and partial completion of A Fairy Tale III).
Talk to Bill Teach in The Other Inn. (1•✓)

substeps.text: If you have lost your Little Book o' Piracy, talk to him to get a new one.

steps.text: Buy three pieces of pirate clothing from Dodgy Mike's Second-hand Clothing.

sections.heading: Getting arrested
sections.needed: 3 pieces of pirate clothing

steps.text: Go to house in south-east Rimmington with the Customs Sergeant while wearing three pieces of pirate clothing.
Read the noticeboard next to the entrance door for information on the answers to the trick questions. The answers to the trick questions are different for everyone.
Talk to the Customs Sergeant

substeps.text: Taking note of the ship name/s he references, select the answers that match the story on noticeboard.

steps.text: Deposit all your items in the Locker on the north side of the room. You need to store all the items you are wearing as well as dismiss any familiars.
Talk to the Customs Sergeant again.
Once in the prison, shout-through the barred window to your east.
Pick up the tin cup in the cell and use it on the cell door 3 times until Heavy-Handed Harry throws stew on you, turning your prison uniform top into a fishy prison uniform top.
Right-click tap the pipes on the eastern wall to receive a pipe.
Shout-through your cell door until you receive a quill, paper, and ink bottle.
Leave your cell through the hole to the north and search the rubble to receive an accordion (broken).
Use the ink bottle on the paper to receive inky paper and ink bottle (empty).
Use the ink bottle (empty) on the sharp rock outside on the east-most wall near the pier to get a smashed bottle.
In order, use the smashed bottle, pipe, and inky paper on the accordion to get a vacuum pump.
Use your fishy prison uniform top on the perch rock just east of the hole in the wall.
Right-click use the vacuum pump on the perch rock once the seagull appears.
Right-click use the vacuum pump and gull on the barred window.
Dive off the pier on the east side of the island. (1)

sections.heading: Captains' marks
sections.needed: Two bronze wires, pirate clothing, charcoal (can be obtained during quest), diving apparatus, fishbowl helmet, ghostspeak amulet, at least 20 coins, and 5 empty inventory spaces
sections.recommended: Ectophial (for fast travel to Port Phasmatys), Arc journal (for fast travel to Port Sarim), and weight-reducing clothing
notes: To obtain the marks of the five captains, you must visit each of them (in any order you like) and convince them to give you the mark.

steps.text: Travel to Braindeath Island by speaking to Pirate Pete north of Port Phasmatys. (1)
Go west and speak to Captain Braindeath. He will give you the fake beard, fake moustache and nose, fake monocle, moustache and nose, curly wig, and straight wig disguises. (1)
Travel to the bar in north Port Sarim called The Rusty Anchor.
Talk to the Bartender. (2)
Talk to the Bartender again. (3)

substeps.text: Repeat this about five times until he says he's tired.

steps.text: Go outside, put on a disguise, and then ask about the rum again. Repeat this step with each disguise. (2)
Talk to the bartender again, this time with no disguise, and he will give you an order slip. (2)
Speak to Redbeard Frank outside of The Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim. (3)
Travel to Mos Le'Harmless via the charter boat, fairy ring DIP if you have repaired the bridge, or Bill Teach, and talk to Brother Tranquillity to receive a letter. (3)
Return to Redbeard Frank on the Port Sarim dock and deliver the letter. (3)
Put on your pirate clothing and head back to Braindeath Island.
Talk to Captain Braindeath for his mark. (1)
Go down the southern stairs, and talk to Captain Donnie to get plans.
Head north-west to 50% Luke by the bridge and use charcoal on him.

substeps.text: There is charcoal in a crate on the other side of the gate near 50% Luke.

steps.text: Return to Redbeard Frank on the Port Sarim docks and exchange the Charcoal rubbing for Frank's mark. (3)
Optional: Talk to the bartender and ask about 'rum' once more to complete the Rusty Reward achievement required for the master quest cape. (2)

sections.heading: Bill Teach and Captain Brass Hand Harry

steps.text: Travel to Mos Le'Harmless.
Talk to Bill Teach in The Other Inn to obtain an introduction letter. (1)
Climb-up the bamboo ladder in Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum' just north and speak with 50 Ships Mufassah. (1)
Talk to Brass Hand Harry for 5 broken hands.
Take-apart the five broken hands.
With the two bronze wires in your inventory, use any piece of the hand on another to trigger a puzzle.
Complete the puzzle to obtain a brass hand (the interface will close automatically when the puzzle has been completed).

substeps.text: Try flipping the brace (bottom) piece if you're having trouble completing the puzzle.
The location of the hand is as important as the components; make sure you're constructing the hand atop the silhouette.

steps.text: Talk to Brass Hand Harry (nearby) to receive an ink pad. Use the ink pad on the brass hand to get a inky hand. Then use the inky hand on the paper.
Talk to Brass Hand Harry again to show him the completed Brass Hand Harry's mark.

substeps.text: If you haven't done so yet, feel free to destroy the ink pad and hand.
notes: For the following part, you must weigh under 28 kg.

steps.text: Equip your ghostspeak amulet, diving apparatus, and fishbowl helmet.
Travel to Dragontooth Island by talking to the Ghost captain at the small boat in Port Phasmatys (he is at the south-eastern end of the docks). (1)
Travel to the north-east part of Dragontooth Island and dive via the chain.

substeps.text: You will need both hands free to dive.

steps.text: Swim around until you find a Karamthulhu and catch it. (It is the only fish that appears on the mini map.)
Head over to the ship and climb-up the stairs.
Open and search the chest to get a crowbar.

substeps.text: An aggressive giant lobster may attack you. You can open and search the chest while being attacked.

steps.text: Return down the stairs and climb down the ladder.
Go west on the bottom floor of the ship and dig the mess a several times to uncover the idol of many heads buried in the pile of planks and sand. Pick it up.

substeps.text: You can wield weapons while down there digging, so you can kill any aggressive giant crabs or lobsters that may be hindering you from digging successfully.

steps.text: Bring the idol back to Bill Teach to receive Bill Teach's mark. (1)
Travel to Brimhaven and go to the Brimhaven Agility Arena entrance, located south-east of the docks.
Speak to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard. (1)
Return to the Rimmington Customs Office. Deposit all of your items in the locker and get arrested by talking to the Customs Sergeant.
Search the bed for a crude lockpick and use it on your cell door.
Kill one of the customs officers, loot the uniform and equip it to disguise yourself.

substeps.text: You can withdraw your pickaxe from your tool belt to use as a weapon.
Make sure you do not have lootshare enabled, as this can prevent the uniform from being dropped. If you do not get the loot, try relogging.

steps.text: Climb the stairs twice to the top floor.
Open the door to the room with the cabinets.
Search the northern-most cabinet on the second column from the west for "Wanda the Fish". (1)
Talk to the Locker Officer and receive the brooch.
Return to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard in Brimhaven to receive Izzy's mark. (1)

sections.heading: Back to prison and quest completion
sections.needed: Izzy's mark, Bill Teach's mark, Frank's mark, Braindeath's mark, and Brass Hand Harry's mark

steps.text: Talk to the Customs Sergeant in Rimmington with the five marks. He will give you a file.
Use one of the marks on the file.
Talk to the Customs Sergeant to give him the filled file.
Talk to him again to get sent back to prison.
Search the bed for the crude lockpick and break out of your cell. Kill the Customs Officer(s) for another uniform, equip it, then head to the top floor.

substeps.text: You may get a message saying that the lock is rusty, and the lockpick does not work. Continue trying until it works.

steps.text: Go to the top floor and talk to the Locker Officer to get back the filled file.
Return to your cell and right-click open the door.

substeps.text: If you do not have the option to open the cell door, hop to a different world.

steps.text: Shout-through the barred window to Young Ralph. A cutscene will follow.
Quest complete!

items: Free access to the Brimhaven Agility Arena
Access to the Rock Island Prison, where players can steal from customs evidence files
Access to a bank deposit box in Rimmington
The ability to buy Braindeath 'rum' from The Rusty Anchor Inn
The ability to understand pirates on Mos Le'Harmless without the book o' piracy
The ability to catch pirate implings (with 76 )
The ability to raise an ex-ex-parrot by speaking to Bill Teach and 50 Ships Mufassah (with 71 )

Rune Mechanics.name: Rune Mechanics
items_required: 5 steam runes (you must craft one during the quest; the rest can be bought)
1 fire rune or water rune (needed to craft the steam rune; 5 if crafting all 5 steam runes during the quest)
Item to access fire altar if bringing water rune, or water altar if bringing fire rune (a fire talisman and water talisman are given to you in the quest)
Progress hat (and 5 or more pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena)

steps.text: Talk to Apprentice Clerval in the basement of the Mage Training Arena. (✓)

sections.heading: Wizard Dougal
sections.needed: 5 steam runes, 5 mind runes, 5 body runes, 5 water rune (if at fire altar) or 5 fire rune (if at water altar), 5 pure essence

steps.text: Talk to Wizard Dougal who is also in the basement. (1)

substeps.text: You need four free spaces in your inventory for Dougal to give you items. If he doesn't give you the items, he will not accept the steam runes.

steps.text: Wear the binding necklace that Dougal gave you.
Craft at least one steam rune. The remaining runes (4 steam runes, 5 mind runes, 5 body runes) can be obtained or bought ahead of time.

substeps.text: Steam runes can be crafted by using fire runes on the water altar (consuming a fire talisman).
Alternatively, use water runes on the fire altar (consuming a water talisman).

steps.text: Talk to Wizard Dougal.
Give the runes to Clerval.
Talk to Wizard Edvin who is also in the basement. (You will need to dismiss any pets currently active) (1)
Solve the portal maze.

substeps.text: From the start, go through the west portal, then go to the northern portal 3 times.

steps.text: Exit the maze.
Take Edvin's tool to Clerval.

sections.heading: Wizard Shug
sections.needed: 2 emeralds, 20 pure essence

steps.text: Obtain five pizazz points from Mage Training Arena minigame, if you don't already have five. Enchantment Pizazz points are easy to obtain by casting any level jewellery enchantment spell (Lvl-1 Enchant, Lvl-2 Enchant, Lvl-3 Enchant, Lvl-4 Enchant, Lvl-5 Enchant, Lvl-6 Enchant) on a dragonstone lying on the arena floor. (Requires at least level 7 Magic.)
Talk to Wizard Shug on the top floor of the arena. (2•2)
Enchant the emeralds using the workbench by Clerval.
Talk to Clerval, holding 20 pure essence. (2)
Fix the animation table nearby.
When finished, click the green check button. (1)
Use the carving tool on the lump of rune essence.
Talk to Clerval.
Quest complete!

items: Binding necklace, obtained during the quest with 14 charges left

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: These Stones (When entering Mage Training Arena basement)

steps.text: Talk to Kennith along the east coast of Daemonheim near the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef). (1•✓)
Go west, and talk to him again.
Talk to Ezekial (~)
Enter the opening formed in the mountain nearby.

sections.heading: Daemonheim Dungeon
sections.needed: 1 free inventory space
sections.recommended: food and protection prayers for low levels

steps.text: Head east two rooms
Kill the three enemies in this room
Find the blue key on the floor
Return to the first room and unlock and enter the puzzle room door
Choose a hero (preferably the one with the most health).
One way to solve the puzzle is:

substeps.text: Jump south across the first gap
Jump west twice
Jump south
Jump north, back to the same spot
Jump east three times
Jump south twice and the puzzle is completed.

steps.text: Inspect the Seeker of Truth and return across the gap. (Quickest method is to get caught and teleported back).
Kennith will then teleport you to the Fishing Platform. (1)

sections.heading: Fishing Platform
sections.needed: 3 free inventory spaces

steps.text: Once on the platform talk to Kennith.
Talk with Bailey. (3•2•2)
Head east to the fishing spots.
Lure the fishing spot and go back to Kennith, the slug will follow you.
Talk to Kennith and he will give you a Seeker gland.
Combine the ingredients to make the anti-mind control serum.
Talk to Kennith, a little to the west. (1)
Talk to the Slug thralls. (2•2•3•3)

sections.heading: Slug Citadel
notes: Controlling your characters: Your party members will follow you automatically. If they are attacked, they will fight to the end unless you move them. To make a party member stay, go to a specific point, or perform an action, simply click on the character and click where you want them to go or on what you want them to interact with.
For more information on controlling your party members, click here.
If a party member dies, you will have to restart the room you are currently on.

steps.text: Leave one character by the Witchaven villager just north of the entrance and move the other 2 to the metal gate to the north-east and kill the Risen knight.
Use the character you left behind to knock out the Witchaven villager and proceed south with your player.
Go into the room with the lever and pull it.
The metal door to the north will now be open. Send a character through.
Pull your player's lever again.
Use the character you left near the entrance to knock out the other villager again, allowing your player to run north to the other characters you left by the gate.

Bring the character you left at the entrance to join your player. Use the character in the room to pull the lever to let you all in. Pull the lever again and run south, east, and then north to the exit while killing any risen knights in your path.
Send everyone to the north as far as they can go while avoiding the villager.
Pull the lever and send Kennith and your player into the room to the east. Send Ezekial to the western room and leave Eva in the central chamber.
Leave Kennith in the eastern room and send your player south to pull the lever.
After the lever is pulled send Kennith into the easternmost room to pull the lever.
Have your player pull the southern lever again.
Send Ezekial west (if not already in the western room) then all the way south to pull the lever.
Make Kennith pull the lever again and then send him into the southernmost room on his side to pull the lever.
Send your player back to the central chamber with Eva.
Make Ezekial pull his lever again and then send Kennith back to the central chamber.
Make Ezekial pull the lever once more and send him back to the central chamber.
Now that your party is regrouped, go to the next room.
Kill all of the Risen Knights.
Send a character to each of the rooms in the four corners.
Pull all four levers in the following order: northeast, southeast, southwest, & then northwest.
Run to the newly opened gates and 'regroup' all of the characters. Proceed to the next room.

sections.heading: Fourth Room
notes: Be careful not to kill the two knights that spawn side-by-side at the same time, or a bug will occur that forces you to re-enter the dungeon. For more information on this room click here.

steps.text: Use your player to investigate the strange device. Put your arm in. (1)
Kill the first wave of knights with Kennith, Ezekial, and Eva. Your player will then investigate the second hole.
Kill the second wave of knights. Your player will investigate the third hole.
Kill the third wave of knights.
Enter the tunnel to the north.
Use Kennith to speak to Brother Maledict to the west.
Once the gate is open, knock down the wall in the west room with Ezekial and move Kennith north. Place him as close as possible to Mother Mallum while standing on the western ledge.
Take control of Ezekial and knock down the wall to the east and proceed north.
Kill or run past the knight and position Ezekial directly opposite Kennith.
Take control of Kennith and attack Mother Mallum.
You now have control of Eva. Talk to Mayor Hobbs and knock him out, then attack Mallum.
Move Eva north of the statue and topple it.
Talk to Lucy. (~)
Leave the Citadel using the cave exit.
Quest complete!

items: 100 more bound ammunition/runes in Daemonheim (raising the total to 225)

steps.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library. (1•✓)
Search the east side of the centre bookcases (with the navy blue book) for The Shield of Arrav book, then read it.
Talk to Reldo and ask about the Phoenix Gang. (1)
Talk to Baraek who is located in the north-east of Varrock square, and give him 10 coins. Ask him every question available. (1•1•2)
Travel to the Phoenix Gang Hideout which is located south of Aubury's Rune Shop. It will be marked by a dungeon link to the Misthalin Underground on the map.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to Straven and ask to join. Tell him you know who he is. (1•1)
Go to the Blue Moon Inn which is just north of Varrock's southern entrance.
Kill Jonny the beard.
Grab the Intel report that he drops.
Return to the hideout and talk to Straven.
Search the chest in the south-west corner of the hideout for a broken shield.
After climbing back up the ladder, enter the house east of the Phoenix Gang Hideout and go up the ladder there.
Pick up the two Phoenix crossbows on the floor, you will need these for the next gang.
Talk to Charlie the Tramp located just north of Varrock's southern entrance. Ask him what's down the alley. (3•1)
Follow the alley to the west and enter the building.
Talk to Katrine. (1•~•1•1•1)
Talk to Katrine again to give her the crossbows.
Head north through the door and climb up the staircase.
Open and search the cupboard on the south-eastern wall for the other broken shield piece.
Use one half of the shield on the other for a restored shield.
Talk to King Roald located in the immediate east room of the Varrock Palace. (1)

substeps.text: If you have completed Priest in Peril (2)

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: If you are a member, you can talk to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum to receive 5 kudos and an antique lamp that gives 1,000 experience in a skill of level 20 or above.

Sliske's Endgame.name: Sliske's Endgame
items_required: A disguise with which to enter the Black Knights' Fortress
Alternatively, the Dulcin armour cosmetic override or the teleport option on the Skull of Remembrance can be used
Alternatively, the Communication device from Dishonour among Thieves may be used to teleport to Zamorak

sections.heading: Gathering the party
sections.recommended: an Armadylean token or skills necklace to the Crafting Guild for quick access to Armadyl's Tower, mind altar teleport for quick access to the Black Knight's Fortress

steps.text: Talk to Relomia in Draynor Village. (1•1•✓)
Talk to each of the gods.

substeps.text: Talk to Seren and Zaros up in the Tower of Voices by using the stairs north-east of the Prifddinas lodestone. (1)
Talk to Saradomin in the throne room on the east side of the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of White Knights' Castle.
He may not speak to you if you have the [Name] of Zamorak title active. Lobbying may be necessary if he only insults you.
Talk to Armadyl on the roof of his tower north-west of Port Sarim.
Go up the tower by the teleporter.
Climb up the stairs on the west side to the roof.
Talk to Zamorak on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Black Knights' Fortress or at Zamorak's hideout.
You may get there by using the mind altar teleport to mind altar, a communication device, or a Skull of Remembrance.
Talk to Icthlarin in Death's office by entering through portal in the north of Draynor Village. (2)
You cannot go from War's Retreat directly.

notes: There is a teleblock in place; however, you can leave the arena by using the portal's right-click option. You can have a familiar for the fight.

steps.text: Return to Relomia using The Heart teleports and resume the battle against Sliske
The fight is divided into 3 phases, at the end of each phase you can bank and return to resume from that checkpoint
Fight against wights of increasing difficulty, kill enough of them to increase the progress bar on top.

substeps.text: Use Deflect Melee or Deflect Ranged depending on the types of wights you are fighting

sections.heading: Phase 2
notes: This part of the fight can be extremely difficult. It is highly recommended to stand between the middle and western rifts at all times, beginning while Sliske is talking. This prevents Linza from attacking throughout the fight.

steps.text: Kill Nomad.

steps.text: Kill Linza the Disgraced.

substeps.text: Use Deflect Melee while fighting her.
Linza reflects damage which is less deadly after she's the only surviving boss.

She also has a blue charged bar that appears above her head and does a very high damage move. She will also bind before she does this move so have surge or freedom ready. It is recommended to dodge this attack.

steps.text: Kill Gregorovic.

substeps.text: Use Deflect Ranged while fighting him.
The spirits that spawn towards Gregorovic will heal him if they reach him. Kill them before they touch him.

steps.text: Kill Sliske. You cannot use deathtouched darts to kill Sliske.

substeps.text: Use Deflect Magic throughout the fight as the majority of the damage will be magic classed. Keep in mind that prayer points are drained faster than normal in this fight.
If you are having trouble, wearing the Armour of Trials and wielding Vanquish can help greatly has it can provide a 25% defensive and offensive bonus during the fight if you die 5 times in a row.

Beware of his special attack where several shadow pits will appear below your feet. Step away to avoid significant damage. He will summon 4 shadow pits in the first round, 5 in the second, and 4 in the subsequent two rounds. On rounds 3 and 4, Sliske's attacks will predict where you are walking towards on the 4th and final shadow pit.
Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health, he will teleport away.
Destroy the Power Source in the centre of the room.
Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.
Enter one of the rifts. Sliske will bring you back into the arena.
Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.
Jump on the rock formation in front of Sliske.
Attack Sliske until he reaches 10,000 health again.
Defeat Sliske one final time. You have unlimited life points and adrenaline and all ability cooldowns are halved. (If you have Onslaught Ability you can kill him automatically)

substeps.text: The heaviest weight will always be random.
Drag two sets of three weights onto both sides of the scale and click the central green gem to weigh.

If one of the sides is heavier, you know the heaviest weight is part of the 3 weights that went down. Put one of those weights on the left side and one weight on the right side of the scale, the last one in the bottom row and click the green gem again. If either side went down you know the heaviest weight. If they are equal you know it's the one you put back in the bottom row.

If both sides were of equal weight, you know the remaining 3 weights in the bottom row are the heaviest. Put one of those weights on the left side and one weight on the right side of the scale, the last one in the bottom row and click the green gem again. If either side went down you know the heaviest weight. If they are equal you know it's the one you put back in the bottom row.

sections.heading: The battle with Vanstrom
sections.needed: Equip full Darkmeyer disguise, Vertida's bottle of holy water, and a blisterwood weapon of choice

notes: How to kill Vanstrom:

steps.text: Only blisterwood weaponry can deal damage.
If you're attacking at a distance use Deflect/Protect from Magic; otherwise, Deflect/Protect from Melee.
If he shouts "Stare into the darkness!" run to the edge of the arena and rotate your camera away from him. Maximum 4000 damage.
If he shouts "Let the blood consume you!" run away from the blood splodge on the floor. Maximum 6000 damage.
If he shouts "Come, fiends, and aid your master!" kill the two easy minions that he spawns.
If he throws blood bombs towards you, keep running around the room to avoid them. Maximum 4000 damage per bomb.
Once he is very low health he turns into a cloud. Keep using holy water near him until he loses all health. Unequip your ring of life if you're wearing one.

substeps.text: If you are saved by a ring of life after a group of bloodveld guardians spawn, heal up and return without a ring of life. You will be damaged, but in a safe way. You will not have to redo the fight.

steps.text: Use Deflect/Protect from Magic for this last part as Vanstom can do rapid magic damage to you whilst he is dying.

Kill the 2 Tz-Kek.
Kill the Tz-Kih and Tok-Xil

Move the statues such that TzHaar-Mej faces TzHaar-Ket, who faces TzHaar-Xil, who faces TzHaar-Mej. This involves a triangle formed by Xil and Mej (parallel) to the south and Ket to the north. If it doesn't work, make the triangle smaller.
Go through the ancient gate.
Turn off Auto-retaliate so your character does not inadvertently step on a glowing square when running to attack a monster (they deal 1000+ damage per second).
Pass the hot vent door to the east.
Avoid standing on glowing floor squares.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Kets and 2 TokHaar-Hurs.
Kill the 3 TokHaar-Xils.
Kill the TokHaar-Ket Champion and pick up the obsidian maul it drops.
Pass back through the hot vent door.
Place the maul on the scales.
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 4 Tz-Kils.
Pick up each of the obsidian weapons: throwing ring, sword, mace and staff.
Place each of the obsidian weapons on the scales according to their location:
Go through the Ancient gate.
Kill the 3 Tz-Kihs.
Kill the 2 Tz-Kils and Yt-MejKot.
Touch one of the pedestals.
Touch the pedestals in the order that they light up until the puzzle is complete. There are 8 combinations you will need to complete correctly.

substeps.text: Recommended to give each pedestal a number between 1-4. Write the number of the last pedestal that lights up each round in your chatbox, forming a list. When touching pedestals, simply follow the numbers in your chatbox.

steps.text: Go through the Ancient gate.
Turn off Auto-retaliate so your character does not inadvertently step on a glowing square when running to attack a monster (they deal 1000+ damage per second).
Pass the hot vent door to the east.
Avoid standing on glowing floor squares.
Kill the 4 TokHaar-Hurs.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Xils.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Mejs.
Kill the 2 TokHaar-Ket Champions and pick up the obsidian maul dropped.
Pass back through the Hot vent door.
Place the maul on the scales.
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 3 Tz-Keks.
Pick up the sword, maul, mace, knife and staff.
Inspect each scale for the TzHaar word. Use the correct obsidian weapon on each scale according to the table below:
Go through the ancient gate.
Kill the 3 Tz-Kils.
Kill the Ket-Zek and 2 Tz-Keks.
Rotate the tiles on the ground to form the TzHaar symbol.
Go through the Ancient gate.

sections.heading: Room 9
sections.recommended: In Legacy Mode, bring a weapon with more than one special attack (dragon dagger recommended)

steps.text: Pass the hot vent door to the east.
Talk to Ga'al-Xox. (~)
Rotate the eastern valve.
Kill TokHaar-Hok.

substeps.text: You cannot teleport out or leave the fight early.
Pray Deflect/Protection from Melee the entire fight.
Avoid standing on glowing floor squares, as always.
You do not need to kill the spawned enemies - higher level players may focus on TokHaar-Hok. When he is defeated, the spawned enemies will die.
Stun TokHaar-Hok once he has lost half his health, this prevents him from healing at the flowing lava.

The stun mechanic may be bugged and you may only be able to use basic Ranged ability, Binding Shot, the basic Magic ability, Impact and the Magic threshold ability, Asphyxiate, and the basic melee ability, Backhand.
In Legacy Mode, you need to stun him with a special attack.

steps.text: Talk to TokHaar-Hok.
Talk to Ga'al-Xox. (~)
Talk to Ga'al-Xox again. (5)
Return to the city through the door. Activate your communication orb.

substeps.text: If you have destroyed your communication orb, talk to either TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza of TzHaar City.

steps.text: Go back to the Fight Kiln entrance. (1)
A cutscene ensues. (1•~)
Quest complete!

items: 275,000 Combat experience lamp in a choice of Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic or Necromancy (skill must be level 80 or higher)
Ability to smith obsidian armour and donate 15,000 Tokkul to a coffer at the Fight Cauldron to temporarily buff the armour
Access to the Fight Cauldron and an added teleport to the TokKul-Zo
Ability to find a wandering Ga'al

The Curse of Arrav.name: The Curse of Arrav
items_required: Crossbow and mithril grapple (with rope) or enhanced grappling hook on toolbelt
Familiar with remote view ability such as a macaw (level 41) or a ravenous locust (level 70)
Combat equipment to survive against a level 91 monster

sections.heading: Getting to the tunnels
sections.needed: Trollheim Teleport or Trollheim tablet or God Wars Dungeon Teleport (or climbing boots if you cannot use the teleports), food and equipment for a level 91 monster, several Mining boosts (if required), 7 backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to Ali the Wise in Nardah (north-most building). (✓•3•3)

substeps.text: To get there: teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run south.
Or teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay Pass, then take a magic carpet to Nardah.

steps.text: Head to the snowy area northwest of Trollheim, enter the troll tunnels and head north to go through the tunnels, and then head to the east to Ritual plateau tunnels.

substeps.text: Follow the directions on the map below to get to the Ritual plateau tunnels, or use Trollheim Teleport if you have it. If you travel through Death Plateau or Troll Stronghold, you must bring the climbing boots.
Prepare for combat before going through Trollheim as you don't have any access to bank in there.

sections.heading: The tunnels
sections.needed: 7 backpack spaces and equipment to fight Arrav

steps.text: Navigate through the caves by mining the rubble; some rubble must be mined from multiple sides to clear it.

substeps.text: Optional: pick up the stone, granite, slate, and shale tablets.
Optional: Search the small bookcase for notes (a-j) if you want to give all information to Ali the Wise after the quest is completed. There is no reward for doing so.

steps.text: Enter the room east of the caves.
Climb the stairs.
Talk to Arrav, who will attack you immediately.

substeps.text: After he starts attacking you, if you do not auto-retaliate, right-click and attack him.

steps.text: Fight until he teleports away. The fight will pause multiple times for dialogue.
Enter the room to the south and search the tapestry on the west wall for base key and base plans.
Travel back to Nardah and speak to Ali the Wise.
After the cutscene, speak with Ali the Wise again.

sections.heading: Preparing the jar
sections.needed: 3 dwellberries, a ring of life and 1 backpack space

steps.text: Enter the nearby Uzer Mastaba pyramid.

substeps.text: To get there, either run north-east of Ali the Wise, use the nearby magic carpet network to get to Uzer and run south, or teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run east.

steps.text: Enter the pyramid, head north-west through the imposing doors, then south, down the stairs and talk to Senliten for oil in a canopic jar. (1)

substeps.text: Players who have completed certain quests can also choose to head directly to the Pharaoh Queen from the pyramid doors.

steps.text: Use (do not eat) your dwellberries and ring of life on the oil in a canopic jar to obtain a full canopic jar.
Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.

substeps.text: If Leela is in the mummy's tomb, she can return you outside the Uzer Mastaba (3)

sections.heading: Saving Arrav's heart
sections.needed: Insulated boots, either a macaw pouch or a ravenous locust pouch, a method of grappling (either any crossbow and a mithril grapple, or an enhanced grappling hook on your toolbelt), a full canopic jar, the base key, 4 backpack space, and enough summoning points to summon your familiar

steps.text: Go to the Varrock Palace and speak to Hartwin (northwest tower, 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US]) to travel to Chaos Temple Dungeon. (1)
Climb down the trapdoor.
Follow the path, opening three doors along the way.
Head east to the room with the range.
Equip your insulated boots then enter the pipe on the south wall of the room.
Run through the sewers and attempt to enter the next pipe.
Summon your familiar, interact with it and choose the remote view option.
Run to the room south of you, search all the tables for decoder strips and notes (k-z).
Right-click pick-lock on the chest to obtain the code key.
Go north to the room east of the pipe and operate the keypad and solve the keypad puzzle:

substeps.text: First read the code key and memorise or write down the letters.
Drag-and-drop strip #1 over the line indicated by the first letter of the code key (A, B, C...).
The strip has a hole that reveals a specific number, this is the first digit of the passcode.
Use the up and down arrows to enter that number, and press the right arrow to move to the next digit.
Repeat this for the other three strips.

steps.text: Enter the room, equip your crossbow and mithril grapple, then grapple the pipe above you.
Take from the pedestal for a heart in a canopic jar, then teleport out.
Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.
Quest complete!

items: Arrav can be faced in the Dominion Tower

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Heist - After entering the third gate in Zemouregal's base in level 13 Wilderness
Lamistard's Labyrinth - At the entrance to the Trollweiss cave
Romancing the Crone - At Trollweiss Mountain (if not yet unlocked during Troll Romance)

The Darkness of Hallowvale.name: The Darkness of Hallowvale
items_required: 1 law rune and 1 air rune for Telekinetic Grab (obtainable during the quest)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: 2 planks (regular, oak, teak, or mahogany), 8 nails (any type except rune nails)
notes: As you will need Telekinetic Grab further into the quest, it is recommended to have the standard spellbook active.

steps.text: Go to Burgh de Rott, then enter in the inn where you will climb over the broken down wall and climb down trapdoor in the northwest of inn.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub basement. (4•✓•1•2•3•4•5)

substeps.text: Search the chest to the north for garlic if you do not have one.

steps.text: Run directly south of the furnace until you find a boathouse.
Search the boat, then use a plank on it to fix it.
South of the boat, use plank on the boat chute to fix it.
Push the boat down the chute, then go down to the docks and board the boat. If a Vyrewatch stops you at any point, just activate Freedom and walk away.

substeps.text: Keybind may not work, recommended to click the ability on your action bar or in the Defence abilities tab.

steps.text: Exit the boat by jumping onto the nearby rock, and continue north-west a short distance.
Just before the shore, kick down the floor, and climb down it as shown on the image on the right.
Climb the wall rubble to the north and talk to a Meiyerditch citizen. (4•4•4)
North of the wall rubble, talk to Old Man Ral ( Taskmaster icon on the map). (4•4)

substeps.text: (Optional) If you want to reduce detection chance by the Vyrewatch, you can buy a set of Vyrewatch clothing from Trader Sven just south of Old Man Ral before continuing.

sections.heading: Navigating Meiyerditch
notes: If you get snared by a vyre, you can still get away for free by using Freedom. Another option is to challenge them to a fight and then just running away without attacking.
Below are the steps to navigating Meiyerditch from the ladder south-west of Old Man Ral. You can click each step to highlight it to keep track of completed steps.
Changing "Entity Highlight Mode" in Settings->Accessibility->Visual Accessibility->High Contrast Mode to "Proximity" may help during the next steps.

steps.text: Go to the house south-west of Old Man Ral with the door facing north (the western of the two houses with northern doors – it has a sickle next to it on the outside wall). Open the door and enter it.
Climb up the ladder there.
Jump to the floorboards in the south.
Jump to the floorboards in the east.
Go to the north-east corner of the room, push the wall and walk across the floor.
Crawl under the wall to the north.
Go north to the second room, look on the west side, push the wall and walk across the floor.
Climb down the ladder.
Search the table next to the wall, open the trapdoor table, and go through the trapdoor tunnel.
Climb up the shelf next to the sickle logo in the north-west corner of the room.
Crawl under the wall to the east side.
Jump to the floorboards in the east.
Climb down the ladder.
Search the pots near the eastern door to get a key and use it to open the door.
Climb up the ladder in the room to the east, by the sickle.
Jump to the floorboards in the south.
Go east, south, west then climb up the shelf to the south.
Climb up the ladder in the west.
Jump to the floorboards in the south.
Walk a little to the south-west and climb down the ladder once.
Go east through the rooms and walk across the washing line.
Climb down the ladder.
Push the wall to the north and walk across the floor.
Climb up the shelf to the north.
Climb down the shelf in the north-eastern corner.
Jump to the floorboards in the north.
Jump to the floorboards in the north again.
Go to the north end of the house and jump to the floorboards in the east.
Climb up the ladder to the east.
Search the wall to the west to get the ladder top.
Climb down the same ladder, repair the broken ladder going down by using the ladder top from inventory to broken ladder and climb down the ladder.

Open the door to the east and go northwest outside. Go past the house immediately north of the house you just left and into the house with a door on its east side. You should be in a room that has an unlit fireplace, a portrait, and some sort of wall east of it joined to a room that is a perfect diamond.
Go west through the door into the next room, then north out of the house until you see barricades.

Head east at the sickle logo, past the north side of the house with two buckets. Enter the first door to your south; you should be east of the room with two buckets and north of the diamond room from earlier.
Climb up the ladder.
Jump to the floorboards in the east.
Climb down the stairs.
Go south along the eastern side of the stairs. Attempt to push the wall and choose a knife or a sickle to unlock the latch (tool belt knife works), allowing you to push it open.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Open the lumpy rug on the southeast square in the 4-square pattern of the rug. If you take too long, you will have to push the wall again as the mechanism will quickly reset.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.
Run far north and talk to Vertida. (3•4)
Take the message back to Veliaf Hurtz who is in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott. (1•3•4)

substeps.text: Recommended to travel via Fairy ring BKR, and use the boat to Mort'ton, barrows teleport, or the Canifis Pub hideout.

steps.text: Talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum under the Paterdomus temple west of Canifis. Use CKS or the invitation box to teleport nearby. (2•5)

substeps.text: If you have destroyed your Temple library key (1)

steps.text: Take the west exit, past the monuments.
Search the small bush slightly south-west of the western church steps.
Return and talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum. He will give you runes to teleport to Varrock.

substeps.text: Depending on other running quests, you might need to talk to him. (2)

steps.text: Talk to King Roald in the Varrock Palace. (1•4•1)

substeps.text: You will be teleported back to the Paterdomus.

steps.text: Talk to Drezel about what to do next. (2•3)
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz back in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott. (1•2•3•4)
Return to Meiyerditch using the boat in the boathouse south-east and try to get caught by a Vyrewatch. (2)
Mine 15 ore from the walls. (Only requires 1 backpack space as the ores stack)
Use them on a minecart (1)
Run south-east to the house marked on the map (right).
Go south through 3 doors and up the ladder.
Jump the floorboards to the east, descend the stairs and enter the hideout.
Talk to Vertida (3•2)

substeps.text: You will be teleported back to sector 1.

steps.text: Climb down the ladder, open the door, run south and climb over the wall rubble near the shore.
Run south and climb the fallen floorboards back towards the boat and onto the top of the wall.
Run north along the top of the wall and climb down the ladder.
Choose the "search" option on the rocky surface.
Open the barricade to the north; then go north, and climb up the ladder.
Keep running north along the wall, over more ladders. Talk to Safalaan at the very end to receive papyrus and charcoal. (2•1•3)
Run clockwise around the wall until you reach the north wall and see a sickle drawn on the ground.

substeps.text: If playing on high graphics settings, the sickle will be hard to see due to the shadows on the ground. The sickle is located just past where the shadows first appear on the north wall.

steps.text: Use the papyrus on the charcoal and watch the cutscene.
Go anticlockwise around the wall to a sickle on the west wall, and then one on south wall. Use papyrus on charcoal at each of the symbols.

substeps.text: Western wall
Southern wall

steps.text: Watch cutscene. Let Vanstrom attack you a bit which will knock you out.

Talk to and finish the dialogue with Sarius if she didn't automatically talk to you when Vanstrom knocked you out. You must talk with Sarius until she disappears, otherwise Safalaan will say your sketches are not genuine in the next step.
After being knocked out, go back to the south wall and finish your final sketch.
Go south back to the ladder and climb down.
Return to the hideout and talk to Safalaan (1•4•5)

substeps.text: The quickest way to return is to get noticed by the Vyrewatch, get sent to the mine, and then go southeast to the hideout as before. If you are having trouble getting noticed just log out and log back in.

steps.text: Leave the hideout, push the wall, climb the stairs, jump the gap, down the ladder.
Go out the north door, walk slightly west and then south, and open the door to a room with a fireplace. Look at the fireplace.
Choose knife from tool belt option to receive a Message.
Read the message.
Search the portrait on the south wall and slash it with the knife.
Search the portrait again to pick up a large ornate key.
Talk to Safalaan in the base and give him the message. (2)
Leave the hideout, push the wall, climb the stairs, jump the gap, down the ladder.
Run north through three doors.
Head to north-east in Meiyerditch (follow the eastern wall north). There is a bright red and yellow tapestry (with a door on the east side of the room).
Look-at the tapestry and slash it with a knife.
Walk-through the slashed tapestry.
Use the large ornate key on the vampyre statue.
Go east through the door, then down the staircase, and telekinetic grab Haemalchemy (Vol. 1).

substeps.text: Runes can be found by searching the broken rune case directly west of the stairs.

steps.text: Head back to the Meiyerditch Myreque base:

substeps.text: Go up the staircase, out the door, and through the tapestry.
Run south to the previously marked building through three doors.
Go up the ladder, jump to the east floorboards, down the stairs.
Push the wall, push the decorated wall, open the lumpy rug, and climb down the trap door.

steps.text: Speak to Safalaan. Be sure he hands you a sealed message and shortcut key, which the key can be added to the key ring after the completion of One Small Favour.
Take the sealed message to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott cellar. (1)
Quest complete!

items: 3x 2,000 Skill experience tome (Skill must be over level 30)
A shortcut key, can be put on the steel key ring after One Small Favour

Access to the Burgh de Rott Ramble, which is the Temple Trekking minigame in reverse route. Ability to unlock the Burgh de Rott teleport for a games necklace with 500 companion levels from Temple Trekking.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Darkmeyer (Although designed to unlock during The Branches of Darkmeyer, it can be unlocked when meeting Safalaan at the vantage points for the first time around the walls of Castle Drakan)
Lament of Meiyerditch (Can be unlocked in Meiyerditch)
The Last Shanty (When taking the boat from Burgh de Rott to Meiyerditch)
Night of the Vampyre (During the cutscene at Castle Drakan)

The Death of Chivalry.name: The Death of Chivalry
items_required: 5 free backpack space (for an armour set)
Combat equipment (not required from the start, able to retrieve from the bank when necessary)

steps.text: Speak to Sir Owen in the garden north of the Edgeville Monastery. (1•1•1)
Talk to Saradomin after the cutscene. (1•2•✓)
Alternatively if aligned with another god. (1•~•~•✓)
Pick up the suit of armour just south-west of you and equip it.
Talk to Saradomin. (1)
Open the Portcullis.
Fortress guard: (guaranteed suspicion on first chat option) (~•1•1)

substeps.text: It is required to dismiss pets and familiars before proceeding.

steps.text: Head north, to Lieutenant York: (2)
Head north-west, and climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you. (1•2)
Head to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] to the south, talk to Hierophant Marius. (2•3)
Head south-east of the room, and climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you. (2•1)
Go upstairs, head north to Lieutenant Graves. (3•1)
Search the Lieutenant's body, and choose whether you want to kill him or not. It doesn't matter.
Head up the stairs in the north-east to the ritual chamber.
Search the wardrobe for a Letter from Lord Daquarius.
Search the box of candles for three red candles.
Search the shelf for chalk.
Pick up the Grimoire and read it. (1)
Use a candle on each stand, and fix the symbol on the floor.
Light the candles.
Use chalk on Ritual circle.
Chant over the north-west candle. (3•4•2)
Chant over the north-east candle. (2•4•2)
Chant over the south-east candle. (4•2•4)
Enter the portal. (1)

substeps.text: You must remove the suit of armour that was equipped at the beginning of the quest.

steps.text: Defeat the three Black Knights.
Search their bodies for Cage door key.
Unlock the hanging cage to the north, freeing the Damsel.
Talk to Dawn and learn all she knows. (1•2•3•4•1)
Search the supply crate south of the portal.
Enter the doorway to the east.
Inspect the coffins or the heaps of bones.
Open the portcullis to the south.
Search the Black Knight's bodies.
Talk to Fern and defeat her. (3•1•2)

substeps.text: If The Restless Ghost has been completed, (4•1•2)
Dodge her charge ability.

steps.text: Head south, to the Wand of Resurrection.
Solve the puzzle by matching the tiles to lower the barrier.

substeps.text: The image of the completed puzzle is taken with the compass facing south.

steps.text: Try to take the wand. A chat option appears. Select offer to risk your life. (2•1)
Head north. Talk to Dawn. (3•2)
Defeat the Black Knights and Sir Owen.
Go north and open the portcullis.
Kill Dawn. Refer to the full guide if you're having trouble.
Search Dawn's body.
Head south, enter the Portcullis and speak with Saradomin. (4•2•2•~•2•~)

When Saradomin asks if the player wants to be teleported back to Edgeville, it is recommended to stay in the tombs, to claim the extra post-quest rewards which require level 40 Strength and two other coffins requiring level 60 and 80 Strength.
Quest complete!

items: 3 quest points (if you have already done Black Knights' Fortress before its removal, you will not receive the quest points)
500 Combat experience lamp (usable on one of the skills: Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic or Necromancy)
4 Knightly titles (you are suggested one based on choices made during the quest, but you can pick any one at any time through the title interface) [Name] the Gallant

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Ability to make Black Knight captain's armour a cosmetic override, "Dulcin", by defeating Dawn in battle after the quest. This can be done by using the Skull of Remembrance on Dawn's dead body.
Searching the supply crate by Black Knights' tents next to the portal will yield 200 water runes and 100 fire runes if you did not take them during the quest.

rewards.label: Members-only
items: Ability to replant the cabbages on the scorch marks in the Edgeville Monastery cabbage patch with 12 cabbage seeds and level 7 Farming, awarding 250 Farming experience.

Players can find these rewards in the coffins in the Tomb of the Fallen, which can be returned to via the portal in the Black Knights' Fortress or by selecting teleport as an option on the Skull of Remembrance which is given to you in the quest. 3,500 Combat experience lamp (usable on one of the skills: Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, Necromancy, Prayer or Summoning), requires 40 Strength and 40 in the chosen combat skill, including Prayer).
60,000 Prayer experience lamp (requires 80 Strength and 65 Prayer).

Gilded cabbage which summons Brassica Prime, who awards 10,000 bonus experience after being kicked 30 times (requires 60 Strength). This bonus Prayer experience is awarded in the form of double experience while you train in the skill, not instantaneously as given by XP lamps.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Skirmish (if not unlocked already during Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Fortunes)

The Dig Site.name: The Dig Site
items_required: Cup of tea (can be obtained during quest)
