2 ropes (can be pick-pocketed from the Dig Site workmen)
Uncut/cut opal (an uncut version can be acquired during the quest)

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: 1 backpack space

steps.text: Speak to an examiner in the Exam Centre. (✓)

substeps.text: Teleport to the Archaeology Campus by using the archaeology journal and run south-east.

steps.text: Talk to Seth Minas (site manager) in Archaeology Guild. (1)
Grab a cup of tea from the desk in the south side of the building. It is behind Acting Guildmaster Reiniger or Drew (depends on your progress). Not required if you have one.
Talk to an examiner in the Exam Centre; you will fail the exam. (~•~•~)

sections.heading: Lost and found
sections.needed: Cup of tea

steps.text: Search the green bushes to the west of the Monolith in the middle of the Archaeology Campus (not the ones to the south, near the fences) until you find a teddy bear.
Take the panning tray from the small building south of the screening station.
Pan the water to the east of where you found the panning tray. Someone will try to stop you. Give him the cup of tea to pan the water. (2)

substeps.text: Pan until you find a special cup.
Pan until you find an uncut opal if you have not already.

steps.text: Pickpocket the Dig Site workman in the north-east corner of the dig site until you get an animal skull.
Talk to Katarina (student) in the central area of the dig site.
Talk to her again.
Run south-east, talk to Dorian (student).
Talk to him again.
Run west, talk to Eduardo (student) who can be found in the dig spot closest to the well.
Talk to him again.

sections.heading: Exams
sections.needed: Opal

steps.text: Return to an examiner. (1•1•3•2)
Talk to all 3 students again.
Return to an examiner. (1•3•1•2)
Talk to all 3 students again.

substeps.text: Katarina will demand an opal (talk to her again). You can obtain this by panning.

steps.text: Return to an examiner. (1•1•1•3)

Optional: Give Seth Minas (site manager) the level 1, 2 and 3 certificates to receive a Fruit Blast or a chocolate cake. The Fruit Blast can be saved for the quest Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest.

sections.heading: Helping the expert
sections.needed: 2 ropes (or pickpocket Dig Site workman until you get enough), specimen jar, specimen brush

steps.text: Dig at the level 3 grid (near Dorian at the east digsite, see image) until you find an ancient talisman. It may take over 40 attempts to get it.
Talk to Terry Balando back at the Exam Centre.
Go to the north-eastern winch (a square hole in the ground with a rope going down it), at a dig site north from Dorian. You will also find Elissa wandering nearby and a training grid near the winch.
Operate the winch three times to hand in your invitation, attach a rope, and climb down.
Pick up an arcenia root. One is directly to the east of the rope and another is west of the rope, under a torch on the wall. You may use Area Loot to pick them up.
Search the brick east of the rope. (~)
Climb back up, then climb down the winch near Katarina to the southwest.
Talk to Doug Deeping to receive a chest key. (4)

Optional: If you do not already have one, take a charcoal from the sack of charcoal on the north side of Doug Deeping's small cavern. Take two if you intend to do Desert Treasure, but do not grind both.

sections.heading: Explosives expert
sections.needed: Chest key, vial, trowel

steps.text: Go back to the northeastern winch and climb down, use the key to unlock the chest in the north east room and search it for ammonium nitrate.
Use the trowel on the closed barrel directly east of the chest.
Use a vial on the barrel.
Grind the charcoal.

substeps.text: If you didn't grab charcoal earlier, search the sack of charcoal a few steps north.

steps.text: Mix the nitroglycerine and ammonium nitrate together, add ground charcoal, then finally add the arcenia root.
Search the bricks to the south and select the compound on the brick.
Search the brick again, select your tinderbox.
Enter the large chamber, take the stone tablet.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: Stone tablet

steps.text: Use the tablet on Terry Balando in the Exam Centre.
Quest complete!

items: Ability to do specimen cleaning in Varrock Museum to obtain Kudos and a clean necklace

Talk to Terry Balando with either 75 Magic, 75 Ranged, or 91 Constitution to obtain the Codex Ultimatus, which when read, unlocks 3 ancient abilities: Shadow Tendrils - An enhanced ability requiring 75 Ranged
Smoke Tendrils - An enhanced ability requiring 75 Magic
Ice Asylum - An ultimate ability requiring 91 Constitution

The Elder Kiln.name: The Elder Kiln
items_required: Adamant pickaxe (or better), or a melee weapon if the pickaxe is on the tool belt.
Melee, magic or ranged armour, weapons, potions, and food.
Necromancy does not work on TokTz-Ket-Dill.
A dwarf multicannon is not allowed in all encounters.
Summoning familiars are not allowed in last encounter.

steps.text: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh at the Birthing Pool in TzHaar City. (✓)
Keep the gauge within the two arrows using fire spells to heat it and water spells to cool it until the egg hatches.

substeps.text: The two TzHaar will also fire occasionally. Keep an eye on them as both may shoot fire spells at the egg simultaneously which could result in overheating.

steps.text: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh. (1•2•1)

sections.heading: In the pits
sections.needed: Combat equipment

steps.text: Go west to the main plaza and talk to TzHaar-Mej-Ak. (1•1)
Kill all enemies in the Fight Pits whilst protecting Ga'al-Jeh.
After the cutscene, kill TzHaar-Ket-Yit'tal.

sections.heading: Path to the kiln
sections.needed: 1 backpack space

steps.text: Talk to one of the TzHaar-Mejs. (1•2•2•3)
Head east of the plaza to the kiln.
Enter the cave. (2)

sections.heading: Room one
sections.needed: Adamant pickaxe or better (tool belt only works when using a melee weapon), as well as melee, ranged, or magic weapon and armour

steps.text: Jump the chasm (1)

substeps.text: Do not use protection prayers until the TokTz-Ket-Dill's shell is broken as this will increase the frequency of making the rocks fall on you, dealing over 1,000 damage.
You need a pickaxe to break the shell of TokTz-Ket-Dill, which is weak against water spell after its shell is broken. Necromancy will not work against him.

steps.text: Investigate the skeleton at the end of the cavern (1)
Proceed to the next room.
Take the TokKul on the ground and kill all of the monsters.
Proceed to the next room.
Kill all of the monsters and examine the note in the Journal of Perjour (the book which should be in your backpack). (2)

For the left scale, use the picture to find its resulting sum and put that much tokkul on it. Repeat for the right scale. A Tzhaar number symbol can be higher than 15 that is shown in the picture of this guide on the right.
Proceed to the next room.
Go through the room, jumping over chasms and killing the TokTz-Ket-Dill along the way.
Proceed to the next room.
Kill the monsters in this room.
Proceed to the next room. (1)
Complete all seven waves of the Kiln.
Talk to TokHaar-Hok. (2•5•2)

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: 2 backpack spaces

steps.text: Proceed back through the caves, ignoring monsters along the way.

substeps.text: Teleporting away and attempting to avoid heading back through the caves will result in the player being forced to return where Ga'al Xox was left at the kiln, then head back through the caves as originally intended.

steps.text: Return to the centre of the Main Plaza and talk to one of TzHaar-Mejs. (1•2•3)
Quest complete!

items: 2 quest points The Early Bird reward screen for The Elder Kiln.
100,000 Combat experience lamp in one of: Attack, Strength, Defence, Magic or Ranged (Skill must be level 75 or higher; can be reobtained after destroying - speak to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza)
A Tokkul-Zo, which increases damage to TzHaar, lava, and obsidian monsters, while also allowing teleportation around TzHaar City
A random amount of tokkul, up to 98 (whatever is left from the scale puzzle).

steps.text: Talk to Phoenix south of Eagles' Peak. (1•1•2•✓•1)
Enter the tunnel.
Talk to Flint for a pitch can. (3)

Use the pitch can to light fires by right-clicking make-fire-here to complete the arrow on the ground. If you mess up, you can right-click the fire to stomp it out. You can also drag the pitch can onto an action bar, and use a key-bind to light fires with it. However, this will light a fire one tile in front of you.
Light the fire pit.
Take the Firemaking journal on the rock. (2)
Light the fire again. (2)
Enter the tunnel on the east side of the room. (1)
Complete the pattern which is in the shape of a falling boulder.
Avoid falling boulders. Pick-up rocks one at a time, placing them on the rock pile to the east. (Repeat this 6 times)
Climb up the rock pile.
Light the fire pit.
Take the journal. (3•1•1)
Tie-up firemaker on the Column, selecting Twig. (3•1)
Light the fire pit again.
Enter the tunnel to the east.
Using the bowls of red and yellow powder by the entrance, complete the puzzle.
Immediately after the puzzle, dodge 2 fire walls by standing in the open gaps.
Proceed to the next room north.
The lights dim after a short time, dealing 50-100 damage every few seconds. Lighting the fires postpones this effect.

substeps.text: If you come close to dying in this room, you will be rescued by the firemakers and restored to full health. If this happens, any activated pillars will remain activated, but all lit fires will be extinguished. You don't have to relight all the fires.

steps.text: Complete the puzzle:

substeps.text: Go west, light the fire pit. Push nearby column switch.
Go far east, light the fire pit. Push nearby column switch.
Go back west and north to the centre and jump the pillar east of you. Push the nearby column switch.
Jump the ledge just south-east of you, jump the next ledge east. Light the fire pit.
North of you is the flame switch - loop around by going back west then east and push it.
Head west, light the fire pit then push the switch. Move fast here to avoid being hit by the rocks above you.
Jump back to the centre and push the switch immediately south of you.
Head to the north-west corner and light the fire pit, press the switch just south. Watch out for the falling rocks.

steps.text: Enter the tunnel in the north-east corner.
Light the fire and pick up the journal. (1•2)
Tie-up firemaker on the Column, selecting Sera. (5•1•1)
Light the fire again and proceed to the next room east.
Complete the puzzle.
Immediately after the puzzle, dodge 4 quicker fire walls by standing in the open gaps.

substeps.text: There might be a bug where 2 firewalls spawn at the same time, leaving no open gaps. A solution might be to stand in the far south-east corner of the room or run around the fire walls.

steps.text: Proceed to the next room north.
Light one of the oil pools on the wall.
Avoiding being damaged by the fire balls. You have to hold on to all the waves for about 10 minutes.

substeps.text: You can light the oil pool lines as a barricade.
If you stay in the north-west corner and immediately light the oil pools as soon as they're ready you should stay safe. There is no guarantee however.
If the fire balls start congregating on one side, run to opposite corner, placing a barricade behind you.
Another tactic is to use the option on the oil pools and use "right" and "left" to perform a clockwise rotation of the edges of the pit.

steps.text: Proceed to the next room north.
Light the fire and grab the journal.
Tie up Twig again (2•1)
Proceed to the next room east.
Complete the puzzle.
Light the fire pit.
Take-torch from the fire pit and continue down the path.
When there are dark tendrils, ward them off at the edge of your screen by clicking on them.

substeps.text: Tendrils may hide behind your interface if you have panels on the edges of your screen. To make the tendrils more visible, right click on World Map and click "Toggle High Contrast Mode".

steps.text: Proceed to the next room at the end of the path.
Light the fire and take the journal.
Tie-up Emmett (3•1)
Proceed to the next room east.
During this fight, you must fight Char with Necromancy, Magic or Ranged.
Teleport out and prepare for the battle.

substeps.text: Carry an inventory full of food (such as sharks or rocktails).
Carry necromancy, range or a mage weapon.
Do not bring any armour as it has no effect during this battle.
Do not bring a familiar as this might cause the dialogue with Char to be glitched.

steps.text: Teleport back to Eagles' Peak and run south to the entrance of the cave.
Talk to Flint to get another Pitch can.
Climb down the steps to enter Char's lair.
Take the journal. (2•~)
Talk to Char to engage the fight.
During the fight, you should keep a distance from Char at all times.
The amount of damage you deal is determined by the amount of flames you have lit (100 damage per active flame).
As you fight her, keep lighting flames.
Add your pitch can to your ability bar to make fires much more easily.
Run around the edges of the arena lighting flames as fast as you can.
When you have 10 active flames, run some distance from Char and attack her a few times, dealing 1,000-5,000 damage in total.
Repeat steps 1-2 until she is defeated.
Remember to avoid the firewalls by maneuvering through the gaps, or you'll be hit for 1,000-4,000 damage.
While Char is glowing she is invincible, so focus on lighting flames during this period.
After the battle ends, talk to Char. (2)
There may be a glitch where you cannot finish the dialogue, in this case leave the cave through the southern tunnel and come back in.
Exit through the tunnel to the north.
Quest complete!

items: The Book of Char: When activated in the off-hand slot, it causes fiery orbs to spin around the player, spontaneously igniting any log the player walks/runs over.
Access to two new events and a new Firemaker's costume in Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza.
Access to Char's training cave (with level 91 or higher Firemaking). Ability to collect the four fire creature pets (Warming Flame, Twisted Firestarter, Glowing Ember, and Searing Flame).

The Fremennik Isles.name: The Fremennik Isles
items_required: Ores (can be noted) depending on your Mining level:

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.needed: Raw tuna, one of either 8 tin ores (level 1-10 Mining), 7 coal (11-54 Mining), or 6 mithril ores (55+ Mining)

steps.text: Right click and talk to Mord Gunnars on the northern Rellekka dock about Jatizso's history. (✓•1•3)
In Jatizso, talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the building with tiled floors.
Give the King a raw tuna or use the tuna on the cat.

substeps.text: Can be obtained from the cage/harpoon fishing spots to the south.

steps.text: Give the King your ores.

substeps.text: There is a mine down the stairs to the north-west if you didn't bring them.

steps.text: Open the chest (behind the throne) and take the silly jester outfit. (1•1•1)
Return to Rellekka and Travel-Neitiznot Maria Gunnars.
Equip the silly jester outfit, with nothing in your hands, and talk to Slug Hemligssen, north of the bank. (4•1)
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar in the building south of the bank. Dismiss any Summoning familiars and pets.
Use the jester controls to follow Mawnis's instructions.
Return to Slug Hemligssen. (1•3•2•1)

sections.heading: Bridge repairs
sections.needed: 8 split logs, 8 ropes

steps.text: Remove the silly jester outfit (keep it for later) and talk to Mawnis Burowgar.
If you don't have 8 ropes:

substeps.text: Kill yaks for 8 yak hair and spin them on the spinning wheel in the southeastern-most house.
Optionally, make an additional rope for later in the quest.
Take three yak-hide for later if you don't already have them.

steps.text: If you don't have 8 split logs:

substeps.text: Cross the bridge to the north.
Chop 8 arctic pine logs if you don't already have them.
Optionally, chop 2 more for later in the quest. Don't split these 2, keep them whole.
Use logs on the woodcutting stump across the bridge to the north (not a regular tree stump).

steps.text: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar with the items.
Talk to Thakkrad Sigmundson about the bridges. (1•2)
Right click bridges, north of Neitiznot, to repair them.
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar.

sections.heading: Taxes
sections.needed: 1 bronze nails, 2 arctic pine logs, 1 rope, 3 yak-hides, 2 thread, silly jester outfit

steps.text: Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV on Jatizso.
Tax the shop keepers of Jatizso:

substeps.text: Hring Hring must pay 8,000; he is in southwesternmost house. (1)
Skuli Myrka must pay 6,000, north of Hring. (1)
Vanligga Gastfrihet must pay 5,000, north of the king's palace. (2)
Keepa Kettilon must pay 5,000, east from Vanligga. (1)

steps.text: Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Tax all bearded people for 1k:

substeps.text: Hring Hring. (1)
Raum Urda-Stein in a house with Hring Hring. (1)
Skuli Myrka, north of Raum and Hring. (1)
Keepa Kettilon, he is in the northeasternmost house. (1)
Flosi Dalksson in a house with Keepa Kettilon. (1)

steps.text: Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Return to Rellekka, and take the boat to Neitiznot.
Equip the silly jester outfit and talk to Slug Hemligssen.
Empty your hands and entertain Mawnis Burowgar again.
Talk to Slug Hemligssen. (1•2•1•3)
Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in Jatizso.

substeps.text: Make sure King Gjuki Sorvott IV gives you the Royal decree first. You may need to speak with him twice.

steps.text: Remove the silly jester outfit and talk to Mawnis Burowgar in Neitiznot.
To obtain a yak-hide armour set:

substeps.text: Kill three yaks and give the three yak hides to Thakkrad Sigmundson to tan. (1)
Craft the top and legs with thread in the backpack.
Thread can be bought from Jofridr Mordstatter in the building with the bank chests north of Mawnis Burowgar.

steps.text: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar when you have the yak armour.

substeps.text: Make sure Mawnis mentions "Fremennik round shield" in order to craft the shield. You may need to speak with him twice.

steps.text: To obtain a round shield:

substeps.text: Buy 1 bronze nail from Jofridr in the bank, obtain 1 rope, chop two arctic logs
Take everything to a woodcutting stump and interact with the woodcutting stump to craft the Fremennik round shield.

steps.text: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar with these items.
Prepare for battle then enter the Ice Troll Caves to the far east of the northern-most island.

substeps.text: Protect from Ranged is advised. Familiars are not allowed. Equipping the Fremennik round shield drastically reduces Range damage taken from Ice Troll Females. Yak-hide armour drastically reduces Melee damage taken from Ice Troll Males, Runts, and Grunts. If you do not have good Ranged Defence, bring high-healing food. Even with Protect From Ranged active, the trolls quickly deplete your health. The Ice Troll King has a very high defence to ranged, so it is not advised to kill the boss with ranged weapons.
Talk to or right click Request-supplies on Bork Sigmundson for seven Tunas, four 4 dose Strength potions, and two 3 dose Prayer potions if you need supplies. (1•2•3)

steps.text: Kill 10 ice trolls (killing the trolls by farcasting the ones on the east does not count).

substeps.text: There is a chatbox message saying "You have defeated enough trolls to attack the King."

steps.text: Cross the bridge, kill and then decapitate the Ice Troll King.
Take the head to Mawnis Burowgar.
Quest complete!

items: 2 × 10,000 Combat experience in Strength, Attack, Defence, or Constitution
14,000 coins in assorted rewards during the quest.
A replaceable Fremennik royal helmet known as the Helm of Neitiznot, which is an upgrade to the warrior helm with a +3 prayer bonus and a better defensive bonus.
Access to a new tree, the arctic pine.
Access to a new mine north-east of Neitiznot that contains drakolith rocks.
Access to a new mine near Jatizso with mithril rocks and coal rocks, and a new mine with banite rocks (require completion of the elite Fremennik achievements).
The ability to make yak hide armour which protects against the granite clubs wielded by the trolls and the shield which protects against the stones thrown by the trolls.
The Contraband Yak Produce store is available on Jatizso if the player refunds the 5,000 coins tax to Vanligga Gastfrihet, north of the king.
Ned in Draynor Village will now give an additional rope for free each time rope is purchased from him.

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Major Miner (In the mines on Jatizso)
Ogre the Top (Leave and re-enter the cave where you fight the trolls to unlock this track)

The Fremennik Trials.name: The Fremennik Trials
items_required: A raw shark, raw manta ray or raw sea turtle (any of the three will work, and sharks are typically the cheapest)

steps.text: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka. (3•✓•1)

substeps.text: If Mountain Daughter has been completed but you never talked to Brundt the Chieftain after its completion: (2•3•✓•1)
notes: You can complete the trials in any order.
Click on either the map circle or the name of the Fremennik below to go to that NPC's section of the guide

sections.heading: Manni the Reveller
sections.needed: Beer, 250 coins

steps.text: Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall next to Brundt. (1)
Pick up a Keg of beer and beer (tankard) from one of the tables. This is a different item standard beer.
Talk to the Poison Salesman at Forester's Arms in Seers' Village. (2•1)

substeps.text: Buy a beer from the bartender nearby if you need one. The tankard from the previous step won't work.

steps.text: Use beer on council workman at the bridge south of Rellekka.
Light the strange object and put-inside pipe on the outside eastern wall of the Rellekka longhall.
Enter the longhall. Use low alcohol keg on the keg of beer in the backpack.
Challenge Manni. (1)

sections.heading: Olaf the Bard
sections.needed: Raw potato, onion, cabbage, and a raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle

steps.text: Speak to Olaf the Bard, who is located east of the longhall. (1)
Travel south-east to the swaying tree, north-west of the Golden Apple Tree on the world map, surrounded by rabbits and doogle leaves.
Chop off a branch and craft it into an unstrung lyre.
Head south-east and talk to Lalli. (1)
Talk to Askeladden south of the longhall.
Grab a raw potato, an onion, and cabbage from the farm in south-east Rellekka. It's recommended to pick an extra onion and cabbage in case you accidentally eat them.
"Use" the potato, onion, cabbage, and pet rock on Lalli's Stew.
Talk to Lalli to obtain a golden fleece.

substeps.text: Use the drop trick to obtain another if you plan on completing Kili's Knowledge VII.

steps.text: "Use" the golden fleece on a spinning wheel to make golden wool. There's one in south-west Rellekka.
Use the wool on the unstrung lyre.
Use your raw shark, manta ray or sea turtle on the strange altar south-west of Rellekka.
Enter the backstage of the longhall through the north-east door. Play the enchanted lyre in front of the crowd. You will receive Olaf's vote.

sections.heading: Sigli the Huntsman
sections.recommended: Combat gear

steps.text: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman near Rellekka's southern entrance. (1•1)

Use the received hunters' talisman to locate and kill The Draugen. The Draugen is not visible until you get close to his location. Look for a tiny grey butterfly. There are only a few of these, one of which is the Draugen. Once in melee distance of the butterfly, use the 'Locate' function on the talisman once again, The Draugen will appear.
Return to Sigli to receive his vote.

sections.heading: Sigmund The Merchant
sections.needed: 5,000 coins

steps.text: Talk to Sigmund The Merchant in the marketplace. (1)
Talk to the Sailor on the middle dock. Right-click and select Talk, as Travel is the default option (1)
Talk to Olaf the Bard, east of the longhall. (1)
Talk to Yrsa in the clothing store, just west of the marketplace. (1)
Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. (1)
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman south of the longhall. (1)
Talk to Skulgrimen in the helmet store just north of the longhall. (1)
Talk to the Fisherman on the first dock west of the helmet store. (1)
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in a house south of the market. (1)
Talk to Peer the Seer west of Swensen. (1)
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the helmet store. (1)
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall. (1)
Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall. (1)
Talk to Askeladden outside the longhall. (1•1)
Give the promissory note to Thora in the longhall. (1)
Give the legendary cocktail to Manni in the longhall. (1)
Give the champions token to Thorvald in the helmet store. (1)
Give the warriors' contract to Peer southwest of the market. (1)
Give the weather forecast to Swensen east of Peer. (1)
Give the sea fishing map to the Fisherman on the first dock west of the helmet store. (1)
Give the unusual fish to Skulgrimen in the helmet store. (1)
Give the custom bowstring to Sigli south of the longhall. (1)
Give the tracking map to Brundt in the longhall. (1)
Give the fiscal statement to Yrsa in the clothing store, just west of the marketplace. (1)
Give the sturdy boots to Olaf east of the longhall. (1)
Give the Fremennik ballad to the Sailor on the middle dock. (1)
Give the exotic flower to Sigmund in the marketplace. You will receive his vote.
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in his house south-west of the longhall. (1)

Go down the ladder in the small room in his house. In each room, there are four portals. Enter them in the correct order to receive his vote. The first letter of each direction spells out the name SWENSEN. The correct order is as follows:

substeps.text: South
West
East
North
South
East
North

steps.text: Climb up the ladder, then talk to Swensen to receive his vote.

sections.heading: Thorvald the Warrior
sections.recommended: A lot of food (such as sharks), rings of recoil, super attacks, super strengths, and super defences. Weapon poison also works. Make sure to store all armour and weapons prior to visiting Thorvald. You may speak to Peer the Seer and deposit your items; you cannot use the right click option

steps.text: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the helmet store north of the longhall. (1)
Climb down the ladder and wait for him to appear to begin the fight.
Defeat him three times and either kill him the fourth time or let yourself be defeated. (You will not die).
Talk to Thorvald to receive his vote.
Speak to Peer the Seer, who can be found south-west of the market in Rellekka. (1)

To enter his house, you must solve a simple riddle. The riddle gives hints to letters in a four-letter word. Possible answers include: "tree", "time", "life", "mage", "fire", "wind", "mind" and "disk".
Enter the building and climb the ladder.

substeps.text: Study the unicorn's head for an old red disk.
Study the bull's head for a wooden disk.
Search the bookcase for a red herring.
Open then search the eastern chest for an empty jug.
Open then search the south-west cupboard for an empty bucket.

steps.text: Use the red herring on the cooking range to get sticky red goop.
Use the goop on the wooden disk to get a second red disk.
Go down the eastern trapdoor and use the two disks on the abstract mural for a vase lid.
Climb the ladder.

substeps.text: Use the empty jug on the tap, then the full jug on the empty bucket.
Use the empty jug on the tap again and fill the bucket. You'll have a full bucket and a 1/3rds full jug.
Use the full bucket on the drain to get an empty bucket. Or search the cupboard again.
Use the 1/3rds full jug on the empty bucket.
Use the empty jug on the tap, then use the full jug on the 1/5ths full bucket to get a 4/5ths full bucket.
Use the 4/5ths full bucket on the northwestern chest to receive a vase.
Use the vase on the tap.
Use the vase lid on the vase of water to get a sealed vase.

steps.text: Use the sealed vase on the frozen table to receive a frozen key.
Use the frozen key on the range, then go down the eastern trapdoor again and out the exit. You will receive Peer the Seer's vote.

sections.heading: Finishing up
sections.needed: 10 free inventory slots

steps.text: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall in Rellekka.
Congratulations, quest complete!

items: Ability to make an Enchanted lyre that can be used to teleport to the gates of Rellekka.
Access to the islands of Miscellania and Etceteria, along with access to the facilities in Rellekka.
A Fremennik blade (only if you killed Koschei the deathless the 4th time)
Ability to wear Berserker, Warrior, Farseer, and Archer helms.
Ability to wear Spined, Skeletal and Rock-shell armours.
Ability to see The Epic of Bukalla performance in the Rellekka longhall.
Ability to claim a new Pet rock by talking to Askeladden after the quest.
Bardur can now provide sharks in exchange for Fremennik blades, helms and shields

The Golem.name: The Golem
items_required: A phoenix feather from the Desert Phoenix (obtained during quest)

steps.text: Head east of the Shantay Pass to Uzer (north-east of the fairy ring DLQ).

substeps.text: If running from the Shantay Pass, pick up the phoenix feather on the way.

steps.text: Talk to the broken clay golem. (✓)
With four soft clay in your backpack, use one on the golem. All four will be used to repair the golem.
Talk to the golem. (1)
Pick up and read the letter west of the clay golem.
Pick a black mushroom, found on the south-east corner of the stairs leading into the ruins.
Climb down the stairs in the ruins east of the golem.
Head to the north-western room and pick up the strange implement.
Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Archaeology journal, or teleport to Varrock and run east, or teleport to Fort Forinthry and run south.
Use the letter on Elissa and talk to Elissa who is east of the winch in the north-east corner of the digsite (just north of The Stormbreaker ship). (3)
Head to the Exam Centre just south of the Dig Site.
Search the bookshelf on the southern wall and read Varmen's notes.
Talk to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about the statuette. (3•1)
Pickpocket him for the display cabinet key.
Head upstairs and use the display cabinet key on the northwestern most case to get the statuette.
Return to Shantay Pass and cross into the desert.
Go east to the Desert Phoenix, and grab a phoenix feather.

substeps.text: Make sure you un-equip any item porters, as wearing an activated Porter or grace of the elves will teleport the feather to your bank.
Make sure you un-equip the Thieving Cape or Thieving master cape, as they will cause the feather to be noted.

steps.text: Go to the ruins of Uzer where you started the quest and go back down the stairs.
In the centre of the room will be four alcoves. Place the statuette in the empty one.
Turn the statuettes so they all point north towards the double doors. You may have to click "turn" more than once.
Go north, through the double doors.

substeps.text: Optional: Take the gems from the throne at the north side of the room to unlock the achievement Looting the Demon Throne and obtain two cut rubies, two cut emeralds, and two cut sapphires.

steps.text: Go back through the south portal.
Go back upstairs and talk to the golem.
With an empty vial in your backpack, right click Grind the black mushroom (Don't left click "Eat" it).
Use the phoenix feather on the black mushroom ink.
Use the phoenix quill pen on a piece of papyrus to get the golem program.
Use the Strange implement on the golem then quickly use the newly acquired golem program on the golem.
Quest complete!

items: As an extra reward, you may search Thammaron's throne to get six gems – 2 rubies, 2 emeralds, and 2 sapphires – if you did not do so during the quest
A new magic carpet route to the ruins of Uzer
Ability to collect multiple phoenix feathers without using the drop trick

steps.text: Talk to Vanescula Drakan at the docks south-east of Burgh de Rott. (✓)
Board the nearby boat to Icyene graveyard. (2)
Talk to Safalaan.
Solve the ring puzzle by rotating the rings until they turn blue and their markings join together.
Inspect the statue of Queen Efaritay to receive Efaritay's pendant.
Talk to Safalaan.
Travel to the Myreque Hideout with Drakan's medallion (3)
After the cutscene, talk to Safalaan in the northern room.
Equip your Darkmeyer disguise.
Use your Drakan's medallion to teleport to Darkmeyer (4)
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz inside the Arboretum. He will not appear until you walk into the central chamber.

substeps.text: At this point you are able to craft more types of blisterwood weapons.

steps.text: Head south-west inside Vanstrom's former mansion.
Open then search the vyrewatch crate to obtain vyrewatch uniforms.

sections.heading: Castle Drakan
sections.needed: Four backpack spaces

steps.text: Return to Veliaf. (1)
No items other than the Darkmeyer outfit, House Drakan outfit, Drakan medallion, runes, Ivandis flail, and blisterwood weapons and ammo can be taken to Castle Drakan.
Equip the House Drakan outfit, unequip any weapons, and talk to Vanescula near Overwatch Mornid.
Complete the following to gain status:

substeps.text: North-west, talk to Lady Nadezhda Shadum. (4)
West, talk to Lord Alexei Jovkai. (1)
East, talk to Lord Mischa Myrmel. (4)
Shoo the bats flying around.

steps.text: Talk to Vanescula. (~•~•~•~)

Exit your cell and unlock the five other cells. You will take damage equal to 10% of your life points. You will have a chance to eat in the next section. Make sure you talk to the Myreque while doing this or the portcullis will not open.

Go to the next chamber and solve the ring puzzle. This is similar to the earlier puzzle with the addition that rotating a ring causes the smaller, adjacent ring to rotate as well. Rotating the centre ring causes the outer ring to rotate.

substeps.text: Start from the outside and work your way in.

steps.text: Go to the next chamber and talk to Safalaan.
Go up the stairs and leave the dungeon.
Go to the eastern room and take all the mysterious jerky you are able to from the butchery table.

substeps.text: Eat to full health, you can take more after eating.

steps.text: Talk to Vanescula and Mornid in the western room.
Go to the southern room, and read the A Taste of Hope book obtained earlier. Investigate each blood lock. The correct matches are:

substeps.text: Ghrazi - Veliaf (5•3)
Alzeph - Radigad (5•1)
Pyrah - Kael (2)
Myrmel - Mekritus (3)
Vitur - Polmafi (4)
Shadum - Vertida (5•4)
Jovkai - Safalaan (5•2)
Drakan - Ivan (1)

steps.text: Unlock the tithing door south and escape through the cellar exit.
Enter the tunnel and Lowerniel Drakan will appear.

sections.heading: Ascending the castle
notes: If you die at any point you will continue from where you died at or just before. You may not bring any potions in, but you can drink them for the potion's effect and then enter. If you log out, you will be returned to Darkmeyer, and to return to the quest go west and enter the gatehouse doors. You will be returned to the last room you were in.

steps.text: Vandalise the statue of Lord Drakan to obtain a statue spear (if the option to vandalise doesn't appear then enter the east door for a cutscene).
Brace the entrance door.
Defeat the venator and climb the stairs.

sections.heading: First floor
notes: When you climb the stairs a timer will start. You will need to smash furniture and collect debris to barricade the windows. If you don't succeed before the timer runs out, a venator will attack.

steps.text: Smash 2 tables and 3 chairs and collect 9 furniture debris.
Barricade the three windows. Do not click away before you get the message confirming the window is barricaded.
Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.
You can collect 3 extra debris from smashing the remaining chairs in this room to make subsequent rooms easier.
Unlock the blood lock and enter the second room. Another timer will start.
Smash the table. You should have 6 furniture debris.
Barricade the two windows. Do not click away before the "the window is barricaded" message appears.
Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.
Unlock the blood lock and enter the third room.
Lift the table.
Defeat the venator.
Lift the table.
Unlock the blood lock and enter the fourth room.
Smash the chairs and table to the right of the door and the weapon racks which are against the north and south sides of the staircase.
Barricade the two windows. Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.
Solve the puzzle by making the following moves (if you mess up, you can reset the puzzle by talking to Polmafi):

substeps.text: Rotate ring 'E' clockwise once.
Rotate ring 'D' clockwise three times.
Rotate ring 'C' clockwise twice.
Rotate ring 'B' clockwise twice.
Rotate ring 'A' clockwise once.

steps.text: Climb upstairs.
Talk to Veliaf.
Climb the stairs on both sides and open the blood valves in each room.

substeps.text: After defeating the venator in the western room, check on Ivan.

steps.text: Back on the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US], enter the northern door and open the blood valve.
Climb down the stairs and solve the final ring puzzle by making these moves:

substeps.text: Rotate ring A anticlockwise once.
Rotate ring B clockwise three times.
Rotate ring C clockwise once.
Rotate ring D anticlockwise three times.
Rotate ring E anticlockwise three times.

steps.text: Before entering the fight you can use stat-boosting potions and prayer restoration potions to make the fight easier, but these items cannot be brought to the fight.
Climb the stairs in the ring puzzle room and prepare to fight Lowerniel Drakan.
Kill the three venators. (You can stand behind Vertida, Veliaf and Safalaan when attacking each of the venators and they won't attack you, saving you from needing to eat.)
Fight Lowerniel Drakan.

substeps.text: Run away from bombs which appear after he says "Ha ha ha!".
When he says things like "Still trying to run?" or "You think you can escape?" use Anticipation to avoid being stunned and dealt high damage.

steps.text: Fight Lowerniel Drakan again.

substeps.text: When he says "Fear me!" and transforms into a cloud of dust, run away from the cloud.
When he says "Embrace darkness", stand within the sphere of lightning surrounding Safalaan.
When he says "Graaah!", use Anticipation or Freedom if you get stunned.

steps.text: Jump into the portal and fight Lowerniel Drakan again - he will use the same attacks as in the previous fights.
Talk to Lowerniel Drakan and then fight him for the final time.

substeps.text: Avoid bombs as before.
Move away from him when he is doing a special attack (rapid melee attacks) to avoid taking damage.

steps.text: Select the "finish" option on Lowerniel Drakan.
Talk to Ivan. A cutscene will follow.
Talk to Ivan again. (1)
Go to Varrock Palace and talk to King Roald. (1)
Quest complete!

items: The Tome of xp 4th ed with 3 charges, each charge giving 75,000 XP in a chosen skill at or above level 75
The ability to craft more types of blisterwood weapons. This is granted early in the quest when you first talk to Veliaf Hurtz inside the Arboretum.

The Lost Tribe.name: The Lost Tribe
items_required: A light source (preferably a covered source such as the oil lantern, any Seer's headband or a bullseye lantern which can be easily obtained from the lorehound if you have 50 quest points)

steps.text: Talk to Sigmund on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Lumbridge castle. (1•✓)
Talk to the following NPCs about Lumbridge cellar around the castle until one of them mentions a goblin:

substeps.text: Duke Horacio, in the same room. (3)
Cook, just downstairs. (4)
Hans, in the courtyard. (4)
Father Aereck, in the church. If you have not previously spoken to him about gravestones, you must complete that dialogue, then speak to him again. (2)
Bob the smith, in his axe shop. (5)

steps.text: Talk to Duke Horacio. (4)

sections.heading: Dorgeshuun
sections.needed: A light source

steps.text: Descend the trapdoor in the kitchen.
Mine the wall rubble to the east.
Squeeze through the hole and take the brooch.

substeps.text: Optional: Mine the wall rubble to the south for a shortcut to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

steps.text: Show the brooch to the Duke. (3)
Talk to Reldo in Varrock Palace about the brooch. (4)
Search the northern most bookcase on the western wall for a goblin symbol book. (3)
Read the book to the end. (2•3)

substeps.text: Reldo will force-greet you and mention the Goblin Village.

steps.text: Talk to Generals Bentnoze and Wartface in the Goblin Village. Make sure you have the brooch with you.

sections.heading: Finding the lost tribe
sections.needed: A light source

steps.text: Grab your light source and return to Lumbridge Castle.
Climb down the trapdoor in the kitchen.
Squeeze through the hole in the wall you mined earlier.
Run through the Goblin Mine (pictured right).
Use the Goblin Bow emote near Mistag.
Right-click follow on Mistag.

sections.heading: Sigmund's treachery
sections.needed: 4 backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to the Duke. (3)
Pickpocket Sigmund for a key. (4)
Open the chest in the other room for a H.A.M. hood, shirt, and robe. Make sure to have 3 backpack spaces, otherwise the outfit might disappear with no means of receiving it again.
Enter the H.A.M. Hideout in the Lumbridge forest northwest of the Lumbridge Castle by opening and then climbing down the trapdoor.
Search the crate near the ladder for the missing silverware.

sections.heading: Making peace
sections.needed: Silverware

steps.text: Return to the Duke. (3)
Go back down the trapdoor in the castle kitchen. (4)
Squeeze through the hole in the wall and follow Kazgar, who'll be waiting just on the other side.
Talk to Mistag.
Quest complete!

items: The ability to use the Goblin Bow and Goblin Salute emotes
Quicker access to Lumbridge Swamp Caves

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Return the brooch to Mistag for a lightable mining helmet

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Cave of the Goblins (if you fall into a trap, or you have not visited Lumbridge Swamp Caves earlier)

The Slug Menace.name: The Slug Menace
items_required: At least 5 rune essence or pure essence (the essence can break during the quest, so to be safe, bring 10-15)
Tools to access air, earth, water, fire, and mind altar by any means:
An air, an earth, a water, a fire and a mind talisman
An elemental and a mind talisman
A wicked hood charged with any of above combinations will also work

steps.text: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park. (1•✓•3)
Talk to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven (fairy ring BLR or Cape of Legends and run south). (3•4)
Talk to Mayor Hobb in the western building just south of Caroline. (~•2•4)
When you try to exit the building, Savant will contact you and request that you scan nearby the Mayor using the Commorb v2
Go back into the mayor's building, stand beside him and begin scanning.
Talk to Brother Maledict in the church. (4)
Talk to Holgart to the north.
Report back to Col. O'Niall. (4)

sections.heading: Imposing door
sections.needed: Commorb v2, 2 backpack space
sections.recommended: Traveller's necklace, cape of legends

steps.text: Climb-down the old ruin entrance west of Witchaven.
Push the wall to your immediate east.
Enter the Wall Opening
Run through the cave until you reach a set of imposing doors.

substeps.text: Take the Agility shortcut (requires level 30).

steps.text: Savant will contact you.
Scan with the commorb to obtain a door transcription.
Pick up the dead sea slug on the ground nearby. You only need one.
Talk to Jorral in the small Outpost, north-west of West Ardougne. (2)

substeps.text: Traveller's necklace to the Outpost.

steps.text: Savant will contact you while talking to Jorral and after.
Talk to Col. O'Niall in Witchaven (fairy ring BLR or cape of legends and run south).
Go near the church (a cutscene will begin).
Talk to Brother Maledict in the church. (2)

sections.heading: Page pieces
sections.needed: Commorb v2, 1 swamp paste, 5 backpack spaces, 1 Dead sea slug

steps.text: Search the Mayor's study desk. You may fail, so repeat until you receive Page 1.
Talk to Ezekial Lovecraft in the fishing shop. (4)
Talk to Col. O'Niall. This step requires 3 backpack spaces.
Try to use the swamp paste on the fragments.

substeps.text: Savant will contact you.

steps.text: Talk to Jeb to reach the fishing platform.
Talk to Bailey to the west.
Use the Sea slug glue on the fragments.
Use the image to solve the puzzle, there are 2 sides to the pieces so you might need to flip some.

sections.heading: Shaped runes
sections.needed: At least 5 rune or pure essence, access to runecrafting altars

steps.text: With essence in your inventory, right click the papers to create 5 shapes.

substeps.text: Page 1 to shape a blank earth rune.
Page 1 to shape a blank air rune.
Page 2 to shape a blank fire rune.
Page 2 to shape a blank water rune.
Page 3 to shape a blank mind rune.

steps.text: Use the blank runes on their respective runecrafting altars.
Using spellbook teleports will use the runes you have created.
It is possible to fail at chiselling the essence and/or at converting the blank shapes at the altar. More rune essence will be required if unsuccessful.
Take caution as to not click on the altar, as your essence may be crafted into runes.

sections.heading: Final fight
sections.needed: The runes you created, Commorb v2, Melee equipment to kill a level 51 monster

steps.text: Climb down the old ruins in Witchaven, then enter the wall opening to your immediate east.
Follow the path to the imposing door again.
Use the runes on the door. Immediately after the placement of the last elemental block, a cutscene will happen prompting you into combat.
Kill the Slug Prince.
Talk to Sir Tiffy. (1)
Quest complete!

items: Promotion to Proselyte among the Temple Knights. This means you can buy and wear new Temple Knight armour with a greater Defence bonus than Initiate. You can buy each piece individually, or buy the armour pack which, when opened, gives you the plate, helm, and legs/skirt all at once. The pack is worth 25,000 coins.

The Tale of the Muspah.name: The Tale of the Muspah
items_required: 4 cut sapphires (can be mined and cut during the quest if you have the recommended crafting level)
Equipment to cast Lvl-1 Enchant 8 times (one of the following):
8 cosmic runes and a staff that provides water runes, such as a staff of water

steps.text: Talk to Erjolf on the mountain north-east of Rellekka. (Fairy ring DKS) (✓•1)
Jump the flat rock to cross the river.
Enter the Cave opening to the north-west.
Talk to Erjolf about his progress and offer to help. (2•2•2)

substeps.text: Continue through the following dialogue and cutscene.

steps.text: Take at least 14 driftwood from the driftwood pile (can also be done in smaller batches if backpack space is a concern).
Make-fireraft with the driftwood you picked up. (4)

substeps.text: You should have 14 fire raft in the backpack.

steps.text: Block-stream using the ice mound to the west to block the west stream.
Jump the flat rock nearby on your side of the stream (you're now in the NW quadrant).
Jump the flat rock to the northeast (you're now in the NE quadrant).
Block-stream using the ice mound southeast of you to block the east stream.
Jump the flat rock to the northwest (you're now in the NW quadrant).
Walk to the tile as same as the picture shown below.

Launch 5 fire rafts quickly from the northern shore of the pool. Launch them from the same spot such that when they float south, they end up across the east side of the frozen armour and are blocked from leaving the cave by a rock. You do not need to face correctly to launch fire rafts, the player character will launch the raft into the water next to the tile they are standing on.
Walk to the tile as same as the picture shown below.
Launch 3 fire rafts from the northern shore of the pool. Launch them on 3 adjacent spots that, when they float south, they end up on the north side of the frozen armour.
Unblock-stream using blocked icy stream to the west (unblocks the west stream).
Jump the flat rock nearby (you're now in the SW quadrant).
Jump the flat rock to the southeast on your side (you're now in the SE quadrant).
Block-stream on the southern stream using the ice mound in the southeast.
Walk to the tile as same as the picture shown below.
Launch 4 fire rafts quickly from the eastern shore of the pool. Light them on the same spot that, when they float west, they end up across the south side of the frozen armour.
Unblock-stream using blocked icy stream to the east.
Jump the flat rock to the southwest (you're now in the SW quadrant).
Block-stream using the ice mound to the west to block the west stream.
Walk to the tile as same as the picture shown below.

Launch 1 fire raft from the western shore of the pool. Light them on the spot that, when they float east, they end up on the west side of the frozen armour. You'll need to light the rafts in the western stream, not against the pool shore.
Jump the flat rock to the west (you're now in the NW quadrant).
Walk to the second tile in the picture shown below.
Launch 1 fire raft from the western shore of the pool.
Talk to Erjolf. (2•1)
Exit the cave, climb down the mountain and go north across the narrow strip of land. Head north-east and past the sabre-toothed kyatts in the Rellekka Hunter area.
Talk to the natural historian. (1•1•1)
Describe the creature to him. (3•2•1•2•2•1)
Continue dialogue with the historian. (1•2)

sections.heading: Terror of the mind
sections.recommended: Pollnivneach Teleport scroll or a ring of slaying

steps.text: Head north of Pollnivneach along the River Elid to a sand pile.
Dig the sand pile.
After Ali the Wise speaks, talk again and ask about the Muspah. (3•3•3•3•4)

sections.heading: The muspah's true form
sections.needed: 4 cut sapphires, 4 water runes , and 4 cosmic runes

steps.text: Head back to the Muspah cave.

substeps.text: The ice cave where you started, by Fremennik Province lodestone, or fairy ring DKS.

steps.text: If you haven't obtained sapphires yet, mine the sapphire rocks nearby.
Cross the floating bridge.
Bore-sapphires in the ice block, then enchant-sapphires on it.
Pick up the four sapphires from the ground, or more will have to be obtained.
Talk to the Muspah and offer to help. (1•1•3•1•1•5)

sections.heading: Hibernating
sections.needed: 4 water runes and 4 cosmic runes, 4 cut sapphires

steps.text: Talk to Erjolf just outside the chamber.
Exit the caves and head north to the icy Rellekka Hunter area.
On the western shore, make-canoe with the fallen log, then travel with the canoe.
Enter the cavern.
Dismiss any followers you have (if Jhallan still says to dismiss your pet, turn off any overrides you may have for other pets).
Slightly south, talk to Jhallan. (1)
Lead him to the far south-west corner of the cave, away from the monsters.
At the end of the path, talk to Jhallan. (1)
After speaking, bore-sapphires on Jhallan, then enchant-sapphires on him.
Return to the icy hunter area via the canoe or the Fremennik Province lodestone.
Talk to Erjolf to give him the Muspah tail.

substeps.text: Talk to the natural historian for an experience lamp.

steps.text: Quest complete!

items: New slayer cave full of jellies
Access to ice strykewyrm cave and ice strykewyrms
Unlocked dialogue with Ali the Wise about the Mahjarrat

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: 200 Skill experience antique lamp from the natural historian for any skill at or over level 10

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Muspah's Tomb (After entering the tomb)
Rest for the Weary (After sailing the canoe)

The Tourist Trap.name: The Tourist Trap
items_required: Desert shirt, desert robe, and desert boots (Black variants will not work. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)
10 feathers (You can only use regular feathers. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)
Bronze bar (The bar must be in your inventory.)
At least 200 coins (or 100 with ring of charos (a))

steps.text: If you don't have desert clothes, buy them from Shantay.
Begin the quest by talking to Irena (south of Shantay Pass). (1•1•3•1•✓)
Run south and slightly west to the gate of the Desert Mining Camp.
Making sure not to attack him, talk to Mercenary Captain (the one with the all-grey shield). (1•2•2•2•1)
Kill the Mercenary Captain to obtain a metal key.

substeps.text: The metal key can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour.

steps.text: Unequip all armour (includes amulets, rings, etc.) and weapons, and keep them unequipped whenever inside the mining camp or mine.
Open the gate to enter the camp.
Go east to the mine door entrance and talk to the male slave on the east of the camp (it's the one who never mines). (1•2•1•1•1•1•1)

substeps.text: If a guard catches you unlocking the slave's chains and you end up in the cell, bend the bars on the window and escape. Talk to the slave to try again.

steps.text: While wearing the slave outfit, open the mine door entrance. The outfit must be equipped any time you enter the mine.
Upon entering, head north and follow the cave around until you come to a guarded cave entrance.
Making sure not to attack him, talk to one of the guards. (2•2•2)
Head back to the mine doors and exit.
Unequip your slave clothing and leave the Desert Mining Camp through the gate.
Run west to the Bedabin Camp.
Talk to Al Shabim in the southernmost tent to receive the Bedabin key. (1•1)

sections.heading: The plans
sections.needed: Bronze bar, 10 feathers

steps.text: Run east back to the Desert Mining Camp and climb up the ladder in the white building.
On the western wall search the south-western bookcase for a book on sailing.
Talk to Captain Siad in the same room and ask him if you can chat with him, then mention the sailing book. (1•5•3•1)
Open the chest beside the table to get the plans.
Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans. (1•1)
Enter the tent to the north.
Use the experimental anvil with a bronze bar in your inventory and answer the prompt (1)
Use a feather on the dart tip to make a prototype dart.
Take this back to Al Shabim. He will take the prototype dart, technical plans, and Bedabin key in exchange for a bronze dart and Tenti pineapple.
Wear the slave outfit, head back down into the mine and give the pineapple to one of the guards.
Walk through the mine cave and run east to the mine cart.
Choose "Search" option on one of the empty barrels nearby and answer the prompt (1)
Choose "Search" option on the mine cart to ride it to the other side, answering the prompt to confirm. (1)

substeps.text: Failing to enter the cart will cause minor damage. If you fail, attempt to enter the cart again.

steps.text: Go down the northwestern passageway containing a large number of slaves at the end and you will find Ana.
Use the barrel in your inventory on Ana to squeeze her inside it, and head back to the mine cart.
Use Ana on the mine cart first, then ride it yourself when it comes back. (1)
Search the barrels around the cart and retrieve the one that has Ana in it.
Use the winch bucket north-west of the cart to put the barrel on it.
Accept the guard's offer for help and give him a compliment. (1•1)
Head back to the surface and go to the winch bucket in the south-western corner of the camp.

substeps.text: Do not remove your slave clothes at any point.

steps.text: Operate it and then search the barrel west of it.
Use Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the camp.
Talk to the Mine cart driver. (Warning: If you use the wrong responses you'll have to rescue Ana again!) (2•2•1•3•3•3•1•2)

substeps.text: If you fail, you need to head back into the deepest part of the mine with a barrel and get Ana out again.

steps.text: Search the cart and answer the prompt (1)
Run northeast towards Shantay Pass and talk to Irena.
Congratulations, quest complete!

items: 4,650 experience in your choice of two from the following skills (you may pick the same skill twice): Agility, Fletching, Smithing or Thieving
A wrought iron key for access to the Desert Mining Camp and the cave beneath it (can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour)

The Vault of Shadows.name: The Vault of Shadows
items_required: Ancient timepiece (if Time Served is not completed)
Pontifex signet ring (can be on the tool belt)
500 Divination memories, vibrant or better (collected after shadow engrammeter (depleted) has been obtained)

steps.text: Talk to Dr Nabanik near the bank chest at Kharid-et Dig Site. He will "loan" you any of the spell scrolls that you are unable to obtain. (✓)

You will need to activate four buttons within the dig site. After activating each button you will be able to enter the corresponding door and complete a puzzle. While the buttons may be activated in any order, the puzzles are always received in the same order.

You will need to activate all shadow anchors or wait until the Pylon is active to do the 4th puzzle. If you don't have a ring of visibility or have the ability to permanently see the Shadow Realm, this is also required for a step after gathering 500 divination memories.

substeps.text: You will need 80 batteries to charge all eight anchors. You can get these batteries by excavating in Kharid-et Dig Site or by doing Zarosian I collection for Soran, Emissary of Zaros in Varrock. He will give you 20 batteries each time you repeat the collection (after the first time).

sections.heading: Ice button
sections.needed: Pontifex signet ring, 'Incite Fear' spell scroll (or 'Incite Fear' spell scroll (loaned))

steps.text: Head into the prison block section of the dig site.
Enter the eastern door which leads to the solitary confinement area.

substeps.text: If you haven't completed Time Served but you have the repaired artefact in your inventory, then just inspect the ancient mechanism to the North. Insert the artefact and then the eastern door will open.

steps.text: Go down to the southern end of the corridor, there will be an inactive dial on the west wall, just before the last empty room.
Cast an 'Incite Fear' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the ice button and enter the vault (1)
Pick up the praetor's log page 1 and right click Transcribe.
Set your compass to face north (so the central vault is on the east of the screen).
Using the image, press each button in order. Backwards turns are denoted by '. For example, SW' means turn south-west back.
You may cancel pressing the wrong direction (e.g. SW instead of SW') by pressing the same button in the other direction (e.g. SW'). You can then proceed with the right move (e.g.SW').
If you make a mistake, you can leave and return via the button on the western wall to reset the puzzle.
NE, E, NE', SW', S, S
SE, SE, C, N'
S', W, NW
The final combination of the dials on the wall is, from top to bottom: shadow, blood, smoke, ice.
The door will open, and you will automatically receive praetor's log page 2, transcribe the page.
To leave, you can use the Vault exit to the south-west.

sections.heading: Blood button
sections.needed: Pontifex signet ring, 'Exsanguinate' spell scroll (or 'Exsanguinate' spell scroll (loaned))

steps.text: Head to the Main Fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site (first room) and go to the south-east corner (the chapel).
Pass the Pontifex barrier and find the inactive dial on the northern wall, directly north of the Orcus altar.
Cast a 'Exsanguinate' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the Blood button and enter the vault (1)
Set your compass to face north (so the central vault is on the north of the screen).
Using the image, press each button in order.
Backwards turns are denoted by '. For example, SW' means turn south-west back.
SW', C, NW, NW, SW'
C', C', NE, SE, C'
NE', NE', C', C', NE'
C', SW', SE, C, SE
C, SE, SW, C, SW'
C, C
The final combination of the dials on the wall is, from top to bottom: shadow, blood, smoke, ice.
The door will open and you will automatically receive praetor's log page 3, transcribe the page.
To leave, you can use the Vault exit to the south-east.

sections.heading: Smoke button
sections.needed: Pontifex signet ring, 'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll (or 'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll (loaned))

steps.text: Return to the main fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site and go directly north of the Pontifex barrier, by the oven.
Find the inactive dial on the wall immediately west of the oven.
Cast a 'Smoke Cloud' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the smoke button and enter the vault (1)
Walk to the large door and stand in the centre of the control dials.
This time, set your compass facing west (unlike the other puzzles), making you face the big door.
Using the image, press each button in order.
Backward turns are denoted by '. For example, 5' means turn 5 back.
5', 2, 7', 3, 3, 4' - Top row complete (all pink)
3, 3, 8, 3, 3 - Second row complete (all red)
7', 4, 8, 4' - Puzzle complete
The final combination of the dials on the wall is, from top to bottom: shadow, blood, smoke, ice.
The door will open and you will automatically receive praetor's log page 4, transcribe the page.
To leave, you can use the Vault exit to the east.

sections.heading: Shadow button
sections.needed: All eight Shadow anchors active, or Pylon active, 'Animate Dead' spell scroll (or 'Animate Dead' spell scroll (loaned))

steps.text: For the shadow button, you will either need to have activated all the shadow anchors or wait until the Kharid-et pylons are active.
You will need 80 batteries in total to charge all 8 shadow anchors.

To quickly obtain batteries, you can repeatedly complete the Zarosian I collection for Soran, Emissary of Zaros in Varrock. He will give you 20 batteries each time you repeat the collection (after the first time).
Normally, it's best to charge the shadow anchors first (since you will have to charge it sooner or later anyway, you might as well do it now).

However, if the power tower is about to activate (90% or higher), you can consider waiting. Even so, you should use all the batteries (10 of each) to charge the shadow anchor instead of the pylon (because 10 batteries only increase the activation progress by 0.01%), just in case you cannot complete the charging within 30 minutes.
Return to the Main Fortress of the Kharid-et Dig Site and enter the war room by clicking the praetorium war table (middle of the Main Fortress)
Find the inactive dial on the western wall in the small western room.
Cast an 'Animate Dead' spell scroll whilst standing next to the dial.
Press the Shadow button and enter the vault (1)
Set your compass so that it is facing south (so the central vault is at the top of the screen).
Using the image, press each button in order.
Backward turns are denoted by '. For example, 5' means turn 5 back.
The final combination of the dials on the wall is, from top to bottom: shadow, blood, smoke, ice.
The door and now the vault will open.
Pick up the shadow engrammeter (depleted) from the centre of the vault.
Collect 500 divination memories (vibrant tier or higher). Recharge the Shadow engrammeter when you have an inventory full of memories to charge it. Enriched memories count as double.
Return to the centre of the vault via any of the dials and Operate the engrammeter.
Take Trindine's memory to Dr Nabanik.

substeps.text: You will receive the memory as a book, and be granted 25,000 Divination experience.

steps.text: Return to the vault using any of the dials.
Speak to Praetor Trindine in the centre. This will complete The Vault of Shadows mystery.

substeps.text: If the shadow anchors weren't activated, or Pylon isn't active, you will need to wear a ring of visibility or have the ability to permanently see the Shadow Realm.

steps.text: Return to and speak to Dr Nabanik.
Speak to him again after the cutscene.
notes: Quest complete!

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Two ghost praetorians may now be found by the smoke and shadow buttons. The ring of visibility must be equipped or Sliske's gift must be unlocked, and each of the shadow anchors must be activated. Speak to each of them to receive: 80 Ancient vis

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.needed: 3 free inventory spaces

steps.text: Talk to Korasi in Falador Park. (✓)

sections.heading: Infiltration
sections.needed: 5 backpack spaces, limestone brick, hard leather, black full helm (bugged), black platebody (bugged), and black platelegs (bugged)
sections.recommended: Food, armour, and a melee weapon

steps.text: Go to the entrance of the Black Knights' Fortress north-west of the Edgeville Monastery.
Equip the black full helm (bugged), black platebody (bugged), and black platelegs (bugged). Open the portcullis. Commander Colby will yell at you and teleport you.

substeps.text: Once you finally get to the storage room, your helmet will be taken.

steps.text: If you leave the room at any point (including disconnect), or once your helmet is taken, you will no longer be able to use the Black Knights' Fortress to return to the storage area.

substeps.text: Instead, enter via the Black Knights' Base inside the Taverley Dungeon.
Inside the Black Knights' Base, enter the door south from the conquest map table, which is found in the middle of the floor.

steps.text: Talk to Captain Gilroy.
Attempt to take an item from any crate.
Speak to Gilroy. (3)
Talk to Gilroy again. (3•1•5•2•4)
Balance the scale on the wall to the south, arrange the weights to make 15 on each side. (Top: 3-5-3-4 and Bottom: 2-2-5-6)
Proceed to the next room.
Kill the enemies in the room and pick up the security blocks that are dropped.
Talk to Gilroy. (2)
Exit the room and head to the jail, northeast of the storage room, and search the crate for a piece of hard leather.
Search a crate in the kitchen for some logs, just north of the jail.
Head to the tiny forge on the west side of the base (icon on minimap).
Search the crate in the south-west corner of the forge room for a limestone brick.
Return to the forge and repair it.
Use the logs on the forge to fuel it.
Light the forge.
Use the broken security block on the forge to repair it.
Go back into the room with Gilroy and place all the blocks within the western wall.
Proceed to the next room.
Click on the panel on the western wall. (2)
Open the panel.
Drag the tiles into the panels so that a horizontal line is going across all three panels, while filling the empty spaces. Press confirm once completed.
Proceed to the next room.
Reveal yourself and explain the danger to Lord Daquarius. Accept the allegiance. (1•3•1)
Talk to Korasi.
Talk to Commodore Tyr. (1)

substeps.text: At this point you can equip your own armour again instead of the Black Knight (bugged) armour.

steps.text: Enter the portal and watch the cutscene. (1)
A game of modified conquest must be played and won.

substeps.text: Spinners are very powerful but do not heal like in Pest Control.
Ravagers have the movement range of Scouts and the damage rate of a Knight.
Shifters are less of a threat than other units and can be tanked if need be.
Torchers are similar to Mages.
Defilers are similar to Archers.
Splatters will explode and deal 100 life points of damage to any adjacent unit that is within 1 square.

steps.text: Win the game and proceed to the next room.
Sacrifice either Korasi or Jessika.
Speak to Valluta before stocking for the fight or Sir Tiffy won't teleport you back.
Make all necessary preparations to fight the Pest Queen. Korasi's sword will be the primary weapon during the fight and its Special attacks will be used a lot.

substeps.text: It may be helpful to use manual attack abilities rather than Revolution.

You can use necromancy to trivialise the encounter. Summon conjures prior to equipping Korasi's sword, and keep your necromancy offhand equipped. Ghost will provide full sustain without food, and skeleton will do the majority of the damage.

steps.text: Kill the Pest Queen.

substeps.text: The Weapon Special attack is located under Constitution abilities.

If you die, talk to Sir Tiffy in Falador park and he will teleport you back to the portal. You will lose the weapon if you die. Reclaim this from Jessika/Korasi before you attack the Pest Queen again. (3)
Build your adrenaline up more than 60% then use the special attack "Disrupt" to stun the Pest Queen when she raises her head and starts shaking for several seconds.
Hurt but don't kill the spawning Elite defilers to defend Void Knight archers. They need to be focussed on you so more don't respawn and so they don't hurt your archers.
More in-depth strategies can be found here.

steps.text: Talk to Korasi or Jessika. Decide who to let deal with Wizard Grayzag. (~)
Talk to Commodore Tyr.
Quest complete!

items: 2 Book of Equilibrium (can be stored in bank) - 50,000 Combat experience each in any combat skill level 75 or higher (except Necromancy and Constitution)
Korasi's sword and the ability to use Jessika's sword

Elite void knight top. Its colour will depend on how many white/black decisions you made in the void quests. Examining it will reveal its type: white for Guardian, grey for Justiciar, and black for Executioner, and it can be changed by talking to Commander Tyr and paying 100,000 coins.
The ability to upgrade your Void Knight armour for its elite version at the cost of 100 Void Knight commendation points.

sections.heading: Helping Orlando
sections.needed: Gear and food for fights

steps.text: Talk to Orlando Smith, West of the Legends' Guild (fairy code BLR, or use the Ardougne lodestone). (1•1•✓)
Open the door.
Investigate the following 6 artefacts:

substeps.text: Inactive obelisk (north-west)
Stone carvings (north)
The other stone carvings (north-east)
Clouded vials (north-east)
Dusty parchment (south-east)
Shattered blade (south)

steps.text: Investigate the Guthixian statue to the east.
Enter the next room to the east and kill the 3 automatons.

substeps.text: You must finish the entire dialogue with the Automatons before clicking to attack them (there's a small break in the dialogue) or you will have to redo the cutscene again.
Warning: Automatons can deal high damage to players standing within their special attack range. Lower-level players should use ranged, magic, or necromancy to attack them.

steps.text: Talk to Sliske. (3•1•1•1)
Continue talking to Sliske after the cutscene. (1•2•1•~)
If Kree'arra and Commander Zilyana don't spawn, talk to Sliske again.
After the cutscenes, talk to Kree'arra. (3•3)
Defeat Kree'arra. Avoid standing on the tornadoes.
Pass through the door (east).
Run to the other side of the room and activate the control panel. (1)

While using the control panel you can release a boulder by clicking on the dispenser in the corner of the screen. The goal is to get the boulder from the dispenser to the receptacle tile (circular cavity with a green dot).
To solve the puzzle:

substeps.text: Rotate the tracks to create a path from the dispenser to the green hole, matching the solutions below (NOTE: puzzle can crash based on camera settings try classic)
Click the appropriate dispenser to release the boulder
When the boulder halts at a gate, wait for the next tile to auto-rotate such that the path continues, and click the gates to release the boulder at the right time

steps.text: The solution to the first puzzle. Click the top-right dispenser.
The solution to the second puzzle. Click the bottom-right dispenser.
The solution to the third puzzle. Click the top-left dispenser.
The solution to the fourth puzzle. Click the bottom-left dispenser.
After the cutscenes (skippable), view the strange map to the east.
Answer four randomised questions to balance the pillars (Chaos, Order, Good, and Evil must all be exactly 50%). Refer to the below table and pick the appropriate answers:
Give the group a motivational speech (1•1•1)
Drag the guardian icons to the correct threat based on the hover text in the top row:
Talk to Juna. (1•1)
Finish the dialogue after the cutscene (including a pause in dialogue) or you will be forced to watch it again.
Drink from the elixirs if you need to restore your health or prayer.
Note: you can bank if you talk to Druidess. Look for the bank icon on the minimap.
Enter the north-west storage wing guarded by Chaeldar and Thaerisk Cemphier. (1)
Defeat General Graardor. Protect from Melee is preferred.
Be aware of his special attacks:

substeps.text: He reflects your damage when he shouts "Graardor protect!".
Move away from his charging path when he shouts "Graardor mad!".
Avoid the falling debris by looking at the shadows when he shouts "Graardor smash!".

steps.text: Enter the exit.
Enter the north storage wing guarded by Cres. (1)
Defeat Zemouregal. Bringing Antipoison is recommended.
Protect from magic works best here.
Start by killing the two dark portals.
Stay away from Decaying portals or kill them quickly.
Attack Zemouregal to about 70%.
Kill 4 more dark portals.
Kill the decaying portals to lower his defence, if necessary.
Finish Zemouregal.
Enter the exit.
Enter the south-west storage wing guarded by Death. (1)
Defeat K'ril Tsutsaroth. Be aware of his special attacks.
When he shouts "You cannot stand against Zamorakian might!" avoid the spikes that appear under you.
When he shouts "Run, coward!" he will charge forwards, simply move out the way.
When he shouts "Guthix will die in the name of Zamorak!" you will need to constantly run from K'ril otherwise he will hit you very rapidly.
Enter the exit.
Enter the south storage wing guarded by Fiara and Valluta.
Defeat Enakhra.
Protect from Magic is preferred.
She will sometimes start to steal from your health. Hide behind any obstacle to stop her. It may help to disable auto-retaliate since her ranged attacks can unintentionally draw you out of hiding.
The lower your health, the less she heals. Low-healing food like cakes, pizzas, or a bunyip can keep you alive for a long time.
She will occasionally stun you. Activating Freedom will free you.
Enter the exit.
Talk to Cres in the center.
Talk to Juna in the east.
Defend Juna from the spiritual enemies for 2 minutes.
Jump over a barrier to safety near Juna and simply repair barriers as they slowly become half-broken.
Alternatively, kill the enemies, which are fairly weak. Attacks that hit multiple enemies simultaneously are effective, such as Ancient Magicks.
Talk to Azzanadra after the skippable cutscene. (~•~)
Note: The next area does not require combat, but contains environmental hazards that can easily lead to unsafe death, and does not allow teleporting out. You may wish to bank now.

substeps.text: Teleport out to bank all gear and items; bring high-healing food. Fireballs do 20% of your max life points rapidly while running under them. Do not bring life points boosting gear as it will be harder to out-eat them.
Return via the Ardougne lodestone and run east to the entrance of the chamber.

steps.text: Enter the shattered wall.
Run down the path, avoiding the boulders and flames. If you get trapped between ice spikes, click them to break free.
After the skippable cutscene, walk east down to the pedestal in front of Guthix. He will teleport you.
Walk between the islands, talking to Guthix along the way. (~)
On your return, talk to one of the guardians. (~•~)
After a skippable cutscene, Saradomin will appear in front of you. Talk to him. (~•~)
Talk to Juna (10 free inventory slots are required).
Quest complete!

items: 3 ancient lamps granting 100,000 experience in three different skills at or above level 75 (you may destroy them and get them back from the High Druid)
3 static lamps granting 50,000 Combat experience each in any combat skill at or above level 65 (you may destroy them and get them back from the High Druid)
Glossy lamp granting 110,000 Slayer experience, requiring 70 (if you do not have 70 , you can destroy it and get it back from the High Druid)
Pale lamp granting 250,000 Prayer experience, requiring 80 (if you do not have 80 , you can destroy it and get it back from the High Druid)
4 new ultimate combat abilities Death's Swiftness (Ranged)

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: The ability to 'pay respects' at the shrine near where Guthix died, to receive 100,000 Prayer experience. Doing so requires level 90 .

The ability to light the five torches around the shrine, yielding 10,000 experience each, for a total of 50,000 Firemaking experience. Doing so requires 74 . The fifth torch is located on the platform below the other four torches. This experience is not affected by experience boosting items like the flame gloves and the ring of fire.
Offering 100 Chronicle fragments at the shrine will unlock the [Name] of Guthix title.

Certain additional rewards are available if additional quests are completed: Ritual of the Mahjarrat, The Firemaker's Curse, The Branches of Darkmeyer, The Void Stares Back, and The Chosen Commander: The Sixth-Age circuit, given to players by the Guthixian High Druid
[Name], the World Guardian title, which can be obtained by talking to the Guthixian High Druid.
Access to automaton area and automatons as a Slayer assignment (also requiring 67 ).

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Bird of Prey (When Zilyana, Kree and K'ril arrive)
Boulder and Brighter (When beginning the large puzzle)
Chamber of Guthix (In the central chamber)
Guthix's Warning (During the cutscene with Sliske in the Shadow Realm)
Invaders Must Die I (When Graardor arrives)
Invaders Must Die II (When Zemouregal arrives)
Invaders Must Die III (When K'ril arrives for the second time)
Memories of Guthix (In Guthix's memories of his homeworld)

steps.text: Talk to Effigy at the Tower of Life near fairy ring code DJP. (1•✓)
Talk to Bonafido, the builder lying down north of the door to the tower.
Talk to 'Black-eye'. (3•1•2)
Talk to 'The Guns' and give him the beer.
Talk to 'No fingers'.
Pickpocket the boots from him. It may take multiple attempts.
Search the plants south-east of the tower for the trousers.
Equip the costume and talk to Bonafido. (2•3•1•2)
All of the items you need for the quest will be found on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US] of the tower in crates. Refer to image for item crate locations.

sections.heading: Pressure machine
sections.needed: 4 coloured balls, 3 metal sheets, and 4 valve wheels

steps.text: Go to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US].
Fix the pressure machine.
Turn wheel 1 left until blocked.
Turn wheel 1 right until fixed.
Pull left lever.
Turn wheel 2 left until blocked.
Turn wheel 2 right until fixed.
Turn wheel 3 right until it reaches the hole.
Turn wheel 3 left until blocked.
Turn wheel 3 right until fixed.
Pull right lever.
Turn wheel 4 right until it reaches the hole.
Turn wheel 4 left until blocked.
Turn wheel 4 right until fixed.

sections.heading: Pipe machine
sections.needed: 6 rivets, 4 pipes, and 5 pipe rings

steps.text: Go to the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US].
Fix the pipe machine and move the pieces as shown in image.

sections.heading: The cage
sections.needed: 5 metal bars and 4 bottles of Binding fluid

steps.text: Go to the 3rd floor[UK]4th floor[US].
Fix the cage using the instructions below.
Front side

substeps.text: Vertical 2
Horizontal 3
Horizontal 2
Turn right

steps.text: Right side

substeps.text: Vertical 4
Vertical 2
Horizontal 2
Turn right

steps.text: Rear side

substeps.text: Horizontal 4
Vertical 2
Vertical 3
Turn right

steps.text: Left side

substeps.text: Horizontal 2
Horizontal 2
Vertical 2

steps.text: Return to the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US], exit the tower and talk to Effigy.
Go to the top of the tower to start a cutscene.
After the cutscene, talk to Effigy outside of the tower.
Return to the top of the tower and talk to Homunculus. (1•3•3•1•2•2•3)
Return to Effigy for a final cutscene.
Go down the trapdoor inside the tower.
