Talk to Homunculus.
Quest complete!

Tree Gnome Village.name: Tree Gnome Village
items_required: 6 normal logs (or a hatchet to get some)

steps.text: Head through the Gnome Maze and squeeze through the loose railing.
Talk to King Bolren. (2•✓)

sections.heading: The ballista
sections.needed: 6 normal Logs

steps.text: Talk to Commander Montai north of the maze. He is wearing red and will be wandering near the catapult to the east of where you are exited out of the maze. (1)

substeps.text: Talk to him again to give him six logs.

steps.text: Talk to Commander Montai again. (2)
Talk to the 3 tracker gnomes (map locations below).
West of Commander Montai, fire the ballista and choose coordinate until successful.

sections.heading: Orbs
sections.recommended: Combat gear and / or food to fight Khazard warlord (level 53)

steps.text: The building next to Tracker gnome 1, climb over the crumbled wall which is to the right of the locked door.
Climb up the ladder and search the chest for an orb of protection.
Climb back down the ladder and head out the door or climb back over the crumbled wall.
Run back towards the north-west entrance of the maze, click Elkoy to Follow him.
Talk to King Bolren. (1)
Head north-west of the battlefield and follow the Ardougne wall all the way west.
Kill the Khazard warlord.
Return back to the maze and follow Elkoy.
Talk to King Bolren.
Quest complete!

items: Use of the Tree Gnome Village spirit tree for transportation to other spirit trees

Troll Stronghold.name: Troll Stronghold
items_required: Climbing boots, rock climbing boots or 12 coins to buy the climbing boots.

sections.heading: Mountain climbing
sections.needed: 1 backpack space, climbing boots
sections.recommended: Fremennik round shield

steps.text: Talk to Commander Denulth in Burthorpe, east of the castle. (1•2•✓)

substeps.text: If Denulth tells you that the ambush is still being planned, try asking him about the White Knights first.

steps.text: If you don't own climbing boots, buy them from Freda. (3•1)
Enter Sabbot's cave from Death Plateau and cross all the obstacles to reach the exit of the tunnel (recommended for low Defence and Constitution levels).

substeps.text: Alternatively, take the shortcut by running through the Death Plateau on the surface, clockwise around it, and climbing the rocks to the northwest, then climb the cliffside while wearing climbing boots. Beware of level 67 thrower trolls.

steps.text: Exit the cavern, climb the rocks to the immediate west of the exit and follow the path east over the rocks until you reach the arena entrance.

sections.heading: Dad
sections.needed: Combat equipment

steps.text: Open the arena entrance and attempt to leave through the northern entrance.
Defeat Dad after he attempts to attack you. You may choose to kill him or spare him.

substeps.text: An easy way to kill Dad safely is to bring him over to the northern entrance or down by the southern rocks and safespot him.

sections.heading: Advancing towards the stronghold
sections.recommended: Food, Fremennik round shield

steps.text: Exit through the north arena entrance.
Follow the path north-west, go through the cave to the north and go outside.
Continue the path to the stronghold to the north and west; deal with thrower trolls via agility shortcuts, running counter-clockwise past them, Protect from Ranged, Dive, or a Fremennik round shield.
Look for a dungeon on your minimap northeast of the Troll Stronghold, and enter the cave entrance.

sections.heading: Prison break
sections.needed: Combat equipment, 3 backpack spaces

steps.text: Run south, go through the open wooden door, then continue north.
Kill a troll general and take the prison key. Safespot with magic, ranged, or necromancy behind the counter.
Head back towards the entrance, past the door and go down the stone staircase to the north.
Unlock the Prison Door to the immediate east and head down the stone staircase.
Open the exit to the south and enter the secret entrance.
Pickpocket (or kill) Twig and Berry.
Take the cell keys and unlock the two jail cells to free the prisoners.
Talk to Dunstan, the blacksmith in north-eastern Burthorpe.
Quest complete!

items: Two mysterious lamps that give 10,000 experience in any skill level 30 or above.
Access to Trollheim and the Troll Stronghold
Access to God Wars Dungeon with the requirement of 60 Agility or 60 Strength.

Twilight of the Gods.name: Twilight of the Gods
items_required: At least three free spaces in backpack

steps.text: Talk to Sir Cadian outside of the surface entrance to Senntisten. (✓)

substeps.text: To get there, you may use the Archaeology journal teleport and run north.

steps.text: Enter the nearby ancient door. (1)

substeps.text: Do not use the pontifex ring's Senntisten teleport as it will exit the instance.

steps.text: Talk to Naressa or Gregorovic in the house near the southwest corner of Senntisten and agree to meet them in the asylum. (~•1)
Talk to Naressa or Gregorovic once inside.
Talk to them a second time and pull the crane lever under the desk, not the lever on the wall.
Head up the stairs.
Search the drawer (not the chest of drawers) near the filing cabinet for a chain of keys.

substeps.text: If you cannot find the keys, head downstairs and flip the lever again (see image). If you still cannot find the keys, search the crate, then the bookcase upstairs and the drawer near the filing cabinet should be interactable.

steps.text: Search the notes on the ground to the east for key instructions then read it.
Head downstairs and open the gate (6)
Operate the asylum elevator.
Talk to Naressa and Gregorovic.
Head east into the next room and talk to one of the abyssal savages, then talk to Yk'Lagor, Cyrillus or Dahaka. (~)

sections.heading: Curing the demons
notes: If you teleport out at any time, you will have to re-enter from the surface entrance north of the Varrock Dig Site.

steps.text: Find Rowena (little girl ghost) starting at the south-east.
Follow her through the dungeon and collect the following items from the area.

substeps.text: Syringe from the crate of syringes in the incinerator room (south).
Infernal ashes from the spiky chair several rooms later (west). It is in small rectangular room with a single abyssal savage.
Vial from the crate of vials in the nothernmost room.

steps.text: Talk to Senecianus (appearing as Rowena) in the north-westernmost room to obtain a Break Curse scroll.
Create the cure:

substeps.text: Use the syringe on Senecianus to obtain a Syringe of Chthonian blood.
Fill the vial using the sink in the southwestern operating room to obtain a Vial of vile water. (1)
Right-click to use the infernal ashes on the vial to obtain Experimental potion 6.
Use the blood syringe on the incomplete potion to obtain a SIPD cure.

steps.text: Return to the large northeasternmost room and talk to Yk'Lagor. (1)
Talk to Yk'Lagor again. (~)
Talk to Saradomin on his throne in the White Knights' Castle in Falador. (1)
Talk to Saradomin again.
Talk to him a third time.

substeps.text: After finishing the last dialogue, your quest journal should mention "The White Knights in the Jolly Boar Inn" as the current step.

steps.text: Talk to the four white knights at the Jolly Boar Inn.

substeps.text: Sir Cull
Sir Berus
Sir Dated
Sir Plus

steps.text: Just west of the inn, descend the lift to enter the Infernal Source Dig Site. (1)
Talk to Blythe. (1•3•2)
Wear the cultist attire and climb down the secret passage to the north.
Pickpocket cultists until you obtain a cast iron key (pickpocketing the same one works).
Collect information about the cult:

substeps.text: Head north and talk to Wilona. (1•2•2•3)
Talk to Audrey (near the east pillar).
Talk to Ridley (in the east hallway).
Talk to Edda (in the southeast room).
Search the crate against the southern wall for spare cultist robes.
Talk to Tyne in the jail cell west.

steps.text: Return and talk to Saradomin. (1)
Talk to Saradomin again.
Talk to him a third time. (~•1•2•3)

substeps.text: After finishing the last dialogue, your quest journal should mention "re-establishing the Edicts of Guthix" as the current step.

steps.text: Go downstairs and talk to Adrasteia in the room to the west.

substeps.text: If she is not there, you may lobby and log back in.

steps.text: Talk to the Tree of Balance south-west of the Archaeology Campus. (1)
Talk to any of the guardians of Guthix for a cutscene.
Return and talk to Saradomin to obtain an Energy scanner.
Scan with the energy scanner, then go to the Memorial to Guthix

substeps.text: You can teleport directly to the Memorial using either Sixth-Age circuit or by using memory strand from the currency pouch

steps.text: Stand in front of the pool and talk to the Archivist if he is visible near the pool.
Scan with the energy scanner, then go to the gleaming wisp divination site south-east of the Karamja lodestone and interact with the green mystical wisp.

substeps.text: You can use the elder divination outfit for a direct teleport to the gleaming wisp colony, or Karamja gloves 3 or higher to teleport nearby to the Shilo Village mine.

steps.text: Talk to the confused automaton and complete all the dialogue.
Exit the cache and scan with the energy scanner, then talk to Merethiel at the Lost Grove (1•1)

substeps.text: You can use the Boss portal to Solak, fairy ring BJS if repaired (Take 5 Bittercap mushroom to repair it if you have not) and then interact with the magical mushrooms, the elder divination outfit to the incandescent wisp colony, or BKP and then run west to the standstone to get to the Lost Grove.

steps.text: Talk to the Guardians of Guthix once inside.
Talk to Isaura at the Black Knights' Base (northeastern corner of the base, next to the kitchen) in the Taverley Dungeon (1)

substeps.text: You can quickly get to her using the Archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit teleport to Collectors, then Isaura. (0→4)

steps.text: Return to The Lost Grove, then talk to Merethiel. (1•1)
Speak to Juna once inside.
Place effigy on the stone circle in the middle of the arena.
Harvest from the energy spring until you have 52 Guthixian energy.
Make all of the letters at the offering cradle (the large orb in the middle of the area).
Collect four stone circle building kits from the material cart slightly north-east of Juna and construct four empty stone circles starting from the west.
The spelling of 3 words is required for each of the 3 rituals (9 total).

substeps.text: For each ritual phase, the order of words is random per player.
To spell words, add a rune (letter) on each of the stone circles you've just constructed.
Words are spelled in clockwise orientation on the stone circles along the perimeter of the arena.
To attempt the word you spelled, place effigy on stone circle, followed by "start ritual".
Each successful ritual phase will yield the chat message: Ritual #: #/3 words completed.

steps.text: In the first ritual, the words are; in no certain order:

substeps.text: H A L T
W A R D
G O D S

steps.text: Talk to Juna.
Collect from the material cart again and build the 5th stone circle.
In the second ritual, the words are; in no certain order:

substeps.text: L E A V E
A N I M A
A E G I S

steps.text: Talk to Juna.
Collect from the material cart again and build the 6th stone circle.
In the third ritual, the words are; in no certain order:

substeps.text: B A N I S H
S H I E L D
D I V I N E

steps.text: Talk to Juna.
Return to Saradomin's throne at the White Knights' Castle at Falador (1)
Talk to Adrasteia again.
Go to the Empyrean Citadel (Adrasteia offers to teleport you). (1)

substeps.text: Alternatively use the invitation box. (1•1)

steps.text: Talk to the gods.
Interact with the fake quest completion certificate and talk to the voices in your head.
Quest Complete!

items: 5 Chaos die reroll tokens and the ability to use them.
10% damage reduction in the Zamorak: Lord of Chaos encounter

Underground Pass.name: Underground Pass
items_required: A few bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows
Enough backpack space to hold all your armour and at least six spaces for items received during the quest

steps.text: Go to the upper floor of Ardougne Castle in East Ardougne.
Talk to King Lathas. (✓)

sections.heading: Getting in and across the bridge
sections.needed: a shortbow, some arrows, 1-2 ropes
sections.recommended: Combat gear and food, and a plank

steps.text: Talk to Koftik in the western most part of West Ardougne. (1)
Enter the cave entrance and go on either the north or south passages with rockslides to bypass the middle swamp.
Talk to Koftik for a damp cloth. Use it on an arrow and then light the arrow.
Standing around the bend to the north, equip your bow and the lit arrow. Fire at the guide rope attached to the bridge.
You may pick up the plank for passing through some traps further in the cave, located just after the bridge to the north.
Continue through the cave to the south-east until you reach a gap north of the rope swing.
Use a rope on the old spike near the northern edge of the gap on your side.

substeps.text: If you fail the obstacle, you can climb out of the pit via the pile of rocks on the north western wall past some rockslides.

steps.text: Continue through the cave over the two rockslides until you reach a large grid (5x5) next to Koftik.
Find your path across the grid (keep a record for Regicide quest); you will fall through some of the tiles.
Pull the lever to the south at the end to continue.

sections.heading: Lights in the night
sections.needed: 4 free backpack space

steps.text: Run past the zombie camp; search the odd markings/traps along the walls to disarm them, or simply run past taking damage.
Reach a chaos altar, take the north path using a plank on the flat rocks, take the orb of light, return to the altar.
Take the north-west path towards the ogres, take the orb, return to the altar.
Take the middle west path using the plank as before, take the orb.
Take the final path; search the flat rock underneath the orb to disarm the trap first, then take the orb.
Return to the zombie camp (disarming traps again).
Use the 4 orbs on the furnace.
Return to the altar.
Climb down the well (you can search the two stacked crates for 2 salmon and 2 meat pies).
Follow the path until you reach the cages.
Pick the lock and dig the mud in the south-easternmost cell.
Walk west and cross the ledge, reaching the eastern side of the wooden bridge maze.

substeps.text: With level 50 Thieving, take the shortcut through the cages avoiding the bubbles. Otherwise cross the wooden bridge maze (may fall and retry).

steps.text: Head south and enter the obstacle pipe.
Search the unicorn cage to find a piece of railing.
Use the railing on the boulder south of the unicorn.
Search the smashed cage to get a unicorn horn.
Pass through the tunnel north of the cage, until you reach 3 paladins.

substeps.text: If low on health, talk to Sir Jerro for free food and potions (needs 7 backpack space).

steps.text: Kill them and take their badges (3 backpack space).
Continue forward using your plank on the flat rocks, until you see a well.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Open the door.

sections.heading: Meeting the dwarves
sections.needed: 6 free backpack space

steps.text: Reach the dwarf camp in the cavern below (via south-east corner stairs, north-west corner stairs, or by failing a bridge jump).
Koftik will appear with some brief dialogue.
Go to the dwarf camp in the cavern's south-western corner.
Talk to Niloof the dwarf.
Go back up the stairs to the east.
Cross the wooden bridges to pick up the witch's cat, wandering near her house (south-eastern-most platform).
Use the cat on the door to the witch's house.
Open the door to the house.
Search the chest in her house for a few items and the History of Iban book.
Kill Doomion, Othainian, and Holthion west of the witch and take their amulets.
Open and search the chest north of the middle demon.
Pour Iban's shadow on the doll of Iban.
Return downstairs and talk to Klank the dwarf, taking his gauntlets.
Take the bucket in the large house; use it on the barrel in the smaller house to receive a dwarf brew.
Run east to a tomb in the south-east corner of the cave.
Use the dwarf brew on the tomb.
Light the tomb to obtain Iban's ashes.
Use Iban's ashes on the doll of Iban.
Run to the furthest north-east corner, kill Kalrag the spider.

substeps.text: IMPORTANT: after killing Kalrag, the blessed spiders attack with range - enable Deflect/Protect from Ranged and run away.

steps.text: Go to the north-western corner and ascend the stairs to the half-soulless area.
Walk south to the third walkway and cross the bridge.
Walk north to the first cage, then east to the next cage.
Walk north then west to the cage containing Iban's dove.
Equip Klank's gauntlets to prevent taking damage.
Search the cage to find Iban's dove.
Use Iban's dove on the doll of Iban.

sections.heading: Ultimate demise
sections.needed: enough backpack space to unequip gear plus 3 extra spaces

steps.text: Head back towards the most recent bridge you crossed, but instead follow the bridge east then south-east towards the Disciple of Iban.
Kill a Disciple of Iban, grab both the Zamorak robe top and Zamorak robe bottom.
Un-equip everything and equip the robes.

substeps.text: Keep 3 free backpack spaces to avoid missing 15 death runes and 30 fire runes.

steps.text: Jump the bridge south and continue south-west to the large door.
Open the door to enter Iban's temple and use the doll on the well.
Talk to Koftik at the west end of the cave.
Return to King Lathas in Ardougne.
Quest complete!

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Underground Pass (If you fall into the grid trap)
Expecting (If you fall into the swamp bubble)

steps.text: Talk to Violet found on the southern tip of White Wolf Mountain. (✓)
Enter the Land of Snow portal.
Run north towards Violet and a cutscene will ensue.

Dodge snowballs and run up the hill. You can run straight up the far east side (or far west side) of the hill and avoid getting hit by any snowballs. If you cannot make it and get hit enough, eventually, it will ask if you want to make it easier.
Talk to Violet.
Knock on the door. (3•1)
Talk to Trevor or Betty. (1•1)
Talk to Violet in the room to the north.
Violet requests an object based on the starting letter five times. Search various objects around the room and bring her items that begin with the letter she requested.
Talk to Trevor or Betty.
Exit the building. (1)
Investigate the frozen bucket for an empty bucket.
Investigate a maple tree two times to receive maple logs.

substeps.text: Investigate the logs to make a spile. (1)

steps.text: Use the spile on the maple tree.
Use the empty bucket on the same maple tree to receive a bucket of syrup.
Walk north, and check four leaning trees along the path.
Talk to Trevor to receive the firefly jar. (1)

Shake multiple bushes and catch 10 fireflies. They may be difficult to see if playing on low graphics. To make this easier, right click the globe near your mini-map to toggle high contrast mode. This will make the fireflies stand out easier.
Talk to Violet.
Talk to Violet.
Take icy snow from behind Violet. (~•~•~•~•~)
Click on the headless golems (spam clicking works) and put all 15 heads on.
Talk to Violet.
Collect 75 snowballs at the pile of snow to the south.
Continually search the abandoned crate for 3 carrots, 3 top hats, 21 coal.
Prune a tree to the west three times for 6 branches.
Build all melted snowmen (24 Construction XP), then talk to Violet after each snowman.
Walk north.
Reach into the icy water on the south-east shore to obtain a barrel.
Talk to Violet.
Navigate the ice maze while pushing Violet as shown in the diagram. You may move diagonally.

substeps.text: The controls require precision, best to rotate your camera to give a birds eye view (top down) when trying to move diagonal. It may be helpful to think of a 3x3 square when moving diagonally, with the player character in the centre.

steps.text: Talk to Violet.
Investigate:

substeps.text: The ice in the small pond to the north-east
The fire to the north
The rotten barrel to the east of the sled (south-east of Violet)
The crate just to the west of the sled

steps.text: Chop down the Yeti village sign, a few steps south of the crate.
Investigate the open space, just east, multiple times while adding the items each time.
Talk to Violet. You can choose any name for the sled.
Quest complete!

items: Lamp of joy – Grants 1,000 experience. (500 if an elite skill, e.g. Invention, is selected) (currently presents 1,000 experience in Invention)
Lamp of wonder – Grants 1,000 experience. (500 if an elite skill, e.g. Invention, is selected)
Lamp of laughter – Grants 1,000 experience. (500 if an elite skill, e.g. Invention, is selected)

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Members can obtain a total of 90,000 experience from thawing all four frozen snow implings hidden around Yeti Town. 2,000 experience from the crates near the house on the south-east side of town (requires level 20 in all non-elite skills).
8,000 experience from the south well (requires level 40 in all non-elite skills).
30,000 experience from a barrel on the western docks (requires level 60 in all non-elite skills).
50,000 experience from the cart near the bonfire in the centre of town (requires level 80 in all non-elite skills).

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: The Best is Yeti to Come

steps.text: Talk to the Bartender at the Rusty Anchor tavern in Port Sarim. (1•✓)
Drink the dragonfire mead.
After the cutscene, go downstairs via the door on the east side of the room.
Talk to the Bartender. (1)
Talk to 'Shady' Sullivan by the entrance of the tavern.
Talk to Captain Lorris on the Port Sarim docks just east of the lodestone. (1)
Talk to Old Man Jocko on the dock. (1)
Head east towards the city of Wendlewick, then speak to Adam in the building north of the well in the centre of the village. (2)
Head south and then south-east towards the Shrine of Inanna and talk to Shrine Tender Joanna.
Pray at the Altar of Inanna west of the summoning obelisk.
Talk to Shrine Tender Joanna.
Return and talk to Adam.

sections.heading: Building along the coast
sections.needed: 10 backpack spaces

steps.text: Talk to Zeke in the building east of the well.
Head west to the beach and kill 10 juvenile boulder crab. Pick up the limestone they drop.

substeps.text: You must kill the crabs, but you can bring your own limestone bricks to Zeke.

steps.text: Return to Zeke.

substeps.text: If you do not have level 12 Crafting, now it is time to give the limestone to Adam so that he can turn those limestone into bricks.
If you want to convert them yourself and have the skill to do it, you may do so now.

steps.text: Run south across the first bridge, through the lighthouse and out the back door. From the outside go up the stairs.
Talk to Esther.
Go back downstairs, walk north, and build at the Lodestone hotspot just across the river.
Quest complete!

Waterfall Quest.name: Waterfall Quest
items_required: 1 rope (can be obtained during quest if you've built a rope rack)

steps.text: Talk to Almera inside her house, south of the Barbarian Outpost. (✓)
Board the raft to the west.
Talk to Hudon north of where you land.

substeps.text: If you do not talk to Hudon you will not be able to find the Book on Baxtorian later.

steps.text: Click swim on the river to the south to end up back on shore.
Once back on shore, head north-west to the house south of Almera's house, and climb the staircase.
Search the southern bookcase on the east wall to find the Book on Baxtorian.
Read the book.
Head to the Tree Gnome Village, north-west of Yanille.
Follow the path through the maze towards the dungeon marked on the map (or follow Elkoy if Tree Gnome Village is partially complete).
Go east and enter the dungeon.
Inside, go to the eastern room.
Search the south-east stack of crates (different colour) to find a key (must have read the book to find it).
Head to the westernmost room and use the key on the gate to unlock it.
Enter and speak to Golrie to find Glarial's pebble.
Bank everything except Glarial's pebble and your rope (no combat items allowed in the tomb).

substeps.text: You may drop 6 air, 6 water and 6 earth runes outside the tomb to retrieve on exit, skipping a bank trip.

steps.text: Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and go north-west of the Fishing Guild to find Glarial's tombstone.
Use Glarial's pebble on the tombstone.
Go west and search the chest to obtain Glarial's amulet.
Go south and search Glarial's Tomb to obtain Glarial's urn.
Head north-east back up the ladder you came down.

sections.heading: Baxtorian Treasures
sections.needed: 6 air runes, 6 water runes, 6 earth runes, a rope, Glarial's urn, and Glarial's amulet

steps.text: Go north-west to the quest start point (Almera's house) and board the raft once more.
Use your rope on the rock situated on the bank to the south.
Use your rope on the dead tree next to you.
With Glarial's amulet in your inventory, enter the cave door north.
Go north-east, open the door, and search the light-coloured crates on the northern wall for another key.
Return to the centre room and go down the western passage, past the fire giants, through the doors north.
Use the key on the last door.

Follow these three steps carefully or you will be washed downstream: use an air, water, and earth rune on each of the six pillars; use Glarial's amulet on the western statue of Glarial; use Glarial's urn on the Chalice of Eternity in the centre.
Quest complete!

items: Access to the Waterfall Dungeon for combat training. You must have Glarial's amulet in your inventory to re-enter the dungeon – attempting to enter without the amulet will result in the tunnel flooding with water, you getting washed into the river, ending up on the bank and taking some damage.

While Guthix Sleeps.name: While Guthix Sleeps
items_required: Three air runes, an earth rune, a fire rune, a water rune, a mind rune, a law rune, and a death rune
Any logs (except acadia or eternal magic)
A charcoal and a papyrus (both may easily be obtained during the quest)
Mort myre fungus (can be obtained during the quest)
Equipment to enter the Black Knights' Fortress
Runes to cast the NPC Contact spell four times (8 air runes, 4 astral runes, and 4 cosmic runes)
Runes for any charge orb spell (30 runes of a chosen element and three cosmic runes)
Equipment for two different attack styles or Necromancy equipment
Either a snapdragon seed or 100 coins to buy one from Thaerisk

sections.heading: Starting out
sections.recommended: Varrock teleport, any boosts you wish to use to start the quest, and equipment to kill two Assassins

steps.text: Talk to Radimus Erkle in the Legends' Guild (fairy ring BLR). (4•✓)
In Taverley, talk to Ivy Sophista in the house west of the summoning obelisk. (1•4)
Go upstairs and talk to Thaerisk Cemphier. Kill both assassins that appear.
Talk to Thaerisk again. (1•2•2•3•4)
Talk to Reldo in Varrock Palace library and "Talk about Lucien and Movario"

substeps.text: If Desperate Times is completed, you need to choose one more chat option before proceed the aforementioned quest dialogue. (2)

sections.heading: Finding Movario's base
sections.needed: Logs of any type, ring of charos (a) or 5,000 coins, one of each of the following runes: air, mind, water, earth, fire (bring more in case of failure), mort myre fungus (can be obtained during quest), at least 6 free backpack spaces, but more is preferable
sections.recommended: Watchtower Teleport, Ardougne Teleport (Ardougne cloak preferably)

steps.text: Talk to the Hunting expert in Feldip Hunter area and ask about tracking down a person.
Go west and trap pit (which builds a pitfall trap) at the square trap pit (uses one set of logs), then use your mort myre fungus on the built trap.
Dismantle the collapsed trap to obtain an unconscious broav.
Talk to the Hunting expert again about tracking a person.

Head to the west of Fight Arena and into the laundry room two houses north of the pub. (Kandarin monastery Teleport then run south, or Watchtower Teleport and run north, or use the Fairy ring code DJP and run south are quick ways to get there.)
With your ring of charos (a) equipped, talk to the Khazard launderer to obtain dirty laundry. (2•2)

substeps.text: If you brought coins instead, take them out of your coin pouch and use them on the launderer. (2•1)

steps.text: Go to the Khazard Battleground north-west (north of Tree Gnome Village and across the bridges).
Climb-over the crumbled wall inside the north-westernmost building.
Drop your Broav in the room with the broken table then use the dirty laundry on him.
Search the broken table to reveal a trapdoor, then go down.
Pick-up your Broav.
Go through the door, and follow the path to the north, then climb-down the stairs.
Search the old battered door and find the correct rune to use on it. After you enter the correct rune, you'll hear a click.
Search the door again (boost your Thieving level if needed), and you will find a trap to disarm. (1)
Go through the old battered door.
notes: "Prohibited" is the key indicating which rune to use. In the game, only one letter will be affected.

steps.text: Search the painting on the east wall (1)
Choose the Search option on the bookcases until you receive the chat response CLICK!.
Follow the wire that faintly glows to the next bookshelf. (for those with colourblindness, zoom the camera in to see the wire slightly pulsate)

substeps.text: Search that bookshelf.
Repeat, searching each bookshelf until the electricity on the gate disappears.

steps.text: Open the gate and search the spiral staircase to disarm the trap, then climb-up.
Search the desk to obtain Movario's notes (volume 1)

substeps.text: Read the notes.

steps.text: Pick-up the waste-paper basket.

substeps.text: With Movario's notes in your backpack, search the basket.

steps.text: Search the bookcase to the west of the waste-paper basket.

substeps.text: Use the ruby key on the bookcase.
Climb-up the stairs just north of you.

steps.text: Search the bed.

substeps.text: Use the ruby key on the bed chest.
Search the bed chest to disarm the traps (1)
Use the ruby key on the chest. Open and search the chest to obtain a strange key loop, strange key teeth, and Movario's notes (volume 2). Read these notes too.

steps.text: Climb back down twice to the wire room and cross-over the broken wall, then search the drawers.

Look-at the thermometer. Note down the number it says. Check your current character's weight in your equipment interface. You must equalise both numbers. If you weigh more than the number: subtract the number from the thermometer from your character's weight to get the result number. For example: if the thermometer says 20 and you weigh 30 kg, you would need 10 kg. If you weigh less than the number: subtract your character's weight from the number from to get the result number.

substeps.text: Pick up your Broav if you haven't already, otherwise it will mess with the numbers.

steps.text: On the floor of this room is a Pile of weights. Take weights equalling the result number you got. If you have been following the guide, you will need to take two 2kg weights, as Movario's notes and the key parts weigh 4kg collectively. CAUTION: You will not be able to recover any items dropped in this room.

Climb back up the spiral staircase. If you weigh more than the number: use all the weights on the statue just north of you, then open the door just east. If you weigh less than the number: keep the weights in your inventory and open the door east of the statue.
Head east through the door and up the ladder to leave the hideout.

sections.heading: Catching Lucien's spy
sections.needed: Strange key loop, Strange key teeth, Movario's notes (volume 1) and Movario's notes (volume 2), equipment to kill two mercenary axemen and a mercenary mage

steps.text: Return to Thaerisk Cemphier in Taverley with the items obtained in Movario's base. (2•5)
Head to the building in McGrubor's Wood (Seers' Village lodestone or fairy ring ALS), and a cutscene will start. Kill all the mercenaries.
Search the dead mercenaries and talk to the wounded Guardian of Armadyl.
Go upstairs in the Seers' Village pub and talk to Idria. (1•3)
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in the Falador Park. (1)
Go to the White Knights' Castle.
In the eastern room on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US], talk to Akrisae. (3•1)
At Draynor Village, use the teleorb on the shady stranger wearing white robes and near the shore. This may take several attempts.
Talk to Akrisae in the White Knight's Castle. Cutscene plays.
If you don't have a snapdragon seed for the next step, buy one from Thaerisk. (2•1)
Talk to Thaerisk to teleport to Port Sarim. (3)

sections.heading: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
sections.needed: Lantern lens, snapdragon seed, 20 coins, 6 air runes, 3 cosmic runes, 3 astral runes , lunar spellbook

steps.text: Talk to Betty in the Port Sarim magic shop for truth serum and pink dye. (1•1•1)
If the snapdragon seed isn't already on the counter, talk to her again until she places the seed on the counter.
Use the pink dye on your lantern lens.
Stand just inside the doorway, use the lens with the counter and take the enriched snapdragon seed by searching the counter.
If not already, switch to the Lunar spellbook.
Using the most western staircase in White Knight Castle, head to the top of the castle and plant the seed in the herb patch.
Go back downstairs and talk to Thaerisk on the ground floor of the eastern part of the castle. (1)
Cast NPC Contact to talk to the following people:

substeps.text: Turael (1)
Duradel (1)
Mazchna (1)

steps.text: Talk to Hazelmere upstairs in the hut east of Yanille near fairy ring CLS.

sections.heading: Questioning the spy
sections.needed: Truth serum, 1 astral rune, 1 cosmic rune, and 2 air runes

steps.text: Pick the enriched snapdragon (top of west tower at White Knights' Castle) and mix it into your truth serum for a super truth serum.
Head back to the room with Thaerisk and the others.
Open and search the drawers to find charcoal and papyrus.
Go into the cell and use the serum on the shady stranger. (~)
Talk to Idria (she is now in this same room).
Cast NPC Contact to talk to Cyrisus. (1)
Head to the Warriors' Guild and talk to the following:

substeps.text: Ghommal just outside
Harrallak Menarous in the main lobby (1)
Sloane upstairs (1)

steps.text: Return to the White Knights' Castle and speak to Idria, then Akrisae.

sections.heading: Into the Black Knights' Fortress
sections.needed: Unpowered orb, runes for any charge Orb spell (3 cosmics and 30 runes of any element or any elemental staff), items to enter Black Knights' Fortress (Skull of Remembrance, bronze med helm/iron chainbody, black armour set or Black Knight captain's armour), equipment for two combat styles or Necromancy (Necromancy recommended)
sections.recommended: Falador teleport, Food for fighting multiple enemies, Elite Black Knight armour from the Grand Exchange to save some time. Once you have a set of Elite Black Knight armour, you will need 9 free inventory slots to proceed. If you have purchased Elite Black Knight armour, you do not need combat gear, but some food is still advised. Bringing a summoning familiar with a different combat style will make the fights much easier

steps.text: WARNING, BEFORE KILLING ANY ELITE BLACK KNIGHTS DISABLE AOE SPELLS, If you are doing this on a ironman killing two at once will cause a duplicate piece to drop. The only way around this is farm elite black knights to get the piece you will be missing.
Switch back to the standard spellbook.
You will need 11 free inventory slots to proceed.

Equip your disguise and head inside Black Knights' Fortress with all the items above or use the skull of remembrance to teleport to the ritual chamber, and make your way down to the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US].
Climb down the ladder in the south-west corner.
Along the east wall, right-click search the floor tile. Cast your charge orb spell on the floor tile.
Climb-down the trapdoor.

Kill Elite Black Knights to obtain a helmet, platebody and platelegs if you don't have a set already. The three pieces of armour are guaranteed to drop until 3 pieces are received. Do not use multi-target abilities as killing two Elite Black Knights at once will cause them both to drop the same piece, with both counting toward the first 3 pieces received. Equip the full set to remove their aggression.
Head north by jumping across the broken bridge, go east, and climb up the wall.
Jump over the barricade and walk north-west until you reach a fork in the path, then head east.
Talk to Silif in the northmost cell. (1•2•3)
Go back west and enter the northern centre Solid black door.
Search all desks and wardrobes in the room for:

substeps.text: Another set of elite black armour
Full set of Dagon'hai robes
Restore potion (4) (Do not drink the restore potion) (4)
Strange teleorb
Lobster (Do not eat the lobster)
If you accidentally eat the lobster, any kind of cooked food will work as well.

steps.text: Right-click search the key rack on the northern wall (a few tiles east of the wardrobe) for a Cell key.
Enter Silif's cell. Use the piece of food on Silif, then the potion. (2)
Give Silif a set of elite black armour (dismiss your familiar if you have one).
Return to the northern room. Walk to the map board on the southern wall then talk to Silif.
Plant the teleorb on Dark Squall, who is located in the east of the room, then escape back to Falador.

sections.heading: Lucien's Army
sections.needed: Strange teleorb, Dagon'hai robe armour, one law rune, one death rune
sections.recommended: In this section, there is a brief encounter in the Wilderness, where it is possible to encounter danger from creatures and/or events. Therefore, carrying food and defensive armour is recommended. Teleport (preferably to Falador)

steps.text: Talk to Akrisae. (1•2•3)
Wear your Dagon'hai robes and enter the nearby jail cell.

Climb up the ladder in the north-eastern corner, stand in the stone circle in the middle of the room, and right-click activate the strange teleorb. (Note: Activation will fail if the required runes are in a pouch.)
Follow the north-eastern path towards the chapel and climb-up the ice wall. There is a stick in the ice wall to indicate where to climb.
Jump-to the ledge on the chapel into the Wilderness.
Walk east to activate a cutscene.
Return to Falador after the cutscene.
Talk to Idria.

substeps.text: If she won't talk about Movario and instead keeps saying to investigate Lucien's camp, then unfortunately the game glitched and you must go back and rewatch the cutscene. Remember to bring the strange teleorb, a law rune, and a death rune. A good indicator that the cutscene registered is to check for the "You have unlocked a new music track: The Evil Within" game message.

sections.heading: Into the chasm
sections.needed: Sapphire lantern, Dagon'hai robe armour, equipment for two combat styles (or Necromancy) and some food (You can go back to get these at a later step), prayer points to use the Bloom ability (a sickle and pouch are provided) OR two druid pouch charges (neither needed if you have an ouroboros pouch). You also need enough free inventory space to unequip anything in your main hand and off hand, plus 6 additional free inventory slots
sections.recommended: Games necklace, emergency teleport, energy potions, super restore potions for fighting the balance elemental

steps.text: Go to the Tears of Guthix cavern.
Equip your Dagon'hai robes and talk to Movario North. (3•1•3)
With a sapphire lantern lit, right-click travel into cavern with a light creature.
Search the northernmost skeleton for a silver sickle (b) and 6 druid pouch charges.

substeps.text: If you have an Ouroboros pouch or brought two druid pouch charges of your own, you can drop the silver sickle to save inventory space.

steps.text: Search the rocks (1)
Repeat on the north-west rock for the earth orb.
Repeat for the standing lit braziers for air and water orbs in the south-western and south-eastern corners.
Head further south to reach three skull cavities on the southern wall. Examine each recessed block and use the respective orb on the block.
Climb up the wall twice and use the water orb on the recessed block.
Jump down the same way you came up. For each of the three lower skulls, enter its nose cavity.

substeps.text: Dismiss any followers and empty both your main and off-hand slots before entering the cavities.

steps.text: Crawl along the tunnel in each cavity to its end. Examine the door there and insert the respective element key into the door lock. Crawl back through the tunnel and exit the skull.
Climb up the walls to the upper skull. Use the fire key on the skull's recessed block, then search the stone cube in front of the skull.
Climb-through the cave opening to enter the Guthixian temple.
You will now need at least two free backpack spaces, though more can make it quicker to proceed. Ensure that you have also deactivated any sign of the porter effects.
There are eight statues in this temple. Each, when examined, will reveal what type of potion must be "made" at that statue.

Use your druid pouches on the druid spirits. Each will drop required ingredients for the statues once - if these are lost (e.g. by dropping and letting them timeout), you will have to get replacements yourself. Grace of the elves will send items to the bank so unequip it or disable its porter functionality.
Do not let your druid pouch empty completely or it disappears! You need 3 open inventory slots to add 3 flowers into the druid pouch.

substeps.text: Use the Bloom spell on your silver sickle (b) while standing on or close to the dead vine to grow some vine flower to recharge your druid pouch.

steps.text: Use the herbs and the secondary ingredients on the various statues referencing the table below. Not all keywords will be on statues.

substeps.text: If you have an ouroboros pouch, you do not need to worry about the druid pouch losing charges. However, you must carry a druid pouch in the backpack to "use" it on the spirits, though it will never deplete.

If you need to refill your druid pouch, right-click bloom with your silver sickle near dead vines to get flowers. These can be used to refill the druid pouch. If you received a mort myre fungus from the druids, use it with the correct statue or drop it for a moment before filling the druid pouch else you will lose it!

steps.text: Use the dolmens you receive from the statues on the Stone Table in the middle of the temple. It will open the huge door in front of it.

sections.heading: Required ingredients for the statue
notes: An alternative to using druid spirit drops to solve this puzzle is to make a list of all potions that need to be made (either by simply looking at or Examine-ing each statue), and teleport out to obtain the needed ingredients based on the table below. You do not need to save the druid spirits to continue. Using a Herb bag can help in finishing it with one trip.

steps.text: Make whatever arrangements necessary to battle the level 117 Balance Elemental that can use all three combat styles, and lowers your combat stats (except for Necromancy). You can leave the area to get supplies, but always bring your lit sapphire lantern. Don't forget to bring at least two combat styles for the tormented demon fight, unless using Necromancy. The Balance Elemental drains combat stats during the fight, so be sure to bring at least one full super restore.
Proceed down the corridor and enter a large chamber.
Once ready, search the mysterious stone (1)
Search the mysterious stone again for a cutscene. Doing so boosts all your combat stats to level 255 except Prayer.
Continue dialogue with Movario (1•2•3•4)
Kill the two Tormented demons, switching between your two combat styles.
Talk to Idria to have her teleport you to Falador. (1)
Continue dialogue with Idria in Falador.
Quest complete!
Optional: after using of all four of Idria's 100,000 exp boosts, talk to her again to view the "Elsewhere..." epilogue.

items: 4 × 100,000 experience from Idria, in any skill that is at least 65.
Opportunity to loot Movario's base. 100 magic logs, 100 coal, 100 fire runes, and 100 death runes; all items are in their un-noted form.
A strange key teeth and a strange key loop

rewards.label: Music unlocked
items: Black of Knight (in the Black Knights' Fortress dungeon)
The Evil Within (in the cutscene where Lucien slays the heroes)
The Sound of Guthix (in the Guthixian temple)
Temple Desecrated (at the battle with the Balance Elemental near the Stone of Jas)

Within the Light.name: Within the Light
items_required: Two sets of mourner outfit (including the gas mask) – you will lose one set during the quest. The second set is easy to obtain during the quest.
To enter the death altar, you will also need:
A death talisman, death talisman staff, death tiara, omni-talisman, omni-talisman staff, omni-tiara or a properly fed wicked hood (a death talisman can be obtained during the quest)
These items can also be obtained during the quest, but it's possible you already have them in the bank. If so, you will need to bring them with you:
New key (may be stored on a steel key ring)

sections.heading: Trouble in the temple
sections.needed: Two sets of mourner outfit, new key, tarnished key, one backpack space

steps.text: Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya in the large building to the east. (✓)

substeps.text: To get to Lletya easily, use a crystal teleport seed, a Tirannwn quiver 1, or pass through the forest from Tirannwn lodestone.

steps.text: With your mourner gear equipped, enter the Mourner Headquarters in the north-east of West Ardougne and climb down the trapdoor.
If you need the keys, search the Head Mourner's desk in the basement's south-east room for the tarnished key and new key.
Enter the tunnels with the new key and run to the west to approach the Temple of Light.

Remove your gas mask and chant-to the blank teleport crystal in your backpack, whilst standing east of the first slave on the square directly between the north and south crates (picture for reference).
After the cutscene, return to the room next to the Head Mourner's office.
Talk to the gnome. (1•2)

substeps.text: Talk to Head Mourner if you want to honour your deal.

steps.text: Optionally for the second set of mourner outfit, you can kill a mourner nearby.
Return to Lletya.
Use a piece of mourner's outfit on Arianwyn.
Use the enchanted crystal on Arianwyn.
Bank for food to fend against shadows.
Talk to Arianwyn and accept the teleport. Dismiss your pet or familiar if you have any. (1•1)

substeps.text: Make sure to have a second set of mourner gear to hand in, if not done earlier, talk to him again once he is dressed.

sections.heading: The death altar
sections.needed: Crystal trinket, Death talisman

steps.text: Proceed to Thorgel in the temple. Do not teleport out of the room to the death altar until rotating the red beam back the way it started, or else the light door will be locked on return.

substeps.text: Go up the stairs to the west, up the stairs to the south, down the stairs in the centre, down again, and through the light door. Rotate the red beam west and go through another light door.
Do not use death altar teleport at this point unless you are absolutely certain the light beam is situated to let you out of the altar room.

steps.text: Talk to Thorgel near the death ruins. (1)
Talk to Arianwyn.
Investigate the energised pillar (east multi-coloured 4-beam pillar).
Talk to Arianwyn.
(Epilepsy warning about 2s duration) Use the crystal trinket on the energised pillar.
Talk to Arianwyn. (3)

substeps.text: Speak to Arianwyn again if you need a death talisman.

steps.text: Enter the death ruins.
Remember the following steps and do them quickly, or you'll have to try again:

substeps.text: Talk to Thorgel to become energised. (1•2)
He is south of the altar, and does not appear as a yellow dot on the minimap.
Exit the altar.
Pass the door of light.
Rotate the first pillar of light mirror by the stairs.
Go up the first stairs and immediately take the stairs to your left (north).
Run all the way east then south to the large crystal and investigate it. (If it speaks, you were not fast enough and have to go back to Thorgel.)
Run back down the stairs and touch the energised pillar. (If you don't get transported, you were not fast enough.)

sections.heading: Within the light itself
notes: For this puzzle the position of the receivers differ from player to player. Make sure you have time available to complete the following portion of the quest, as it is instanced; i.e. if you log out, return to lobby, or die, you will appear back at the death altar room.

steps.text: Once inside, search the dead slave on the ground.
Chop, then fix the eastern crystal tree with the blue light beam.

Solve the puzzles by reflecting the light beams to the opposite coloured receivers. You only have one receiver available at a time. For example: if the receiver in the end is yellow and since the opposite of yellow is blue (refer to the colour wheel), you need to direct the blue light beam to the yellow receiver. Due to how mirrors reflect, you often have to reroute, just keep trying different paths for the quickest solution. Refer to the in-depth guide if you cannot figure it out.

substeps.text: Redirect the blue light to the yellow receiver. This enables the red light.
Redirect a combination of red and blue light to the green receiver. This enables the green light.
Redirect a combination of blue and green light to the red receiver.
Redirect all three colours to the colourless receiver. When done all receivers on the western wall will be white. See below for example solutions.

steps.text: Exit using the ladder in the south-east (not the portal).

sections.heading: Sharpshooter
notes: If you die, your grave will appear behind the energised pillar. To get there, teleport to the death altar through the death rift in the Abyss or the death altar teleport if the door to the altar is unlocked. You will have to repeat the energisation process again to re-enter the platform puzzle area. Progress of the light puzzle will also be saved.

steps.text: Reach the platform with the ballista by jumping between the platform and trying to avoid the spikes in the floor.
Shoot it at the right time to hit the target.
Go back the way you came and jump to the ladder.
Go-through the large stone door on the west wall.
Search the Elf messenger.
Read the report.
Important: Before you leave the temple, rotate the mirror of the red beam back to the east, so that when you return to the Temple again, you will be able to access the Death Altar room.
Now is your last chance to inquire about saving the Gnome, if you intend to (it's completely optional).
Return to Arianwyn in Lletya and give him the report.
Quest complete!

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: The ability to add a choice of destination to your crystal teleport seeds. Talk to Eluned in Isafdar during or after the quest with a charged crystal teleport seed in inventory. The teleport can't be added if you are carrying more than one crystal teleport seed. The crystal teleport seed will acquire the ability to teleport to a safe area in front of the Temple of Light, in addition to its original Lletya teleport.

steps.text: Teleport to Seers' Village and run north-west to McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring ALS).
Enter the woods through the Loose railing.
Attempt to chop the tree 14 paces west and 6 paces south of the crate. (Slightly different colour, and near the quest marker on the minimap)
Read the mysterious clue scroll. (✓)
Talk to Reldo in the library of Varrock Palace.
Read the mysterious clue scroll again.
Stand in the room with Duke Horacio on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of Lumbridge Castle.
Remove all worn items, then perform the Cry and Panic emotes (in that order). You should see a cutscene if it works.

Go to Lumbridge cemetery. Using the mysterious clue's dig option, dig one square to the north of the largest tombstone along the southern fence. You will get a locked casket. You must complete the cutscene in order to continue.
Enter the POH portal in Rimmington to trigger a cutscene.
Teleport to Draynor, run into the Draynor Manor, and head into the first door to the west after entering the building.
Search the bookcase in the north-western part of the room to find the casket key.
Open the locked casket to obtain an old necklace.
Take a rope, and go back into McGrubor's Wood. Enter the railing shortcut and stand two squares south of the crate (which is south of the building).
Dig via the old necklace.
Inspect and then descend into the Mysterious Hole.
Follow the path to the end and investigate the coffin for a cutscene.
Talk to the double agent. (3•4)
Investigate the mantle to the east for a cutscene. (6•1)
Talk to Uri.
Quest complete!

items: Old necklace, which you can use to find jade trinkets around Gielinor if over level 50 Dungeoneering. Each piece obtained grants 10,000 Dungeoneering experience; if the exact location is known it is possible to obtain these without the Dungeoneering requirement. It is recommended to keep it since it is used in Desperate Times.

rewards.label: Additional rewards/activities
items: Search for necklace trinkets scattered around Gielinor. Combining them creates the necklace of Charos
